name: Seared Bison with Sweet Potato Wedges (800 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Just cranberry juice by r.w. knudsen
Grape zero calorie soda by zevia

steps: Take out your Ground Bison 20-30 min before cooking it, just to let it get to room temperature. Also preheat the oven to 380 if you're using the oven and not your air fryer
Slice your Russet Potatoes
Cut your Russet Potatoes with your Crinkle Cutter into evenly sized fries
Spray the fries with Avocado Oil spray, then sprinkle with Salt and Garlic Powder
Put your Bison in the oven on the 'Air Fry' setting, or in your Air Fryer for 8 minutes on 380-ish
With your Bison in the Air Fryer or Oven, heat up a pan with garlic Grass-Fed Butter, and cook your Asparagus for a couple minutes (don't let them get sloppy)

Once the 8 minutes is up for the Bison, take the Bison out and put your fries either in the oven on the 'Air Fry' Setting, or in your separate Air Fryer, and air fry them on 380-ish for 15-ish minutes
Pour 1 cup of Cranberry juice in a glass along with a can of Grape Zevia
Once the fries have a couple minutes to go, put some more Garlic Grass Fed Butter in the pan and put it on high heat. Then sear the Bison for 30-ish seconds each side
Put it all together, add salt and pepper to taste, and put some Truffle Ketchup next to your fries

name: Super Juicy Turkey Burgers (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Flame grilled fajitas rajas by pura vida
Soft pretzel burger buns by pretzilla

steps: Grill the patty in a pan
Scoop out some of the inner bread pieces from your buns, and then toast them
Add the Fajitas Rajas to the pan
Put it all together with the Alfalfa sprouts and condiments and enjoy

name: Nutella & Jelly Protein Sandwich (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Organic multigrain sprouted power by silver hills
Organic whole raw milk by organic pastures
Comlete spectrum animal protein complex powder by mark bell's steak shake
Peanut powder with cocoa by pb2

steps: Mix your Protein powder with your peanut powder first
Then add a little bit of milk and mix until you get a thick, pasty consistency
Err on the side of adding too little milk, you can always add more later. The goal is to keep this chocolate paste nice and thicky thick
Spread the chocolate paste on one loaf, jelly on the other, and voila

name: Blueberry Chocolate Chip Protein Waffles (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Power cakes flapjack & waffle mix by kodiak cakes
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Semi sweet baking chocolate chips by hu
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino
Luckyleaf lucky leaf blueberry pie filling by Knouse foods
Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms

steps: First mix your eggs in a bowl with the Kodiak Powder, Protein Powder, and a splash of water - make sure to keep a thick consistency
Then add the chocolate chips into this mix
Pour it all into your waffle maker
Once done, put some of that Blueberry Pie Filling over your waffles, along with some raspberries and cinnamon... and done

name: Chocolate Strawberry Cheesecake Ice Cream (350 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Super Life Monk Fruit Sweetener with Fiber
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Bear bites honey graham crackers by kodiak cakes
Spreadable cream cheese by Horizon organic
Milk nonfat skim or fat free

steps: Add the strawberries, milk, protein powder, sweetener, and salt into a small blender and blend till smooth
Then add to your Creami pint and freeze overnight
This is when you add your cream cheese to the freezer if you want those cream cheese chunks in your ice cream. You’ll chop it up into small pieces before adding during the mix-ins part of the recipe
Once frozen, add to your Creami holster and do the “Lite Ice Cream” function
After spinning, take your pint out and make a hole in the middle to add your 1.5 tbsp of cream cheese, 2 strawberries and 4 small honey graham crackers
Add back to the Creami, do the mix-in function, and add some optional cinnamon on top

name: Chocolate Blueberry Protein Ice Cream (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Organic 70% cacao salty dark chocolate by hu
All-bran bran buds cereals by kellogg's
Comlete spectrum animal protein complex powder by mark bell's steak shake
1% milkfat organic pasture-raised lowfat milk by horizon

steps: Mix everything except for the chocolate bar, banana, and cereal in a blender till smooth
Let it freeze for at least 6 hours
Then put it in the Creami under the 'Lite Ice Cream' function
Once done, take it out and make a hole in the middle
Stick your banana in there, then run a 'mix-in' function on your Creami
Once done, take it out and make another hole in the middle for your Bran cereal and cinnamon (you might have to take some bites out here if your tub is getting too full)
Run another mix-in function
Once done, put the ice cream in your fanciest dish and break up your chocolate bar so you can put it on top of your ice cream along with some raspberries and more cinnamon

name: Chipotle Honey Mustard Pretzel Chicken Tenders (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Pasture raised heirloom chicken breast by cook's venture
0% milkfat icelandic style skyr plain yogurt by siggi's
Real salt kosher salt by redmond

steps: Add the yoghurt, honey mustard, salt, pepper, and garlic powder all into a bowl
Combine the mix with the chicken tenders and put it all in a plastic bag (this will help the crushed pretzels stick to the chicken tenders later)
Let the chicken tenders marinate for 30-ish minutes
Crush the pretzels and coat your chicken with them
Spray the chicken pieces with some Avocado Oil Spray, and air fry them on 390-ish degrees for 10-ish minutes (ideally flipping them at the 6 minute mark)
While those are cooking, make your chipotle honey mustard by blending the yoghurt, honey mustard, chipotle peppers, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and water till smooth
Once the tenders are done, dip in the chipotle honey mustard

name: Chocolate Vanilla Oreo Ice Cream (667 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Super Life Monk Fruit Sweetener with Fiber
Black cocoa powder by king arthur baking company
Comlete spectrum animal protein complex powder by mark bell's steak shake
1% milkfat organic pasture-raised lowfat milk by horizon

steps: Add 2 cups of milk with the protein powder, cocoa powder, sweetener, chia seeds, and salt to a blender
Blend it and freeze it overnight in your Creami tub
Once frozen, add to your Creami holster and do the “Lite Ice Cream” function
Then make a hole in the middle for a banana with a dash of milk, run the mix-in function, and sprinkle some cinnamon on top before consuming it

name: Caramel Chocolate Cinnamon Yoghurt (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Organic greek plain non fat yogurt by kirkland signature
Dark chocolate cocoa almonds by skinny dipped
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino
Sea salt caramel poppables by yasso

steps: Mix your Yoghurt with the Protein Powder first
Then add the Holy Basil Seeds and mix
Then add everything else, boom boom boom
Enjoy

name: Loaded Sweet Potato Fries with Grass Fed Beef (800 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Cheese colby jack by boar's head
Grass fed angus ground beef 93% lean by the butcher's cut

steps: Cut your russet potato into crinkle cut fries
Add them to a bowl of cold ice water to soak for 15-ish minutes (this helps getting them crispy on the outside, yet soft on the inside)
Once done, drain the water and pat fries as dry with a towel
Preheat a stove top pan on 7/10 heat
Add fries to a bowl and spray with Avocado Oil Spray, then season with Sea Salt & Garlic Powder
Air fry your fries at 390-ish for 17-ish minutes (toss every 6-ish minutes to make sure they cook evenly)
With fries in the air fryer, add your Grass Fed Beef to the stove top pan
Break it up into crumbles and once you start to see some browning, season with sea salt, garlic powder and yellow mustard (the mustard helps keep the beef juicy)
Once the Grass Fed Beef is fully browned, add the Colby Jack Cheese and mix with the Beef
Put the fries on a plate, then add the cheesy Beef with some Alfalfa sprouts on top
Pour some Rao's Truffle Ketchup on top and you're done

name: Chocolate Yoghurt Rice Cakes (350 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Premium baking unsweetened cocoa 100% by ghirardelli
Lowfat chocolate milk by horizon organic
0% milkfat plain skyr yogurt by siggi's
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino

steps: Mix the Collagen Protein Powder with the Yoghurt and Holy Basil Seeds and mix until smooth
Pour some of the Chocolate Milk in a shallow bowl
Add a thin layer of your mixed Yoghurt to a 10 oz Ramekin - if your yoghurt is too thick you can add tiny amounts of water to thin
Then dunk a Rice Cake in the bowl with Chocolate Milk until it's soft and flexible
Add that Rice Cake on top of the layer of Yoghurt
Add another layer of Yoghurt on the chocolatey Rice Cake
Soak another Rice Cake and add on top of the Yoghurt
Then add Yoghurt for the very last time
Sprinkle Cocoa Powder and Cinnamon on top and you're done

name: Popcorn Chicken & Waffle Fries with Truffle Ketchup (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Pasteurized egg whites by horizon organic
Unbleached white all purpose flour by Bob's red mill
Organic russet potatoes by wild harvest
Real salt kosher salt by redmond

steps: Wash and dry your potatoes. Then use your crinkle cutter and cut into even size fries. Add to a big bowl.
Spray the fries with Avocado Oil spray and toss in the air fryer. Do this 2-3 times. Now season with sea salt and garlic powder and toss. Do this 2-3 times
Air fry on 375-ish degrees for 7-ish minutes
Cut your chicken tenders or chicken breast into bite size pieces. Add to a bowl and combine with the Egg Whites
Add your flour, baking powder and spice mix to a separate shallow bowl, then mix together
Now add your chicken to the spice mixture with one hand and coat them with the other. Or you can try using rubber gloves
Once fries are done, take them out and add your chicken. Try to have them not touch, and spray with Avocado Oil spray. Air fry on 375-ish for 11-ish minutes
Once your popcorn chicken is done, take out and add fries back in to the air fryer for another 7 minutes on 375

name: Cheesy Turkey Spinach Burrito (800 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Unsalted pure irish butter by kerrygold
Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
All purpose flour by bob's red mill
Micro kale mix by bright fresh

steps: First let's make your own tortillas. Let's make them super strong so they're clean and don't tear.
Add 2 cups of water to a pan and heat it up (not boiling, but hot)
Put 4 cups of All Purpose Flour + 1.5 tsp of salt in a bowl and mix
Then add 1 1/8 cup (or 1 cup and 1 tbsp) of steaming hot water to the mix, and mix
Mix until a rough dough starts to form
Once it's a dry, crackery mass, take it out on the counter and knead
Tear the dough ball into 2 and knead 2 balls until they're smooth in texture
If the dough is feeling too chalky, add some water to your hands and knead it in there
Roll both balls into 2 logs of dough and put in a plastic bag to dry for at least 10 minutes
Then cut each log into 3 equal-sized pieces (so you have 6 balls total) and roll those balls out with a rolling pin (keep the other balls covered while you're rolling one)
Get that doughy disc as thin as possible, and when it starts to bubble up as it's rolled you are approaching max thinness
Put a non-stick pan on high heat, then add your rolled out dough for 30-ish seconds before flipping
Once your tortilla has bubbly and brown spots, take it off and sandwich it between 2 plates to keep them moist (or 2 damp paper towels)
Then it's time to make the burritos - first brown and cook the Ground Turkey in pan with spices on medium-high heat
Add the cottage cheese and mix well
Add in the Spinach and cook down until everything starts to thicken
Once it's getting thicky thick, put the meat combo in a bowl or plate to cool and thicken
Lightly scramble all 18 eggs over medium-high heat until they're cooked and creamy
Then put them into a container to cool
Portion out the Cheesy Turkey Spinach into 6 of the Tortillas you previously made
Cut the Bell Peppers into small pieces and sprinkle them on top along with the Baby Kale - then wrap the Burritos
If you want to save Burritos for later, put them into a baking dish or tray and let them freeze overnight
If you then want to have one the next day, take it out of the freezer the night before and put in fridge to thaw - then air fry for a couple minutes to heat up

name: Bison & Bell Peppers (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: 90% lean 10% fat all natural premium ground bison by great range
Flame grilled fajitas rajas by pura vida
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Real salt kosher salt by redmond

steps: Take your Bison out of the fridge 30 min before cooking (to let it get to room temperature)
Spray a pan with some Avocado Oil spray
Literally just cook the Bison and Fajitas Rajas in a pan until they're done... it's that simple
Salt to taste, enjoy =)

name: Vanilla Berry Ice Cream (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: 1% milkfat organic pasture-raised lowfat milk by horizon
Comlete spectrum animal protein complex powder by mark bell's steak shake
Raw organic cacao nibs by ultimate superfoods
Smart bran with psyllium & oatbran by nature's path
Semi sweet baking chocolate chips by hu
Organic super smoothie by clovis farms

steps: Add 1.5 cups of milk with the berries, peanut butter, maca, and protein powder
Blend it and freeze it overnight in your Creami tub
Once frozen, add to your Creami holster and do the “Lite Ice Cream” function
Then make a hole in the middle for the banana, cacao nibs, chia seeds, cinnamon and run the mix-in function
Then take it out, make another hole in the middle to add the chocolate chips and a little splash of milk, and run one more mix-in function
Finally, add it to your bowl of Smart Bran, and put some Raspberries on top

name: Everything Bagel Rice Cakes (350 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Micro kale mix by bright fresh
Sriracha organic lime garlic & date blend by yellowbird
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms

steps: Spread about 0.5 tbsp of Cream Cheese to each rice cake and add the Everything Blend seasoning on top
Cook your 4 eggs however you want. If you add a cover on top of a pan and cook till the outsides whites are solid, but the yolk is still jiggly, then you'll have yourself some runny eggs
Add the cooked eggs to the rice cakes with some salt, pepper, Sriracha, and Micro Kale
Eat it right away (otherwise the cakes will become soggy)

name: Chocolate Air Fried Protein Brownie (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Super Life Monk Fruit Sweetener with Fiber
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Steak shake chocolate protein complex by mark bell's
Premium quality cocoa powder by eat well
Cereals regular rolled oats by bob's red mill

steps: Add all dry ingredients into a blender and blend until it forms a fine powder
Add the wet ingredients and blend till smooth
Spray two 10 oz ramekins with Avocado Oil spray and add a 'bottom layer' of batter evenly to both
Try adding 0.5 tbsp unsweetened Carob Chips in the middle of the bottom layer (to create a chocolate filling)
Then add the second layer of batter on top of the Carob Chips and add some more Carob Chips on top of all that to make it extra chocolatey
Put both ramekins in the air fryer at 275-ish for 20-ish minutes
Once done, let both ramekins sit for at least an hour before eating

name: Maple Buffalo Breakfast Burger (800 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Original buffalo sauce by yo mama's
Maple syrup sugar free by choc zero
Spreadable cream cheese by Horizon organic
Organic sprouted power plain bagels by silver hills
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Pasture-raised hard boiled eggs by vital farms
Colby jack cheese by organic creamery

steps: First make the Maple buffalo sauce by mixing both ingredients together
Grate the 3 hard boiled eggs, then add to a bowl and season with sea salt and black pepper
Form your 16oz Grass Fed Beef into 3 even sized patties. Flatten to form into as big of a patty as possible because it will shrink when cooking. Make each big enough to cover a whole bagel

Preheat pan on 7/10 heat. Add burger onto pan and salt the top side with sea salt. Cook on that side for 3-4 minutes until it starts to brown up the sides. Then flip and cook on the other side for another 2 minutes. Take off pan and repeat for all your other burgers. If you pan is big enough, do all 3 burgers at the same time

Now add all your burgers back to the pan and add your chicken broth to the pan. Add your cheese to the tops of each burger, and then a cover on top. This will keep the burgers juicy and melt the cheese
Toast your bagels and spread them with the cream cheese. Then first add your burger to the bottom bagel. Then your grated egg. Then the Maple Buffalo sauce. And then the top bagel

name: Apple with Protein Peanut Butter (500 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Grade a raw whole milk by organic pastures
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino

steps: Mix the PB2 powder in a bowl with the Kino Collagen and Holy Basil
Slowly add the Raw Milk while stirring
Keep stirring until it reaches your desired thickness
Chop up an apple and dip it in the protein mixture
Make sure you get all the proteins by scooping every last bit of mixture with each piece of apple

name: Chocolate Blueberry Ice Cream with Choc Chip Waffles (800 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms
Premium quality cocoa powder by eat well
Raw organic chocolate cacao nibs by sunfood
Fresh frozen wild blueberries by wyman's
Steak shake chocolate by mark bell's
1% milkfat organic pasture-raised lowfat milk by horizon
100% whole grains power cakes pancake & waffle mix buttermilk by kodiak

steps:
Start with putting your milk in the blender (preferably a Vitamix) so you can make sure it's 3 cups
2. Then add the frozen fruits
Then add the blueberries
And then follow this order in adding stuff - protein powder - maca - cacao nibs - cinnamon
Blend it all together, then pour into your 2 Creami tubs
Put your Creami tubs in the freezer and let them freeze overnight (min 8 hours)
Next day, turn on your Waffle Maker to preheat and spray it with some Avocado Oil spray
Then take out your Creami tubs, load them in the holster and go through the 'Lite Ice Cream' function once
While the Creami is spinning, mix 2 eggs manually with the pancake mix thoroughly - then add the carob chips with a little bit of water to make it more smooth
Add your pancake mix to your waffle maker, make sure all the carob chips go into the waffle maker
By now your Creami is done with the Lite Ice Cream spin, go get the holster and make room in the middle for half of a small banana
Stick that banana right in there and do the full 'Mix-In' function on the creami
Take out your waffle when it's ready, break it up into pieces, and lay them on top of the cereal
Lastly, scoop out your ice cream over the waffles in your bowl. The heat from the waffles will help melt your ice cream.

name: Frozen Protein Rice Cakes (350 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Two good good save meyer lemon greek yogurt by danone
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino
Super Life Monk Fruit Sweetener with Fiber
Snacks rice cakes brown plain unsalted
100% premium powdered peanut butter by naked pb

steps: For the Protein Frosting, add all your ingredients in a bowl and mix till smooth
For the Protein Peanut Butter layer, add all your dry ingredients into a bowl and mix to avoid clumping
Then slowly add the almond milk and mix till you have an icing-like consistency (usually 0.25 cup but this can vary)
Add 1/4th of the Protein Frosting to each rice cake
Then add 1/4th of the Protein Peanut Butter layer to each rice cake
Melt the carob chips and drizzle over the rice cakes
Sprinkle some salt over them, then add to the freezer for at least an hour

name: Chocolate Oatmeal Protein Cookies (350 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Super Life Monk Fruit Sweetener with Fiber
Premium baking unsweetened cocoa 100% by ghirardelli
Organic quick cooking rolled oats whole grain by bobs red mill
Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms
Steak shake chocolate by mark bell's

steps: Add a banana to a bowl and mash it
Then add all other ingredients except for the carob chips
Mix together till you get a cookie-dough-like consistency
Then mix in your chocolate chips and chia seeds
Put a third of your mixture on some parchment paper and form it into a cookie shape (make it thin)
Air fry your cookie for 5-ish minutes on 250-ish
You can either eat them warm right away, or let them cool and harden a little

name: High Protein Acai Bowl (667 Calories DRIVEN)

ingredients.name: Organic unsweetened acai berry smoothie by pitaya foods
Organic super smoothie by clovis farms
Comlete spectrum animal protein complex powder by mark bell's steak shake
Plus bar protein bar chocolate by greens plus

steps: First break your frozen Acai packets in small pieces before opening the actual packets
Then cut the packets open over your blender, and put them in the blender
Then add the Almond Butter
Then some more frozen Berries and Bananas (you can mix the fruits up here)
And then... add the protein powder first
And lastly, add the Cacao Nibs, Maca, Chia seeds, and Cinnamon
Blend blend blend, this might require some muscle (and a Vitamix is 100% preferred here)
Stop blending when it has a thick sorbet-like consistency
Pour it out over a nice layer of Bran Cereal
Then optionally, break up a Greens+ Protein Bar and put it in your acai bowl, along with some raspberries and extra cinnamon
Btw... you can also just make half of this for half the calories and protein (which is still a nice meal)

name: Gochujang Chicken Burgers (500 Calories)

ingredients.name: Pasture raised heirloom chicken breast by cook's venture
Gochujang korean chili paste vegan by sempio
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Organic uncured turkey bacon by wegmans
Organic light brown sugar by wholesome sweeteners
Micro kale mix by bright fresh

steps: First make the kimchi bacon jam by preheating a stovetop pan to 7/10 heat
Add the bacon, kimchi and brown sugar to the pan and cook until they caramelize (this will take about 8-10 minutes, after which you can set it to the side)
Mince your chicken breast and add to a bowl with the Panko, Garlic Powder, and Sea Salt. Then mix until combined.
Shape this mixture into 4 evenly sized balls.
Add a ball to your preheated pan on a 6/10 heat
Use a burger press to smash it down and cook with burger press on top for 4-ish minutes. Then flip.
Add a splash of chicken broth to the pan to help the insides of the burger reach at least a 165 degrees F temp
Repeat steps 5, 6, and 7 for all your burgers.
Then build the burger with a toasted Brioche Bun, Low Fat Mayo, Cucumber slices, Chicken Burger, Kimchi Bacon Jam, Micro Kale, and some more Low Fat Mayo

name: Turkey Pepper Hot Pockets (350 Calories)

ingredients.name: The big 16 sprouted power wheat bread by silver hills
All natural roasted turkey breast by boar's head
Cheese colby jack by boar's head
Whole fire roasted red peppers by del destino
Pasteurized egg whites by horizon organic
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Micro kale mix by bright fresh

steps: Roll out 2 slices of bread with a rolling pin, and make the bread as flat as you can
Brush the inside edges of one slice with egg-whites
Add the Cheese, Turkey, Peppers, Onions, Guacamole, and Micro Kale on that slice, in the middle
Brush the inside edges of your other slice with egg-whites (this will be your top slice)
Add the top slice and press down the edges
Then brush more egg whites on the edges of your hot pocket, and push it together with your fork
Carefully cut off the edges of your hot pocket and crimp them together until it's all sealed (use a pizza cutter if you want)
Use caution in putting this into your air fryer, then spray the top with some Avocado Oil spray
Air fry on 390-ish for 4-ish minutes or until golden
Cut in half for 350-ish calories with 30-ish grams of protein, or eat the whole thing for double that

name: Bang Bang Egg Roll in a Bowl (800 Calories)

ingredients.name: Tri-color coleslaw mix washed and ready to eat
Organic coco aminos by big tree farms
0% milkfat icelandic style skyr plain yogurt by siggi's
Real salt kosher salt by redmond

steps: Air fry the ground beef on 365-ish for 5-ish minutes
Preheat a stove top pan to a 7/10 heat, then add the onions and beef until the beef starts to brown and onions start to soften
Grate the baby carrots, then add them along with the garlic, ginger and chicken broth - and sautée for a few minutes
Add your coleslaw mix and power slaw mix
Add a cover on top of the pan to soften those mixes so it’s easier to mix with the rest of the ingredients
Then add the Coco Amino's, Rice Vinegar, Sesame Oil, Sea Salt, Black Pepper and mix until the vegetables start to get a little charred
Then add half to your bowl and add your green onion, sesame seeds and bang bang sauce on top
You will then have 2 servings (put the other half in some glass tupperware and refrigerate)

name: Peanut Butter Protein Cheesecake (350 Calories)

ingredients.name: 2% low fat simply cottage cheese by good culture
0% milkfat icelandic style skyr plain yogurt by siggi's
Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino
Super Life Monk Fruit Sweetener with Fiber
Bear bites honey graham crackers by kodiak cakes

steps: Add all ingredients except the melted Peanut Butter to a small blender and blend till smooth
Add the mixture to a 6.5" Cast Iron Skillet, then swirl in your 10g melted Peanut Butter
Air fry on 250-ish for 17-ish minutes
Once done, let it cool at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Then cover it with a plastic wrap and let it sit in your refrigerator overnight to thicken up
Once cool, crunch up your Graham Cracker and add the crumbles over your cheesecake along with some more melted Peanut Butter

name: Chicken Caesar Salad Wrap (667 Calories)

ingredients.name: Crushed red pepper flakes by tone's
Pasture raised heirloom chicken breast by cook's venture
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
0% milkfat icelandic style skyr plain yogurt by siggi's
Flax oat bran & whole wheat lavash bread by joseph's

steps: Flatten your chicken breasts first with a meat tenderizer
Then marinate your chicken breast for an hour with the Lemon Basil Chicken Marinade and cook in the air fryer on 375-ish degrees for 10-ish minutes
While that's cooking, add all Caesar Dressing ingredients into a bowl and mix till smooth
Get a big bowl and add your Romaine, Peppers, Cucumber, Grape Tomatoes, Chicken, and Caesar Dressing
Toss it all together and add some optional more Parmesan Cheese on top

Add it all to your Lavash Wraps (divided over 3 Wraps), roll them tight (the Lavash Wraps are flexible) and slice them in half if you want to. Each Lavash Wrap will be roughly 676 Calories with 89 grams of Protein.

name: Dream Pop Cinnamon Siggi's (500 Calories)

ingredients.name: 0% milkfat icelandic style skyr plain yogurt by siggi's
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino
Plant-based vanilla sky bites by dream pops

steps: Simply mix the Siggi's with the Kino Collagen until it's smooth
Then add the Almonds, Dream Pops, Cinnamon, and Holy Basil Seeds
Wait a little for the Dream Pops to melt (minimum 5 minutes), then mix it all together a little

name: Straight-Up Fitness Wagyu Burger (500 Calories)

ingredients.name: Organic japanese sweet potato by whole foods
Classic turkey uncured bacon by garrett valley
Micro kale mix by bright fresh
Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods

steps: Peel your sweet potato, then slice it in half right through the middle the LONGITUDINALLY (meaning, you will end up with 2 long pieces of potato)
Take each piece of your sweet potato and do your best to cut off a slice that is 0.5" thick. You should end up with 2 slices that are equally shaped. You will use these as 'buns' for your burger
Smash yourself a burger patty out of the Wagyu meat that is similar in shape to your potato slices
Then put some salt and pepper over the meat and air fry your patty for 11-ish minutes on 360-ish
While patty is in air fryer, spray some avocado oil into your pan, heat pan up, and put in 2 slices of turkey bacon
Once turkey bacon is getting brown, take both slices out and add onions and spinach into pan to grill them
Once patty is done, take out of air fryer and let sit on a plate. Then put both slices of sweet potato in for 14-ish minutes on 375-ish degrees

Once potato slices are ready, put mustard on one, ketchup on the other, and load up the alfalfa sprouts, micro kale mix, pickles, turkey bacon, patty - and fold it double for the most nutrient-dense burger in the world

name: Air Fried Bison & Fries (500 Calories)

ingredients.name: Just cranberry organic juice by r. w. knudsen
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
90% lean 10% fat all natural premium ground bison by great range

steps: Try getting the lean Bison here (90%), and cut open your Bison packaging and store what you won't be using back in the fridge (preferably 30-60 min before cooking)
Spray your air fryer with avocado oil just to prevent the meat from sticking, then put the bison in at 360-ish for 11 minutes (every air fryer is different, you might have to find your ideal time)
Cut off the edges of your sweet potatoes, and slice off the skin
Cut them into fries, discs, or whatever you feel like - then spray them, add salt, garlic powder, and toss them around a little
Once bison is done, take it out and let it sit on the counter. Then put your sweet potatoes in the air fryer at 385-ish for 14 minutes
While the potatoes are in the air fryer, put your spinach in a pan, chop up your bell peppers, and get your almonds and cranberry juice ready

Quick tip: I recently started making my 'magnesium drink' while the potatoes are in the air fryer - simply mix 1 cup of cranberry juice with a scoop of Magnesium powder, and add it to a glass with Zevia soda... it'll look fancy and taste great
When your sweet potatoes are done, put the whole plate together and if possible soak the potatoes in any juices the bison left behind
Another quick tip: Rao's Ketchup with Truffle is amazing here, especially with sweet potato fries.

name: Cottage Cheese & Ice Cream (350 Calories)

ingredients.name: Organic low fat cottage cheese by nancy
Collagen protein vanilla macaron by kino
Chocolate chip cookie dough frozen greek yogurt bars by yasso

steps: Mix the cottage cheese with the protein powder (slowly)
Bite or scrape off the Yasso ice cream from the stick and add it to the cottage cheese
Add cinnamon, stir it up, done

name: Smoked Bison Burger (667 Calories)

ingredients.name: Real salt kosher salt by redmond
Micro kale mix by bright fresh
Sprouted ancient grain whole grain burger buns by silver hills

steps: Make yourself a nice thick patty out of the bison meat
Put black pepper, salt, garlic over it
Put the patty into your smoker, air fryer, or oven at 450. Or you can use a skillet on medium heat
If smoking, leave patties on 450 for around 8 minutes each side
Spray some avocado oil into your pan, and heat pan up
Put in 2 slices of turkey bacon
Around the same time, add onions into pan to grill them
Take both bacon and onions out when they're getting brown on both sides
Put cheese over your hot turkey bacon so it melts a little
Once patty is ready, take it out and let it sit for 10 minutes before putting on your bun
Put mustard and ketchup on the insides of your bun, and build your burger as shown in the attached video

name: Bison Happy Meal (667 Calories)

ingredients.name: Real salt kosher salt by redmond

steps: Pour a little bit of Olive Oil over the Bison meat
Pour some salt, pepper, and garlic powder over Bison meat
Cook the whole pound of Bison at 450 degrees in your smoker, oven, or air fryer (you might not use it all, just save the rest for a later meal)
Cook rice in rice cooker with Bone Broth only
Chop sweet potatoes up into small slices
Sprinkle sweet potato slices with olive oil and pour salt over them
Once smoker or oven hits 450 degrees, put sweet potatoes in and let bake for 35-45 minutes (or just use your air fryer for this)
When the rice, bison, and potatoes are all cooking - heat some spinach in a pan
Slice some Bell Peppers, take out 5 baby carrots from the fridge
Once all ingredients are done, put them together as much as you can fit on one plate

name: Grass Fed Beef Bowl (800 calories)

ingredients.name: Tangy bbq coco aminos seasoning sauce & marinade by big tree farms

steps: Chop Bell Peppers up into thin slices
Cook rice in rice cooker with Bone Broth, Spinach, and Bell Peppers
Put Grass-Fed Beef in an air fryer or smoker or oven until medium-rare or medium
Once both are done, mix together to make a bowl and add some of that heavenly BBQ Coco Aminos

name: The Ultimate Omelet (667 calories)

ingredients.name: Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms
Grass-fed pure irish butter unsalted by kerrygold

steps: Cut up 2 bell peppers into thin slices
Crack your eggs over a bowl to capture the yolk and egg-whites
Whisk your eggs together so that all the yolks mix with the whites, until it turns into a yellow mixture
Heat up 0.5 tbsp of butter in a pan
Once entire pan is covered in butter, pour eggs in pan and put stove on medium heat
Add in the bell peppers and 2 handfuls of spinach
Flip omelet until both sides are cooked to your liking
After putting omelet on plate, put slice of cheddar cheese over it to have it melt
Add salt to taste
If you feel like it, cook some extra spinach in your pan (this will clean your pan out as well)
Put 3 baby carrots, 10 almonds, and additional spinach on a separate plate

name: Squeaky Clean Protein Pancakes (667 Calories)

ingredients.name: Large grade a pasture-raised organic eggs by vital farms
Comlete spectrum animal protein complex powder by mark bell's steak shake
Cereals regular rolled oats by bob's red mill
Unsalted pure irish butter by kerrygold

steps: Mix all the above ingredients except for the butter together in a blender, until it's a nice and smooth texture
Heat up some butter in a pan, cover the entire pan
Pour pancake mix into pan, put on medium heat
Flip as soon as you can, without ruining your pancake like I did in the video =)

name: Bar Bending Burrito (800 calories)

ingredients.name: Pasture raised heirloom chicken breast by cook's venture
Grilling marinades three citrus garlic by Frontera foods
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Micro kale mix by bright fresh

steps: Put 1 cup of rice into rice cooker along with 2 cups of Bone Broth
Turn rice cooker on in White rice setting
Cut up your chicken breast into small pieces
Put chicken breast pieces in a pan with marinade (as shown in video)
Let chicken breast sit for at least 30 minutes
Once chicken is marinated, put in oven or smoker at 450 for 20-ish minutes
Cut up (or get pre-made) some pico de gallo
Cut up (or get pre-made) some cilantro
Shred your own cheeses together (both monterrey jack and cheddar)
Once chicken and rice are ready, put your partially cooked tortillas in a pan on medium heat for 20 seconds each side
Put guacamole on the tortilla first
Then roll up the burrito as shown in the attached video

name: Caramel Cacao Acai Bowl (800 calories)

ingredients.name: All natural roasted almond butter crunchy by maranatha
Smart bran with psyllium & oatbran by nature's path
Steak shake salted caramel by mark bell's
Unsweetened acai superfood puree by acai roots

steps: Mix all ingredients in a high-power blender, as shown in the attached video

name: Turkey Bison Pepperoni Pizza (667 calories)

ingredients.name: Gluten free pizza naked crust by capello's

steps: Preheat your pizza oven (or oven with pizza stone) to 450 degrees
Pour a little bit of Olive Oil over the Bison meat
Pour some salt, pepper, and garlic powder over Bison
Cook the whole pound of Bison at 450 degrees in your smoker or oven (you might not use it all, just save the rest for a later meal)
Grate the Parmesan cheese yourself
Pour a little Olive Oil over the pizza crust, along with a small layer of pizza sauce
Sprinkle parmesan cheese over pizza, with small pieces of mozzarella randomly placed on top
Put as many slices of turkey pepperoni on pizza as you like
Sprinkle lots of Basil over pizza
Once oven hits 450 degrees, put pizza on stone and let sit for 5 minutes
After 5 minutes, pour a little extra pizza sauce on, and let sit for another 5 minutes
After 10-12 minutes total, take pizza out
Take your bison out of your smoker or oven, and let it sit for 10 minutes
While waiting for Bison to finish cooking out of the smoker/oven, cook your spinach in a pan on the stovetop
After Bison has been out of the oven for 10 minutes, chop it up into small pieces and sprinkle over pizza

name: Simply Perfect Steak, Spinach, & Taters (800 calories)

ingredients.name: Grass-fed beef filet mignon by butcher box
Olive oils extra virgin organic by Spectrum
Potatoes Yukon Gold flesh and skin raw

steps: Take your steak out of the fridge and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes
Rub your steak in with olive oil, and cover with salt, pepper, and garlic on both sides
Pour 2-3 tbsp of Olive Oil into plastic bag
Add in 8-10 shakes of salt, pepper, and garlic
Add in potatoes, and shake bag around so olive oil with spices cover all potatoes fully
Leave the potatoes marinating in the fridge for at least 30 minutes
Once steak is roughly room temperature, put in smoker for 10 minutes on smoke setting (optional)
Put both potatoes and steak in smoker or oven at 350
Flip steak after 5 minutes, take steak out after 8-10 minutes total for it to be medium rare
Take potatoes out after 40-50 minutes, though test for readiness
Make sure to watch detailed instructions as shown in the attached video in your Training App

name: Strong & Tasty Turkey Sandwich (667 calories)

ingredients.name: All natural roasted turkey breast by boar's head
Cheese monterey jack raw milk by Organic valley
Avocado oil spray by chosen foods
Classic turkey uncured bacon by garrett valley
The big 16 sprouted wheat bread by silver hills
Broccoli sprouts by banner mountain sprouts
Micro kale mix by bright fresh

steps: Spray some avocado oil in a pan, put in 2 slices of turkey bacon in. Take out when both sides are brown and crisp
Smear out some mustard on one slice, mayo on the other slice
Put the onions on the mustard side of the bread
Put the broccoli sprouts and micro kale on the mayo side of the bread
Start with stacking 5-8 slices of turkey breast on the mayo side of the bread
Stack on your cheese
ut the turkey bacon on the cheese side, so the cheese melts a little from the heat
Fold it together, and make sure to watch detailed instructions as shown in the attached video

name: Fast Thai Wrap

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients and slice the grilled chicken.
In a small bowl, combine the peanut butter and vegetable oil.
Heat the tortilla just long enough to soften, using a pan or microwave. Place it on a flat surface.
Preheat the air fryer at 180 °C for 5 minutes.
Prepare the wrap, layer the cabbage, red pepper, chicken, and green onions. Drizzle the peanut butter and sprinkle with red chili flakes.
Wrap carefully,  then place seam-side down in an air-fryer-safe tray, spray with vegetable oil, and air fry at 180°C for 3 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Halve the wrap, serve, and enjoy!

name: Breakfast Hash

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Turkey ham sliced prepackaged or deli meat

steps: Peel and grate the potato. Cut the turkey ham into small cubes and mince the cilantro.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs and egg whites with a pinch of garlic, salt, and pepper.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Spray with vegetable oil, add the grated potato, cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until slightly softened and lightly golden.
Add the diced bell pepper and turkey ham. Cook for a few minutes until heated through, and the bell pepper pieces are soft.
Pour in the egg mixture, reduce the heat to low, and cook. Stirring gently.
Serve on a plate, sprinkle the cilantro on top, and enjoy!

name: Peach Blueberry Smoothie
steps: Halve the peach, remove the pit, and chop it.
Next, add the chopped peach into a food processor with the blueberries, Greek yogurt, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Cheesecake Pudding

ingredients.name: Cookies graham crackers plain or honey lowfat

steps: In a food processor, add the cream cheese and yogurt and blend until smooth. Then add the protein powder and blend until it's thoroughly mixed
Crush the cookies and add them to a glass. Pour the chocolate cream and combine with a spoon.
Garnish with a few pieces of crushed cookies, and enjoy!

name: Savory Yogurt Bowl
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the cucumber.
Spoon the Greek yogurt into a small bowl, and grate the garlic over it. Add salt and mix well.
Pour the yogurt into another bowl. Top with the chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber.
Drizzle the tahini over the bowl and garnish with pine nuts.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Potato Egg Wrap

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients: peel and thinly slice the potatoes. Slice the tomatoes and set aside.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and black pepper until well combined.
Heat a large nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly coat with vegetable cooking spray. Add the sliced potatoes in an even layer. Cook for 4 minutes, flipping once, until slightly softened.
Pour the whisked eggs over the potatoes. Cook without stirring until the top is fully set. Turn off the heat.
Top with the Swiss cheese, alfalfa sprouts, and sliced tomatoes. Fold in half to form a wrap.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Paradise Vibes Smoothie
steps: Place all the ingredients in a food processor, add ice, and blend until smooth
Serve in a glass and enjoy!

name: Oriental Chicken Sandwich

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Shred the chicken, peel and shred the carrot, shred the cabbage, and chop the broccoli.
Place the chicken, carrot, cabbage, and broccoli in a bowl. Add the sesame oil, sesame ginger dressing, and green onion. Mix well.
Toast the bread slices.
Prepare the first sandwich: spread a portion of the salad on one slice of bread, close the sandwich with a second slice, and cut it in half.
Cut the third slice of bread in half. Add the remaining salad to one half and close with the other to make the third piece.
Serve the sandwich halves and enjoy!

name: Salmon with Brown Rice Salad

ingredients.name: Rice brown medium grain cooked without salt

steps: Chop the asparagus into small to medium pieces.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and add 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Add the asparagus and cook for 4 minutes, until lightly tender. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining olive oil. Add the salmon and cook for 3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, combine the brown rice and asparagus and season with salt. Add the cranberries and feta cheese, then mix gently.
Place the rice salad on a plate and add the salmon on the side.

name: Shrimp With Udon Noodles

ingredients.name: Bok choy or pak choi or Chinese cabbage raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Slice the bok choy and chop the broccoli into small pieces.
In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce with the honey and set aside.
Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the broccoli and cook until slightly tender.
Add the bok choy, udon noodles, and cooked shrimp. Pour in the soy mix and stir to combine.
Heat for 4 minutes or until the bok choy is soft.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Scrambled Eggs With Corn Tortilla
steps: Cut the tortillas in half, then slice them into thirds to make a triangle shape.
In a bowl, beat the eggs with the egg whites, add salt.
Heat a skillet, spray with vegetable oil, and add the tortillas. Cook them for a few minutes, then pour in the beaten eggs. Stir and scramble the eggs as they cook. Serve and enjoy!

name: Apple Chicken Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the apple and shred the chicken breast.
In a bowl, add the greek yogurt, apples, chicken, cranberries, and almonds. Season with nutmeg and salt.
Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Breakfast Pita

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Place the eggs in a small pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then cook over high heat for 15 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl with ice water.
Peel and slice the eggs. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Prepare the vegetables: halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the cucumber, thinly slice the red onion, and halve the black olives.
Cut the whole wheat pita in half to create two pockets. Spread the hummus evenly inside each half.
Fill the pita with the sliced eggs, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olives, and feta cheese.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Cheesecake
steps: Preheat the air fryer at 180°C for 5 minutes.
In a blender, add the Greek yogurt, honey, eggs, vanilla, and cottage cheese. Blend until smooth.
Add the corn starch, cocoa powder, and blend once again
Pour the mix into a baking pan, sprinkle with chocolate chips and cook on the air fryer for 30 minutes or until it's fully firm.
Once it's ready, let it cool slightly. Serve and enjoy!

name: Hash Brown Omelette
steps: Grate the potato and swiss cheese.
In a bowl, pour the eggs and egg whites, add a pinch of salt, and whisk with a fork until well combined.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and spray with oil. Add the bell peppers and cook until they are slightly soft. Remove and set aside.

Heat the same pan, spray with vegetable oil. Spread the grated potato evenly to cover the bottom. After 4 minutes, pour the egg mixture over the potatoes. Cook on low to medium heat until the top looks firm.
Add the cheese, spinach, and cooked bell peppers to one side of the omelette. Fold it gently and turn off the heat. Let it sit for 1 minute to allow the cheese to melt.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Texas Omelette Sandwich

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Cut two slices of bread and toast until lightly golden. Set aside.
Prepare the ingredients. Finely chop the red bell pepper, spinach, and bacon.
Crack the eggs into a bowl. Season with salt and black pepper, then whisk until well combined.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the bacon and cook.
Add the red bell pepper and cook until softened.
Pour in the eggs. Cook gently, until begin to set.
Top one half of the omelette with the spinach and cheese. Fold the omelette in half and turn off the heat. Let sit for about 1 minute until the cheese melts.
Place the folded omelette on one slice of toasted bread, and close the sandwich with the second slice. Enjoy!

name: Omelette Quesadilla
steps: Prepare the ingredients, slice the mushrooms and onion. Chop the spinach.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until well combined.
Heat a medium nonstick pan over low heat. Add the onion and mushrooms and cook until softened.
Add the spinach and mix until soft.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook gently until the surface begins to set.
Sprinkle the Swiss cheese over one side of the omelet and place the tortilla on top. Turn off the heat and fold the omelet in half to form a quesadilla.
Serve on a plate, halve the quesadilla, and enjoy!

name: Salmon Lettuce Boats

ingredients.name: Rice brown medium grain cooked without salt

steps: Heat a nonstick pan over low to medium heat. Add the salmon and cook for 4 minutes per side, or until tender and easy to flake. Remove from heat, transfer to a cutting board, and flake the salmon using two forks.
In a bowl, combine the cooked rice, parsley, red onion, and cucumber. Dice the tomato into small cubes and add it to the bowl. Season with salt and black pepper, then mix well.
Layer two lettuce leaves together to create the boat base.
Fill each lettuce wrap with the rice salad and top with the flaked salmon.
Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Cottage Crepes
steps: In a food processor, add cottage cheese, eggs, and cinnamon. Blend until smooth.
Preheat a large nonstick pan over low heat and lightly spray with vegetable oil. Pour a small amount of the mixture into the pan, spreading it into a crepe.
Cook until the edges begin to set and the bottom is lightly golden. Add sliced banana on one side and fold into a triangle.
Serve the crepes on a plate. Drizzle the chocolate-hazelnut spread, top with blueberries, sprinkle with cinnamon, and enjoy!

name: Chimichurri Chicken with Couscous Bowl

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large
Couscous or cous cous cooked without salt

steps: In a bowl, combine the couscous with the chopped peppers and olives. Add the cooked chicken and drizzle with chimichurri
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook until fully cooked and lightly golden. Once ready, set aside.
Halve the black olives, and chop the bell peppers.
In a bowl, combine the couscous with the chopped peppers and olives. Add the cooked chicken, drizzle the chimichurri, and enjoy!

name: Caprese Chicken Pasta Salad Bowl

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Chop the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly spray with vegetable oil. Add the chicken breast and cook for a few minutes until it's no longer pink.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
In a bowl, combine the pasta with pesto, then add the cherry tomatoes, chicken, basil, and enjoy!

name: Asian Noodle Salad

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and spray with vegetable oil. Add the beef flank steak and season with salt and black pepper.
Cook over low heat until browned. Flip the meat and continue cooking until done. Place on a cutting board and slice thinly.
Chiffonade the spinach.
In a large bowl, add the cooked soba noodles, red cabbage, spinach, and chives. Drizzle the sesame oil, season with salt, and combine well.
Then add the sliced beef and toss gently to combine all ingredients. Sprinkle the sesame seeds and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Shrimp Bowl
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Shred the cabbage, chop the avocado, and mince the bell pepper
Prepare a pineapple salad. In a bowl, combine the pineapple, avocado, and red bell pepper. Season lightly with salt and mix gently.
Assemble the bowl, add the quinoa, top with the pineapple salad, shredded cabbage and shrimp.
Assemble the bowl, add the quinoa, top with the pineapple salad, shredded cabbage, and shrimp.

name: Creamy Spinach Chicken
steps: Chop the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
In a food processor, add the cottage cheese, salt, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
In a pan over medium heat, add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken pieces to the pan and the cottage cheese, and heat for 3 minutes until warmed through.
Serve on a plate, complete with bread slices, and enjoy!
Replace the sourdough bread with a gluten-free option.

name: Tuna Salad With Crispy Rice

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200°C
Prepare the ingredients. Slice the cucumber and chop the green onions.
Place the cooked rice in an air-fryer–safe bowl. Lightly spray the rice with oil.
Cooks for 5 minutes, or until the rice gets crispy. Stir halfway through with a spatula. Let it cool slightly.
Drain the tuna and place it in a bowl. Add the edamame, cucumber, and green onions.
Add the sesame oil and red chili flakes, then combine gently.
Add the rice to the bowl, mix well, and enjoy!

name: Breaded Chicken With Crunchy Salad

ingredients.name: Breaded fried chicken breast meat and skin

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Grate the carrots and the red cabbage.
Slice the breaded chicken into strips
In a bowl, add the quinoa, carrots, cabbage, drizzle the olive oil, and season with salt. Combine well.
Place the salad on a plate, and the chicken strips on the side, and enjoy!

name: Potato Salad With Shrimp

ingredients.name: Shrimp raw frozen medium peeled and deveined tail off
Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Peel and dice the potatoes into small pieces. Boil in salted water for 10 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain and let them cool.
Boil the shrimp for 2 minutes or until pink. Drain and let them cool slightly.
Prepare the ingredients. Chop the red onion, the red peppers, and the basil.
In a bowl, add the potatoes, shrimp, peppers, red onion, and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and black pepper. Combine and enjoy!

name: Creamy Cucumber Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Slice the cucumbers, then cut the slices in half to form half-moons. Slice the red onion, drain the corn, and finely mince the garlic.
In a bowl, add the Greek yogurt, olive oil, honey, salt, minced garlic, and red chili flakes. Mix well.
Add the cucumbers, red onion, and corn. Combine and enjoy!

name: Insalata di Patate

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large
Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids
Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Peel and dice the potatoes into small pieces. Boil in salted water for 10 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain and let them cool.
Prepare the ingredients. Halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the olives, chop the basil, and drain the tuna.
In a bowl, add the potatoes, tuna, cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, and basil.
Drizzle the olive oil, and combine well. Garnish with basil, and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Soup With Tofu
steps: Slice the mushrooms, chop the onion, and tofu. Dice the tomatoes and carrots.
Heat a pot over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Stir in the carrots and mushrooms and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the tomatoes and quinoa, season with salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Add water until the ingredients are completely covered.
Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then reduce to medium heat and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the quinoa is cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Add the tofu and spinach. Stir gently.
Serve the soup in a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Green Quinoa Tuna Salad

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids
Dill weed fresh or raw herb
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients, mince the garlic, chop the chives, dill, and cilantro.
In a food processor add the greek yogurt, olive oil, garlic, chives, dill, and cilantro. Season with salt and squeeze the lemon. Blend until smooth.
Drain the tuna and place it in a bowl. Add the cooked quinoa and the dressing. Combine well.
Place on a plate, add the saltine crackers on the side, and enjoy!

name: Tofu Nuggets

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari
Apple cider vinegar by always save

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200°C for 5 minutes.
Drain the tofu, and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
In a small bowl, combine the almond milk and apple cider vinegar, then set aside.
In another bowl, place the panko breadcrumbs, paprika, black pepper, and nutritional yeast and combine well.
Place the cornstarch on a plate.
Coat each tofu piece in the cornstarch, dip into the almond milk mixture, then coat it with the panko mixture.
Place the breaded tofu in an air-fryer basket, spray with vegetable oil, and cook for 10 minutes, or until crispy.
In a small bowl, combine the barbecue sauce with olive oil.
Place the tofu nuggets on a plate and serve with the barbecue dip. Share and enjoy!

name: Oriental Chicken Salad
steps: Cut the grilled chicken breast into strips. Finely chop the parsley.
In a small bowl, add the balsamic vinegar and honey. Mix well to form the dressing.
In a bowl, add the red cabbage, green cabbage, parsley, carrots, and almonds. Drizzle the dressing and combine.
Add the chicken strips on top, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Teriyaki Chicken with Veggies and Quinoa

ingredients.name: Mixed frozen vegetables boiled with salt

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Mince the garlic and cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces.

Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant. Add the chicken breast, season with salt, and cook, stirring occasionally, until it turns white and is cooked through. Set aside.
Heat another pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and cook the mixed vegetables until soft. Then add the cooked chicken and pour in the teriyaki sauce.
Place the quinoa in a bowl. Add the teriyaki chicken and veggies, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Southern Beans
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Chop the green peppers and bacon, and mince the jalapeño. Drain the beans.
Heat a pan over medium heat and cook the bacon for until it releases fat. Add the ground beef, breaking apart with a spatula until browned.
Add the bell peppers and jalapeño and cook for 2 minutes.
Then add the beans, and pour in the beef broth. Stir for 3 minutes until everything is heated through.
Spoon into a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Rainbow Tuna Sandwich
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Slice the avocado, finely shred the red cabbage, and carrot.
Drain, the tuna.
Toast the bread slices.
Prepare the sandwich. Layer the spinach, avocado, tuna, carrots, and red cabbage. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich. Serve and enjoy!

name: Hummus Tuna Sandwich
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Finely shred the red cabbage and drain the tuna.
Toast the bread slices.
Prepare the sandwich. Spread the hummus on one slice of bread, then layer the tuna, red cabbage, and alfalfa sprouts. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich. Serve, and enjoy!

name: Cream Cheese Sandwich
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Slice the cucumber and avocado.
Toast the bread slices.
Spread the cream cheese on both slices of bread, then layer the ham, avocado, cucumber, and alfalfa sprouts on one slice. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich, serve, and enjoy!

name: Curry Chicken Sandwich
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Finely dice the red bell pepper, red onion, and celery. Shred the grilled chicken breast.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing. Combine the greek yogurt, mayonnaise, curry powder, and salt.
Add the chicken, bell pepper, red onion, and celery to the bowl. Combine gently until coated.
Toast the bread slices. Place the lettuce leaves on one slice, then add the curry chicken mixture. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich. serve and enjoy!

name: Crunchy Chicken Sandwich

ingredients.name: Chicken broiler or fryers breast skinless boneless meat only cooked grilled

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Finely shred the red cabbage and slice the grilled chicken into strips.
In a small bowl, prepare the dip by adding the mayonnaise, mustard, and honey. Mix well.
Toast the bread slices.
Prepare the sandwich. Spread the dip on each bread slice. On one slice layer the cabbage and chicken. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich, serve, and enjoy!

name: Curried Tofu Sandwich

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Shred the red cabbage, and chop the tomato.
Dice the tofu into small cubes and transfer to a bowl.
Add lemon juice, curry powder, a pinch of salt, and vegan mayo. Mix gently to coat.
Toast the bread slices.
Prepare the sandwich. On one slice of bread, add the curried tofu, tomatoes, and cabbage. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Crunchy Tuna Wrap

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Peel and shred the carrot and cabbage. Slice the avocado, and drain the tuna.
Microwave the tortilla for 10 15 seconds to soften it.
Assemble the wrap, place the cabbage, carrots, avocado, and tuna in the center of the tortilla.
Wrap carefully, slice in half, and enjoy!

name: Tuna Steak Tacos

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients, slice the bell peppers and the onion lengthwise. Cut the tuna into small pieces, and chop the cilantro.
Heat a pan over medium heat and spray lightly with vegetable oil. Add the onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Using the same pan, spray with vegetable oil. Add the tuna pieces and sear them over medium heat, turning gently until seared on the outside.
Heat the tortillas in a pan or microwave.
Prepare the tacos, spread the avocado over each tortilla, add the vegetables, and top with the seared tuna pieces. Garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Easy Fish Tacos

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Cut the tilapia into medium strips. Chop the tomatoes and green bell pepper. Finely chop the red onion and cilantro. Dice the avocado into small cubes.
In a bowl, prepare the avocado salsa. Combine the avocado, tomato, green bell pepper, red onion, and cilantro. Squeeze the lime juice over, season with salt, and mix well.
Heat a pan over medium heat and spray with vegetable oil. Add the tilapia strips and cook until the fish turns white.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a pan or microwave just until soft and flexible.
Add the cooked fish strips to each tortilla and top with the avocado salsa.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Tofu Lettuce Cups
steps: Drain the tofu and cut it into small cubes.
In a small bowl, combine the peanut butter, soy sauce, and honey. Stir well.
Heat a pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and cook the tofu for 5 minutes, turning gently, until lightly golden. Pour in the peanut sauce and cook for 2 minutes, stirring to coat evenly.
Place the lettuce leaves on a serving plate, add a portion of rice noodles to each leaf, and top with the tofu.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Cajun Chicken With Zucchini Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the red bell pepper, slice the zucchini into half-moons, halve the cashews, mince the garlic, and parsley.
Cut the chicken breast into strips, add Cajun seasoning, and minced garlic.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and spray lightly with cooking oil. Add the chicken and cook over low heat until it begins to turn white.
Add the zucchini, red bell pepper, and cashews, then continue cooking over medium-low heat until the chicken is fully cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Remove from heat, serve on a plate, garnish with chopped parsley, and enjoy!

name: Avocado Chicken Wrap
steps: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips.
In a small bowl, combine the yellow mustard, honey, garlic powder, and onion powder. Mix until smooth.
Coat the chicken strips evenly with the mustard mixture.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and spray lightly with cooking oil. Add the chicken and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through and lightly golden. Remove from heat.
Mash the avocado with a fork.
Heat the tortilla just long enough to soften, using a pan or microwave. Place it on a flat surface.
Spread the avocado over the tortilla, add the chicken, and wrap carefully.
Halve the wrap, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Tuna and Rice Frittata
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until well combined.
Add the tuna, sour cream, and cooked rice, and mix gently.
Pour the mixture into an air-fryer-safe bowl
Place in the air fryer and cook at 180°C for about 15 minutes, until the center is set.
Once ready, let it cool down slightly, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Chicken Wrap

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Dice the tomatoes into small pieces.
Prepare the pico de gallo, place the tomatoes in a bowl with the chopped red onion, minced jalapeño, and chopped cilantro. Squeeze fresh lime juice over the mixture, season with salt, and mix well.
Shred the grilled chicken breast and set aside.
Heat the tortilla in a pan or microwave to soften.
Place the tortilla on a flat surface, and spread the avocado evenly over the tortilla. Add the shredded chicken and top with the pico de gallo.
Roll the wrap carefully, cut it in half, place it on a plate, and enjoy.

name: Broccoli Cottage Quiche
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the garlic. Chop the cooked broccoli into small pieces. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt. Add the cottage cheese and pesto, and mix until well combined. Stir in the garlic, chickpeas, and chopped broccoli.
Pour the mixture into an air-fryer-safe mold or bowl, spreading it evenly.
Place the mold in the air fryer and cook at 180°C for 15 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is lightly golden.
Let rest for 5 minutes. Then serve and enjoy!

name: Spinach Cottage Quiche

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small pieces. Chop the spinach.
Place the potato pieces in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to medium heat. Cook until the potatoes are fork-tender. Drain well and set aside.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, garlic powder, and onion powder. Add the cottage cheese and mix until well combined. Fold in the chopped spinach.
Place the cooked potatoes in an air-fryer-safe bowl, and pour the cottage cheese mix.
Place the mold in the air fryer and cook at 180°C for 20 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is lightly golden.
Allow to cool down slightly and enjoy!

name: Chinese Shrimp Omelette
steps: Halve the baby potatoes and microwave them until fork tender. Next, cook them with 2 tsp of coconut oil. Season with salt and paprika to taste.
Place the remaining oil in a pan, and stir in the onion, egg, shrimp, and some green onions. Add salt and mix.
Transfer to a plate, garnish with the remaining green onion, and enjoy!

name: Beef Sweet Potato Hash Wrap

ingredients.name: Sweet potato boiled without skin or salt

steps: Peel and chop the sweet potato into small pieces. Finely chop the onion, red bell pepper, and parsley.
Place the sweet potato pieces in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to medium heat.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until the sweet potato pieces are fork-tender. Drain and set aside.

Heat a pan over medium heat and spray lightly with vegetable oil. Add the onion and cook until softened. Add the red bell pepper and ground beef. Season with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook until the beef is fully cooked and no longer pink. Remove from heat.
Heat the tortilla just long enough to soften, using a pan or microwave.
Add the beef and sweet potato pieces to the center of the tortilla, and top with parsley.  Wrap carefully.
Halve the wrap. Serve and enjoy!

name: Lemon  Garlic Shrimp

ingredients.name: Shrimp raw frozen medium peeled and deveined tail off
Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Mince the garlic and chop the parsley. Peel and cut the potatoes into small cubes. Halve the lemon.
Place the diced potatoes in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to medium heat and cook for 3 minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Melt the butter, then add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. Add the shrimp and season with salt and black pepper.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the shrimp and gently toss to coat. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Cook until everything is fully combined.
Add the cooked potatoes to the pan, fold gently with the shrimp, and warm together for a minute.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Chicken Breast With Caprese Salad
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes. Chop the mozzarella into small pieces. Slice the chicken breast.
In a bowl, add the cooked quinoa, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella, and arugula. Season with salt, pepper, and italian spices. Combine well.
Add the chicken slices on the side, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Steak Wrap

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak broiled trimmed to 0" fat
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Chop the tomatoes, slice the beef flank into strips.
In a food processor, blend the avocado, Greek yogurt, cilantro, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Heat the tortilla just long enough to soften, using a pan or microwave. Place it on a flat surface.
Prepare the wrap, add the strips, onion, jalapeño, and tomato. Spread the avocado dressing on top, and wrap carefully.
Halve the wrap, serve, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Creamy Corn With Shrimp

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Drain the corn and finely chop the cilantro. Set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the butter.
Stir in the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes
Pour in the corn and vegetable broth, let it simmer for  2 minutes.
Lower the heat and add the sour cream, mixing gently until creamy.
Squeeze some lime juice and chopped coriander. Serve and enjoy!

name: Salmon Quinoa Bowl
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly spray with vegetable oil. Lower the heat slightly and cook the salmon for about 4 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Chop the avocado and tomatoes into small pieces. Place them in a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and gently combine.
Cut the nori sheet into thin strips.
Assemble the bowl and serve the quinoa on one side. Place the tomato salad on the other side, and top the quinoa with the salmon.
Sprinkle sesame seeds, top with nori strips, and enjoy.

name: Power Muffin Sandwich
steps: Heat a nonstick pan on low heat, spray with vegetable oil, and pour in the egg whites. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until set, then fold into a compact shape. Remove from the pan.
Heat the chicken patty in the microwave until warmed through.
Meanwhile, toast both halves of the English muffin in the same pan until lightly golden. Place the cheese slices on one half and heat gently until slightly melted.
Assemble the sandwich. Place the egg white omelet on the bottom half of the muffin. Add the arugula, tomato slices, and chicken patty. Cover with the muffin half topped with melted cheese
Halve the sandwich, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Avocado Toast With Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: In a bowl, mash the avocado with the cream cheese. Season with salt, and mix until smooth and spreadable.
Prepare the pico de gallo: finely chop the tomatoes, red onion, and jalapeño. Place them in a bowl, add a pinch of salt, and mix well.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the egg whites, season lightly with salt, and cook, stirring gently, until just set. Turn off the heat and set aside
Slice the bread and toast it until lightly golden.
Assemble the toasts, spread the avocado mix over each slice of toasted bread, top with the cooked egg whites, and spoon the pico de gallo on top.
Finish by sprinkling with coriander, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Grilled Pesto Sandwich

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari

steps: Halve the bread and toast the slices.
Prepare the ingredients: slice the eggplant and red bell pepper. Slice the tofu lengthwise.
Preheat a grill pan on medium heat. Spray with vegetable oil, then grill the tofu, eggplant, and bell pepper for 2–3 minutes per side, until lightly golden.
Spread the pesto on the toasted bread. Layer with spinach, grilled tofu, eggplant, and bell pepper.
Close the sandwich, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Tuscan Egg White Sandwich
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over low heat. Spray with vegetable cooking spray oil.
Pour in the egg whites and cook until set, forming a round omelet shape that fits the bread. Remove from the pan.
Slice the sordough bread. Toast both halves in the same pan until lightly golden.
Prepare the sandwich, take one slice of bread, and place the arugula, egg whites, mozzarella, and tomato slices. Cover with the other bread slice.
Press gently, halve the sandwich, serve, and enjoy!

name: Egg Breakfast Tacos
steps: Heat the corn tortillas in a pan or microwave just long enough to soften. Set aside on a plate.
Heat a pan over low heat. Spray with vegetable cooking spray oil. Add the spinach and cook lightly until are lightly soft. Place the spinach over each tortilla.

In the same pan, spray again with vegetable cooking spray oil. Add a portion of the cottage cheese and allow it to begin warming. Crack one egg over the cottage cheese and cook sunny-side up until set. Place the egg on top of one tortilla.
Repeat the process with the remaining cottage cheese and eggs.
Season each taco with salt and pepper, and enjoy!

name: Egg White Breakfast Tacos
steps: Prepare the ingredients: whisk the egg whites and add salt to taste. Chiffonade the spinach.

Heat a pan over low to medium heat and spray with vegetable oil. Pour about one-third of the egg white mixture into the pan to cook the first omelet. Repeat the process for the remaining two omelets, adding vegetable oil spray each time.
Once the omelets are ready, spread the beans onto each one, then add the spinach and fold the omelets.
Blend the salsa verde with the avocado. Next, drizzle over the omelets and enjoy!

name: Steak and Blue Cheese Salad

ingredients.name: Corn sweet yellow frozen kernels on cob cooked boiled drained with salt
Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Cut the steak into thin strips and season with salt and garlic powder.
Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the beef for 3 minutes per side. or until browned and cooked through.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and place them in a bowl with the arugula.
Cut the corn kernels off the cob in long strips. Halve the cherry tomatoes and place them in a bowl with the arugula.
Add the corn strips and cooked steak to the bowl. Crumble the blue cheese over the salad, and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Wrap
steps: Prepare the shrimp: in a bowl, season with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and drizzle with olive oil. Mix well.
Preheat a nonstick pan on medium heat, spray with cooking oil, and add the shrimp. Cook until they turn pink, turning halfway through. Remove from the pan and let them cool slightly.
Spread the Caesar dressing on the tortilla. Add the lettuce, chopped red bell pepper, and shrimp.
Wrap carefully and cut in half. Serve, and enjoy!

name: Cabbage Egg Sandwich

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Shred the cabbage, chop the green onion, and tomato.
In a bowl, whisk the whole eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the cabbage and green onion, and cook for 2–3 minutes until slightly softened.
Pour in the egg mixture, tomato pieces, and using a spatula, gently shape it into a square. Once the top looks lightly set, flip and cook for 1–2 more minutes until fully cooked.
Toast the whole wheat bread slices until lightly golden.
Assemble the sandwich,  press lightly to compact, and secure with a toothpick in the center. Enjoy!

name: Avotuna Bagel

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids
Bagels plain enriched with calcium propionate includes onion poppy sesame

steps: In a bowl, mash the avocado with a fork and season with salt. Add the tuna and red onion, and mix until well combined.
Toast the bagel halves in a pan over medium heat. Place the cheese on one half and toast until the cheese is almost melted.
Assemble the bagel: spread the tuna mixture over the cheesy bagel half, add the tomato slices, and close with the remaining bagel half.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Sproud Salad Breakfast
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Chop the avocado and halve the cherry tomatoes.
In a bowl, add the alfalfa sprouts, chickpeas, mixed greens, avocado, and cherry tomatoes. Combine gently.
Top the salad with the sliced hard-boiled eggs. Season with salt and pepper, and enjoy!

name: English Muffin Sandwich
steps: Cut the English muffin in half and toast until lightly golden.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and cook the bacon until warmed through. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg, egg white, and season with salt and pepper.

Heat a small pan over low to medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture, add the spinach, and cook until the eggs are mostly set. Fold or shape the eggs to fit the muffin and continue cooking until fully set.
Assemble the sandwich: place the egg on one half of the muffin, top with bacon, and close with the other half. Serve and enjoy!

name: Skinny Muffin Sandwich
steps: In a bowl, whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt and garlic powder.
Heat a small nonstick pan over low to medium heat and lightly spray with vegetable cooking spray.
Pour in the egg whites, spinach, and cover with a lid, and cook for 5 minutes until the top looks firm
Flip carefully, turn off the heat, and cook until fully cooked. Remove from heat.
Toast the  English muffin until lightly golden.
Slice the cherry tomatoes in half.
Mash the avocado with a fork and spread it over one half of the muffin.
Add the cherry tomatoes, egg white patty, and close the sandwich.
Place on a plate, and enjoy!

name: French Rice Cake Toast

ingredients.name: Skinny syrup zero calorie maple syrup by the skinny food co

steps: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the cinnamon until well combined.
Dip each rice cake into the egg mixture, making sure both sides are evenly coated
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly spray with vegetable cooking spray.
Place the soaked rice cakes in the pan and cook for 3 minutes per side, until lightly golden and set. Flip carefully.
If there is egg mixture left, dip the rice cakes again and return them to the pan for an extra minute per side.
Transfer to a plate, drizzle with the maple syrup, garnish with the raspberries, and enjoy!

name: Rice Cake Treat
steps: In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the vanilla whey protein powder until smooth and creamy.
Spread the yogurt mixture evenly over the rice cakes and set aside.
Heat a small pot over low to medium heat. Add the dark chocolate and melt gently, stirring occasionally. Once fully melted, turn off the heat.
Drizzle the melted dark chocolate over each rice cake. Sprinkle lightly with sea salt on top.
Place the rice cakes in the freezer for 1 hour, or until set.
Remove from the freezer and enjoy!

name: Spicy Chicken Rice Cake

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Shred the chicken breast and place it in a bowl. Add the Greek yogurt and buffalo sauce, and mix until well combined.
Shred the cheese and set it aside.
Spoon the chicken mixture over each rice cake.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese.
Place the rice cakes in the air fryer and cook for 1 minute, or until the cheese is lightly melted.
Serve on a plate, garnish with cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Chicken Alfredo Rice Cake Toast
