steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C  for 5 minutes.
Shred the cheese and the chicken breast.
In a bowl, place the shredded chicken and Alfredo sauce and mix until well combined.
Spoon the chicken Alfredo mixture evenly over each rice cake.
Sprinkle the cheese on top and add a pinch of black pepper.
Place the rice cakes in the air fryer and cook for 1 minute, or until the cheese is lightly melted.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Tuna Melt Rice Cake Toast

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Mince the bell pepper and onion.
In a bowl, add the drained tuna, red onion, and green bell pepper. Season with a pinch of salt and mix well.
Place the rice cakes on a flat surface. Spoon the tuna mixture evenly over each rice cake.
Top each rice cake with the cheddar cheese.
Place the rice cakes in the air fryer and cook for 1 minute, or until the cheese is lightly melted.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Shrimp, Broccoli & Quinoa Salad
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C  for 5 minutes.
Chop the broccoli into small pieces.
In an air fryer basket, add the broccoli, quinoa, and shrimp. Spray lightly with the vegetable cooking spray and season with a pinch of salt, garlic powder, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Cook for 7 minutes, until lightly crispy and heated through.
Serve into a bowl, top with feta cheese, and enjoy!

name: Crunchy Wraps
steps: Prepare the cabbage leaves, and finely chop the red and yellow bell peppers.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the ground chicken, season with salt and pepper, and cook, breaking apart with a spatula, until it begins to change color.

Add the chopped bell peppers to the pan, and continue cooking until the chicken is fully cooked and the peppers are slightly softened. Drizzle the honey and mix well. Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool slightly.
Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the chicken mix in the center of each cabbage leaf. Fold and roll gently to form wraps.
Serve the wraps on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Creamy Tuna Salad

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients: drain the tuna, corn, and black beans.
In a bowl, add the tuna, mayonnaise, and sour cream. Mix until well combined.
Add the corn, black beans, red onion, and red bell pepper. Combine well.
Garnish with the cilantro, serve, and enjoy!

name: Summer Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients, drain the tuna and chickpeas. Halve the cherry tomatoes, chop the cucumber, and mince the red onion.
In a bowl, add the cucumber, red onion, and cherry tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper, drizzle with the olive oil, and mix well.
Add the cottage cheese, tuna, and chickpeas. Stir gently until everything is combined.
Garnish with parsley leaves, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Corn Salad

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the hard-boiled eggs, drain the corn, and finely chop the red bell pepper.
In a bowl, combine the eggs, corn, red bell pepper, and Greek yogurt.
Add the cilantro, season with salt and pepper, and mix gently until well combined.
Garnish with extra cilantro, serve, and enjoy!

name: Tofu Tacos

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Cut the tofu into bite-sized cubes. Place them in a bowl and toss with the soy sauce until evenly coated.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the tofu and cook for a few minutes, flipping occasionally, until lightly golden on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
Warm the corn tortillas in a pan or use the microwave.
Place the avocado in a small bowl and mash with a fork until slightly smooth.
Assemble the tacos: spread the mashed avocado in each tortilla, add the red cabbage, tofu, and cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the tacos, and enjoy!

name: Steak Salad With Corn

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the steak for about 3 minutes per side,
Cut the kernels off the corn in long strips. In a small bowl, combine the pesto and olive oil until well mixed.
In a bowl, place the arugula on one side and the corn strips on the other. Top the arugula with the cooked steak slices.
Drizzle the pesto dressing over the steak, and enjoy!

name: Black Rice Salad
steps: Cut the raw chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
In another cutting board, cut the red bell pepper, broccoli, and spinach.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and spray lightly with vegetable cooking spray. Cook the chicken until fully cooked and no longer pink. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
Spray the pan with the vegetable cooking oil, and add the bell peppers. Once they are soft, add the spinach and broccoli, cook for 2 minutes, and remove from the heat.
In a bowl, combine the black rice, cooked chicken, broccoli, bell peppers, spinach, and cashews. Toss gently and enjoy!

name: Chicken Chickpea Bowl

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with chili flakes, garlic powder, ground cumin, salt, and pepper.
Drain the chickpeas.
Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the ghee. Add the chicken and cook until fully cooked and lightly golden.
Add the chickpeas and cilantro to the pan, cook for 2 minutes, stirring gently
Serve in a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Salmon  Rolls

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Cut each rice paper sheet in half and set aside.
Lay the lettuce leaves flat on a clean surface. Spread cream cheese evenly over each leaf.
Place smoked salmon slices on top, and sprinkle with fresh dill.
Roll each lettuce leaf tightly.
Lightly moisten one piece of rice paper with some water. Place a lettuce roll in the center and wrap it gently and firmly.
Repeat with the remaining rolls.
Serve the rolls on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Persian Omelette
steps: In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and egg whites. Season with turmeric and a pinch of salt.
Halve the dates and remove the pits.
Preheat a nonstick pan on low heat and spray with vegetable oil. Pour in the egg mixture.
Add the dates and sprinkle feta cheese on top. Cover with a lid and cook on low heat until the top looks set.
Serve the omelette on a plate with the toasted bread and enjoy!

name: Italian Breakfast Bowl
steps: Prepare the ingredients: halve the cherry tomatoes and cut the prosciutto into small pieces.
Heat a nonstick pan on low heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the eggs sunny side up.
In a bowl, place the cooked farro as the base. Add the spinach, cherry tomatoes, and prosciutto.
Place the eggs on top, drizzle with pesto, and enjoy!

name: Breakfast Bagel Sandwich

ingredients.name: Bagels plain enriched with calcium propionate includes onion poppy sesame

steps: Chop the spinach.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with spinach. Season with salt, and pepper.
Heat a nonstick pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and pour in the egg mixture. Cook as an omelet, then fold in half and fold once more into quarters.
Toast the bagel.
Assemble the sandwich. Add the cheese, ham, and spinach omelet inside the bagel.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Cheesecake Jars
steps: In a food processor, add the cottage cheese, strawberries, and vanilla. Blend until smooth. Pour the mixture into a jar.
Place the chocolate in a small nonstick pan over low heat and melt gently, stirring until smooth. Pour the melted chocolate over the strawberry mix.
Chop the pistachios, and sprinkle the pieces on top.
Refrigerate overnight and enjoy the next morning.

name: Mexican Breakfast Tostada

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the pico de gallo, chop the onion and tomato, mince the jalapeño, place them in a small bowl, and combine well.
In a food processor, add the beans, a pinch of salt, and blend until smooth.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat a nonstick pan on low to medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the eggs until scrambled.
Microwave the tortillas in a single layer for 3 minutes, then let them cool slightly.
Assemble the tostadas, spread the beans on each tortilla, add the scrambled eggs, top with pico de gallo, and garnish with cilantro.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Sandwich with Grilled Veggies
steps: Prepare the ingredients: slice the red bell pepper, eggplant, and zucchini.
Heat a grill pan on low heat for  5 minutes. Place the vegetables and cook for 2 minutes per side. Remove from the pan.
Assemble the sandwich, spread pesto on each bread slice, add the cheese, and fill with the grilled vegetables.
Place the sandwich on the grill pan and toast for 2 minutes per side until golden and warm.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Egg Breakfast Toast

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Cut the bread slices and toast them.
Chiffonade the spinach.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat a nonstick pan, spray with vegetable oil, pour in the eggs, and cook, stirring gently with a spatula, until scrambled.
Spread cottage cheese over each slice of bread, add the spinach, top with scrambled eggs, and garnish with red pepper flakes.
Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Breakfast Wrap
steps: In a bowl, pour the egg whites, add a pinch of salt and garlic powder, and whisk with a fork.
Preheat a nonstick pan on low heat and spray with vegetable oil. Pour some of the egg whites to form an omelet, and add the spinach on top.
Cook until the top looks set, then flip and cook for a few seconds more. Repeat with the remaining mixture to make more omelets.
In a small plate, mash the avocado with a fork and season with salt.
Assemble the wraps, spread avocado over each omelet, then add the sprouts and quinoa
Roll carefully, place on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Breakfast Bowl
steps: Prepare the ingredients: drain the black beans, chop the tomatoes, and slice the avocado.
In a small bowl, make the pico de gallo by mixing the onion, tomato, and jalapeño.
Assemble the bowl, place the quinoa. Add the black beans, then the pico de gallo, and avocado slices.
Heat a pan on low heat, spray it with vegetable oil, and cook the egg sunny-side up. Place it on top of the bowl, and enjoy!

name: Ground Beef Breakfast Bowl
steps: Peel and chop the sweet potato. Place it in a pot with water and boil for 5 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain and place the sweet potato pieces in a bowl. Add the kale on one side.
Heat a pan on low heat. Add the ground beef, season with salt, garlic powder, and paprika. Cover with a lid and cook until the beef is brown. Place it into the bowl.
In the same pan, spray vegetable oil and cook the egg sunny-side up over low to medium heat. Place on top of the bowl.
Add the sliced avocado to the bowl, and enjoy!

name: Breakfast Pita
steps: Chop the spinach.
In a bowl, add the eggs, egg whites, salt, and pepper,  and whisk with a fork.
Heat a nonstick pan on low heat. Pour in the egg mixture and cook as scrambled eggs. Once the eggs begin to set, add the spinach and stir with a spatula.
Halve the pita, spread hummus inside each piece, then fill with the scrambled eggs. Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Apple Cinnamon Cottage Bowl
steps: Cut the apple into small cubes and place them in a bowl. Sprinkle with cinnamon and mix.
Heat a nonstick pan over low to medium heat, and spray with vegetable oil.
Add the apple and cook until soft. Turn off the heat, add the sweetener, and mix.
Place the cottage cheese in a glass or bowl, and top with some apples. Repeat the layers, and enjoy!

name: Greek Omelette

ingredients.name: Fat free feta cheese by athenos
Olives black canned small to extra large
Peppers sweet red canned solids and liquids

steps: Prepare the ingredients, slice the olives in half lengthwise. Drain and chop the red bell peppers.
Prepare the Greek salad. Place the bell peppers, black olives, red onion, chickpeas, feta cheese, and cucumber in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well until evenly combined.
In another bowl, add the eggs and egg whites. Add a pinch of salt, and whisk with a fork.
Heat a nonstick pan over low to medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and pour in the egg mixture. Cover with a lid and cook for 5 minutes until the top looks firm.
Place the omelette on a plate, fill one side with the Greek salad, add feta cheese, and fold it over. Spoon the rest of the salad on top.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Baked Egg Bowl
steps: In a bowl, add the eggs and cottage cheese. Add salt and pepper, then whisk with a fork.
Preheat the air fryer to 150°C for 5 minutes.
Pour the mixture into the air fryer container, add the spinach and red bell pepper pieces, and mix with a fork. Cook at 180°C for 10 minutes or until the mixture is completely firm.
While the eggs cook, halve the strawberries.
Insert a toothpick into the egg mixture to check if it’s ready. If it doesn’t come out clean, let it cook a little longer.
Once ready, serve on a plate with strawberries and enjoy!

name: Omelette With Smoked Salmon
steps: In a bowl,  place the eggs and egg whites, add salt and pepper, and whisk with a fork.
Heat a large pan over medium heat. Spray with vegetable oil and pour in the egg mixture. Cover with a lid and cook for 5 minutes.
Carefully flip the omelette. Place the red onion, arugula, smoked salmon, and capers over one half. Fold the opposite side over the filling and serve on a plate.
Toast the bread, add it to the plate, and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Chicken Bake
steps: Prepare the ingredients, halve the butternut squash, remove the seeds, and chop into small cubes. Chop the chicken breast into bite-size pieces.
Place the butternut squash in a pot, cover with water, and boil for 10 minutes or until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.
Cook the rice according to the package instructions and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 180°C for 5 minutes
In a baking dish, place the butternut squash, drizzle the olive oil, and combine. Add the cooked rice and chicken, then mix again.
Spread the warm cranberry mixture all over the dish and top with the almonds and dried cranberries. Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven, let it cool slightly, serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Rotisserie Chicken Bowl (High Protein)
steps: Place the chicken and corn in a bowl and mix well.
Next, combine the salad, chopped bacon, and strawberries.

name: Rotisserie Chicken Bowl (Low Carb)
steps: Place the chicken, corn, and cream cheese in a bowl and mix well.
Next, combine the salad, chopped bacon, and strawberries.

name: Cheeseburger Wrap
steps: Heat a pan on low heat, spray with vegetable oil, and add the ground beef is brown. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and cook until the beef changes color. Once ready, set aside.
Prepare the ingredients: halve the tomato, remove the seeds, and chop. Next, grate the cheese.
Microwave the tortilla for 10-15 seconds just to soften it.
Prepare the wrap. Place the lettuce on the tortilla, add the chopped tomato, cheese, and ground beef. Wrap carefully.

Storage Tip:
Avoid adding lettuce and make sure to remove the tomato seeds properly to prevent moisture from softening the tortilla. Wrap with aluminum foil, refrigerate the wrap for up to 5 days, and toast in a pan before eating for extra crispiness.

name: Edamame Avocado Salmon Sandwich
steps: Heat a non-stick pan over low to medium heat. Add the salmon, cover with a lid, and cook for 2–3 minutes. Carefully flip and cook for another 2 minutes. Set aside.
In a blender, combine the avocado and edamame. Season with salt and blend until smooth, creating a spread.
Toast the bread slices. Meanwhile, shred the salmon using two forks.
Place the avocado–edamame spread on one slice of bread, add the shredded salmon, and top with the alfalfa sprouts.
Close the sandwich, cut it in half, and enjoy.

name: Savory Sandwich
steps: Drain any excess liquid from the cottage cheese and press lightly with a fork.
Slice the red pepper and red onion. Heat a pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Toast the bread slices.
Halve the bread slices and prepare the sandwiches by adding the cottage cheese, bacon, red pepper, and red onion. Close and repeat with the rest
Serve and enjoy!

name: Quick Cajun Fish Tacos

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Heat a pan over medium-high heat.
Cut the fish fillet into medium-sized cubes. Transfer the cubes to a bowl, and add the oil, cajun seasoning, and salt to taste. Toss until well combined.
Add the fish to the pan and cook, turning gently, for 2-3 minutes or until just cooked through.

Warm the tortillas in the microwave or in a pan. Place the slaw in each tortilla. Top with the fish and pineapple. Add coriander leaves, and enjoy!
Option: add lime juice.

name: Beef Lettuce Taco
steps: Drain the black beans and corn.
Dice the tomatoes.
In a bowl, combine the black beans, corn, ground beef, and tomatoes. Season with salt and paprika, then mix well.
Place the lettuce leaves on a plate and fill each one with the beef mixture.
Garnish with fresh coriander and squeeze lime juice on top. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Cauliflower Garlic Rice

ingredients.name: Rice white medium grain dry uncooked

steps: Prepare the ingredients: finely mince the cauliflower and combine it with the uncooked rice.
Add the cauliflower rice mixture to a pot. Pour in the chicken broth, add a pinch of salt, and cook over low heat until the rice is soft and all the liquid has been absorbed.
Meanwhile, mince the garlic and blend it with the cottage cheese and water.
Once the rice is cooked, add the butter and stir gently. Then pour in the cottage cheese mixture and fold it in.
Remove from the heat and let it cook for the mixture thickens.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Protein Cookies

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Blend the rolled oats with pumpkin pie spice, cinnamon, baking soda, and vanilla protein powder. Serve in a bowl.
Blend the cottage cheese, pumpkin puree, egg, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet mixture into the bowl with the dry ingredients. Add the chocolate chips and mix until a dough forms.
Spoon small portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between each cookie.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the cookies are firm.
Remove from the oven, let them cool for a few minutes, and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Protein Balls

ingredients.name: Zero sugar maple syrup by simple truth

steps:
Use your fav plant-based protein. 
Mix all the ingredients, add 4 to 6 tbsp of water, roll into balls, and store in a covered container in the fridge.
Roll into balls, store  in a covered container in the fridge for

name: Carrot & Lentil Soup
steps: Soak the lentils overnight and drain them before cooking.
Prepare the ingredients: mince the onion and garlic, peel and finely chop the carrots.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, and cook for about 4 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Add the carrots and lentils to the pot, season lightly with salt, and cover with chicken broth. Let it simmer slowly for 40 minutes, adding a little more water if it starts to thicken.
Use a hand blender to puree the soup directly in the pot. Add more water for a lighter consistency.
Pour the soup into a bowl, garnish with Greek yogurt, and place the feta cheese on top.

name: Italian Lentil Stew
steps: Soak the lentils overnight in plenty of water. Drain them before cooking.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot, and sauté for 5 minutes until they soften.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper, mixing well.
Add the soaked lentils and broth, and combine.
Cook uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils absorb most of the liquid and the stew becomes thick. Add more broth if needed.
Serve, top with freshly grated Parmigiano, and enjoy!

name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Lentils
steps: Soak the lentils overnight and drain them before cooking.
In a pot, place the lentils, cover them with water, add a pinch of salt, and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside.
Prepare the ingredients: finely chop the red onion, mince the garlic, slice the sun-dried tomatoes, and chop the fresh basil.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, and sauté for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes, and cook for 2 minutes. Add the cooked lentils and basil. Pour in the vegetable broth. Mix well and simmer for 5 minutes to let the flavors combine.
Add the cheese and mix gently until creamy. Remove from the heat and pour in the Greek yogurt, and combine well.
Serve, garnish with basil leaves, and enjoy!

name: Risalamande

ingredients.name: Rice white short grain dry uncooked

steps: Place the rice and milk in a small pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until most of the milk has been absorbed, and the rice is completely tender.
In a blender, add the cottage cheese, yogurt, sweetener, and vanilla extract. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Halve the cherries.
In a bowl, add the rice, pour in the creamy mixture, and combine. Stir in some chopped almonds.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the texture to become thicker
Spoon into cups, top with cherries, and enjoy!

name: Glazed Tofu

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari

steps: Press the tofu to remove excess water. Place it on a clean surface. Poke small holes with a toothpick and make a light crosshatch pattern on both sides with a knife.

In a bowl, mix soy sauce, mustard, minced garlic, finely chopped onion, paprika, maple syrup, and nutritional yeast.
Put the tofu in a resealable bag or container, pour the marinade over it, cover, and place in the fridge for a few hours or overnight.

Preheat the oven to 190°C. Line a baking tray with parchment paper and spray lightly with vegetable cooking spray.
Place the tofu on the tray and press the whole cloves into some of the cuts on top. Bake for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the brown sugar with mustard, and add 2 teaspoons of the leftover marinade.

Take the tofu out of the oven and brush it with the glaze. Put it back in the oven for 10 minutes. 
Remove from the oven again, carefully take out the cloves with a fork, brush with more glaze, and bake for another 10 minutes, until the edges look golden and slightly crisp.
Place the asparagus on another tray, spray with vegetable cooking spray, and season with a little salt and black pepper. Bake for  10 minutes, until just tender.
Let the tofu rest for a few minutes, then slice. Serve with the roasted asparagus, share, and enjoy.

name: Artichoke Creamy Dip

ingredients.name: Spinach frozen chopped or leaf cooked boiled drained without salt

steps: Prepare the ingredients, drain the canned artichoke, and mince the garlic
In a pan over low heat, add the spinach, artichokes, garlic, cream cheese, mayonnaise, and Parmesan cheese.
Cook gently, stirring occasionally, until the cream cheese softens and becomes creamy. It does not need to melt completely, just enough to combine well.
Place the mix into a bowl or serving plate.
Serve with the bread slices, share, and enjoy!

name: Golden Cabbage Soup With Chicken

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the parsley, red peppers, celery, and onion. Dice the Portobello mushroom into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the ginger and chicken pieces, sprinkle with the curry powder, and cook for two minutes.
Add the cabbage, carrots, potatoes, and zucchini, and pour in the chicken broth. Season with salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and cook for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables and chicken are tender.
Turn off the heat and stir in the coriander.
Serve in bowls, and enjoy!

name: Mushroom and Lentil Soup
steps: Soak the lentils in water overnight. Drain them the next morning.
Prepare the ingredients: chop the parsley, red peppers, celery, and onion. Dice the Portobello mushroom into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add onion, celery, and red peppers, and cook until slightly softened.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, mushrooms, vegetable broth, lentils, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper.  Add Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, add the parsley, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the soup thickens and the vegetables are tender.
Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Creamy Cod With Potatoes

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Peel and chop the potatoes, place the pieces in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and combine well.
Spread the potatoes on a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden.
Mince the garlic and chop the shallot.
In a pan, melt the butter over low heat. Add the garlic and shallots, and cook until the shallots are soft.
Stir in the mustard, lemon zest, lemon juice, rosemary, sour cream, salt, and pepper.
Add 1/3 cup of water and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened.

Remove the baking dish from the oven, make a space in the center, and add the cod and rosemary. Pour the creamy mixture over the fish and return to the oven for 10 minutes, or until the cod is fully cooked and flakes easily.
Serve, garnish with rosemary, and enjoy!

name: Ricotta Prosciutto Toast

ingredients.name: Lemon raw
ingredients.unit: wedge or slice (1/8 of one 2-1/8" dia lemon)

steps: Place the frozen mixed berries in a small pot over medium heat. Allow them to melt and release some liquid. Mash gently with a spatula, then stir in the chia seeds and half of the lemon zest. Cook until it thickens. Remove from the heat and let it sit to set.
Slice the sourdough bread and toast until golden
Spread the ricotta cheese over each toast
Add the prosciutto, berry chia jam.
Drizzle olive oil on each slice and top with lemon zest.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Creamy Corn Casserole
steps: In a food processor, blend the Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, eggs, oat flour, and baking powder until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish. Add the drained corn, chicken, and half of the cheddar and white cheese. Stir gently to combine.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese and white cheese over the top.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes, or until lightly golden and set in the center.
Cool slightly before serving. Enjoy!

name: Cranberry Salmon Bites
steps: Chop the salmon into bite-size pieces.
In a bowl, combine the panko, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Coat the salmon pieces evenly with the mixture.

Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Place the coated salmon in the basket and air fry for 15 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a small pan and cook the cranberries over low heat until very soft. Mash lightly with a fork. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the olive oil and honey to the mashed cranberries and stir to combine.
Place the cooked salmon in the bowl and toss to coat with the cranberry dressing.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Tomato Shrimp Soup

ingredients.name: Shrimp raw frozen medium peeled and deveined tail off

steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the red onion and green pepper. Mince the garlic and fennel
Heat a pot over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the onion, bell pepper, fennel, and garlic, and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the tomato paste, paprika, flour, and a pinch of salt. Mix well and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes and chicken broth, stir, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until they turn pink and firm.
Turn off the heat and stir in the sugar.
Serve the soup in bowls and top with feta cheese and minced parsley. Enjoy!

name: Apple Cinnamon Cheese Bake

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and lightly spray a baking dish with vegetable oil.
Peel and dice the apple into small cubes.
In a food processor, add the eggs, maple syrup, vanilla, and cottage cheese. Blend until smooth.
Add the rolled oats, cinnamon, and baking powder. Blend again to combine.
Pour the mixture into the baking dish and add the apple pieces, spreading them around evenly. Press them down gently so they are lightly coated.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden.
Let it cool slightly, then sprinkle extra cinnamon on top.
Slice, share, and enjoy!

name: Sweet Chicken and Butternut Bake
steps: Chop the chicken and squash into small bite-sized pieces.
Place the squash in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and cook until fork-tender, then drain and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
In a baking casserole, add the rice, chicken, cooked squash, cranberries, and almonds. Season with salt, drizzle the maple syrup, and combine well.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until it's slightly golden.
Remove from the oven, let it cool slightly. Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Pomegranate Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Sesame seed kernels (shelled) toasted without salt
Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods
Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat and fat raw

steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Line a baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
In a bowl, combine the Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, canola oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well.
Cut the pork into pieces if needed. Add the pork to the marinade and toss until fully coated. Let it sit for at least 10 minutes.
Place the marinated pork pieces in the prepared baking dish, leaving some space between pieces.
Bake for 40 minutes, turning the pieces halfway through, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine the pomegranate arils, honey, sesame seeds, and chopped parsley.
Once the pork is cooked, add it to the pomegranate mixture and toss until well coated.
Place the pork on a serving plate, and enjoy!

name: Salmon Bruschetta

ingredients.name: Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods
Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Slice the bread into small pieces.
Grate the garlic and mix it with the cream cheese, half of the lemon zest, and half of the dill. Stir until smooth.
Spread the seasoned cream cheese on each slice of bread.
Arrange the bread on a large plate, forming a crown.
Add pieces of smoked salmon on top, then add the pomegranate arils over the bruschetta.
Sprinkle the remaining lemon zest and dill.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Pea Salad With Bacon

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Green peas frozen boiled without salt

steps: Defrost the green peas and drain the excess water.
Chop the bacon into small pieces, the red onion, and the cheddar cheese.
In a bowl, mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, salt, and pepper.
Add the green peas, bacon, cheese, and red onion to the bowl and combine well.
Serve chilled and enjoy!

name: Edamame Kale Salad
steps:
Prepare the ingredients, defrost the edamame, and warm it slightly.
Chop the tofu into small bite-sized pieces.

In a bowl, place the kale, cabbage, edamame, quinoa, and tofu.
Sprinkle salt and combine well.
Drizzle the tahini on top, and mix. Serve and enjoy!

name: Broccoli Bacon Salad

ingredients.name: Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the broccoli and pork into small pieces, and dice the bacon. Halve the date, remove the pit, and mince it.
Heat a pan over low heat and cook the bacon until it starts to release fat. Add the pork pieces and cook until golden.
Stir in the date and broccoli, season with salt and garlic powder, and combine well.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy.

name: Festive Smoked Salmon Crown
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Thinly slice the fennel, shallots, radishes, and cucumber. Place the avocado in a bowl and mash with a fork, add salt and pepper.
Arrange the salad in a large plate, leaving a space in the center. Spread the avocado and add the remaining ingredients on top. Adjust the shape with your hands
Slice the bread and serve it on the side.
Share and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Edamame Bowl

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari

steps: Defrost the edamame and cut the tofu into small cubes.

Place the edamame and tofu in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle the garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Add the cranberries and feta cheese, combine gently, and enjoy.

name: Cheesy Green Casserole

ingredients.name: Soup cream of mushroom canned, condensed
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Toast slices of bread until golden, then cut into small pieces to make croutons.
In a baking dish, add the green beans, edamame, white cheese, cheddar cheese, and cream of mushroom soup. Season with salt, garlic powder, and pepper, and combine well.
Add the croutons and mix gently to coat.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake at 180°C  for 35 minutes.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Sourdough Stuffing
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C
Prepare the ingredients, chop the celery and onion, slice the mushrooms, and mince the garlic.
Toast the bread until golden, then cut into small pieces. Set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, thyme, and rosemary. Set aside.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Add the garlic, onion, and celery, and cook for 2 minutes. Add the pork sausage, break it apart with a spatula, and cook until it changes color. Turn off the heat and set aside.
In a baking dish, add the sourdough pieces, mushrooms, cheese, the cooked sausage, the egg mixture, and the chicken broth. Combine well to make sure all the bread is moistened.
Bake at 180°C for 50 minutes, or until the top is golden and crispy.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Carrot Protein Bites
steps: Prepare the ingredients: grate the carrots, chop the raisins, and blend the cottage cheese with milk until smooth.
In a bowl, mix the almond flour, oat flour, cinnamon, and vanilla protein powder.
Add the cottage cheese, grated carrots, and raisins. Stir until you get a creamy, thick mixture.
Shape the mix into bite-sized pieces with your hands. (dry hands)
Once ready, shape the mix into bite-sized pieces with your hands.
Place them on a plate, share, and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
steps: Rinse the quinoa a couple of times, then cook it according to the package instructions, using the chicken broth instead of water.
Chop the carrot and onion.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cabbage head and cook until the outer leaves begin to soften.
Remove the cabbage to a cutting board and gently separate the leaves. Return the head to the pot if needed to soften more leaves.
Heat the olive oil in a pan. Add the onion and carrot, and cook until softened.

Stir in the marinara sauce and ground turkey, season with salt and pepper, and cook over low to medium heat for about 30 minutes, breaking the meat apart with a spatula, until it changes color and absorbs some of the sauce.
Remove from the heat and allow it to cool slightly.
Place a cabbage leaf on a plate. Add a small portion of the quinoa and meat mixture in the center. Fold the sides over, then roll it tightly. Wrap again with a second leaf.
Prepare the remaining cabbage rolls.
Arrange the rolls in a baking dish, pour any remaining sauce on top, and bake for 15 minutes until the leaves are fully tender, watching carefully to avoid overcooking.
Serve warm, garnish with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Bean Soup With Ground Turkey
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes and the ground turkey, break it apart with a spatula, and cook until it changes color completely.
Add the spinach, oregano, and pinto beans. Season with salt and pepper, and pour in 2 cups of water,
Simmer for 5  minutes to allow the flavors to combine.
Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Cabbage Soup With Ground Beef
steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the cabbage, onion, and tomatoes. Peel and chop the carrots, and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the garlic, onion, and carrots and cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tomatoes, ground beef, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking up the meat with a spatula, until it’s fully browned.
Stir in the rice, cabbage, and beef broth. Add the Italian seasoning and combine well. Bring to a gentle simmer, reduce the heat, and cook for 10 minutes or until the cabbage is soft.
Serve in a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Potato Soup With Chicken and Bacon

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients: Peel and chop the potato and carrot, chop the celery, onion, and chicken.
Heat a pot over medium heat and cook the bacon until golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add the carrot, onion, and celery. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the potatoes, salt, Italian seasoning, and pour in the chicken broth. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Stir in the chicken, mustard, and spinach. Cook for 5 more minutes. Add the bacon back to the pot and mix again.
Pour the soup into a bowl, serve warm, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Bean Soup With Chorizo

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Chop the onion. Heat a pan over low to medium heat. Add the chorizo and break it apart with a spatula. Cook for a few minutes until it starts to brown.
Stir in the onion, combine well, and cook until soft.
Add the pinto beans, milk, and vegetable broth. Season with salt and combine well. Bring to a gentle boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve the soup in a bowl. Add the sour cream on top, garnish with cilantro, and enjoy!

name: Mexican Black Bean Soup
steps: Prepare the ingredients chop the onion, tomatoes, and bacon, and drain the corn.
Heat a pan over low to medium heat. Add the bacon and cook until it releases some fat. Stir in the onion and cook for 2 minutes.

Add the tomatoes and ground beef, season with salt and pepper, and pour in about 2 cups of vegetable broth. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then reduce the heat and cook for 5 more minutes, until the beef is no longer pink.
Add the corn and pinto beans without draining them. Stir well and let the soup rest for a couple of minutes
Serve in a bowl and top with the sour cream. Garnish with cilantro on top.

name: Hearty Pumpkin Soup

ingredients.name: Pumpkin seeds whole with shell roasted with salt

steps: Prepare the ingredients: peel and chop the pumpkin, dice the onion, mince the garlic, chop the kale, and slice the bacon.
Heat a pot over medium heat. Add the bacon and cook until it begins to release some fat. Stir in the garlic and onion and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook on medium heat until it changes color, breaking it apart with a spatula.
Add the pumpkin pieces, season with a pinch of salt and pepper, and pour in the vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low–medium heat and cook until the pumpkin is fork-tender.
Stir in the kale and cook for 2 more minutes until it softens.
Serve in bowls and sprinkle pumpkin seeds on top, and enjoy!

name: Bacon & Chicken Comfort Soup

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw
Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the bacon, onion, and dill.  Mince the garlic. Peel and dice the potato and carrot into small cubes. Chop the chicken breast and set aside.

Heat a pot over medium heat and cook the bacon until it releases some fat. Add the garlic and onion and cook for a couple of minutes. Stir in the carrot and potato, season with salt and pepper, and pour in enough water to fully cover the vegetables.
Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then reduce to low–medium heat and cook until the vegetables are fork-tender.
Add the chicken breast and cream cheese, stirring until the cream cheese has melted and blended into the broth.
Add the spinach, mix gently. Turn off the heat and sprinkle the dill on top.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Turkey Bake

ingredients.name: Turkey breast meat only cooked roasted

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C
Peel and dice the sweet potatoes. Chop the onion, dice the chicken, and mince the garlic.
Place the sweet potatoes in a pot, cover with water, and boil until fork-tender. Drain and transfer to a large bowl.
In a pan over low heat, melt the butter. Add the onion, garlic, and thyme, and cook until fragrant.
Mash the sweet potatoes, then add the butter mixture and the milk. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix until creamy.
Fold in the turkey breast pieces, then transfer everything to a baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes, until it's lightly golden on top.
Remove from the oven. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Feta Turkey Meatballs

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C
Finely chop the red onion and mince the dill.
In a bowl, combine the ground turkey, egg, feta cheese, breadcrumbs, red onion, cranberries, and dill. Season with salt and pepper, and mix until well combined.
Shape the mixture into meatballs using your hands.
Line a baking dish with parchment paper, place the meatballs on top, and bake for 40 minutes, or until fully cooked.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Feta, Cranberry Chickpea Salad
steps: Drain the chickpeas and chop the turkey breast and fennel.
In a bowl, combine the chickpeas, cranberries, turkey breast, and fennel.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, sprinkle with feta cheese, and gently toss.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Butternut Squash

ingredients.name: Pumpkin seed kernels (shelled) roasted with salt

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Slice the butternut squash in half lengthwise, remove the seeds, and place it cut-side down on a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes, or until soft.
Chiffonade the kale and finely chop the tofu to create small crumbles.
Once the squash is cooked, scoop out a bit of the center and place it in a bowl.
Add the quinoa, tofu crumbles, kale, and maple to the bowl. Mix gently to combine.
Spoon the mixture back into the squash halves. Sprinkle the pumpkin seeds on top.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Holiday Potato Toast

ingredients.name: Turkey breast meat only cooked roasted
Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C for 10 minutes
Meanwhile, halve the potatoes and place them cut-side down on a baking dish. Bake for  30 minutes, or until tender.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and scoop out some of the flesh from each half. Place it in a bowl.
Add butter to the bowl, and mash with a fork. Stir in the turkey and mix well until combined.
Fill each potato half with the mixture, then sprinkle the cheese on top. Return to the oven for 5 minutes, just until the cheese melts slightly.
Turn off the oven, remove the potatoes, and place them on a serving plate. Top each piece with cranberry sauce and garnish with green onion or rosemary
Share, and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Skewers
steps: Cut the pineapple into bite-size pieces.
Place a slice of cheese on top of each piece, then wrap each piece in prosciutto.
Secure with a toothpick and garnish with fresh thyme.

name: Creamy Holiday Spread

ingredients.name: Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods

steps: Prepare the ingredients, mince the rosemary and bacon. Slice the bread,
On a plate, mix the pomegranate arils, rosemary, and bacon. Place the cream cheese block on top, then press gently so the mixture sticks to the surface.
Carefully flip the cream cheese and roll it over the mixture to coat it thoroughly on all sides. Press lightly.
Place the holiday spread on a plate, add the bread slices, and drizzle with olive oil and maple syrup.
Share and enjoy!

name: Holiday Leftover Wrap
steps: Shred or finely chop the turkey breast.
Place the tortilla on a flat surface and spread the cranberry sauce.
Add the brie cheese along one side of the tortilla and press gently.
Top with the arugula and the turkey.
Wrap it tightly.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and toast the wrap on one side until lightly golden. Flip and toast the other side until crisp.
Remove from the pan, halve it, and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Bites

ingredients.name: Lemon raw
ingredients.unit: wedge or slice (1/8 of one 2-1/8" dia lemon)

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic, and onion powder.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spoon the mixture, forming small patties.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until firm and lightly golden.
Meanwhile,  prepare the dip. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, mayo, Dijon mustard, and a squeeze of lemon. Stir until creamy.
Serve the quinoa bites, share, and enjoy!

name: Greek Artichoke Casserole

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids
Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Cook the orzo according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Drain the artichoke hearts, tuna, and black olives.
In an oven-safe dish, combine the cooked orzo, artichokes, tuna, red peppers, and black olives. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs, then pour them over the mixture in the baking dish. Stir gently to coat everything.
Sprinkle the feta cheese on top, bake for 30 minutes, or until set and lightly golden on top.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Comfort Turkey Noodle Soup

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the carrots, salt, and the vegetable broth. Cook until the carrots are soft.
Meanwhile, shred the turkey breast.
Add the turkey, and cooked pasta. Stir gently and simmer for 2 minutes to warm everything through.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprouts Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C
Prepare the ingredients. Halve the Brussels sprouts, finely chop the onion, and mince the garlic.
Add the Brussels sprouts to a pot, cover with water, add a pinch of salt, and cook until they are just tender. Drain well and set aside.
In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic. Cook until soft and translucent, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion and garlic. Stir continuously for about 2 minutes.
Blend the cottage cheese, then add it to the pan and stir until creamy. Add salt and pepper.
Place the Brussels sprouts in a baking dish and pour the cottage cheese sauce over them.
Bake for 20 minutes, until hot and slightly golden on top. Let it cool down slightly.
Serve, share, and enjoy

name: Ground Chicken and Sweet Brussels Sprouts (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Frozen petite brussel sprouts by woodstock

steps: In a nonstick pan, cook the chicken with salt and pepper to taste. Once ready, set aside.
Next, cook the carrots. Once the carrots are soft, stir in the Brussels sprouts, and complete by adding honey, balsamic vinegar and combine.
Assemble the bowl, add the chicken, Brussels sprouts, and carrots.

name: Ground Chicken and Sweet Brussels Sprouts (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Frozen petite brussel sprouts by woodstock

steps: In a nonstick pan, cook the chicken with salt and pepper to taste. Once ready, set aside.
Next, cook the carrots. Once the carrots are soft, stir in the Brussels sprouts, and complete by adding honey, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, and combine.
Assemble the bowl, add the chicken, Brussels sprouts, and carrots.

name: Ground Chicken and Sweet Brussels Sprouts (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Frozen petite brussel sprouts by woodstock

steps: In a nonstick pan, cook the chicken with salt and pepper to taste. Once ready, set aside.
Next, cook the carrots. Once the carrots are soft, stir in the Brussels sprouts, and complete by adding honey, balsamic vinegar and combine.
Assemble the bowl, add the chicken, Brussels sprouts, and carrots.

name: Pumpkin Chili

ingredients.name: Cannellini or white kidney beans canned

steps: Prepare all the vegetables. Peel and chop the carrots, chop the onion and celery, and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over low to medium heat. Add the onion and cook until it starts to soften. Stir in the carrots and celery and cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the ground beef, paprika, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking up the meat with a spatula, until it is no longer pink and lightly browned.
Add the peanut butter, beans, pumpkin purée, and thyme. Stir well until everything is evenly combined.
Pour in the chicken broth, mix again, then cover the pot. Cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add more water for a lighter consistency.
Serve in bowls, share, and enjoy!

name: Winter Lentils With Sausage
steps: Prepare the ingredients: dice the onion, mince the garlic, peel and chop the carrots, chop the kale, and slice the sausage into rounds.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, and carrots, and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, lentils, and chicken broth. Season with salt and pepper, and add the rosemary sprigs.
Cover and cook over low to medium heat for 50 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Once the lentils are ready, stir in the sausage and kale, cover the pot, and let the kale soften. Once tender, mix well.
Serve, share and enjoy!

name: Creamy Zucchini Rice

ingredients.name: Rice white short grain dry uncooked

steps: Prepare the ingredients: grate the zucchini, chiffonade the spinach, and mince the garlic.
Heat a pan and melt the butter. Add the garlic and zucchini, and cook for 4 minutes. Add the spinach and mix until everything softens.
Transfer the cooked vegetables to a blender, add the cottage cheese and a pinch of salt, and blend until completely smooth.
Cook the rice according to package instructions. Once it begins to soften, pour in the zucchini-cottage cheese mixture and stir for 2 minutes until creamy and well combined.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Creamy Butternut Squash Pasta

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the butternut squash and remove the seeds, mince the garlic, and slice the Italian sausage.
Place the butternut squash in a pot, cover with water, and boil until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and cook the sliced sausage until lightly browned.
In a blender, add the cottage cheese, butternut squash, garlic, and a pinch of salt. Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Place the cooked pasta in a pot over low heat. Pour in the creamy squash mixture and stir gently until the pasta is fully coated.
Add the sausage and combine.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Cauliflower Pumpkin Casserole
steps: Prepare the ingredients: mince the onion and cut the cauliflower into small florets.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Boil the cauliflower florets for 10 minutes, or until lightly tender. Drain and set aside.
Melt the butter in a pot. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle in the flour and whisk for 1 minute. Slowly pour in the milk, stirring constantly until the sauce begins to thicken.
Add the pumpkin purée, paprika, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Mix well, fold in half of the shredded cheese until it’s fully melted and smooth.
Place the cooked cauliflower in a baking dish and drizzle with the olive oil. Pour the pumpkin cheese sauce over the cauliflower and mix gently to coat.
Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top.
Bake for 25 minutes, cool slightly. Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Mousse

ingredients.name: Nuts mixed dry roasted with peanuts salt added

steps: Add the cream cheese, pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice, sugar-free syrup, and vanilla whey protein powder to a blender. Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Transfer the mousse to small cups and refrigerate for 15 minutes to thicken slightly.
Chop the mixed nuts and garnish each cup by sprinkling them on top

name: Pumpkin and Sweet Potato Soup With Chicken
steps: Prepare the ingredients: peel and chop the sweet potato, dice the onion, and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, and cook for a few minutes until fragrant.
Add the sweet potato, paprika, a pinch of salt, and the chicken broth. Cook over medium heat until the sweet potato is fork-tender.
Meanwhile, chop the grilled chicken breast into small bites and set aside.
Once the sweet potato is ready, stir in the pumpkin purée and the Greek yogurt. Use a hand blender to puree the soup directly in the pot, or blend in batches using a regular blender.
Add the chopped chicken and combine.
Pour the soup into bowls. Sprinkle the feta cheese and garnish with pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Egg Pie
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180 °C for 5 minutes.
In a food processor, add all the ingredients and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into an air fryer mold and cook for 35 minutes, or until fully set. Use a toothpick to check if it comes out clean, it’s ready.
Remove from the air fryer and let it cool slightly before serving.
Slice, share, and enjoy!

name: Braciole

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Finely mince the garlic and chop the parsley.
Add the bread crumbs to a bowl, then add the Parmesan cheese, parsley, and a pinch of salt. Stir until the mixture is evenly combined.
Lay the beef flank steak flat on a cutting board. If the meat is too thick, either slice it open to create a thinner layer or gently pound it with a meat mallet to even it out.
Spread the breadcrumb mixture over the surface.
Roll the steak tightly, and secure it with a toothpick. Repeat the process.
Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and crushed tomatoes, and bring the mixture to a simmer for a few minutes.
Add the braciole to the pan, and place the lid on. Cook on low heat for 40 minutes, or until the meat is ready.
Once the braciole are done, remove the toothpicks and slice them into rounds on a cutting board.
Serve the braciole in bowls, spoon the tomato sauce over each, garnish with parsley, and enjoy!

name: Butternut Chickpea Soup
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the butternut squash into small cubes, dice the onion, mince the garlic, and drain the chickpeas.
In a pot, place the butternut squash pieces, cover them completely with water, add a pinch of salt, and cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes, or until fork-tender.
In another pot, heat the olive oil over low to medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, and sauté for 2–3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cooked butternut squash, chickpeas, paprika, salt, and the vegetable broth. Stir well and let it simmer for a few minutes.
Use a hand blender to combine everything until smooth and slightly thick. Add a bit of the cooking water to adjust the consistency.
Tip: If using a blender, blend in batches and avoid filling it to the top to keep hot liquids from pushing up.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and mix gently with a spatula until creamy.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Harvest Tortilla Quiche
steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the pumpkin into small cubes, and drain the chickpeas.
Place the pumpkin pieces in a pot, cover with water, and cook for 5 minutes. Drain well.
Preheat the air fryer to 180 °C for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and the garlic powder. Add the cottage cheese and mix until smooth.
Line the air fryer mold with a tortilla, pressing it gently to form the base.
Add the pumpkin cubes and chickpeas over the tortilla, then pour in the egg mixture. Gently stir to combine.
Cook for 15–20 minutes, or until it's fully set.
Let it cool slightly, remove from the baking pan, and enjoy!

name: Savory Squash Tortilla Quiche
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180 °C for 5 minutes.
Prepare the ingredients, chop the squash, dice the onion, and chop the Swiss chard
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and the garlic powder. Add the cottage cheese and mix until smooth.
Line an air fryer mold with a tortilla, pressing it gently to form the base.
Add the Swiss chard and squash pieces, then pour in the egg mixture.
Cook for 25 minutes, or until it's fully set.
Let it cool slightly, remove from the baking pan, and enjoy!

name: Savory Beef & Kale Tart
steps: In a bowl, combine the flour, a pinch of salt, and melted butter. Add a few tablespoons of cold water and mix until a dough forms. Shape it into a ball, cover, and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic, and cook until fragrant. Stir in the kale and sauté until slightly wilted. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the ground beef over low to medium heat until browned. Season with salt and pepper. Break it into small pieces with a spatula.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs and mix in the ricotta cheese. Add the cooked kale and ground beef, and stir until fully combined.
Roll out the dough and place it into a tart pan or baking dish. Pour the filling over the crust and spread it evenly.
Bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes, or until the filling is set. Let cool slightly before slicing.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Rustic Meat Pie

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the kale and shred the Swiss cheese. Peel and grate the potatoes.
Heat a nonstick pan over low heat and cook the ground beef until it changes color.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Add the shredded potatoes, kale, the cooked ground beef, and some cheese. Mix until everything is well combined.
Line a baking dish with parchment paper. Pour the mixture inside and spread evenly. Top with the remaining Swiss cheese.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes. Once ready, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Cut into portions, share, and enjoy!

name: Winter Baked Bites

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a small baking tray with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the cottage cheese, rolled oats, applesauce, egg, cinnamon, honey, baking powder, and shredded coconut. Mix until everything is well combined.
Use a spoon or your hands to form small mounds of the mixture and place them on the baking tray.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the bites look lightly golden on top.
Let them cool for a few minutes, then serve and enjoy!

name: Potato Cream

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Peel and dice the potatoes, chop the onion, and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, and sauté until soft and fragrant.
Add the potatoes and pour in the chicken broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and cook until the potatoes are very tender.
Turn off the heat. Using an immersion blender, blend the soup until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and Swiss cheese, mixing until fully melted and combined. Add salt and pepper.
Serve, and enjoy!

name: Crunch & Sweet Chicken Bowl

ingredients.name: Lemon raw
ingredients.unit: wedge or slice (1/8 of one 2-1/8" dia lemon)

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the broccoli and kale, shred the chicken breast, and dice the dates.
In a large bowl, combine the quinoa, broccoli, kale, chicken, and dates.
In a small bowl, squeeze the lemon juice and whisk with the olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Drizzle the dressing over the salad and combine.
Add the almonds on top. Share. and enjoy!

name: Crustless Pumpkin Cheesecake

ingredients.name: Nuts mixed dry roasted with peanuts salt added

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C for 10 minutes.
Mince the mixed nuts and blend the rest of the ingredients until smooth.
Line a baking dish with parchment paper, then pour in the mix. Garnish with mixed nuts in the center.
Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Allow to cool down slightly. Slice, share, and enjoy!

name: Creamed Peas With Chicken

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice
Green peas frozen boiled without salt

steps: Heat a saucepan over medium heat and melt the butter.
Pour in the milk, rice flour, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir continuously for 5 minutes or until the mixture thickens into a creamy sauce.
Add the green peas and stir to combine.
Stir in the chicken and cheese. Mix until the cheese is fully melted, and turn off the heat.
Serve, sprinkle the chilli flakes, and enjoy!

name: Cozy Butternut Squash Chicken Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients, peel and chop the butternut squash, shred or dice the chicken, chop the apple and walnuts, and mince the red onion.

Preheat the air fryer at 180 °C for 5 minutes. Add the butternut squash pieces, lightly spray them with vegetable oil, sprinkle with salt, and cook for 15 minutes or until fork-tender. Let cool slightly.
In a large bowl, combine the mustard, Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, and red onion. Stir until smooth.
Add the chicken, apple, cranberries, walnuts, and roasted butternut squash. Gently toss until everything is well coated.
Serve, share and enjoy!

name: Sformato di Melanzane
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Halve the eggplants, place them in a baking dish, and bake for 45 minutes, until soft and tender.
Using a fork, scoop out the flesh of the eggplant it should come out easily. Transfer the flesh to a food processor, add the garlic, eggs, ricotta, salt, and pepper, and blend until smooth.
Line a baking dish with parchment paper and pour in the eggplant mixture.
Bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes, or until the surface is slightly firm.
Meanwhile, halve the cherry tomatoes, remove the dish from the oven, gently press the tomato halves on top of the Sformato, and return it to the oven for another 10 minutes.
Let it cool slightly before serving, and enjoy!

name: Butter Squash, Ground Turkey and Rice Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Halve the butternut squash, remove the seeds, and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Place the squash pieces in a pot, cover with water, and boil for 10–15 minutes until lightly soft. Drain and set aside.
Lightly spray a baking dish with vegetable oil. Add the wild rice, squash pieces, and ground turkey. Season with salt and garlic powder.
Spoon small amounts of butter around the dish, pour in the chicken broth, and sprinkle the Swiss cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the top looks lightly toasted.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly, and enjoy!

name: Turkey Wild Rice Stuffing
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Prepare the ingredients: shred the turkey breast or chop it into small pieces. Drain and halve the mushrooms.
Lightly spray a baking dish with vegetable oil. Add the rice, turkey, and mushrooms. Season with salt and garlic powder and combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth and milk. Pour the mixture into the baking dish and stir gently to combine. Spread the cheese all over the dish.
Top with the blanched almonds and bake for 20 minutes, or until the top looks slightly toasted. Let it rest for a few minutes, serve, and enjoy!

name: Tuscan Winter Salad

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large
Lemon raw
ingredients.unit: wedge or slice (1/8 of one 2-1/8" dia lemon)

steps: Prepare all the ingredients: shred the chicken breast using two forks, chiffonade the spinach, mince the sun-dried tomatoes, chop the red onion, and halve the black olives.
Prepare all the ingredients: shred the chicken breast using two forks, chiffonade the spinach, mince the sun-dried tomatoes, chop the red onion, and halve the black olives.
Drizzle with olive oil, squeeze the lemon juice over the salad, and season with salt and pepper. Toss gently to combine.
Complete with the sourdough bread slices, and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Bake With Chicken
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Prepare all the ingredients, chop the cauliflower into small bites, dice the chicken breast, halve and pit the dates, and mince the garlic and chives.
Lightly spray a baking dish with vegetable oil. Add the cauliflower, chickpeas, pine nuts, and dates. Season with a pinch of salt and paprika, then toss to combine.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the cauliflower is fork-tender. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the cauliflower is fork-tender. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Transfer the cauliflower bake to a serving plate, drizzle with the yogurt sauce, and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Chicken Breast With Brie & Apple
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Slice the apple and chop the brie cheese. Cut the chicken breast open to make a pocket for the filling
In a small bowl, whisk together the honey and Dijon mustard until smooth. Set aside.
Fill each chicken breast with apple and brie.
Place the filled chicken breast in a baking dish and drizzle the honey mustard mixture over it. Bake for 25 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes, serve and enjoy!

name: Orange Rice Chicken Casserole
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C
Shred the chicken.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked wild rice, orange juice, cranberries, sour cream, and chicken. Season with salt and pepper.

Lightly spray a baking dish with vegetable oil. Transfer the mixture into the dish and bake for 20 minutes. Halfway through, check the texture, sprinkle the feta cheese on top, and continue baking until fully heated.
Remove from the oven, let rest for a few minutes. Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Pumpkin With Greek Yogurt Dip
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the pumpkin into medium cubes and place them on the tray. Spray with vegetable oil, season with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast for 30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the pumpkin is tender.
Meanwhile, in a pan over low heat, lightly toast the pine nuts until golden. Set aside. Next, toast the chickpeas for 5 minutes and set aside.
Mince the garlic, place it in a bowl, and combine it with the Greek yogurt and half of the parsley. Mix well.
Place the pumpkin pieces on a plate. Add spoonfuls of the Greek yogurt around the plate. Top with the chickpeas and pine nuts. Sprinkle a dash of paprika on top.

name: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C
Peel and thinly slice the potatoes.
In a blender, combine the cottage cheese, chicken broth, garlic, onion powder, thyme, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Spray the baking dish with vegetable oil. Arrange a layer of potato slices, then pour some of the cottage cheese mixture over them. Repeat the layers.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the top is golden and potatoes are tender.
Serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Turkey Wild Rice

ingredients.name: Turkey breast meat only cooked roasted
Soup cream of mushroom canned condensed reduced sodium
Soup cream of chicken canned condensed

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C
Chop the turkey breast into bite-size pieces, and mince the garlic.
In a saucepan, cook the wild rice according to package instructions. Set aside.
In a pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the garlic, onion, celery, and mushrooms; sauté until the vegetables are soft.
Stir in the mushroom soup, chicken soup, paprika, nutmeg, and salt and pepper. Mix well, then add the turkey breast.
In a baking dish, combine the turkey mixture with the wild rice. Sprinkle the Swiss cheese on top.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed. The texture should be creamy and thick.
Remove from the oven, let it rest for a few minutes, serve, share, and enjoy!

name: Minestrone Soup With Chicken
steps: Dice the onion, celery, and peel and chop the carrot.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and carrot, and sauté for 5 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and add enough water to cover everything. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Add the pasta and chicken breast to the pot. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente and the chicken turns white.  Add more water if needed to keep everything covered.
Once the chicken is fully cooked and white, remove it from the pot, place it on a cutting board, and dice it into small pieces. Return the chicken to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the cooked beans and mix well.
Turn off the heat, serve hot in bowls, and enjoy!

name: Sweet Carrot Crepes

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Peel and grate the carrot.
In a food processor, add the egg, egg whites, grated carrot, rolled oats, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.

Preheat a large pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and pour in a portion of the batter. Cook on low heat until the top looks set, flip and cook the other side, and set aside. Repeat the process until all the batter is used up.
Place the crepes on a plate.
In a bowl, mix the yogurt with the cream cheese until smooth. Spread the mixture over each crepe, then fold each crepe into a triangle.
Serve on a plate, sprinkle with cinnamon, drizzle with honey, and enjoy!

name: Ginger Cinnamon Roll Ups
steps: In a blender, add the oat flour, egg, egg whites, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and ginger. Blend until smooth.

Preheat a pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and pour in a portion of the batter.  Spread it around the pan, and cook on low heat until the top looks firm, flip, and cook the other side. Repeat the process with the rest of the batter and place them on a plate
Finely chop the apple. In the same pan, melt the butter, add the cinnamon, and then add the apple pieces. Cook over low heat until softened.
Prepare the roll-ups. In each base, add the apple, and roll them up tightly. Place some apple filling on each crepe,  and roll them up tightly. Serve on a plate and drizzle the maple.

name: Gingerbread Pancakes
steps: In a bowl, combine the wet ingredients: egg, Greek yogurt, and vanilla extract.
In another bowl, mix the oat flour, baking powder, nutmeg, and ginger.
Add the wet ingredients to the other bowl and whisk until well combined.

Preheat a pan on low heat, spray with vegetable oil, and pour some batter, spread around the pan, and cook on low heat until the top looks firm, then flip and cook the other side. Repeat the process with the rest of the batter,
Serve on a plate, sprinkle the cinnamon on top, and drizzle the maple. Enjoy!

name: Parmesan Bread With Sun Dried Tomato
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
Finely mince the sun-dried tomatoes and basil leaves.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and baking powder. Mix well.
In a small bowl, melt the butter in the microwave, then drizzle it over the top. Next, stir in the Parmesan cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, and basil. Drizzle the melted butter. Combine well.
Pour in the sparkling water and gently fold until just combined.
Transfer the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool.
Remove the bread from the mold and place it on a cutting board. Slice, share, and enjoy!

name: Carrot Oatmeal

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Prepare the ingredients, grate the carrot, and mince the pecans.
Heat a pot on low heat, add the rolled oats and cover them with water, add the cinnamon and a pinch of salt, cook on medium heat until the oats begin to soften and double in size.
Whisk the egg whites and add them to the pot. Add the vanilla extract and carrot. Stir for 2 minutes until it's completely creamy.
Pour into a small bowl, add the Greek yogurt on top, grated carrot, pecans, and sprinkle some cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Apple Pie Protein Smoothie

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: In a blender, add the applesauce, Greek yogurt, rolled oats, cinnamon, vanilla protein, and almond milk. Blend until smooth
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Cherry Almond Protein Smoothie
steps: In a blender, add the cherries, Greek yogurt, almond extract, vanilla protein, and almond milk. Blend until smooth
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Date Cinnamon Protein Smoothie
steps: Halve the dates, and remove the pit.
In a blender, add the dates, greek yogurt, cinnamon, vanilla protein, and the almond milk. Blend until smooth
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Pie Protein Smoothie
steps: In a blender, add the pumpkin puree, banana, Greek yogurt, pumpkin spice, protein powder, and the almond milk
Blend until smooth, pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprouts With Cinnamon Spread and Pomegranate

ingredients.name: Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods

steps: Halve the Brussels sprouts.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the brussels sprouts on a baking sheet, spray with vegetable oil, season with salt, and roast for 15–20 minutes.
Heat a pan and melt the butter. Stir in the cinnamon and combine. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the cinnamon butter  to create the spread.
Spread the yogurt dip on a plate, serve the Brussels sprouts, top with pomegranate, and enjoy!

name: Brussels Sprouts Salad With Salmon Bites

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled without salt

steps: Peel and cut the butternut squash into small to medium cubes and do the same with the salmon. Slice the Brussels sprouts into halves.
Boil the squash cubes in a pot with water until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.

Place the cooked squash cubes and Brussels sprouts in the air fryer, spray twice with vegetable oil spray, season with salt to taste, and cook for 10 minutes until slightly crispy. Once done, set aside.

Place the salmon bites in the air fryer, spray with vegetable oil, and season with salt to taste. Cook for about 5 minutes, just enough to sear the outside while keeping the inside tender and slightly undercooked.
Assemble the plate by arranging the Brussels sprouts and squash as the base. Add the salmon bites around the plate, and top with pecans and cranberries.

name: Brussels Sprouts With Sausage & Squash

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled with salt

steps: Cut the butternut squash into medium cubes. Place the cubes in a pot, cover with water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a simmer. Cook until fork tender, then drain.
Halve the Brussels sprouts and slice the sausage. Cut the sausage into slices.

Next, heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and spray with vegetable oil. Add the Brussels sprouts and sauté until warmed through. Add the cooked Italian sausage, and the butternut squash cubes, and toss everything together.
Drizzle with maple syrup, season with a pinch of salt, and stir well to combine.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Almond Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled with salt
Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg

steps: Halve the Brussels sprouts, place them in a bowl, and add the liquid aminos. Toss to combine well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the Brussels sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, and remove from the fire
Serve on a plate, sprinkle with almonds, and enjoy warm!

name: Brussels Sprouts Tempeh Bowl

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled without salt

steps: Cut the tempeh into small pieces and halve the Brussels sprouts.
Place the Brussels sprouts in a bowl and season with salt, paprika, and garlic powder.
Heat a grill over medium-high heat, spray it with vegetable oil, and grill the Brussels sprouts until golden brown, flipping them halfway through.
Meanwhile, heat the tempeh in a non-stick pan
Assemble the bowl by adding the grilled Brussels sprouts, tempeh pieces, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Brussels Sprouts Skewers

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled with salt
Pork cured ham center slice country-style separable lean only raw

steps: Thaw the Brussels sprouts.
Halve the dates and Brussels sprouts.
Assemble the skewers by creating a mini burger: add a half of Brussels sprout, a date, cured ham, and top with the other half of the Brussels sprout.
Preheat a grill pan on high heat for a few minutes. Add the skewers, drizzle with olive oil, and cook until golden on one side. Flip and cook the other side until browned.

name: Crusted Salmon With Cherry Chia Jam
steps: Finely chop the pecans , place them in a bowl, and mix with the bread crumbs.
Press this mixture over the salmon to form a crust.
Heat a small pot over medium heat, and add the cherries. Once they release their juices, stir in the chia seeds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture thickens into a jam-like consistency.
Preheat a pan. Drizzle the olive oil, add the salmon, and cook over medium heat. Flip after 4  minutes and continue cooking until changes his color.
Serve the salmon on a plate and spoon the cherry chia jam on top. Share and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower Mash
steps: Prepare the ingredients: cut the cauliflower into florets and mince the garlic cloves.
Place the cauliflower in a pot, cover with water, and boil for 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain well.
Melt the butter in the same pot, add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Add the cauliflower and parmesan cheese. Season with salt and combine well.
Place everything in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Blend the mix in a food processor or use an immersion blender.
Serve, share and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Acorn Squash
steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the pecans,  halve the squash lengthwise, and scoop out the seeds.
Spray each squash piece with vegetable oil and place it on a baking sheet, cut side down. Bake for 40 minutes, or until it's fork-tender.
Meanwhile, heat a pan on medium heat. Spray the vegetable oil, add the ground beef, season with salt and pepper, and cook until browned.
Stir in the pecans and the cranberries, and combine well.
Once the squash is cooked, fill each half with the beef mix.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Simple Chicken Corn Chowder

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw
Corn sweet yellow frozen kernels unprepared

steps: In a soup pot, melt butter over medium-high heat. Add onion, celery, and garlic; sauté 2–3 minutes, or until tender.

Add the potatoes, broth, corn, thyme, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for 10 minutes, until the potatoes are tender. Stir occasionally. Cook for two minutes until the mixture is heated through.
Transfer three cups of the soup to a large blender. Blend until almost smooth. Stir into the remaining soup mixture, add chicken, and heat. Serve and enjoy!

name: Chicken Sriracha Rice Roll Ups
steps: Cut the chicken into long thin strips. Slice the avocado and chop the red cabbage.

On a cutting board, slightly overlap two rice paper sheets to form a sturdier base (this helps the roll hold together). Lightly moisten your fingers with water and dab the rice paper just enough to soften it. Place two more sheets on top and repeat the same process.
