Layer the lettuce leaves lengthwise, then add the red cabbage, chicken strips, and avocado. Drizzle with half of the sriracha sauce.
Carefully roll everything up into a tight roll.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Slice the rolls, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Potato Zucchini Cream
steps: Peel and chop the potato into small cubes, and continue cutting the zucchini into small cubes.
Fill a pot with water and bring it to a boil. Add the zucchini and potatoes with a spoon. Cook for a few minutes until the potatoes are fork-tender. Drain the water.
Place the potatoes, zucchini, oil, chicken broth, garlic, salt to taste, and yogurt in a blender or food processor.
Blend until smooth, adding more chicken broth if you prefer a thinner consistency.
Serve in a bowl and top with croutons.

name: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C
Mix the wet ingredients: pumpkin puree, greek yogurt, and eggs
In another bowl, mix the dry ingredients: baking powder, pumpkin spice, vanilla whey protein, and oat flour. Once ready, add the wet mix and combine well.
Prepare the loaf pan by lining it with cooking paper, then spread the batter into the pan. Garnish with pumpkin seeds on top.
Bake for 40 minutes at 160 °C until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out almost clean.
Serve, slice, and enjoy!

name: Eggnog Protein Smoothie
steps: In a blender, add the bananas, eggnog, cinnamon, vanilla protein, and almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato With Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: Pumpkin seeds whole with shell roasted with salt

steps: Peel the sweet potato and chop it into medium-sized pieces.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C  for 5 minutes.
Place the sweet potato pieces in a pot, cover with water, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes until fork-tender.
Transfer the sweet potato cubes into a bowl. Add 2 tsp of oil, a sprinkle of salt, and a sprinkle of paprika. Mix well, then place the sweet potato cubes in the air fryer and cook for 5 minutes.
Prepare the yogurt sauce. In a small bowl, add the yogurt, garlic powder, salt, and the remaining oil. Combine well with a spoon
Once the sweet potato cubes are ready, serve them on a plate, drizzle with the yogurt sauce, and garnish with pumpkin seeds. Sprinkle paprika on top. Enjoy!

name: Rasperry With Hazelnut Spread Roll Up
steps: In a small bowl, combine the cottage cheese and hazelnut spread. Mash with a fork until well mixed.
Spread the mixture evenly over the tortilla.
Slice the strawberries and place them one by one in a line closer to the edge of the tortilla.
Roll the tortilla tightly and then slice into rolls. Each roll should have one raspberry in each slice.

name: Cottage Cheese Breakfast Bake

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, honey, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Add the rolled oats and blueberries until it's well combined
Pour  the mixture into an air fryer-safe mold and cook for 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and fully set.
Let it cool for at least 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Sauerkraut Soup

ingredients.name: Chicken breast stewed meat only skinless

steps: Chop the potatoes, carrots, and onions into small pieces.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, and paprika to the pot. Stir well to combine and cook for another 2-3 minutes.

Pour in the chicken broth, stir to combine, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium and let it simmer until the potatoes and carrots are tender.
Shred the chicken, and once the soup is ready, add the sauerkraut and shredded chicken to the pot. Stir well and cook for a few more minutes to allow the flavors to combine.

name: Carrot Ginger Creamy Soup
steps: Peel and chop the potatoes and carrots into small cubes, place them in a pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook until they are fork-tender. Once done, drain the water and set aside.
Slice the onion, mince the garlic, and chop the tofu into small cubes.
In the same pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for one minute. Then, add the ginger slices, tofu, vegetable broth, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Use a hand blender to mix everything until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a bowl, add the chickpeas, and enjoy!

name: Asian Bowl

ingredients.name: Textured vegetable protein by bob's red mill

steps: Prepare the textured vegetable protein according to the package instructions.
Slice the cucumber into half-moon slices. Slice the shiitake mushrooms, and cook them in a non-stick pan over medium heat until soft. Set aside.
In a small bowl, combine the vegan mayonnaise and sriracha.
In a bowl, add the cooked rice, kimchi, seaweed, mushrooms, textured vegetable protein, cucumber, and grated carrots.
Drizzle the mayo-sriracha mixture, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Beef and Kimchi  Rice

ingredients.name: Rice white long grain cooked with salt
Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and add the ground beef. Season with salt and pepper, stirring constantly.
Add the rice, kimchi, and scallions to the pan, and stir to combine. Create a small space in the middle of the pan, crack the egg into the space, and gently mix it into the beef and rice.
Serve on a plate and enjoy warm!

name: Kimchi Noodle Salad

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari
Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg

steps: Prepare the ingredients: Peel and slice the carrot into strips, slice the bell pepper and mushrooms into thin strips, and finely chop the red cabbage. Mince the tofu and chop the kimchi.
Preheat a pan over medium heat, add the oil, then sauté the carrot, bell pepper, and red cabbage until softened, about 5 to 8 minutes. Once ready, set aside.

Using the same pan or a separate one, add the tofu, mushrooms, and kimchi. Heat and stir to combine. Then, add the noodles and soy sauce, and combine well. Let everything heat through evenly. Turn off the heat and add the cooked vegetables, mixing gently.
Serve on a plate, sprinkle sesame seeds on top, and enjoy!

name: Peach Tofu Pudding With Blueberries
steps: Halve the peach, remove the pit, and slice it.
In a food processor, add the tofu, peach slices, honey, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a container, add the blueberries, cover with a lid, and refrigerate overnight.
Enjoy the next morning!

name: Burger Quesadilla
steps: Heat a nonstick pan on low heat and warm the tortilla for 1–2 minutes.
Flip the tortilla and place the ground beef on one half.
Add the cheddar over the beef, then turn off the heat.
Add the tomato slices and fold the tortilla to form a quesadilla.
Halve the quesadilla, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Summer Roll Bowl
steps: Prepare the ingredients, and chop the peanuts.
Assemble the bowl with all the ingredients, and drizzle the peanut butter. Combine well and enjoy!
Sprinkle red flakes for a special flavor.

name: Grilled Chicken with Peaches and Pesto
steps: Heat a grill pan over high heat for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the peaches and cut the chicken into medium pieces.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the peach slices and grill on both sides until lightly browned.
On a plate, place the chicken and grilled peaches, then drizzle the pesto on top. Enjoy!

name: Watermelon Farro Crunch Salad
steps: Use a melon baller to scoop out watermelon balls. Or cut the watermelon into cubes.
On a plate, add the cooked farro and pecans. Tear the salmon into small pieces with your hands and place them on top. Season with salt and combine.
Add the watermelon balls and spoon small amounts of ricotta around the plate.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Cottage Cheese With Pomegranate and Chocolate Chips

ingredients.name: Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods

steps: In a bowl, serve the cottage cheese, then add the pomegranate arils and chocolate chips. Enjoy!

name: Piadina con Carciofi
steps: Halve the sun-dried tomatoes.
Spread the ricotta cheese on one side of the tortilla.
Add the arugula, sun-dried tomatoes, and artichokes.
Fold the tortilla into a piadina.
Preheat a grill pan on high heat for a few minutes. Place the piadina on the grill 2 minutes per side.
Serve on a plate and enjoy.

name: Creamy Carrot Pistachio Sandwich
steps: Drain any excess liquid from the cottage cheese, pressing lightly with a fork.
Toast the bread slices.
Spread the cottage cheese on one slice of bread, then layer with pistachios, grated carrot, and arugula.
Close the sandwich and enjoy!
Option: use gluten-free bread

name: Easy Beef Tomato Pasta

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the tomato paste with a few spoonfuls of water and stir.
Add the beef and mix well. Turn off the heat.
Add the pasta, chili flakes, and basil. Toss to combine.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!
Option: use a gluten - free pasta

name: Orzo Salad

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids
Olives black canned jumbo and super-colossal

steps: Wrap carefully and cover with a paper towel to make it easier to hold. Enjoy!
Chiffonade the spinach and place it in a large bowl. Add the tuna, olives, capers, and orzo.
Season with salt and pepper, then toss to combine.
Serve on a plate, halve the hard-boiled egg, and place it on top. Enjoy!

name: Mexican Lettuce Wrap

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin separable lean only trimmed to 0" fat all grades cooked broiled steak strip

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the beef into small cubes. Drain the black beans and corn.
In a bowl, mash the avocado with a fork and season with salt.
Place two leaves slightly overlapping, then place the other two on top in the same way.
Spread the avocado over the lettuce leaves. Add the quinoa, black beans, corn, and beef pieces.
Wrap carefully,  cover with a paper towel to make it easier to hold, halve, and enjoy!

name: Salmon Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Preheat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the salmon and sear for 2 minutes per side. Place on a plate and shred using two forks.
In the same pan, cook the red bell pepper pieces for a few minutes until slightly soft.
In a bowl, combine the mayonnaise with the Greek yogurt. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the pasta, broccoli, bell pepper, and salmon. Toss well to combine and enjoy!
Option: use a gluten-free pasta.

name: Tex-Mex Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Dice the green bell pepper and halve the cherry tomatoes.
In a nonstick pan, heat the ground beef with the tomato sauce for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring so the sauce coats the meat.
In a large bowl, add the cooked pasta, beef mixture, black beans, bell pepper, and cherry tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss everything together until well combined. Serve in a medium bowl and enjoy!
Option: choose a gluten-free pasta

name: Grilled Chicken Fajita Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients: slice the bell peppers and avocado, and shred the lettuce. Cut the grilled chicken into strips.
In a bowl, place the lettuce as the base. Add the bell peppers, avocado, and chicken strips.
Lightly crush the tortilla chips and sprinkle them on the salad.
Squeeze lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and enjoy!

name: Farro Salad with Bresaola & Grilled Eggplant
steps: Preheat a grill pan on high heat for 4 minutes.
Prepare the ingredients: dice the eggplant and place it in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and garlic powder, and toss to coat.
Grill the eggplant pieces for 2 minutes per side, until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, add the arugula and cooked farro. Tear the bresaola into small pieces with your hands and add it to the bowl, along with the shallots and grilled eggplant.
Combine well and enjoy!

name: Rice Salad With Grilled Chicken & Avocado

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Rice white long grain cooked without salt
Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients: cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces, chop the green onion, and mince the cilantro.
Cut the avocado in half, dice one half, and set aside.
In a bowl, mash the other half of the avocado with a fork. Add the cooked rice, season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder, and mix well.
Stir in the cilantro, green onion, and chicken pieces. Gently fold in the diced avocado, and enjoy!

name: Antipasto Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the lettuce, dice the bell pepper, and halve the sun-dried tomatoes.
Chop the artichokes, slice the salami, and shred the cheese.
In a bowl, place the chopped lettuce as the base.
Place the toppings on top of the lettuce, one next to the other: first the artichokes, then the bell pepper, salami, cheese, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Chicken Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb
Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Prepare the ingredients: mince the red onion, shred the chicken, chop the dill, and dice the bell peppers.
In a bowl, add the cooked pasta, chicken, arugula, red onion, dill, and bell peppers.
Season with salt and pepper, drizzle with olive oil,  mix well, and enjoy!

name: Corn Tostada With Canned Tuna and Pico de Gallo

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients: mince the cilantro and drain the tuna.
In a small bowl, mash the avocado with a fork and season with salt.
Toast the corn tortillas in a pan over medium heat or in the microwave for 4 minutes. Let them cool slightly.
Spread the mashed avocado on each tostada. Top with tuna, pico de gallo, and cilantro.
Squeeze lime juice on top, serve, and enjoy!

name: Edamame Tuna Wrap

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Defrost the edamame and drain any excess water. Drain the tuna as well.
In a bowl, mash the avocado with a fork and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado along one side of the tortilla. Add the spinach, edamame, carrot, and tuna.
Wrap carefully and enjoy!

name: Asian Beef and Broccoli Skewers

ingredients.name: Seeds sesame whole roasted and toasted
Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Squeeze lime juice on top, serve, and enjoy!
Cut the beef into bite-sized cubes, add them to the marinade, and toss to coat. Let's sit for a few minutes.
Cut the broccoli into small pieces that fit easily on skewers.
Assemble the skewers, alternating beef and broccoli. Brush with the remaining marinade.
Preheat a grill pan on high heat for 4 minutes. Grill the skewers on medium-high heat, turning after a couple of minutes, until the beef is cooked and lightly browned.
Serve on a plate, sprinkle the sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach Salad With Salmon
steps: Slice the tomato and peach. Chop the walnuts.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium to high heat. Sear the salmon for 2–3 minutes per side, then let it cool slightly. Tear into small pieces with a fork.
On a plate, place the arugula as the base. Add the tomato and peach slices, then top with the salmon pieces.
Sprinkle the walnuts and drizzle the honey on top. Enjoy!

name: Peach Italian Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the peaches and halve the cherry tomatoes.
On a plate, place the arugula, then add the peach pieces. Tear the bresaola into small pieces with your hands and place them over the salad.
Add the cherry tomatoes and mozzarella, then drizzle with balsamic vinegar.
Sprinkle the pistachios on top and enjoy!

name: Easy Pasta

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Preheat a nonstick pan over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add the spinach and pasta, season with salt and pepper. Stir in the cherry tomatoes. Cook until the cheese is lightly melted and the spinach is soft.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Pasta With Grilled Zucchini & Chicken

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Cut the zucchini into half-moon slices.
Heat a grill pan on high for 5 minutes, spray with vegetable oil, and grill the zucchini slices over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side.
In a bowl, place the pasta and drizzle with olive oil. Add the chicken breast and zucchini, then grate the Parmigiano on top.
Toss gently to combine and enjoy!

name: Tuna Cabbage Cup

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the onion and drain the corn.
In a bowl, combine the tuna, onion, corn, mayonnaise, and a pinch of salt. Mix well.
Place the cabbage leaves on a plate and fill them with the tuna salad. Garnish with fresh herbs and enjoy!

name: Salmon Cabbage Cups
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the salmon and cook on low for 3 - 4 minutes per side, or just until seared. Remove from the pan, let it cool slightly, and shred with two forks.
Place the cabbage leaves on a plate and fill each cup with quinoa and shredded salmon.
Roll the goat cheese into small balls, place on top of each cup, and drizzle with honey. Enjoy!

name: Greek Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Chop the chicken into small cubes. Cut the cucumber into half-moons, then slice them in half. Halve the tomatoes, remove the seeds, and then dice them.
Take the lettuce leaves and spread the hummus
Add the tomato, cucumber, and chicken. Sprinkle feta cheese on top, and enjoy!

name: Quinoa Shrimp Lettuce Wraps
steps: Defrost the edamame and drain any excess liquid.
In a bowl, mix the edamame with sesame oil and salt. Add the quinoa, grated carrot, and shrimp. Stir to combine.
Place the lettuce leaves on a plate and fill each one with  the quinoa salad.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Orzo Salad With Shrimps

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Cook the orzo according to package instructions. Once ready, drain, place in a bowl, and refrigerate to stop the cooking process and cool quickly.
Cut the cucumber lengthwise, then slice.
In a bowl, combine the orzo, shrimp, cucumber, dill, salt, garlic powder, pepper, and olive oil. Mix well.
Sprinkle feta cheese on top and enjoy!

name: Grilled Steak Potato Mushrooms Skewers

ingredients.name: Boomer gold potatoes by the little potato company
Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Boil the potatoes for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften, then drain them.
Halve the potatoes and cut the steak into medium bite-sized pieces.
Heat a grill pan on high for 5 minutes.
Assemble the skewers with one piece of beef, one mushroom, and one potato half. Season with salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Grill over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Serve the skewers over a bed of arugula. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Romaine Salad

ingredients.name: Corn sweet yellow frozen kernels on cob cooked boiled drained with salt

steps: Brush the cut sides of the romaine with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a grill pan on medium-high. Place the romaine cut-side down and grill for 1–2 minutes, until lightly charred. Flip and grill 1 minute more.
Grill the corn on the same pan, then cut the kernels from the cob.
Cut the chicken breast into thin strips
Serve the romaine on a plate, add cherry tomatoes, corn, chicken, and feta. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Parmesan Cauliflower
steps: Cut the cauliflower into thick slices.  Lightly spray each slice with vegetable oil, then sprinkle garlic powder and Parmesan cheese on top.
Heat a grill pan over medium heat and cook for about 4 minutes per side until golden and tender.
Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Blackberry Skewers
steps: Assemble the skewers by alternating blackberries and shrimp.
In a small bowl, mix the sesame oil, minced ginger, and garlic powder. Brush each skewer with the mixture.
Preheat a grill pan over high heat for 5 minutes. Add the skewers  and cookr for 1–2 minutes per side.
Serve the quinoa on a plate, place the skewers on top, and enjoy!

name: Salmon Caesar Salad Wrap
steps: Spread the Caesar dressing along one side of the tortilla.
Add the lettuce, smoked salmon pieces, and grated Parmesan cheese.
Wrap carefully, halve and enjoy!

name: Tropical Tuna Skewers
steps: Peel and cut the mango into medium cubes.
Use a peeler to slice the cucumber into thin ribbons.
Prepare the skewers by alternating mango cubes, tuna cubes, and rolled cucumber slices. Continue until each skewer is filled.
Place the skewers on a plate, drizzle with sesame oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds on top.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Grilled Salmon Skewers

ingredients.name: Rice brown medium grain cooked without salt

steps: Slice the lemon and chop the salmon into cubes.
Assemble the skewers by alternating between salmon and lemon slices. Repeat until each skewer is complete.
In a small bowl, combine Greek yogurt, minced garlic, and olive oil. Add a pinch of salt and mix well.
Grill the skewers for 2 minutes on each side. To sear the salmon, cook for an additional 5 minutes until fully cooked.
Serve the cooked rice on a plate, top with the skewers, and drizzle the yogurt dressing over the plate. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Tuna Skewer
steps: Prepare the ingredients: Cut the zucchini lengthwise, then slice it into half-moons. Next, cut the half-moons in half to create triangles. Chop the tuna and cut the red onion into cubes.
Assemble the skewers, alternating zucchini, red onion, cherry tomatoes, and tuna. Repeat until each skewer is complete.
In a small bowl, combine olive oil, lemon zest, and honey. Mix well.
Use a silicone brush to coat each skewer with the dressing.
Grill the skewers over medium heat for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Ceviche with Shrimps

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients: mince the red onion and coriander. Chop the pineapple, tomatoes, cucumber, and avocado into equal-sized pieces. Slice the jalapeño.
In a bowl, add all the ingredients, season with a pinch of salt, and combine well. Enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Salad
steps: Cut the cucumber lengthwise and remove the seeds. Take half of the cucumber and slice it into half-moons. Then, cut the half-moons in half again to create cucumber triangles.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and grate the parmesan cheese into thin pieces
In a bowl, add all the ingredients, add a pinch of salt, combine well, and enjoy!

name: Tuna Ceviche
steps: Prepare the ingredients: peel and chop the mango, dice the tuna, and chop the avocado. Finally, slice the jalapeño, red onion, and mince the coriander.
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Squeeze in the lime, add a pinch of salt, and mix until well combined.

name: Plum Yogurt Bowl
steps: Slice the plums
Pour the yogurt into a bowl, add the plum slices, almonds, and enjoy!

name: Clean Avocado Toast
steps: Slice the sweet potato lengthwise.
Preheat a grill pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, then cook the sweet potato slices for 2–3 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, place the avocado in a small bowl, add salt, and mash with a fork.
Spread the avocado on top of each sweet potato slice, and add the smoked salmon. Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Cucumber Summer Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the mango, cucumber, and walnuts.
In a bowl, add the green salad and the rest of the ingredients, combine well, and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Fresh Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients: cut the cucumber into half-moon slices, then cut them in half. Chop the shrimp, dice the pineapple, and mince the parsley.
In a bowl, add all the ingredients. Pour in the olive oil and honey, add a dash of salt, and mix until well combined. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Toast With Scramble Eggs

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Sprinkle with pecans, drizzle with honey, and enjoy!
In a bowl, whisk the eggs, cheese, salt, a dash of garlic powder, and black pepper.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and place the eggs and cook them as soft scrambled eggs
Place the eggs on top of each sweet potato toast, garnish with the green onions, and enjoy!

name: Grilled Sweet Potato Toast
steps: Chop the pecans and slice the sweet potato.
Preheat a grill over medium heat for 5 minutes, then cook the sweet potato slices for 2–3 minutes per side, until tender and lightly charred.
Place the slices on a plate and top each one with cottage cheese.
Sprinkle with pecans, drizzle with honey, and enjoy!

name: Spicy Lettuce Boats

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Potatoes white, flesh and skin, baked

steps: Slice the jalapeño and chop the potato into small bites.
Place the potato pieces in a bowl with the ground beef, and season with salt and paprika. Add the tomato puree, combine well, and heat in the microwave.
Prepare the boats: place a slice of cheese on each lettuce leaf, then add the beef and potato mixture.
Top with the jalapeño slices and enjoy!

name: Cottage Boats
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes.
In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese with salt, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Prepare the boats: spoon the cottage cheese into each lettuce leaf, then add the tomatoes, chickpeas, and bacon slices.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Cantaloup Bowl
steps: In a bowl, serve the cottage cheese, then add the pomegranate arils and chocolate chips. Enjoy!
Spoon the greek yogurt into the center, top with the blueberries, sprinkle with hemp seeds, garnish with pecans, and enjoy!

name: Croissant Toast
steps: Place the cottage cheese in a strainer and press gently with a fork to remove the excess liquid.
Halve the croissant and toast until lightly golden.
Spread the cottage cheese over each half, then top with blueberries, and drizzle the honey on top.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Piadina With Prosciutto
steps: Spread the cream cheese evenly over the tortilla.
Add the arugula and prosciutto on one side of the tortilla, then fold it in half, like a half-moon.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat. Cook the piadina for 1 minute per side until lightly golden and warm.
Serve on a plate and enjoy.

name: Turkey Rolls With Creamy Kale Salad
steps: Mince the walnuts and kale,  and place them in a bowl.
Add the Greek yogurt, cranberries, and walnuts, then mix until well combined.
Lay out the turkey slices and spread a portion of the kale salad along each slice.
Roll them up carefully, place them on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Mini Bell Peppers

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: In a bowl, combine the cream cheese, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and coriander. Mix until smooth and well combined.
Slice the mini bell peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Fill each pepper with the cheese mixture.
Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Salad Crackers
steps: Mince the red bell pepper and cucumber. Place them in a bowl, season lightly with salt, and mix well.
Soften the cream cheese in the microwave for 5–8 seconds to make it easier to spread.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese over each cracker.
Top with a spoonful of the cucumber mix and finish with the shrimp on top. Enjoy!

name: Grilled Eggplant Bites
steps: Cut the eggplant into slices and grill them over medium heat for 4 minutes on each side. Add a pinch of garlic powder and a pinch of salt.
Meanwhile, chop the tomatoes and basil leaves.
Once the eggplants are ready, place them on a plate and spread the cheese over each slice.
Top with the chopped tomatoes, sprinkle with salt to taste, and enjoy!

name: Caprese Chicken Skewer
steps: Cut the chicken breast into small to medium bite-sized pieces.
Prepare the skewers by alternating with a cherry tomato, a piece of mozzarella cheese, chicken, and another cherry tomato. Repeat the process for each skewer.
Using a silicone brush, coat each skewer with pesto, then serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Melon, Prosciutto Skewers

ingredients.name: Pork cured ham center slice country-style separable lean only raw

steps: Halve the cantaloupe and remove the seeds. Using a round spoon, scoop out small balls that will fit onto the skewer.
Assemble the skewers with the cantaloupe balls, ham, and mozzarella. Repeat the process.
Serve the skewers on a plate, drizzle with balsamic vinegar, and enjoy!
For a fresh, special flavor, add basil leaves to the skewers.

name: Tropical Skewers
steps: In a bowl, add the shrimp and olive oil, and mix well. Sprinkle with paprika and salt, then stir to combine.
Peel the pineapple and slice it into rounds, then cut each round into medium-sized triangles that will fit onto the skewers
Grill on medium-high heat for 3 minutes each side. Serve and enjoy!

name: Asparagus with Shredded Boiled Egg Salad
steps: Heat a grill pan for 3 to 5 mins, add the asparagus and cook them
Shred the hard-boiled eggs.
Place the shredded eggs into a small bowl and add salt and mustard, combine well.
Serve the asparagus on a plate, add the shredded eggs, add the capers on top, and enjoy!

name: Orange Mocktail
steps: In a food processor, add all the ingredients and blend until smooth.
Fill a glass with ice, then pour the mocktail into it. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Mint Mocktail
steps: In a food processor, add all the ingredients, ice, and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass, add mint leaves and chia seeds, and gently combine with a spoon.

name: Coconut Watermelon Mocktail
steps: In a food processor, add all the ingredients, ice, and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Watermelon Coconut Water
steps: In a food processor, add all the ingredients, ice cubes, and a pinch of salt. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Pesto Egg Toast
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the eggs and cook for 10 - 12minutes for a tender, jammy yolk. Transfer immediately to cold water, peel, and slice.
Drain any excess liquid from the cottage cheese, pressing lightly with a fork.
Toast the bread. Next, spread the cottage cheese on top.
Add the eggs and garnish with pesto and chili flakes.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Sunny Eggs With Chickpeas
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat, spray with oil, and sprinkle the Parmesan to form a thin layer. Cook for 1 minute until it starts to crisp.
Add the chickpeas, season with salt and pepper. Next, carefully crack the eggs on top.
Cook the eggs until the whites are set. Transfer to a plate and enjoy warm.

name: Breakfast Grilled Sandwich
steps: Slice the zucchini lengthwise into thin strips.
Heat a grill pan, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the zucchini slices until tender.
Heat a nonstick pan and cook the eggs as an omelet. Once ready, cut into four pieces.
Toast the bread slices.
Spread the hummus on one slice of bread. Add the zucchini, omelet pieces, and cheese.
Close the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Egg Shrimp Bagel Toast

ingredients.name: Bagels plain enriched with calcium propionate includes onion poppy sesame

steps: Toast the bagel.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Heat a pan, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the eggs, stirring gently with a spatula to keep them slightly compact. Once ready, set aside.
In the same pan, melt the butter, add the shrimp, and season with salt and paprika. Heat for a couple of minutes.
Split the bagel. On each slice, add arugula, then top with the eggs and shrimp. Serve and enjoy!

name: Earth Breakfast Bowl
steps: In a bowl, add the quinoa, edamame, chickpeas, and alfalfa sprouts.
Halve the eggs and place them on top.
Season with salt, paprika, and pepper.

name: Cilbir

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, season with salt and garlic, and mix well.
Halve the hard-boiled eggs and place them on top of the yogurt.
Drizzle the olive oil around the plate, then sprinkle the red chili flakes over the eggs.
Garnish with dill, serve with toasted bread slices, and enjoy!

name: Parmesan Baked Eggs
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180 °C for 5 minutes.
In an air fryer–safe dish, add the spinach and asparagus. Place the eggs on top.
Season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle the Parmesan cheese.
Cook for 10 minutes, or longer if needed, until the eggs are thoroughly cooked.
Serve with toasted bread on the side and enjoy.

name: Mediterranean Cottage Cheese Wrap

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Drain the excess liquid from the cottage cheese, pressing it lightly with a fork.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and black olives. Cut the spinach into thin strips.
Spread the cottage cheese on one side of the tortilla.
Top with spinach, chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and black olives.
Roll the tortilla carefully into a wrap.
Cut in half and enjoy.

name: Quinoa Bowl
steps: Place the eggs in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 15 minutes. Once ready, transfer to a bowl with ice water. After a few minutes, peel and halve the eggs.
Meanwhile, heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Cook the salmon for about 2 minutes per side, until fully cooked through.
Prepare the bowl by adding the quinoa, alfalfa sprouts, cucumber slices, salmon, and eggs.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper, then enjoy fresh.

name: Salmon Breakfast Bowl
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges. Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes. Add the potato wedges, spray with vegetable oil, season with salt, and cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add the olive oil, and cook the spinach for about 3 minutes, stirring gently, until softened but not fully wilted.
Prepare the bowl: place the spinach, potato wedges, and smoked salmon.
Halve the hard-boiled eggs and add them to the bowl.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve and enjoy!

name: Sweet Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Place the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice the banana and chop the dark chocolate. Place them on top of the cottage cheese.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sea salt.
Drizzle with honey and enjoy.

name: Dream Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Drain any excess liquid from the cottage cheese.
In a food processor, blend the cottage cheese, cocoa powder, and honey until smooth. Transfer to a bowl. For a thicker texture, refrigerate the mixture overnight.
Slice the strawberries and chop the pistachios.
Add them to the bowl and enjoy!

name: Eggplant Rolls

ingredients.name: Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods

steps: Slice the eggplant lengthwise into thin strips, prepare the pomegranate seeds and have them ready.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the eggplant slices on both sides until soft and lightly golden. Set aside to cool slightly.
Chiffonade the spinach and mix it with the ricotta cheese. Add salt to taste.

Place a small amount of the ricotta mixture on one end of an eggplant slice, then roll it up tightly. Repeat with the remaining slices. Next, place all the rolls in an oven-safe dish and bake for 5 to 10 minutes at medium heat.
Grate the garlic and add it to a small bowl. Add the Greek yogurt, salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Drizzle the yogurt sauce over the eggplant rolls and garnish with pomegranate arils.

name: Grilled Salmon Sandwich
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and cook the salmon for about 3 minutes per side, until fully cooked.
Toast the bread. Spread the mayonnaise and mustard on each slice
Assemble the sandwich with the spinach, bacon, and salmon.
Close the sandwich, cut it in half, and enjoy it warm!

name: Green Sandwich
steps: Cut the cucumber into half-moon slices, and mash the avocado with a fork.
Drain the cottage cheese, pressing well with a fork to remove excess liquid. Season it with salt.
Toast the bread slices.
Prepare the sandwich. Spread the cottage cheese on one slice of bread, add the avocado, place the alfalfa sprouts, and top with the cucumber slices.

name: Tuna Omelette Sandwich

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the red onion and cherry tomatoes.
Place the eggs in a bowl, season with salt, and whisk with a fork. Add the tuna, red onion, and tomato pieces. Combine well.
Heat a non-stick pan over low heat. Pour in the egg mixture and cook as an omelette. Once the top looks firm, flip the omelette and finish cooking for 1–2 more minutes.
Cut the omelette into pieces to fit the sandwiches. Toast the bread slices, place the omelette pieces on top, and cover with the remaining bread.
Cut the sandwiches in half and enjoy them warm.

name: Spinach Corn Sandwich With Chicken
steps: Chop the spinach and place it in a bowl with the cream cheese. Microwave for 10 seconds to soften.
Add the corn and shredded chicken to the bowl. Season with salt and garlic powder, then mix well with a spoon.
Prepare the sandwich by spreading the cream cheese mixture onto the bread.
Toast on a grill pan over high heat for 1–2 minutes on each side.
Next, cut the sandwich in half and enjoy it warm!

name: Avocado Tuna Sandwich

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Toast the bread slices.
Drain the tuna.
In a bowl, combine the avocado, sour cream, and tuna. Season with salt and garlic powder, then mash with a fork.
Place the red cabbage on one slice of bread, spoon the avocado tuna mixture on top, and close the sandwich.
Cut in half and enjoy!

name: Artichoke Omelette Sandwich
steps: Drain the artichoke hearts and chop them.
Place the eggs in a medium bowl, season with salt, and whisk with a fork.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and spray the vegetable oil. Add the artichokes and cook for a few minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook, stirring gently, until softly scrambled.
Toast the bread slices, then assemble the sandwiches with arugula and the artichoke scrambled eggs.
Cut the sandwiches in half and enjoy them warm!

name: Hashbrown Sandwich

ingredients.name: Potatoes hashed brown frozen plain prepared

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Halve the tomatoes, remove the seeds, and chop them into small pieces.
Toast the hash browns in a toaster or pan until they are golden brown.
Prepare the sandwich with all the ingredients, using the hashbrown as the bread.
Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Avo Toast With Shrimp
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Prepare the ingredients: place the avocado in a bowl, season with salt, and mash with a fork. Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Assemble the toast. Spread the mashed avocado over the bread, add the alfalfa sprouts, shrimp, and tomato halves.
Season with black pepper and enjoy.

name: Avocado Tomato Wrap
steps: Halve the tomatoes, remove the seeds, and cut them into strips.
Place the avocado in a bowl, season with salt, and mash with a fork.
Place the tortilla on a cutting board. Spread the mashed avocado on one side, then add the tomato strips, Swiss cheese, and spinach.
Wrap carefully, cut in half, and enjoy.

name: Spinach Feta Egg Wrap

ingredients.name: Low fat feta cheese by athenos

steps: In a bowl, whisk the egg and egg whites with a fork. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and, just before it starts to set, add the spinach. Cook until done.
Place the tortilla on a cutting board. Spoon the scrambled eggs onto one side.
Chop the sun-dried tomatoes and add them to the wrap. Sprinkle the feta cheese on top.
Wrap carefully, cut in half, and enjoy warm.
Optional: Toast the wrap in a pan for a crunchy texture.

name: Curry Egg Salad Wrap
steps: Prepare the ingredients. Mince the celery and chop the red onion.
In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, mayo, curry powder, and salt.
Chop the boiled eggs into small pieces. Add them to the bowl and gently mash with a fork until everything comes together.
Stir in the celery and red onion into the bowl, and combine well.
Place the tortilla on a cutting board. Arrange the spinach on one side, then spoon the curry egg salad over the spinach. Wrap tightly.
Halve the wrap, and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Cookie Smoothie
steps: In a food processor, add the banana, Greek yogurt, protein powder, soy milk, half a serving of chocolate chips, and a dash of salt. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and add the remaining chocolate chips, and enjoy!

name: Overnigth Strawberry Chia Pudding
steps: In a food processor, add the strawberries, protein powder, and soy milk, and blend until smooth.
Pour the mix into a glass or container, add the chia seeds, and combine well.
Close with a lid and refrigerate overnight, and enjoy the next morning!

name: Date Chia Pudding
steps: Soak the dates in hot water for a couple of minutes until they're soft.
Add the yogurt, dates, and cinnamon to a food processor, and blend until smooth.
Pour the mix into a glass or container, add the chia seeds, and combine. Close with a lid and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, add the mixed berries on top and enjoy!

name: Kiwi Chia Pudding Plant-Based
steps: In a blender, combine the soy milk, protein powder, and honey. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass or container.
Peel and chop the kiwi into cubes, then place it in the blender and purée until smooth.
Add the kiwi purée into the container, close with a lid, and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, add the blueberries on top and enjoy!

name: Yogurt Cloud Green Smoothie
steps: Peel and chop the kiwi and the apple.
In a blender add all the ingredients and blend until smooth
Pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Apple Kiwi Smoothie
steps: Peel and chop the kiwi and the apple.
In a blender, add all the ingredients and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Kiwi Chia Pudding

ingredients.name: Cereals ready-to-eat muesli dried fruit and nuts

steps: Peel and chop the kiwi.
In a blender, add the kiwi, protein powder, Greek yogurt, and almond milk. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mix into a glass or container, close with a lid, and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, add the muesli on top and enjoy!

name: Chicken and Lentil (Balanced)
steps: Seed and chop the cucumber, and slice the tomato. Transfer to a small bowl, add olive oil, salt, pepper, and combine.
Heat the chicken breast in a pan and serve on a plate. Next, add the lentils on one side, and complete by adding the cucumber salad.

name: Chicken and Lentil (High Protein)
steps: Seed and chop the cucumber, and slice the tomato. Transfer to a small bowl, add olive oil, salt, pepper, and combine.
Heat the chicken breast in a pan and serve on a plate. Next, add the lentils on one side, and complete by adding the cucumber salad.

name: Chicken and Lentil (Low Fat)
steps: Seed and chop the cucumber, and slice the tomato. Transfer to a small bowl, add olive oil, salt, pepper, and combine.
Heat the chicken breast in a pan and serve on a plate. Next, add the lentils on one side, and complete by adding the cucumber salad.

name: Chicken and Lentil (Low Carb)
steps: Seed and chop the cucumber, and slice the tomato. Transfer to a small bowl, add olive oil, salt, pepper, and combine.
Heat the chicken breast in a pan and serve on a plate. Next, add the lentils on one side, and complete by adding the cucumber salad.

name: Blueberry Avo Protein Smoothie
steps: In a food processor, add the blueberries, avocado, protein powder, almond milk, and ice. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Snicker Smoothie (Low Fat)
steps: In a blender, place the tofu cubes and soy milk and blend.
Add the banana, protein, peanut butter, cacao powder, and pitted dates. Blend it again.
Option: blend it with a cup of ice for a frosty consistency.

name: Snicker Smoothie
steps: In a blender, place the tofu cubes and soy milk and blend.
Add the banana, protein, peanut butter, cacao powder, and pitted dates and blend it again.
Option: blend it with a cup of ice and Splenda for a frosty and sweeter consistency.

name: Green Goddess Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!
Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Blue Tropical Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice, pour into a glass, and enjoy!

name: Coconut Banana Smoothie
steps: In a blender add  the coconut milk, protein powder, banana and ice. Blend  until smooth, pour in a glass and sprinkle with dried coconut meat. Enjoy!

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Monkey - Smoothie (Balanced)
steps: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Liquid Carrot Cake (Low Fat)
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth, except for the walnuts.
Serve and garnish with walnuts on top.

name: Liquid Carrot Cake (Balanced)
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth, except for the walnuts.
Serve and garnish with walnuts on top.

name: Tropical Smoothie

ingredients.name: Protein natural vanilla flavor by pure paleo

steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice. Enjoy!

name: Papaya Smoothie (Low Fat)
steps: Place all the ingredients in a blender, add ginger and cinnamon to taste, and mix.

name: Power Green Smoothie  (Low Fat)
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender, add a few ice cubes, and blend until smooth.
Choose plant-based protein for a vegan smoothie.

name: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder ancient cacao by paleopro

steps: Blend the frozen banana with the rest of the ingredients. Serve and enjoy.

name: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder ancient cacao by paleopro

steps: Blend a frozen banana with all the ingredients.  Serve and enjoy.

name: Strawberry Smoothie with Cacao Nibs (Low Carb)
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth. Use the cacao nibs to garnish and make it crunchy.

name: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder ancient cacao by paleopro

steps: Blend together the frozen banana with the rest of the ingredients. Serve and enjoy.

name: Smoothie Bowl (High Protein)
steps: Blend together protein powder, berries, frozen banana, and soy milk (adding more soy milk as necessary to desired texture).
Transfer to a bowl, and top with chia seeds, coconut, hemp hearts, and sliced strawberry.

name: Smoothie Bowl (Balanced)
steps: Blend together protein powder, berries, frozen banana, and soy milk (adding more soy milk as necessary to desired texture).
Transfer to a bowl, and top with chia seeds, coconut, hemp hearts, and strawberry slices.

name: Power Green Smoothie (High Protein)
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender, add a few ice cubes, and blend until smooth.
For a thinner consistency add water and blend.
Choose plant-based protein for a vegan smoothie.

name: Power Green Smoothie(Balanced)
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender, add a few ice cubes, and blend until smooth.
For a thinner consistency add water and blend.

name: Raspberry Banana Smoothie (Balanced)
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.

name: Mango Blueberry Smoothie (Low Fat)
steps: Blend the Mango with two servings of protein, one cup of milk, and chia. Serve in a glass.
Next, blend the frozen blueberries with the remaining milk and protein.
Add the blueberry mix on top of the mango smoothie, and enjoy!
Use your favorite plant-based milk.

name: Raspberry - Avocado Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!
Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Cacao - Avocado Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with icea and enjoy!
Option: add Calorie - Free Sweetener.

name: Tofu Coconut Banana Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Golden Peach Smoothie
steps: Chop the peach and remove the pit.
In a food processor, add the Greek yogurt, peach, raspberries, turmeric, pepper, and almond milk.. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Pineapple Carrot Smoothie
steps: In a food processor, add the carrot, pineapple, flaxseeds, ginger, collagen, and coconut water. Blend until smooth, and add  water for a lighter consistency
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Caribbean Smoothie
steps: In a food processor, add the papaya, cucumber, collagen, coconut meat, some water, and coconut water. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Beet Juice
steps: Use a juicer or blend all the ingredients with one glass of water and strain the juice before serving.
Serve with ice and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Almond Butter Smoothie (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder aztec vanilla by paleopro

steps: Blend together frozen banana with ice, cocoa, protein powder, almond milk, and splenda.

name: Chocolate Almond Butter Smoothie (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder aztec vanilla by paleopro

steps: Blend together frozen banana with ice, cocoa, protein powder, almond milk, and splenda.

name: Chocolate Almond Butter Smoothie (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder aztec vanilla by paleopro

steps: Blend together frozen banana with ice, cocoa, protein powder, almond milk, and splenda.

name: Chocolate Almond Butter Smoothie (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Paleo protein powder aztec vanilla by paleopro

steps: Blend together frozen bananas with ice, cocoa, protein powder, and almond milk.

name: Flat Tummy Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Caribbean Carrot Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients  with ice and enjoy!

name: Caribbean Carrot Juice (Low Fat)
steps: Blend all the ingredients and enjoy!

name: Tomato Lentil Soup - Instant Pot (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Mince the garlic and cilantro, chop the carrots and celery and prepare the other ingredients.
Press saute button and heat the oil. Add garlic, celery, and carrots and stir until garlic is fragrant.

Add the lentils, cilantro, vegetable broth, tomato paste, and crushed tomatoes, and season with chili flakes, salt, and pepper. 
Optional: Add one tbsp of oregano and onion powder.
Secure lid, cook on high pressure for 4 minutes. Quick release steam before open, after cooking add the coconut milk and toss to combine
Ladle half of the soup into a blender  and wait a few minutes to cool off before blending it
Add the protein and  the rest of the soup, blend until smooth, if it's too dense add enough water to obtain the desired texture
Complete by serving the soup in a bowl  and place some basil leaves on top

name: Tomato Lentil Soup - Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Mince the garlic and cilantro, chop the carrots and celery and prepare the other ingredients.
Press the saute button and heat the oil. Add garlic, celery, and carrots and stir until garlic is fragrant.

Add the lentils, cilantro, vegetable broth, tomato paste, and crushed tomatoes, and season with chilli flakes, salt, and pepper. 
Optional: Add one tbsp of oregano and onion powder.
Secure the lid, press pressure cook, and cook on high pressure for 4 minutes. Quick release steam before open
Ladle half of the soup into a blender  and wait a few minutes to cool off before blending it
Add the protein and  the rest of the soup, and blend until smooth. If it's too dense, add enough water to obtain the desired texture
Complete by serving the soup in a bowl and place basil leaves on top

name: Tomato Lentil Soup - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Mince the garlic and cilantro, chop the carrots and celery and prepare the other ingredients.
Press the saute button and heat the oil. Add garlic, celery, and carrots and stir until garlic is fragrant.

Add the lentils, cilantro, vegetable broth, tomato paste, and crushed tomatoes, and season with chilli flakes, salt, and pepper. 
Optional: Add one tbsp of oregano and onion powder.
Secure the lid, press the BEANS/CHILI button, and cook on high pressure for 10 minutes. Quick release steam before opening.
Add half of the soup to a blender and wait a few minutes to cool off before blending it.
Add the protein and the rest of the soup, and blend until smooth. If the soup is too dense, add enough water to obtain the desired texture.
Complete by serving the soup in a bowl

name: Steak Rolls (Low Carb)
steps: Slice the bell pepper.
Heat a pan and place the oil; stir in the bell pepper slices, and add salt and pepper to taste. Once ready, set aside.

Lay the steak slices on a cutting board. Divide the bell pepper slices among the strips and line them vertically on one end of each steak. Start with that end and roll the steaks, securing them with a toothpick.
Mix the soy and honey in a small bowl, then brush each steak roll with the mixture. Cook them in a nonstick pan on low heat for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve the arugula on a plate, place the steak rolls on top, and enjoy!

name: Steak Rolls (High Protein)
steps: Slice the bell peppers.
Stir in the bell pepper slices in a nonstick pan and add salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low heat, and once ready, set aside.

Lay the sirloin slices on a cutting board. Divide the bell pepper slices among the steak strips, lining them up vertically on one end of each steak. Start with that end and roll the steaks, securing them with a toothpick.
Mix the soy and honey in a small bowl, then brush each steak roll. Cook them in a nonstick pan on low heat for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve the arugula on a plate, place the steak rolls on top, and enjoy!

name: Steak Rolls (Balanced)
steps: Slice the veggies.
Heat a pan and place the oil; stir in the bell pepper slices, and add salt and pepper to taste. Once ready, set aside.

Lay the sirloin slices on a cutting board. Divide the bell pepper slices among the steak strips, lining them up vertically on one end of each steak. Start with that end and roll the steaks, securing them with a toothpick.
Mix the soy and honey in a small bowl, then brush each steak roll with the mixture. Cook them in a nonstick pan on low heat for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve the arugula on a plate, place the steak rolls on top, and enjoy!

name: Mango Chia Pudding
steps: Peel and chop the mango.
In a blender, add the chopped mango, almond milk, protein powder, and vanilla extract. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a glass, then stir in the chia seeds.
Place in the fridge overnight and enjoy the next day!

name: Apple Pie Chia Pudding
steps: In a blender, add the applesauce, soy milk, protein powder, and cinnamon. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a glass, then stir in the chia seeds.
Place in the fridge overnight and enjoy the next day!

name: Chicken Avocado Salad Toast
steps: Shred the chicken.
In a bowl, place the avocado, Greek yogurt, and salt. Smash with a fork.
Spread the avocado mix over each rice cake.
Next, add the shredded chicken and red onion, and enjoy!

name: Sausage, Potato & Sauerkraut

ingredients.name: Low fat smoked sausage turkey pork and beef

steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the bell pepper, peel, and grate the potato.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the butter and let it melt. Once melted, add the bell peppers and grated potato, then season with salt and pepper. Cook until the vegetables are soft.
Stir in the sauerkraut and cook for 3 minutes
Serve on a plate and enjoy warm!

name: Beef Lettuce Tacos
steps: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the ground beef, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and cook until browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the kimchi with the beef and combine well.
Prepare each taco with 3 lettuce leaves. Add the ground beef and rice to each taco.
Once all tacos are prepared, serve them on a plate and enjoy!

name: Kimchi Tofu Noodles

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Mince the garlic, tofu, and green onion.
Heat a pan over medium heat, and add the onion, garlic, and tofu. Cook for a few minutes until the onion is soft. Add the paprika and soy sauce, and combine well.
Add the cooked rice noodles and kimchi to the pan. Let them heat through and stir to combine.
Serve on a plate, top with vegan cheese.
Garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and enjoy warm!

name: Smoked Sausage Salad

ingredients.name: Low fat smoked sausage turkey pork and beef

steps: Dice the onion and apple, chop the sauerkraut, and slice the sausage.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sausage, and cook until the onion becomes soft.
Next, add the sauerkraut, ground mustard, apple pieces, and a dash of salt and pepper. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until the apples are softened.
Place on a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Kimchi Noodles

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Once ready, drain the excess water and set aside.
Meanwhile, chop the kimchi.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, then add the ground beef and soy sauce. Season with a pinch of salt and cook, stirring occasionally. Before the beef is fully browned, add the kimchi, mix, and continue cooking until the beef is fully done
Turn off the heat, add the noodles to the pan, and mix well.
Serve on a plate, top with green onions, sprinkle the sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Veggies Bowl With Tofu Dressing

ingredients.name: Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Melt the ghee, then add the chickpeas to a bowl and drizzle with the ghee.
Add the zucchini, carrots, and chickpeas to the air fryer. Cook until the veggies are tender.
Meanwhile, in a food processor, add the tofu, curry powder, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Assemble the bowl: add the cooked quinoa, chickpeas, and roasted veggies. Pour the tofu dressing in the center, and enjoy!

name: Creamy Veggie Soup With Chicken

ingredients.name: Chicken breast stewed meat only skinless

steps: Prepare the ingredients, peel and chop the potatoes and carrots into small pieces. Chop the zucchini into similar-sized pieces. Finely slice the spinach, and shred the chicken using two forks.
In a pot, heat the olive oil and add the potato cubes, carrots, and zucchini. Stir well and season with paprika, turmeric, salt, and pepper.

Pour the chicken broth into the pot, and add more water to cover the vegetables thoroughly. Continue cooking over high heat until the vegetables are tender enough to be pierced with a fork. Once ready, reduce the heat and add the yogurt, stirring until well combined.
Using an immersion blender, puree half of the soup to achieve a creamy texture, leaving the other half unblended for added texture.
Add the chicken and allow it to heat through. Turn off the heat, then add the spinach and stir to slightly cook it.
Pour the soup into a bowl, garnish with fresh coriander, and enjoy warm!

name: Creamy Chicken Curry

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Pour the ghee into a pan over low heat.
Add the curry powder, tomato paste, and a pinch of salt. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the chicken broth, mix well, and add the chicken breast. Cover with a lid and cook for 10 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked and no longer pink.
Pour the yogurt into the mixture and combine well.
Reheat the cooked rice in a pan or microwave.
Place the rice on a serving plate, and add the chicken curry on top. Garnish with cilantro leaves, and enjoy!

name: Salmon With Potatoes & Asparagus

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: In a pot, place the potatoes and cover them with water. Bring to a boil for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender enough to be pierced with a fork. Drain the excess water.
Preheat the air fryer at 180°C for 5 minutes.
Take a large bowl, add the potatoes and asparagus, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Place the potatoes and asparagus in the air fryer and cook for 5 minutes or until tender. Once ready, set aside.
In a small bowl, pour the olive oil, squeeze the lime, add the chopped dill, and combine. Then, coat the salmon with this dressing
Cook the salmon in the air fryer for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through. Once ready, place it on a cutting board and use two forks to separate the salmon into pieces.
Assemble the plate by placing the potatoes first, pressing each potato with a glass. Add the asparagus and top with the salmon pieces. Garnish with dill and enjoy!

name: Bagel Smoked Salmon Salad Bowl

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Prepare the ingredients: slice the cucumber into half-moons, and cut the onion into strips.
Assemble the plate. Add the quinoa, cucumber, onion, salmon pieces, and capers.
In a food processor, combine the yogurt, minced garlic, half of the dill, salt, and oil. Blend until smooth.
Drizzle the yogurt-dill dip over the plate and garnish with the remaining dill. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Quinoa and Veggies Bowl

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb
Peppers sweet bell red raw
ingredients.unit: large (2-1/4 per lb, approx 3-3/4" long, 3" dia)

steps: Prepare the ingredients: mince the garlic, chop the bell pepper, and broccoli.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the salmon, flipping halfway through. Cook until the salmon changes color, then remove from the pan.
In the same pan, cook the bell pepper. Before it softens, add the broccoli, mixing well to heat through and soften the pepper. Once ready, set aside.
Dip: In a food processor, add the yogurt, minced garlic, olive oil, salt, and dill. Blend until smooth.
Assemble the bowl. Add the cooked quinoa, salmon, and veggies. Drizzle the yogurt-dill dip over the veggies and enjoy!

name: Lemon Chicken Tenders and Aparagus with Quinoa
steps: Rinse the quinoa under water.
Cook the quinoa according to the package instructions, and replace the water with chicken broth to add more flavor.
Meanwhile, mince the parsley, cut the chicken into strips, and place them in a bowl. Squeeze lemon juice over the chicken, and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and parsley.

Heat a non-stick pan on low to medium heat and cook the chicken strips for 4 minutes on each side, or until the chicken is no longer pink (Place the lid to keep the strips juicier). Once cooked, remove from the heat.
Cook the asparagus over medium heat for a couple of minutes, flipping occasionally.
Prepare the plate by adding the quinoa. Serve the chicken tenders on top and the asparagus as a side. Drizzle olive oil over the asparagus, add salt if needed, and enjoy!

name: Edamame-Shiitake Salad With Noodles
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the tofu into medium bite-sized pieces, mince the garlic, and slice the mushrooms if needed.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add the sesame oil, and once it's hot, add the minced garlic.

Add the mushrooms and tofu to the pan, and cook, stirring occasionally. Before the mushrooms become too soft, add the edamame and mix well. Allow everything to heat through and cook until the mushrooms become tender. Remove the pan from the heat.
In a bowl, serve the rice noodles and top with the sautéed mushrooms, tofu, and edamame mixture. Enjoy warm!

name: Zen Bowl
steps: Slice the mushrooms and cut the tofu into evenly sized cubes.
Heat a large pan over medium heat, add the sesame oil, and cook the mushrooms until they are soft. Then, add the spinach combine well, and serve on a plate.
Use the same pan, spray it with vegetable oil, add the tofu cubes, and cook over medium heat until golden, flipping them halfway through.
Prepare the bowl, heat the rice, and serve in a bowl. Add the spinach,  mushrooms, and tofu pieces.
Drizzle soy sauce over the top, sprinkle the chili flakes, and garnish with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

name: Tofu Noodle Bowl

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw
Tofu extra firm made with nigari

steps: Slice the mushrooms and cut the tofu into medium cubes, then place them in a bowl. Spray with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan and cook the tofu cubes over medium heat until they are lightly golden. Once cooked, set aside. In the same plan, place the mushrooms and cook them until soft.
Next, add the rice noodles, spinach, green onions, and soy sauce to the pan and combine well.
Serve in a bowl, add the tofu, sprinkle sesame seeds on top, and enjoy!

name: Hummus Bowl

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Slice the grilled chicken breast into strips and finely chop the red onion.
In a bowl, add the chickpeas, cucumber, olives, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and chicken.
Add the hummus on top, sprinkle some paprika for extra flavor, and enjoy!

name: Asian Veggie Bowl
steps: Slice the mushrooms lengthwise into strips and place them in a bowl. Drizzle with soy sauce and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the mushrooms. Flip them after a couple of minutes and cook until soft, then remove from the heat.
In a bowl, add the quinoa, red cabbage, avocado slices, grated carrots, and edamame. Top with the cooked mushrooms and sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Ginger Miso Soup With Noodles

ingredients.name: Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg
Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Prepare the ingredients: Peel and slice the carrots and ginger. Chop the green onions, and cube the tofu into small pieces.
In a pot, bring the vegetable broth to a simmer. Add the sliced ginger and let it infuse for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the miso paste until fully dissolved. Add the sliced carrots and rice noodles, then cook for 5 minutes or until the noodles are soft.
Add the liquid aminos, sesame oil, green onions, wakame, and tofu to the pot. Stir gently to combine.
Pour the soup into a bowl, and enjoy it warm!

name: Miso Soup

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Slice the green onions and carrots. Chop the tofu.
Pour the vegetable broth into a pot, and bring to a boil.
Add the miso paste to the pot, and stir well until it dissolves into the broth.
Next, stir in the carrots, green onions, and wakame seaweed. Cook for about 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Add the soy sauce, tofu, and combine.
Pour the soup into a bowl and enjoy it warm!

name: Quinoa Salad with Raspberry Salmon and Avocado
steps: In a bowl, combine the turmeric, pepper, and salt, then coat the salmon with the mix.
Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the salmon, flipping it after 3-4 minutes.
Once cooked, place the salmon on a cutting board and cut it into small cubes. Then, slice the avocado and halve the strawberries.
Prepare the salad with all the ingredients, and enjoy!

name: Kale Salad With Tofu

ingredients.name: Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt

steps: In a bowl, combine the kale, red cabbage, fennel, carrot, and chickpeas.
For the dressing, blend the tofu, olive oil, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Blend until smooth.
Drizzle the tofu dressing over the salad, toss to combine, and enjoy!

name: Kale Salad With Chicken

ingredients.name: Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt

steps: In a bowl, add the kale, red cabbage, fennel, carrot, and chickpeas. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well.
In a small bowl or plate, combine turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Cut the chicken into strips, then add them to the bowl and coat the strips with the spice mixture.
Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat or spray vegetable oil in the pan and add the chicken strips. Cook for 5 minutes on each side, until fully cooked.
Place the cooked chicken strips on top of the salad and enjoy!

name: Golden Milk Mousse
steps: Soak the dates in hot water for a few minutes, then drain them.
In a food processor, add the tofu, dates, tahini, turmeric, ginger, and pepper. Blend until smooth and add water if needed.
Pour the mixture into a container, cover it with a lid, and refrigerate overnight. Enjoy the next morning!

name: Sauteed Bok Choy

ingredients.name: Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg
Bok choy or pak choi or Chinese cabbage raw

steps: In a bowl, combine the red bell pepper, rice vinegar, and liquid aminos, and mix until well combined.
Heat a pan and add the sesame oil. Stir in the minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the seasoned red bell peppers and cook until softened. Once ready, add the bok choy and mix well.
Serve on a plate and enjoy warm!

name: Spicy Eggplant Stir Fry

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice
Onions green spring or scallions raw
Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg

steps: Cut the eggplant into strips and mince the garlic.
Place the eggplant and garlic in a bowl. Add the sesame oil, liquid aminos, parsley, chili flakes, and a pinch of salt. Combine well.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the eggplant for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once cooked, place the eggplant on a plate, top with the green onions, and enjoy!

name: Carrot Tuna Salad (High Protein)
steps: Blend the tuna with grated carrot in a food processor, adding lime and salt to taste.
Next, add the chopped onion and combine.
Transfer to a serving plate and complete with the corn chips.

name: Green Beans With Mushrooms

ingredients.name: Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg

steps: Mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic. Stir well.
Add the green beans, mushrooms, and a pinch of salt. Cook until the mushrooms are soft.
Add the liquid aminos and mix well.
Serve on a plate, sprinkle sesame seeds on top, and enjoy!

name: Vanilla Chai Smoothie

ingredients.name: Spiced chai tea bags by trader joe's

steps: Prepare the tea by boiling one cup of water. Pour it into a cup and add the two chai tea bags. Let it steep. At the same time, soak the dates in 1/4 cup of hot water just to soften them a bit.
In a food processor, add the greek yogurt, the dates, chai tea and vanilla almond milk. Blend until smooth
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Almond Mousse With Cherries
steps: Halve the cherries and remove the pit.
In a food processor,  add the tofu, almond extract, and honey. Blend until smooth.
Pour the almond mousse into a glass or container, add the cherries, blanched almonds, and cover with a lid.
Place it in the fridge overnight, and enjoy the next morning!

name: Cherry Chia Pudding
steps: Halve the cherries and remove the pit.
Place the cherries, Greek yogurt, and chia seeds in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a container, cover it with a lid, and refrigerate overnight.
Option: Add almond extract and non-caloric sweetener.

name: Golden Peach Smoothie (Plant-Based)
steps: Chop the peach and remove the pit.
In a food processor, add the tofu, peach, raspberries, turmeric, pepper, and almond milk.. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Kimchi Scramble Tofu With Rice

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Heat a non-stick pan and cook the scrambled eggs on medium heat. Next, add the kimchi after 2 minutes and combine well.
In a non-stick pan, add the cooked rice noodles and soy sauce. Mix well and set aside.
In the same pan or another, heat the oil over medium heat, and add the minced garlic.
Add the tofu into the pan and crumble it into small pieces using a spatula. Sprinkle salt and turmeric evenly over the scramble. Next, add the kimchi and stir well.
Prepare the plate, serve the rice noodles, and top with the scrambled eggs. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions. Enjoy!

name: Kimchi Scramble Eggs and Rice

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Chop the kimchi and set aside.
In a bowl, place the eggs and egg whites, add a pinch of salt, and whisk with a fork.
Heat a non-stick pan and cook the scrambled eggs on medium heat. Next, add the kimchi after 2 minutes and combine well.
Assemble the plate, serve the cooked rice, and place the scrambled eggs on top. Garnish with sesame seeds and scallions. Enjoy!

name: Eggs and Kimchi Bowl

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Peel and chop the potatoes.

Place the potatoes in a pot, cover them with water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a boil. Cook the potatoes for 5 minutes, or until they are fork-tender. Once the potatoes are ready, drain the water and place them on another plate.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan, add the eggs and whites, and cook them over medium heat to form sunny-side-up eggs. Once done, set aside.
Prepare the bowl by adding the kimchi, potatoes, and sunny-side-up eggs with the extra egg whites. Sprinkle with green onions, and add a pinch of salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Chai Overnight Bowl
steps: Soak the dates in hot water for a few minutes, then drain them.
In a food processor, add the tofu, chai, dates, and protein powder. Blend until smooth
Pour the mix into a bowl or container, cover with a lid, and refrigerate overnight
The next morning, slice the banana and place the slices on top. Drizzle the almond butter and enjoy!

name: Cocoa Power Overnight Bowl
steps: Soak the dates in hot water for a few minutes. Next, drain it.
In a food processor, add the dates, tofu, cocoa powder, and calorie-free sweetener. Blend until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, spread the tahini on top, sprinkle the hemp seeds over it, and enjoy!

name: Blue Smoothie Bowl
steps: Chop the kiwi and slice the strawberries.
In a food processor, add the kiwi (reserving a small amount for garnish at the end), then add the Greek yogurt and blue spirulina, and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a bowl, drizzle the almond butter, add the strawberries, and the remaining kiwi. Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Smoothie Bowl

ingredients.name: Cereals ready-to-eat muesli dried fruit and nuts

steps: In a food processor, add the pineapple, yogurt, turmeric, black pepper, ginger, protein powder, and half of the flax seeds. Add ice and blend until smooth.
Pour into a bowl, garnish with granola, blueberries, and the remaining flaxseeds. Enjoy!

name: Breakfast Banana With Chia Pudding
steps: Prepare the chia pudding. Pour the yogurt into a container, add the chia seeds, and combine. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Halve the raspberries, slice the banana lengthwise, and place it on a plate. Top with the chia pudding and raspberries. Drizzle the almond butter, add a pinch of sea salt, and enjoy!

name: Kefir Overnight Oats With Blueberrys

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked
Pumpkin seeds whole with shell roasted with salt
Organic low fat kefir plain by lifeway

steps: Pour the kefir into a food processor, add the chia seeds and oats. Next, blend until smooth.
Pour the mix into a container, add the blueberries and pumpkin seeds on top, cover, and refrigerate overnight. Enjoy!

name: Cocoa Smoothie Bowl

ingredients.name: Organic low fat kefir plain by lifeway

steps: Place the dates in a cup and cover them with boiled water. Soak them for a few minutes. Next, remove the dates and add some ice cubes to the water.
In a food processor, pour the kefir, protein powder, and cocoa powder. Add the dates with the water, and blend until smooth.
Pour the blend into a bowl and top with the hemp seeds. Drizzle the tahini on top.

name: Kale Smoothie
steps: In a food processor, add the avocado, kale, pineapple, protein powder, and soy milk. Add ice and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy!

name: Red Lentil Nuggets

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Soak red lentils in water for 4 hours or overnight in the fridge.Drain the lentils and remove any excessive water.
Mince the garlic, onion and parsley. Next, peel the carrot, continue grating it, and finish by grating the cheese.
In a blender place the lentils with onion, garlic, and egg. Blend until smooth.
In a bowl, add the drained  tuna, carrot, parsley, cheese, and complete with salt and onion powder. Next, add the lentils mix and combine well.
Preheat the air fryer at 180 for 5 minutes.

Shape the mixture into nugget fingers or patties and place them in an air fryer-safe mold and cook for 10 minutes, or longer if needed. Place the nugget fingers in an air fryer-safe mold and cook for 10 minutes, or longer if needed.
Place them on a serving plate, and enjoy warm!
Storing tip: Store the cooked nuggets in a container, making sure to cover them, and refrigerate for up to 3 days.

name: Tuna Avocado Cups

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C. Cut the tortilla in thirds and place every piece  in a muffin  air fryer-safe mold. Place the  drained tuna inside and cook for 5 mins  or until the tortilla looks completely firm and crispy.
Meanwhile chop the avocado into small pieces
Once the tortillas are ready, serve on a plate, add the avocado pieces into each cup and enjoy!

name: Sandwich Salad Skewer

ingredients.name: Olives green pickled canned or bottled
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Cut each bread in half, then prepare the small sandwiches by adding the ham and cheese, and cut them into medium sized squares.
Prepare the skewers by adding the lettuce, the sandwich squares, and a cherry tomato. Repeat this in each skewer.
Arrange on a plate and enjoy!

name: Pasta with Stracchino, Bresaola and Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Prepare the pasta according to the package instructions.
Meanwhile, slice the bresaola into thin strips and slice the tomatoes.
Once the pasta is ready, heat a pan, add the olive oil, and allow it to heat slightly. Then, add the stracchino cheese, place the pasta in the pan, and mix.
Add the tomatoes and bresaola, and mix everything.
Serve, adding salt and pepper to taste, and enjoy!

name: Greek Potato Salad With Salmon
steps: Chop the potatoes into small pieces. Place them in a microwave-safe bowl, cover them with water, and microwave for 5 mins or until the potatoes are fork-tender. Once are ready, drain the water and set aside.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat and cook the salmon. Once the salmon is ready, place it on a plate and shred it using two forks.
Take a bowl, and prepare the salad.  Add the greek yogurt, mayo, garlic, a pinch of salt, pepper, and mix well. Next, add the cucumber, red onion, potatoes, and combine.
Add the salmon on top, and enjoy!

name: Potato Soup

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Prepare the ingredients. Shred the chicken breast, peel, and dice the potatoes into small cubes for quicker cooking, and mince the green onion.
Heat the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leek and sauté for 2 minutes until softened.
Add the diced potatoes and chicken broth to the pot. Bring to a boil and cook for about 6 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender.

Add the milk, season with salt and pepper, and blend the soup using an immersion blender until smooth. 
Option: pour the soup into a regular blender, blend, and then return it to the pot.
Stir well, add the cheese, and cook for another 2-3 minutes until the cheese melts and everything is heated through.
Add the shredded chicken ang green chopped green onion, stir to combine.
Serve hot and enjoy!

name: Cottage Cheese Pasta

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: In a blender, add the cottage cheese, two basil leaves, salt, and squeeze the lemon. Blend until smooth.
