Mince the garlic, heat a pan, pour the olive oil, and add the garlic. Sauté for 2 minutes over medium heat.
Add the cottage cheese mixture to the pan, using a silicone spatula to scrape everything out of the blender. Mix well, then add the cooked pasta and combine.
Serve on a plate, top with shredded parmesan cheese and the remaining basil leaves. Enjoy!

name: Pizza Rolls
steps: Preheat the air fryer for 5 minutes at 180°C.
Spread the tomato paste evenly over the tortilla, then sprinkle the mozzarella cheese, and place the turkey salami and bell peppers all over the tortilla.
Roll up the tortilla tightly, then slice it into rolls.
Place the rolls in an air fryer-safe dish or basket and cook for 5 minutes at 180°C.Check halfway through.
Place in a plate, share and enjoy!

name: Cauliflower & Macaroni Cheese

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. Once ready, drain and set aside.
Chop the cauliflower and steam it until soft. Then, blend the cauliflower or mash it to make a puree.

Heat a pot and melt the butter. Add the flour and mustard, and cook for 2 minutes. Then slowly add the milk while stirring continuously to create a smooth sauce. Next, add 200 grams of cheese, paprika, salt and combine.
Add the macaroni and cauliflower puree to the cheese sauce and mix well.
Place the mixture in a baking dish, sprinkle the remaining cheese on top, and bake at 200°C  for 3 minutes or until the cheese is completely melted.
Serve and enjoy!
For a gluten free version, use corn flour and gluten-free pasta.

name: Chicken Pesto Wrap
steps: Cut the chicken breast into strips and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Spread the pesto evenly over the tortilla, then add the chicken strips and cherry tomato halves.
Wrap carefully, serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Veggies, Potatoes and Sausage Skillet

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Slice the chicken bratwurst.

Peel and chop the potatoes. Place the potatoes in a pot, cover them with water, add a pinch of salt, and cook for 5 minutes or until fork-tender. Once ready, drain the water and set the potatoes aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and add the bell peppers. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Next, add the potatoes, sausage, and season with salt and pepper. Mix with a spatula and cook until the sausage is ready.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Burrito with Cheesy Egg Whites and Chorizo

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Heat a pan and spray with vegetable oil. Pour in the egg whites and cook on medium heat. After 2 minutes, add the cheese and scramble, using a spatula to mix the cheese with the eggs. Once ready, set aside.
In the same pan, cook the chorizo over low to medium heat, using the spatula to break it apart and cook thoroughly.
Microwave the tortilla for 10-15 seconds to soften it.
Assemble the burrito: Place the cheesy egg whites on one side of the tortilla, then add the chorizo next to the eggs, making sure both ingredients are placed on the same side. Wrap carefully,

Storage Tip:
Wrap the burrito in aluminum foil or place it in parchment paper. Store in the fridge for up to 5 days or freeze for 5 to 7 days.

name: Cabbage Roll Skillet
steps: Chop the onion and set aside.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the onion, red pepper, and ground beef. Sprinkle some salt, paprika, garlic powder, and pepper. Cook until the beef is brown.
Next, add the grated cabbage and crushed tomatoes. Stir well, cover with a lid, and cook for a few more minutes until the cabbage and tomatoes are soft.
Add the cooked rice and mix until well combined.
Sprinkle the cheese over the top and cover again with the lid until the cheese is melted.
Serve on a plate and enjoy it warm!

name: Shrimp Curry Bowl
steps: Heat the oil in a pot, add the red curry paste, and cook for one minute.
Add the vegetable broth and stir well. Once the curry paste is completely dissolved, add the coconut milk and noodles, and bring to a boil for 3 minutes or until the noodles are soft.
Turn off the heat, remove the pan to prevent the noodles from overcooking, and add the shrimp. Stir well, and let it sit for a couple of minutes to allow the flavors to combine.
Pour the shrimp curry in a bowl, squeeze the lime over it, and enjoy it warm!

name: Greek Chicken Tacos
steps: Prepare the ingredients, cut the cucumber lengthwise, remove the seeds, and dice it into very small pieces. Halve the cherry tomatoes and dice the chicken breast into small pieces.
Assemble the tacos, spread one tablespoon of  hummus onto each tortilla. Then, fill each taco with chicken, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and sprinkle the feta cheese .
Arrange the tacos on a plate and enjoy!

name: Easy Fish Potato Pie
steps: Prepare the ingredients, grate the cheese, and set aside. Peel and dice the potatoes.
Place the potatoes in a pot, cover them with water, and add a pinch of salt. Boil until fork-tender.
Once they are ready, drain them, put them in a bowl, add half of the butter, and use a potato masher or fork to mash them.

Heat the same pot over medium heat, add the rest of the butter, flour, and whisk in the milk, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens. Add the chives, dijon mustard, salt, and pepper, and mix well. Then add the cod fillet (whole or chopped), and combine until well coated in the mixture.
Preheat the air fryer or oven at 200°C for 5 minutes.
Pour the creamy fish pie into an air fryer-safe mold, and spread the mashed potatoes. Sprinkle the cheese, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve and enjoy it warm!

name: Mexican Quinoa
steps: Prepare the ingredients, chop the green bell pepper and red onion, dice the tomatoes, and mince the jalapeno. Drain the black beans.

Heat a pan over low to medium heat and spray the vegetable oil.  Add the red onion, tomatoes and cook until soft. Add the bell pepper, jalapeno and ground beef. Sprinkle garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Once the beef is no longer pink, add the drained beans, cooked quinoa, and stir well.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Balls

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked
Dark chocolate chunks or chips 60 - 69% cacao

steps: Mix together oats, peanut butter, protein powder, honey, and chocolate chips until combined.
Roll into balls, and store them in a covered container in the fridge or freezer. Each serving is two balls

name: Stuffed Portobello - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Finely dice the green pepper, and chop the sweet potato into small cubes.
Prepare the portobello mushroom by gently twisting off or cutting the stem of each mushroom. Hold a mushroom in one hand, then use a spoon to scrape out the gills gently.

Spray the inside of the instant pot with nonstick spray. Press the saute button and add the ground turkey, green peppers, and sweet potato. Continue adding the garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste. Stir together.
Cancel the saute function, set it to pressure cook, and manually set the time for 3 minutes on high pressure. Once ready, allow a few minutes of natural release pressure before opening.
Transfer the meat into a bowl, add the walnuts, and combine.
Carefully place the steamer rack in the Instant Pot, spray the mushroom caps with vegetable oil on both sides, and sprinkle with salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Set to pressure cook and manually set the timer for 1 minute on high pressure. After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid.
Carefully transfer the mushrooms to a serving plate. Place the spinach inside, followed by the turkey stew. Garnish with walnuts and parsley

name: Buffalo Pasta Salad
steps: Dice the chicken breast into small pieces and slice the red onion into long strips.
In a separate bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, and buffalo sauce until smooth. Add the diced chicken and pasta to the sauce mixture and stir to combine well.
Place the shredded romaine lettuce in a large bowl, add the red onion and top with the creamy chicken and pasta.

name: Italian Omelette (High Protein)
steps: Mix the egg whites with the egg, nutritional yeast. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a nonstick pan with oil, and add the egg mixture. Cook over low heat for 3 minutes for each side.
Transfer the omelet to a serving plate. Next, add the zucchini to the same pan, add salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Cook until tender. Add cherry tomatoes halves, arugula, and pesto, stir for a minute then remove from the heat.
Place some veggies on the omelet and close it like a half-moon. Serve the remaining veggies as a side.

Serve with toast. 
Use rice bread or chickpea bread for a Gluten-Free Version

name: Cottage Cheese, Berries and Honey
steps: Place the cottage cheese in a bowl.
Add the strawberries halves and blueberries.
Drizzle the honey on top and enjoy!

name: Tuna Tropical Skewers
steps: Use a peeler to slice the cucumber into thin stripes.
Cut all the ingredients into equal-sized cubes
Assemble the skewers, starting with the avocados, then the tuna, followed by rolling the cucumber slices and slide them on the skewer, and finish by adding the mango.
Drizzle the soy sauce over the skewers and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Raspberry Cookie

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Mash your banana in a small bowl.
Next, mix the baking and cacao powder. Add the oats and mix once again. Add the peanut butter.
Once well combined, add the frozen raspberries and mix to combine.
Use your hands to mould the dough into a cookie shape, then place it on parchment paper.
Air fry at 350f for 8 minutes.
Option: bake at 400f degrees for 15-20 minutes.
Note: This recipe makes 3 servings, yielding 5 to 6 cookies in total. Two cookies equal one serving

name: Pina Colada Overnight Oats (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Place the oats, chia seeds, yogurt, and a dash of sweetener and stir to combine.
Spoon half of the mixture into the bottom of a mason jar, and add half of the coconut flakes, half the pineapple, the rest of the oats mixture, and another layer of the coconut and pineapple.
Place the lid and fridge overnight.
Option: use gluten free oats

name: Berry Cottage Bowl

ingredients.name: Nuts mixed dry roasted with peanuts salt added
Cereals ready-to-eat muesli dried fruit and nuts

steps: Place the cottage cheese in a blender. Add half a cup of the mixed berries and maple syrup.
Blend until smooth, then transfer the mixture into a bowl.
Garnish with the remaining mixed berries, mixed nuts, and muesli.

name: Chicken Picatta

ingredients.name: Margarine-like spread smart balance light buttery

steps: Cut the chicken into thinner slices.
In a bowl, add the flour, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste, and mix to combine. Coat the chicken slices in the flour mixture.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat and add the butter. Once the skillet is hot, add the chicken and cook for 3-5 minutes per side, or until golden.
Once the chicken is cooked, assemble the plate, squeeze the lime on top, and add the capers.

name: Strawberry Cucumber Salad With Salmon Bites
steps: Slice the strawberries and cucumber.
Heat a nonstick skillet and sear the salmon.
Once ready, chop the salmon into small cubes.
Add the strawberries, cucumber, olive oil, and honey to a bowl. Add a pinch of salt, mix well,  top with salmon pieces, and enjoy!

name: Crusted Tuna With Mango Salad
steps: Place the sesame seeds on a plate and coat the tuna on both sides with the seeds.
Chop the mango, cucumber, and red bell pepper into bite-sized pieces.

Sear the tuna. First preheat the skillet, spray the vegetable oil, and place the tuna, cook for two minutes until the color changes, once the first side is seared, flip the tuna and sear the other side.
Once the tuna is seared, cut it into fillets.
Prepare the plate, add the mango salad and place the sliced tuna on top. Serve and enjoy!

name: Fish and Chips

ingredients.name: Potatoes white flesh and skin raw

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a pot with water, bring it to a boil, and add enough salt. Add the potatoes and cook for 4 minutes or until they’re fork-tender. Drain the water.
Place the cooked potatoes in a bowl, add the oil, Cajun seasoning, and mix well. Cook the potatoes in the air fryer at 180°C for 5 minutes, checking halfway through to ensure they’re evenly cooked.

In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolk with salt and pepper. In another bowl, whisk the egg whites using a stand mixer or electric hand mixer until soft peaks form. Gently fold the egg yolk and minced parsley into the egg whites without deflating the mixture.

Dip the fish fillets into the egg mixture, then sprinkle with a bit of parsley. Transfer the fillets to the air fryer basket or tray, spray with vegetable oil, and cook for 8 minutes, or until golden and fully cooked.
Once ready, assemble the plate with the fish, and chips. Enjoy!

name: Beetroot Salmon Salad With Quinoa
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 5 minutes.
Slice the beets into half-moon pieces. Place them into the air fryer, spray with vegetable oil, and cook for 5-10 minutes, or until tender.
Heat a pan and spray with vegetable oil spray. Add the salmon and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the salmon changes color. Remove from the pan and set aside, then cut into pieces.
Squeeze the lemon into a small bowl, add the olive oil, and salt. Mix well.
In a bowl, combine the arugula, beet slices, and quinoa. Add the salmon pieces, drizzle with the olive oil mix, and enjoy!

name: Sweet Beetroot Salmon Breakfast
steps: Peel the beetroot and cut it lengthwise
In a non-stick pan, place the salmon, cover with the lid, and cook over low heat for 5 minutes, flip in the middle of the process. Once it's fork tender, set it aside.
In the same pan, cook the beetroot slices, flipping occasionally until lightly blackened.
Next, in a bowl place the spinach and arugula, add the shredded salmon, beetroot, drizzle the honey on top, and enjoy!

name: Fish With Rice and Broccoli

ingredients.name: Peas green canned regular pack drained solids
Rice white long-grain precooked or instant enriched prepared

steps: Chop the tomatoes into small pieces.
In a pan, heat one tablespoon of olive oil. Next,  add the chopped tomatoes and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.

Add the precooked rice, peas and broccoli, and add the water following the cooking directions from the packet, cover the pan with the lid to keep it juicy. Cook on medium heat for about 10 minutes. Once the rice is ready, set aside.

While the rice is cooking, prepare the tilapia. Season it with garlic salt. Next, heat one tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the fillet and cook on low to medium heat. Once is almost cooked, flip it and cook for two minutes more or until done.
Serve the rice with veggies on a plate, top with the fish, and enjoy!

name: Salmon with Crunchy Salad
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (350°F). Prepare the chickpeas, place them in a bowl, and spray twice with vegetable oil and coat the chickpeas thoroughly with paprika, and salt.
Cook the chickpeas in the air fryer for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden.

To sear the salmon, first preheat the pan over medium heat. Once hot, place the salmon in the pan and cook for 2 minutes until the color changes. Once the first side is seared, flip the salmon and sear the other side for another one or two minutes.
Remove the chickpeas from the air fryer, add the kale, spray with a little vegetable oil, and add a pinch of salt. Cook at 180°C for 2 minutes or until golden.
Place the kale on a plate, add the chickpeas and salmon. Enjoy!

name: Salmon Tomato Stew
steps: Halve the tomatoes and preheat the oven to 180°C
Combine the tomato sauce, chickpeas, tomatoes, salt, and water in a baking dish and mix well.
Add the salmon pieces and cook for 10 minutes. Halfway through, use a spoon to baste the salmon with the juices, then return it to the oven to finish cooking.
Once ready, remove from the oven, add the Greek yogurt, mix, and enjoy!

name: Greek Shrimp

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Chop the shallots, and dill, halve the cherry tomatoes, and chop the feta cheese into small cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, add the shallots and cook for two minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes and salt. Drizzle the honey and cook for five minutes.
Mix in the cherry tomatoes, shrimp, and feta cheese, stir well, and cook for a few more minutes.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Lasagna
steps: Mince the garlic, chop the spinach, and slice the zucchini lengthwise into thin strips.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and spinach. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the spinach is slightly softened. Remove from heat.
Preheat the oven to 180°C
Drain the ricotta cheese and place it in a food processor. Add salt and blend until smooth.
Place the ricotta mixture on a plate and add the cooked spinach. Mix well.
In a small to medium-sized baking dish, layer the zucchini slices, then add some of the ricotta mixture on top. Continue layering until all the zucchini and ricotta mixture are used up.
Bake at 180°C for 10  to 15 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before serving, and enjoy!

name: Apple Breakfast Bowl
steps: Blend the cottage cheese with the vanilla extract and sweetener until smooth.
Cut the apple in half. Slice one half into small cubes and the other half into thin slices.
Stir in the apple cubes with the cottage cheese mixture and combine well.
Complete by adding the apple slices, drizzle the peanut butter, and enjoy!

name: Tuna Rice Cake Toast

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: In a bowl, place the cream cheese and soften it with a fork.
Add the drained tuna, salt, and pepper. Mix everything well.
Spread the mixture on each rice cake,  top with sesame seeds, and enjoy!

name: Cookies and Cream Mousse

ingredients.name: Cookies chocolate sandwich with creme filling regular

steps: Blend the Greek yogurt with cream cheese until smooth. Next, add the protein powder and two cookies and blend again.
Pour the mix into a bowl, crush the remaining cookie, sprinkle all over the bowl and enjoy!

name: Easy Cheesecake
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 160°C for 5 minutes.
Place each ingredient in a blender or food processor, and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a mold that fits into the air fryer.
Cook at 160°C for 10 minutes or until the surface is  firm and lightly golden.

name: Cottage Cheese Cookie Dough
steps: Blend the cottage cheese with the maple syrup and vanilla extract.
In a bowl, add the almond flour and whey protein powder. Combine well.
Next, add the cottage cheese blend, and mix everything together until well combined. Add the chocolates chips and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Fish

ingredients.name: Olives green pickled canned or bottled

steps: Prepare the ingredients, slice the onion into strips, chop the tomatoes, and halve the olives.
Next, heat  the oil in a pan, add the fish, onion, capers, olives and tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper and cook with the lid on.
Halve the baby yellow potatoes and place them on a microwave-safe plate. Cover with water and microwave for 4 minutes or until are fork-tender.
Once the potatoes are ready, add them to the pan and combine.
Serve it on a plate and enjoy!

name: Pork With Carrot Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: Pork tenderloin lean meat and fat raw

steps: Peel the carrots and use a vegetable peeler to slice them into thin strips. Then, halve the cherry tomatoes. In a bowl, add each ingredient, then the cooked quinoa, and toss everything together

Next, mince the garlic. Heat a pan over low-medium heat, and add the butter and garlic and stir well. After two minutes, add the pork tenderloin. Cook on low heat for about 5 minutes each side, flipping the pork halfway through. Cover the pan with the lid while cooking to keep the pork juicy. Once the pork is fully cooked, slice it into strips.
Serve the pork and complete with  the salad as a side.

name: Grilled Nopales

ingredients.name: Cheese pasteurized process american low fat

steps: Grate the cheese and set aside.

Prepare the pico de gallo: Chop the onion, slice the tomato in half, remove the seeds, and dice it into small pieces. Next, slice the jalapeño, remove the seeds, and chop it. 
Option: use green bell pepper instead of jalapeño.
Heat the grill, spray with vegetable oil. Cook the nopales over medium to high heat, flipping them after a few minutes, until they are tender.
Next, spread the beans evenly on each grilled nopal.  sprinkle the cheese, and let it melt slightly.
Place the nopales on a plate, top with pico de gallo and enjoy!

name: Simple Egg White Bacon Sandwich
steps: In a bowl, beat the eggs and egg whites, adding salt and pepper to taste.

Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and pour the eggs mix.  Place the two slices of bread on top of the omelette, side by side. Once the eggs start to set, carefully flip the omelette, allowing it to cook fully.
Next, add a slice of cheese and turkey bacon on top of one side. Fold in the sides, then cover with the other slice of bread.
Slice the sandwich, serve and enjoy!

name: Skillet Nacho Dip

ingredients.name: Snacks tortilla chips plain white corn salted
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Blend the cottage cheese and shredded cheddar together until smooth.
Mix the cheese blend with the cooked ground beef.
Serve the mixture in a bowl.
Top with pico de gallo and arrange the tortilla chips on one side of the bowl
For the pico de gallo, mix chopped onion, chopped tomato, and chopped jalapeño or green bell pepper.

name: Cabbage Wedges With Spicy Garlic Dip
steps: In a food processor, combine the cottage cheese, garlic, paprika, chipotle, and salt to taste. Blend until smooth. Let the mixture chill in the fridge for a few minutes to thicken.
Cut the cabbage into wedges.

Heat a skillet over medium heat and spray with vegetable oil. Place the cabbage wedges in the skillet and cook. After a couple of minutes, spray the wedges with vegetable oil again before flipping them to cook the other side.
Once the wedges are golden and tender, remove from the skillet.
Spread the dip on a plate and top with the cooked cabbage wedges. Sprinkle with red chili flakes finely chopped parsley, and enjoy!

name: Sirlon With Air Fryer Potatoes And Salad

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin broiled steak strip

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (390°F) for 5 minutes.
While the air fryer is preheating, cut the potatoes into medium-length strips. Mince the rosemary.
Place the potatoes in a bowl, spray with vegetable oil to coat them, and mix well. Then, add salt and minced rosemary. For better results, soak the potatoes in cold water for a few minutes before.
Depending on the power of the air fryer, cook the potatoes at 190°C (390°F) for 10 to 15 minutes.
For the salad, chop the lettuce, halve the cherry tomatoes, and slice the onion into half-moons. Combine everything in a small bowl.
Serve the steak sliced crosswise on a cutting board, with the potatoes on the side and the salad bowl.

name: Pesto Chicken Salad
steps: Shred the chicken using two forks. Slice the sun-dried tomatoes into strips, slice the red bell pepper and cut the red onion into thin half-moons.
Mix the shredded chicken with the basil pesto. Then, add the sun-dried tomatoes, red bell pepper, red onion and combine.
Place the arugula on a bowl or plate as a base, then top with the pesto chicken salad. Serve with focaccia on the side. Enjoy!

name: Italian Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Shred the chicken using two forks. Slice the onion into thin half-moons. Halve the black olives and the sun-dried tomatoes.
Place the chicken in a bowl, add the greek yogurt, salt, and pepper, and mix.
Next, combine the sun-dried tomatoes, farro, and avocado slices.
Scatter the olives around the dish and enjoy!

name: Cottage Watermelon Salad
steps: Drain the cottage cheese, pressing with a fork to remove excess liquid.
Cut the watermelon into medium-sized cubes and halve the pecans lengthwise.
Arrange the watermelon and blueberries on a plate, and spoon the cottage cheese over it. Add the mint leaves and pecans on top. Complete by drizzling the balsamic vinegar around the plate, and enjoy!

name: Tilapia With Quinoa Salad
steps: Prepare the salad, grate the carrot, halve the tomato, remove the seeds, and chop it into small cubes. Chop the avocado. Then, combine all the chopped vegetables with the cooked quinoa in a bowl. Season with salt and mix well.
Season the tilapia with salt and garlic powder. Heat a pan over medium heat and spray with vegetable cooking oil. Cook the tilapia for about 5 minutes on each side, until fully cooked.
Serve the tilapia on a plate with the quinoa salad.

name: Salmon Salad With Raspberry Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: Apple cider vinegar by always save

steps: In a nonstick skillet, cook the salmon over medium heat, using a spatula to flake it as it cooks.
Slice the red onion into thin strips.
Combine the spinach, onion, and half of the raspberries in a bowl. Toss well, then add the salmon and feta cheese.
Place the remaining raspberries, vinegar, and lemon juice in a food processor. Blend until smooth, adding 1-2 tablespoons of water for a liquid consistency if desired.
Drizzle the raspberry vinaigrette over the salad, toss, and enjoy!

name: Salmon Bites Bowl

ingredients.name: Soybeans green cooked boiled drained without salt

steps: In a nonstick skillet, heat the cauliflower rice over medium heat. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder, mix well and set aside.
Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces and cook over medium heat just until the salmon changes color, enough to sear the outside.
Serve the cooked cauliflower rice as the base in a bowl. Place the soybeans on one side and the salmon bites on the other.
Drizzle the teriyaki sauce on top and garnish with sesame seeds.

name: Shrimp Mango Cabbage Cups
steps: Chop the mango and cucumber into small cubes. Place them on a plate, add the shrimp, then squeeze the lime juice over the mixture and stir well.
Prepare the cabbage cups by placing a spoonful of the shrimp and mango mix into each red cabbage leaf. Drizzle mayonnaise on top.
Continue the process with the remaining cabbage leaves. Serve on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Dip With Veggies

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Slice the green onion into small pieces and chop the bacon into small bits.

Combine the cottage cheese and cream cheese in a blender. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate the dip for a couple of hours for a thicker consistency.
Transfer the dip to a bowl, or use a cabbage as a bowl, remove a bit of the center and place the dip inside. Stir in the chopped green onion and bacon.
Peel and slice the carrots into sticks, then slice the sweet yellow peppers into sticks. Arrange the veggies around the bowl of dip.

name: Tuna Salad Wrap

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb
Lettuce raw (butterhead boston or bibb type)
Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Mix the tuna, celery, shallots, dill, and mayonnaise together. Add some lemon zest and squeeze the lemon juice. Combine well.
Prepare the wraps. Use one large tortilla or two smaller ones. Place the lettuce leaves on top of the tortilla and spread the tuna mix
Fold the sides of the tortilla inward and then begin rolling it up tightly.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Asian Pork Tenderloin Lettuce Tacos

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw
Lettuce raw (butterhead boston or bibb type)
Pork tenderloin lean meat and fat raw

steps: Cut the pork tenderloin into bite-sized pieces and cut the green onion.
Combine the sesame oil, ground ginger, and minced garlic in a bowl. Add the pork pieces and green onions and combine well.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook the pork, turning the pieces as needed, until the meat changes color and is cooked through.
Assemble the tacos by placing two lettuce leaves as the base. Add a layer of rice, followed by the cooked pork, and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Chicken with Sun Dried Tomatoes and Cottage
steps: Cut the potatoes into small wedges. Fill a pot with water and bring it to a boil. Add enough salt to the water, then add the potato wedges. Cook for approximately 5 minutes or until fork-tender.

Drain the excess liquid from the cottage cheese using a fork to press it gently. Then, transfer it to a food processor. Add the cream cheese, salt, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning to taste, and blend until smooth.
Chop the sun-dried tomatoes, chiffonade the spinach and combine them with the cottage cheese mixture.
Carefully slice the chicken breast open to create a pocket. Stuff the chicken with the cheese mixture and close it securely.

Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add the stuffed chicken breast and cook, covering with a lid to keep it juicy. Cook for 5 minutes, then flip the chicken and cook for another 5 minutes or until fully cooked, making sure not to overcook.
Serve the stuffed chicken with the cooked potatoes, and enjoy!

name: Tuna Sushi Bake

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw
Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Mix the cream cheese with the tuna and green onions in a bowl until well combined.
Place the nori sheets on a small baking dish. Spread the cooked rice evenly over the nori, then top with the creamy tuna mix.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and bake for 5 to 10 minutes.
Allow it to cool slightly, then transfer to a serving plate.
Drizzle the sriracha on top for a little extra heat and flavor. Serve and enjoy!

name: Tuna Sushi Wrap

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Soak the rice paper according to the package instructions, then place it on top of the nori sheet.
In a bowl, mash the avocado with a fork until smooth.
Spread the rice evenly on half of the nori sheet, pressing lightly. Then, add the mashed avocado, salt to taste, tuna, and cucumber slices on top.
Roll up the sushi tightly and repeat the process with the other nori sheet.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Elote Chicken Salad
steps: Shred the cooked chicken breast, mince the onion, and finely shred the cabbage.
Next, blend the cottage cheese with the mayo, and add garlic salt to taste.
Prepare the salad, add the cabbage, corn and onion to a bowl, stir in the cottage dressing and combine. Complete by adding the shredded chicken, and enjoy!

name: Tuna Carnitas Tacos

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: In a bowl, place the drained tuna, add garlic salt and paprika to taste, and mix well.
Heat a nonstick pan and cook the tuna, stirring occasionally.
Heat the tortillas and prepare the tacos by adding the tuna, avocado slices, and cilantro. Squeeze a bit of lemon on top for extra flavor. Enjoy!

name: Baked Beef Tacos

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: In a nonstick pan, cook the onions over medium heat until they begin to change color. Then, add the ground beef, stirring well. Use a spatula to break up the meat as it cooks, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Once the beef mixture is ready, prepare each taco.
Grate the cheese and add it to each taco.
Close the tacos and place them in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 5 minutes. For faster  results, preheat the air fryer before cooking.

name: Easy Cabbage Rolls

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Fill a pot with water and bring it to a boil. Add a pinch of salt and the cabbage leaves. Boil for 5 minutes, and remove the leaves. They should be tender but not completely soft
Add the ground beef, carrots, green onions, and eggs to a nonstick skillet. Cook over medium heat, breaking the meat apart with a spatula. Add salt and pepper to taste, stirring occasionally.
To assemble the rolls, place a portion of the cooked mixture inside each cabbage leaf and roll it up. Arrange the rolls on a plate and pour the teriyaki sauce over them. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Chicken Broccoli

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Shred the chicken and preheat the air fryer to 180°C (350°F) for 5 minutes.
Place the broccoli and shredded chicken in an air fryer-safe mold. Next, crush the croutons, add half to the mold, and combine

In a food processor, blend the cottage cheese, paprika, and garlic to taste. Add a tablespoon of water and the cheddar cheese, then blend until smooth. Pour the cheese mixture over the broccoli and chicken.
Sprinkle the rest of the croutons over the top. Cook in the air fryer at 180°C (350°F) for 10  minutes.
Let it cool slightly, then transfer to a plate and enjoy!

name: Easy Tuna Quiche

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Place the egg in a bowl, add salt and pepper to taste, and whisk with a fork. Then, add the onion and mix.

Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (350°F). Place the tortilla in an air fryer-safe mold, leaving space in the center. Pour the tuna and egg mixture into the tortilla, halve the cherry tomatoes, arrange them on top, and then sprinkle with cheese.
Cook for 15 minutes at 180°C (350°F) or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

name: Power Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Slice the cucumber into half-moon pieces and the onion into thin strips. On a separate cutting board, cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces.

Heat a skillet and spray it with vegetable oil. Add the chicken pieces and cook, covering the pan to keep them juicy. Flip after a couple of minutes, or when the chicken starts changing color, and cook through.
Blend the cottage cheese with the garlic and dill. Add salt and pepper to taste. Next, place the cucumber and onion in a bowl, stir in the cottage dip and mix well.
Add the cooked chicken bites to the salad and finish by topping with croutons. Enjoy!

name: Yogurt Marinated Chicken

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Mince the garlic and cilantro leaves. Next, mix them with the Greek yogurt and olive oil. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Using a knife, make shallow cuts along the outside of the chicken breast to the marinade better.
Preheat the air fryer. Spread the yogurt marinade evenly over each chicken breast and cook in the air fryer for 10 minutes, or until fully cooked.
Transfer to a serving plate or cutting board, and serve with rice on the side

name: Salmon Bites With Cottage Spinach Dip and Brown Rice

ingredients.name: Rice brown medium grain cooked without salt

steps: Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (350°F). Spray the salmon cubes with vegetable oil and cook in the air fryer for 5 minutes to seal them or 10 minutes to cook them through.
Meanwhile, finely chop the spinach into small pieces.
Drain the cottage cheese completely, pressing it with a fork to remove excess liquid. Transfer it to a food processor, add the cream cheese and garlic, and blend until the texture becomes smooth.
Add the chopped spinach to the cheese mixture and combine with a spoon.
Prepare the plate by adding the cooked brown rice on one side, the salmon bites on the other, and the cheese dip.

name: Grilled Chicken Sandwich

ingredients.name: Swiss cheese nonfat or fat free

steps: Toast the bread. Slice the tomato into thin rounds and cut the chicken breast in half lengthwise.
Heat the chicken in a nonstick pan. Once heated, add the cheese on top and let it melt.
Prepare the sandwich by spreading pesto on both slices of bread. Place the chicken with melted cheese on one slice of bread, then layer the tomato slices on top. Close the sandwich.
Halve the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Tuna Zucchini Boats

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Cut he zucchini in half lengthwise and scoop out some of the center. Slice the pepper.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, adding a pinch of salt. Once it starts bubbling, add the zucchini and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender. Drain the zucchini and set aside.
Finely chop the onion and mix it with the quinoa and tuna in a bowl.
Stuff each zucchini with the tuna-quinoa mix and top with the cheese and jalapeño slices.

Place the stuffed zucchini in the air fryer and cook for 2 minutes or until the cheese has melted.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Cactus Rolls With Chicken
steps: Chop the tomatoes and onion. Next, heat a non stick pan and cook them on medium heat. Transfer into a food processor add garlic salt and blend.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and spray with vegetable oil. Cook the nopales on each side for 2-3 minutes, flipping until tender. Use four pieces of nopales, each about 50 g.
Once the nopales are ready, prepare the rolls. Spread the refried beans on each nopal piece, add the shredded chicken, and roll them up. Secure with toothpicks.
Place the salsa in a baking dish, add the cactus rolls, and sprinkle Monterey cheese on top. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 5 minutes or until the cheese melts slightly.

name: Stuffed Eggplant
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (350°F).Slice the eggplant in half lengthwise and place the halves in the air fryer. Cook for 10 minutes at 180°C (350°F).
Meanwhile, mince the garlic and chop the onion and tomatoes into small pieces. Next, cook them in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until the tomatoes soften and the onions change color.
Add the ground beef, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring and breaking up the beef with a spatula, until it’s fully browned and the meat changes color.
Once the eggplant is cooked, scoop out some of the flesh from the center. Finely chop the flesh and mix it with the cooked meat mixture.
Stuff each half of the eggplant with the meat mixture, top with Swiss cheese, and return to the air fryer for another 2 minutes to melt the cheese. Serve and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Ceviche

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Dice the tomatoes and onions into small pieces. Mince the jalapeno by cutting it in half, removing the seeds, and then finely mincing it. Finely chop the cilantro, and cut the avocado into small cubes.
Place the cooked shrimp in a bowl and squeeze the lime juice over it. For more flavor, marinate the shrimp for a few minutes or overnight.
Once marinated, add the chopped ingredients, mix well, and enjoy!

name: Tuna Cucumber Boats

ingredients.name: Fish tuna light canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Slice the cucumber in half lengthwise, scooping out the seeds and some of the center to create a small space for the filling.
Fill each cucumber boat with rice, pressing lightly to pack it in.
In a bowl, mix the tuna with the mayonnaise. Add salt, pepper and paprika to taste.
Spoon the tuna mix on top of the rice in each cucumber boat, sprinkle everything bagel seasoning. Serve on a plate and enjoy!

name: Tuna Cottage Cheese Salad
steps: Drain the cottage cheese and use a fork to press out any excess liquid
In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese, tuna, and mayonnaise. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Next, add the chopped red onion, bell pepper, and coriander, and combine well.
Transfer the mixture to a serving plate and serve with the baked corn crackers

name: Mexican Tostadas

ingredients.name: Baked horneadas tostadas with sea salt by mission

steps: Cut the tomato in half, remove the seeds, and dice it into very small pieces. Chiffonade the lettuce into thin strips.
Mash the avocado and mix it with the cream. Add salt to taste.
Assemble the tostadas. Add the ground beef to the tostadas. lettuce, shredded cheese, tomatoes, and the avocado mix.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Creamy Chicken Pesto
steps:
Mix the pesto and Greek yogurt in a bowl. Coat the chicken breast with the mixture. 
Option: Let it marinate for a few hours for enhanced flavor.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (350°F). Place the chicken in the air fryer and cook for 10 minutes, until fully cooked.

Meanwhile, halve the baby potatoes and season with salt to taste. Place them in a microwave-safe bowl, cover with water, and microwave for about 5 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain the potatoes and set them aside.
Place the cooked chicken on the plate, add the halved baby potatoes, and top with diced tomatoes.

name: Beef and Cheese Rolls
steps: Lightly warm the tortillas. Add the ground beef and cheese to one side of each tortilla. To form the rolls, first roll just one part, then fold in the sides and continue rolling tightly. Repeat the process for the other roll.
Place the rolls in the air fryer basket. Spray with vegetable oil and cook for 5 minutes at 360°F (180°C).  Adjust the time and temperature if needed.
Transfer into a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Zucchini Sandwich
steps: Slice the zucchini lengthwise into medium-thick slices.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, and add the zucchini slices. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes until they become tender. Not overcook them.
Once done, remove the zucchini from the water and gently pat them dry with a paper towel.
To assemble the sandwiches, layer the ham and Swiss cheese on top of one slice of zucchini and then cover with another slice of zucchini.
Place the sandwiches in the air fryer basket, spray with vegetable oil spray, and season with a pinch of salt. Cook at 180°C (350°F) for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the sour cream, ketchup, and mustard. Drizzle over the zucchini sandwiches and enjoy!

name: Taco Bowl

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: To prepare the tortilla bowls, lightly spray both sides of the tortillas with vegetable oil. Place the first tortilla in a bowl that is safe for the air fryer. Use a smaller bowl inside to shape the tortilla, creating space for the filling. Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 5 minutes, then remove and set aside. Repeat the process with the second tortilla.

Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the ground beef and add salt and steak seasoning to taste. Use a spatula to break up the beef as it cooks. Continue cooking until the meat is browned, then remove it from the heat.

For the pico de gallo, dice the tomatoes, remove the seeds, and chop the onion and jalapeño peppers. For a milder taste, substitute the jalapeño with green bell pepper. Mix the ingredients and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for added flavor.
Fill each tortilla bowl with the cooked beef. Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the beef, top with the pico de gallo mixture, and enjoy!

name: Caesar Chicken Skewers
steps: Cut the chicken breast into small to medium cubes. Place the pieces in a bowl, stir in the Caesar dressing, and toss to coat them evenly. Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over the chicken and mix well.
Thread the chicken onto the skewers and cook in the air fryer at 400°F for 10 minutes or until fully cooked.
Meanwhile, chop the lettuce and cut the cherry tomatoes in half. Transfer the salad to a plate.
Once the skewers are ready, place them on top of the salad and enjoy!

name: Supreme Breakfast Tacos

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Slice the tomato in half, remove the seeds, and dice it into small pieces.

Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the ground beef. Once it’s almost cooked, add the eggs, lower the heat, and scramble the mixture, stirring occasionally. Season with salt, pepper, or meat seasoning for extra flavor. Once ready, set aside.
Heat the tortillas, and assemble the tacos with the scrambled eggs mixture. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro leaves. Enjoy!

name: Tortilla Egg Muffin

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the ground beef. Add salt, pepper, and steak seasoning to taste. Cook until the beef changes color and is fully cooked.
Whisk the egg and egg whites together, adding salt to taste. Optionally, add spinach or veggies.
Place the tortilla in each muffin pan, and spoon the cooked beef into each one. Next, stir in the egg mixture into each muffin.
Cook in the air fryer at 180°C (350°F) for 10 to 15 minutes. After 10 minutes, pierce the center with a toothpick to check if they’re done.
Once done, remove from the oven and enjoy!

name: Peanut Butter Milkshake

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Italian Morning Toast
steps: Slice the peach into half-moon shapes, then cut the cheese into slices.
Toast the bread and add the cheese slices on top. Next, fold each slice of prosciutto in half and place it on the bread. Complete with the peach slices on top, and enjoy!

name: Crustless Salmon Quiche
steps: Place the potatoes in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook until fork-tender. Once ready, drain the water and cut the potatoes in half. Place them in a bowl, then add the oil, salt, and paprika. Next, cook in a skillet until golden and crispy
Preheat the air fryer to 350°F (180°C).
Whisk the eggs, egg whites, and cottage cheese and add salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to an air fryer mold and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on the air fryer. Check after 10 minutes until the center is firm.
Let it cool slightly, then remove it from the mold, place it on a plate, add the potatoes, and enjoy!

name: Thai Beef With Veggies & Rice

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Slice the bell peppers into thin strips.  Cut the meat into small piece.
Heat a nonstick pan and cook the bell peppers until slightly tender, then set aside.
Combine the peanut butter, soy sauce, and beef broth in a bowl. Blend if necessary to ensure the mixture is smooth.

Heat the nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add the beef and drizzle with the prepared sauce. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef is browned. Once the beef is ready, add the bell peppers back to the pan and mix to combine.
Warm the cooked rice in the microwave.
Serve the rice on a plate and top it with the beef and peppers, enjoy!

name: Green Beans, Tuna Salad
steps: Drain the tuna and halve the green beans.
Next, mix the tuna with the green beans, capers, and chickpeas.
Add the olive oil and squeeze lemon juice over the  salad

name: Garlic Butter Pork Bites

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled without salt
Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Dice the pork into bite-sized pieces, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat, add the butter and garlic, and sauté for about one minute until fragrant. Add the parsley, season with salt to taste, and mix well.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked.
Slice the Brussels sprouts in half. Heat a pan and spray with vegetable oil. Cook over medium-low heat, making sure to cover with a lid. Cook until they are tender and easily pierced.
Assemble the plate. Serve the butter pork bites, rice, and Brussels sprouts.

name: Bread Pizza
steps: Prepare the ingredients: slice the bread into three pieces (30g each). Shred the cheese.
Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil and cook the beef until the color changes. Break up into crumbles as it cooks.
Assemble the pizzas and spread the tomato sauce on each bread slice. Top with the cooked beef crumbles, pepperoni slices and mozzarella cheese.
Bake for a few minutes until the cheese is melted. Serve and Enjoy.

name: Tuna Avocado Bruschetta
steps: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Place the tuna in the pan and sear for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side or until it changes color. Then, transfer it to a cutting board and slice it.
Slice half of a medium-large avocado. Remove the pit, peel, and slice it into thin pieces.
In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce with the honey. Optionally, add chopped chives
Toast the bread and transfer it to a plate, add arugula on top, then the avocado slices. Top with the tuna slices, and drizzle with the soy mixture.

name: Shrimp Bowl With Cucumber- Avocado Salad

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Shrimp raw frozen medium peeled and deveined tail off

steps: Preheat the air fryer if needed, place the shrimp and spray vegetable spray, and add salt and garlic powder to taste. Cook at 400 °F  for 10 minutes.
Slice the avocado and mince the coriander. Continue with the cucumber cut in half lengthwise. Place each half on the cutting board, cut side down side-by-side, and slice into thin half-moon slices.
Transfer to a bowl, squeeze the lime, add salt and pepper to taste and combine.
Microwave the cooked rice, serve in a bowl, and add the cooked shrimp and the avocado-cucumber salad.

name: Pork Salad

ingredients.name: Pork tenderloin lean meat and fat raw

steps: Cut the pork into thin strips, preheat a nonstick pan and cook the meat over low-medium heat. Season with garlic, salt and pepper to taste.
Cut the onion into rings, the bell pepper into thin strips, and the tomatoes into halves or thirds.
In a salad bowl, combine all the ingredients add the croutons and enjoy!

name: Burger Bowl

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned. Add salt, garlic powder and pepper to taste.
Quarter the tomatoes by slicing them in half lengthwise, then cutting each half in half again.
Prepare the bowl, place the lettuce, and add the meat, grated cheese, tomatoes and red onion. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Curry Chicken
steps: Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the onions, until softened. Stir in the curry powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and stir well to combine. Gradually mix in the sour cream, stirring constantly until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat it evenly in the sauce. Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 5 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the flavors are well combined.
Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Chicken Stew
steps: Chop the potatoes into bite-sized pieces, then move on to the tomatoes, mince the garlic, and cut the chicken breast into small cubes.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat, add the chicken, and cook until it becomes soft and turns white. Once ready, set it aside.
In the same pan, add the olive oil and garlic, and saute. Add the potatoes and mix well.
Next, add 100 ml of water and a pinch of salt, cover with a lid, and cook until the potatoes are tender and can be easily pierced with a fork.

Add the tomatoes, zucchini, and another 100 ml of water. Cook until the zucchini are soft, Make sure to season with salt and Italian spices. Stir in the cooked chicken, mix well, and let everything heat through.
Ladle the stew into a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Bean Soup

ingredients.name: Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Dice the pork into small pieces and chop the turkey bacon into bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic.

Heat a pan, add the bacon, onion and garlic, and cook until the bacon is ready. Add the beans and stir to combine. Set aside and let it cool slightly. Then, transfer the mixture to a food processor, add the vegetable broth, and blend until smooth.
Place a pot over medium heat and cook the pork until fully cooked. Once ready, add the blended bean mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste, heat thoroughly.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Bruschetta Chicken
steps: Cut the chicken into two-three pieces to help it cook faster. Season each piece with salt and dried Italian seasoning.
Slice the cherry tomatoes in half and chiffonade the spinach.

Heat a skillet over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the chicken breast on low heat for a couple of minutes on each side. Before thoroughly cooking, add the mozzarella cheese to the chicken to melt slightly. Add the tomatoes to the skillet and cook them until they are lightly browned.
Assemble the dish. Start by placing the spinach on a plate as the base, then add the chicken on top. Serve with sourdough bread on the side.

name: Tuna Avocado Tower
steps: Start by cutting the tuna into small cubes. Continue with the cucumber, cut it lengthwise. Then use a spoon or knife to remove the seeds from the center. Slice each half into strips, and then dice the strips into small cubes.
Slice the avocado and mash it with a fork until smooth.
In a bowl, combine the diced tuna with soy sauce and stir well.

Take a serving plate and place a ring mold or a bottomless cup in the center. Start layering the ingredients. First, add the white rice and press it down firmly with a spoon. Then, add the mashed avocado and press it gently. Next, layer the diced cucumber and add the tuna on top.
Remove the mold, and enjoy!

name: Pork Stew With Chickpeas

ingredients.name: Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Dice the pork into bite-sized pieces, chop the tomatoes into small chunks, and mince the garlic.

Heat the olive oil in a skillet. Add the garlic and saute for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes and pork, stirring occasionally, and cook until the pork is ready. Add salt to taste and water or beef broth if needed for a saucier consistency.
Stir in the chickpeas and the spinach and mix well.
Remove from heat, transfer to a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Cottage Cheese Flat Bread
steps: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, cocoa powder, and non-caloric sweetener in a food processor until it is smooth.
Pour the cottage cheese mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread it evenly to form a thin layer in the form of flatbread.
Bake for 10-15 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Slice the strawberries. Next, spread the cream cheese over the flatbread, add the strawberry slices and fold the bread. Serve and enjoy!

name: Gourmet  Sandwich
steps: Slice the beet into thin slices. Place in a bowl, add the honey, and mix until coated.
Heat a skillet and spray it with vegetable oil. Add the beet slices and cook until tender and slightly golden, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Toast the bread, and mix the almonds with the ricotta,
Prepare the sandwich by spreading ricotta on each slice of bread, adding beet slices, and putting the sandwich together.
Cut it in half and enjoy!

name: Beef Rolls

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Slice the carrots and bell pepper into thin strips that can be easily rolled and cooked.
Cut the beef into equal-sized pieces to prepare the rolls.
Assemble the rolls. Place carrot and bell pepper strips at one end of each steak strip, then roll the steak tightly around the vegetables.
Combine the balsamic vinegar with honey and olive oil, and brush each steak roll with the mix.
Spray a nonstick pan with vegetable oil, and heat over medium heat.
Place the steak rolls in the pan and cook for 5 minutes on each side or until the steak is browned and cooked.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy.

name: Kale Chickpea Salad
steps: Place the chickpeas in a bowl and spray them with vegetable cooking spray. Season with a pinch of salt and paprika if desired.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Add the chickpeas and cook for 8-10 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through until golden and slightly crispy. Set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, add the kale. Squeeze some lemon juice over the kale and mix well.
Add the crispy chickpeas to the kale, parmesan shavings, and enjoy!

name: Sun Dried Tomato Chicken Sandwich
steps: Slice the chicken breast to get two thinner pieces
Heat a nonstick pan, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the chicken on low heat. Add salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Once cooked, set aside.
Toast the sourdough bread and spread the cream cheese on each slice. Continue assembling the sandwich with the remaining ingredients.
Cut the sandwich in half, and enjoy!

name: Mediterranean Fillet

ingredients.name: Rice white long grain cooked with salt

steps: Slice the cherry tomatoes, red onion and mince the garlic clove.
Rub olive oil onto the tilapia and place it on aluminum foil. Sprinkle with salt.
Arrange the sliced cherry tomatoes, black olives, red onion, and minced garlic over the fish. Fold the foil over the fish, sealing it gently but not too tightly.
Place the foil packet on a hot skillet and cook for 3-5 minutes over medium heat per side or until the fish changes color.
Carefully remove the foil packet from the heat using a spatula, place it on a plate, open it, and serve the rice on the side.

name: Easy Spring Rolls
steps: Shred the carrot and cabbage.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the ground beef, carrots, and cabbage. Cook on medium heat until the meat changes color and the vegetables soften. Add salt and pepper, and set aside.

Follow the package instructions to soften the rice paper. Next, place the rice paper in surface and fill the center of each spring roll with the ground beef mixture. Fold in the sides, then roll tightly to seal. Repeat with each spring roll.
Place the spring rolls in the air fryer and cook for 5 to 8 minutes at 380 or until golden brown. Check after the first 5 minutes.
Meanwhile in a small container mix the soy sauce with honey.
Serve the spring rolls with the dip, and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Quesadillas
steps: Place the shrimp in a bowl with oil. Add paprika and salt to taste and toss to coat evenly.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the shrimp for a few minutes.
Heat another nonstick skillet over low to medium heat. Add the tortilla, place the cheese on one side, and heat until the cheese is nearly melted, then remove the quesadilla from the heat.
Place it on a cutting board, add the shrimp, fold the quesadilla and slice. Serve and enjoy!

name: Asian Tuna Tartare
steps: Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit. Carefully scoop out the flesh, then dice the avocado into small cubes. Set aside the hollowed avocado shells. Place the diced avocado cubes back into the hollowed avocado shells.
Dice the tuna into small cubes. Next, combine the tuna with soy sauce and honey in a mixing bowl. Use a fork to gently mash and blend the mixture until it reaches a chunky consistency.
Transfer the tuna mixture over the avocado-filled shells to a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Salad With Chicken
steps: Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Assemble the salad. Add the spinach to a bowl and drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Toss to coat the spinach evenly.
Top the salad with goat cheese, cranberries, and chopped chicken. Gently combine.

name: Beef and Lentil Soup
steps: Peel and dice the carrots and chop the onions
In a large pot,  heat the olive oil over medium heat. Sauté the onions until translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Next, add the carrots to the pot with crushed canned tomatoes, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste. Stir well and cook for a few minutes.
Pour enough water or vegetable broth to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil, and let it simmer for 5 minutes.
Lower the heat, add ground beef to the pot, breaking it up with a spatula, and cook until the meat changes its color.
Finish by adding the lentils and mixing well. Serve hot and enjoy!

name: Tuna Bowl With Chipotle Mayo
steps: Chop the tuna, mango, and cucumber in small cubes.
In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise with chipotle.
Place the rice into a bowl as the base. Next, add the mango, tuna and cucumber. Drizzle with chipotle mayo on top, and enjoy!
Optionally, squeeze lime for extra flavor.

name: Lemon Chicken Soup
steps: In a pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and sauté until translucent, about 2-3 minutes. Pour the chicken broth into the pot and bring it to a simmer.

Whisk the egg in a small bowl with squeezed lemon juice until well combined. Slowly add a ladle of the hot broth to the egg-lemon mixture while whisking to avoid curdling. Once mixed, gradually pour this back into the pot while stirring continuously.
Stir in the chicken and the cooked rice. Let the soup heat through for 2-3 minutes without boiling. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle the soup into a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Ground Beef Soup With Vegetables
steps: Dice the onion, peel and chop the potato and zucchini into small cubes.
In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add onions and sauté until translucent for about 2-3 minutes. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes to combine flavors.
Add the ground beef to the pot. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook the beef, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink.

Add the vegetables to the pot and stir well. Pour enough water or broth to cover all ingredients. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 to 10 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Ladle the soup into a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Frittata with Ricotta, Spinach and Sun Dried Tomatoes
steps: Peel and dice the boiled potato into small cubes. Place the cubes in a microwave-safe bowl, cover with water, and microwave for 3-4 minutes or until tender. Drain the water.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add the cooked potato, baby spinach, ricotta cheese, and sun-dried tomatoes to the egg mixture. Stir until everything is evenly combined.

Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and spray it with vegetable oil. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. Cook over low heat, with a lid, for 5 to 10 minutes, until the top looks cooked and set. Carefully flip the frittata when the top is almost set. Cook for just 2 more minutes to seal.
Let the frittata cool for a minute, then slice and serve.

name: Cucumber Smoked Salmon Salad
steps: Slice the cucumber, then cut the slices into quarters to create smaller pieces.
Assemble the bowl, adding all the ingredients, add salt and Mediterranean seasoning to taste, and enjoy!

name: Ham Rolls Filled With Potato Salad

ingredients.name: Baked potato without skin with salt

steps: Dice the potatoes into small cubes.
Dice the red bell pepper and celery. Add the potatoes and mayonnaise. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix everything well.
Prepare the ham rolls by placing a small amount of the mixture on each slice of ham and rolling it up. Repeat the process with each slice of ham.
Serve on a plate, and enjoy!
1 Serving: 9 rolls approx. (20 g / 0.71 oz of ham per roll)

name: Shrimp, Asparagus and Rice
steps: Trim the ends of the asparagus.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and add half of the butter. Once the butter is completely melted, add the asparagus and saute for 4-5 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally. Set aside.
Next, add the remaining butter and shrimp and season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until the shrimp are heated through.
Microwave the rice, assemble the plate with all the ingredients, and enjoy!

name: Creamy Chicken Soup

ingredients.name: Cannellini or white kidney beans canned

steps: Blend the beans with half of the chicken broth until completely smooth. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a pot, add the onion and saute for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Pour the blended beans and the remaining chicken broth into the pot. Stir to combine, bring to a boil, and then reduce the heat to low. Add the cream cheese and stir until completely melted. Next, add the shredded chicken and combine.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Cheesy Hot Beef Sandwich

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Hamburger or hot dog buns whole wheat

steps: Finely chop the onion, then heat a pan and add the oil. Once hot, add the onion and cook until it softens and changes color.
Next, add the beef, season with salt, pepper, and paprika, and cook until it browns. Turn off the heat, add the cheese, and mix well.
Warm the bread in a pan over low heat. Place the ground beef inside the hot dog bun.
Transfer to a plate and enjoy!

name: Easy Chicken Soup
steps: Peel the potato and dice it into small pieces, then do the same with the carrot and onion.
Heat a pot and stir in the oil. Once it's hot, add the onion and cook until it changes it's color.
Next, add the potatoes, carrots, salt and pepper to taste. Add the chicken broth and cook until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Complete adding the shredded chicken, salt and pepper and combine.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

name: Steak and Cheese Sandwich.
steps: Cut the meat into strips, season with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the beef on low heat until thoroughly done.
Mix the mayo and mustard, toast the bread, and spread it on each piece of bread.
Assemble the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Tomato Soup With Cottage Cheese
steps: Chop the tomatoes and the onion. Peel the potato and dice it into small pieces.

Heat a pot, and once hot, add the oil. Add the onion and tomato, and cook for a few minutes until the onion softens and changes color. Then, add the potatoes, salt, pepper, and chicken broth and bring it to a boil until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Turn off the heat, transfer it to a food processor, add the cottage cheese, and blend.

name: Simple Tuna Steak Bowl
steps: Heat a pan over medium-high heat and sear the tuna, cooking only the outer layer. Leave it for 30 seconds to 1 minute per side, then flip the tuna steak. Set aside  and slice.
Slice the avocado, and assemble the bowl with all the ingredients. Enjoy!

name: Bell Pepper Sandwich
steps: Blend the potato with the tuna, add salt to taste.
Cut the top off the bell pepper and remove the core and seeds, creating two halves.
Next, blend the cooked potato with the tuna and add salt to taste.
Spread hummus inside each bell pepper half, then fill with the tuna mixture. Add folded lettuce leaves, and close the bell pepper to form the sandwich. Enjoy!

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Cut the broccoli into smaller florets, and peel and cube the potatoes.
Heat a pot, add the broccoli, potatoes, salt, pepper to taste, and the vegetable broth. (Add extra water if needed, make sure the broccoli is fully covered)
Cook until the potatoes are fork-tender. Next, add the yogurt and shredded cheese.
Next, transfer into a food processor add the cheese and yogurt and blend everything until smooth.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy.

name: Sushi Avocado Salad
steps: Peel and chop the avocado, then mash it with a fork. Mix in the mayo until fully combined.
Once smooth, add the tuna, salt, and pepper to taste, and stir until everything is thoroughly mixed.
Chiffonade the nori. Next, combine the rice nori with the tuna mix.
Serve in a bowl, and enjoy!

name: Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.name: Pork tenderloin lean meat and fat raw

steps: Mix the paprika, garlic powder and brown sugar.
Brush or rub olive oil all over the pork tenderloin. Cut the meat into two or more pieces so it fits in the air fryer. Sprinkle the spice mix over the pork and press it gently to make sure it sticks.
Cook for 10 minutes at 350°F or until the meat changes its color.

Meanwhile, peel the potato and cut it into small cubes. Place the cubes in a bowl and cover them with water. Microwave them for 5 minutes until they are fork-tender. Drain the water and mash the potato with a fork to make the puree. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pork on a plate and add the mashed potatoes on the side. Enjoy!

name: Sushi Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Prepare all the ingredients: peel and slice the avocado, drain the cottage cheese, and peel and grate the carrot.
Combine the honey and soy sauce. Chiffonade the nori sheets.
Prepare the bowl and add the cottage cheese. Next, add the cucumber slices and carrot. Drizzle the sauce on top, and put the nori in the middle.

name: Fall Chicken Bowl
steps: Dice the chicken breast, and chop the apple.
Assemble the bowl, add the salad mix, and the rest of the ingredients on top. Enjoy!

name: Italian Rice Tuna Salad (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Drain the tuna, slice the olives and hard-boiled egg.
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, add salt and pepper to taste, and enjoy!

name: Pizza Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Prepare the 3-layer sandwich by spreading a tablespoon of tomato sauce on each slice of bread.
Then, add the cheese and divide the pepperoni slices between each layer.
Once the sandwich is assembled, spray a grill or pan with vegetable oil and toast until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted.
Slice, serve and enjoy!

name: Kale Salad with Roasted Chicken and Quinoa
steps: Cut the pepper into strips. Heat a grill pan, spray it with vegetable oil, and roast the red bell pepper slices.
Prepare the salad, add salt and Italian seasoning, mix all the ingredients, and enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Meatloaf (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Blend the ground beef with the egg, tomato sauce, and oats.  Add salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste.
Peel the potato and cut it into small cubes, then mix them with the meat mixture.
Place the entire mixture in a container that fits in the air fryer, or you can even use silicone muffin molds.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the meat is fully cooked.

name: BBQ Chicken Bowl
steps: Cut the chicken breast into strips, then cover the strips with Bbq. Slice the pineapple and drizzle the remaining BBQ on each slide. Slice the cherry tomatoes.
Heat a nonstick pan, place the chicken strips and pineapple, and cook on low heat. Remove the pineapple slices after 2 minutes and flip the chicken strips.
Assemble the bowl, place the spinach, and serve the tomatoes, avocado, and pineapple. Complete the bowl with the BBQ chicken strips.

name: Blackberry Tuna Steak Salad
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat, spray vegetable oil and place the tuna in the pan. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes on each side, just to sear it, then remove from the heat and slice into not-too-thick pieces. Let it cool slightly.
Meanwhile, prepare the salad. Slice the raspberries and mix them with the arugula and balsamic oil. Next, add the feta cheese around the plate and serve the tuna on top.

name: Bbq Chicken Tacos
steps: Mix the shredded chicken with bbq and microwave.  Mix the red cabbage with cream and add salt to taste.
Heat the tortillas. Next, fill each tortilla with shredded chicken, top with red cabbage mix, and an avocado slice. Enjoy!

name: Ground Beef Quesadilla

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Heat a pan and spray with vegetable oil. Once hot, add the ground beef, salt, garlic powder, and pepper to taste, and cook on low heat until it changes color.

Place the tortilla in a pan and add the cheese on half of the tortilla. Heat over low to medium heat until the cheese melts, then add the meat on top of the cheese. Fold the tortilla in half and close it.
Halve the quesadillas, and serve on a plate, enjoy!

name: Salmon with Potatoes & Veggies
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F  for 5 minutes.
Boil the baby potatoes in a pot of water for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender but not fully cooked. Drain and set aside.
Place the salmon, baby potatoes, zucchini, and tomatoes in the air fryer basket. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook in the air fry for 10 minutes. Check that the salmon is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the salmon with the potatoes and veggies on a plate, and enjoy!

name: Orange Teriyaki Beef

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips.

Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the teriyaki sauce, marmalade, and broth and stir well. Add the beef and cook for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Once the beef is cooked through, remove it from the pan and set it aside.
Serve the cooked noodles in a bowl. Spoon the beef and sauce mixture over the noodles. Enjoy!

name: Tuna Tostadas

ingredients.name: Tostada shells corn
ingredients.unit: pieces (mean serving weight, aggregated over brands)

steps: Prepare the ingredients by peeling the mango and cutting it into small cubes. Dice the tuna into small pieces, too.
In a bowl, add the tuna, pour in the soy sauce and add some pepper. Mix well.
Combine the tuna and mango and start assembling each tostada. Garnish with sesame seeds.
Squeeze some lemon juice on top for extra flavor.

name: Pork Salad with Mango Dressing

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Use cooked quinoa or prepared according to the package.
Peel the mango and chop. Next, blend with chili flakes, mint and 4 tbsp of water.
Chop the pork into medium size cubes. Heat a nonstick pan, stir in the pork, add the mango salsa, add salt to taste, and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from the pan and let to rest for 2-3 minutes.
Place the baby spinach, quinoa, and cooked pork in a bowl. Mix well and enjoy!

name: Tuna Melt

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Onions green spring or scallions raw
Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

steps: Finely chop the red bell pepper and green onions. Next, drain the tuna and combine it with yogurt, and mustard.
Prepare the sandwich by placing the tuna mixture on the bread, then add the cheese and cover it with the other piece of bread.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place the sandwiches in the pan and cook, turning once, until the cheese is melted and the bread is golden, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

name: Piadina with ricotta, black beans and veggies
steps: Preheat a grill pan.
Place the tortilla on a work surface. Spread the ricotta over half of the tortilla, add the beans and the red bell pepper. Complete with spinach leaves.
Fold the tortilla into a half-moon shape.
Spray the grill pan with the vegetable oil, place the tortilla and toast until golden.
Transfer to a cutting board, slice in half, and enjoy!

name: Chicken, Lentil and Feta Salad
steps: Serve all the ingredients in a bowl with feta cheese and drizzle the olive oil.
Option: Squeeze lemon juice to add flavor.

name: Cheesy Ground Beef with Potatoes

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Peel and chop the potato into small cubes. Place the cubed potatoes in a microwave-safe bowl and cover with water. Cover the container with the lid and microwave for 4 minutes, or until tender.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the ground beef and cook for 4-5 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes to the pan with the beef and toss to combine. Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the beef and potatoes, then cover for a few minutes until the cheese melts. Serve and enjoy.

name: Pasta with Shrimps
steps:
Boil water in a pot, add salt and cook the pasta according to the package instructions. 
Option: use pasta gluten-free
Meanwhile, mince the garlic, and heat butter in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and saute for 2 minutes, or until fragrant, stirring occasionally.
Add shrimp immediately season with lemon juice and salt to taste. Drain the pasta, transfer with the shrimp and combine.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Pan Seared Pork Chops With Sweet Potato Pure and Broccoli

ingredients.name: Pork loin center chop bone-in lean meat and fat raw

steps: Heat a non-stick pan for a few minutes. It needs to be hot for the pork chops to get a good sear.
Season each pork chop generously with salt and pepper on both sides. Add the pork to the nonstick pan and cook for 3 - 5 minutes per side. The pork should be golden brown and cooked through.
Meanwhile, peel and chop the sweet potato, transfer it to a bowl, cover it with water and microwave for 5 minutes. Drain the water and mash the potato until it is pureed.
Microwave the broccoli with butter and combine.
Assemble the plate with all the ingredients, and enjoy!

name: Vitel Tone

ingredients.name: Pork loin whole lean meat and fat broiled

steps: In a large pot, place the meat and cover it completely with water. Add the potatoes and salt. Cook over low heat for about an hour. Check the potatoes every 5 minutes; once they are fork-tender, remove them from the pot.
Meanwhile, in a food processor, combine the mayonnaise, cream, capers, and mustard. Add a pinch of salt and blend until smooth.
Once the meat is ready, transfer it to a cutting board and slice it into 12  pieces.
Assemble the dish. Spread the cream sauce on a serving plate, arrange the meat slices on top, and drizzle additional sauce over the meat. Add the potatoes around the plate.
Garnish with extra capers, serve, and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Mushrooms Bites

ingredients.name: Pomegranate arils raw edible seed pods

steps: Clean the mushrooms and remove the stems, leaving a hollow center for stuffing.
Chiffonade the spinach, then mix them in a bowl, with the ricotta cheese. Add salt and pepper to taste. Next, fill each mushroom with the ricotta mix.
Place the mushrooms in the air fryer basket. Cook at 350-390°F (180-200°C) for 5 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender, and slightly golden.
Remove the mushrooms from the air fryer and place them on a serving plate. Top each mushroom with a few pomegranate arils, garnish with rosemary and enjoy!

name: Holiday Left Over Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread the cranberry sauce on one slice of bread, add the turkey breast, arugula and mozzarella cheese. Place the second slice of bread on top.
Toast the sandwich, slice and enjoy!

name: Rosemary Chicken with Cranberries
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a pot, place the potatoes and cover them with water. Add a pinch of salt and bring to a boil. Remove once they are fork-tender.
In a bowl, combine the cranberries, brown sugar, and white wine vinegar. Stir and set aside to allow the cranberries to soften while preparing the chicken.
Season the chicken with 2 minced garlic cloves, rosemary, paprika, and salt and pepper to taste.

Chop the celery and onion, and mince the remaining garlic. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and celery, season with salt and pepper, and sauté until softened. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
heat a skillet and spray vegetable oil. Cook the seasoned chicken over medium heat until browned on the outside. It doesn’t need to be fully cooked at this stage. Remove from the skillet.
In a deep baking dish, layer the celery and onion sofrito on the bottom, followed by the baby yellow potatoes. Garnish with rosemary  leaves
Place the chicken on top, then spoon the cranberry mixture over the chicken. Add a few sprigs of rosemary
Bake in the oven until the cranberries soften slightly and the chicken is golden on top about 10 minutes

name: Holiday Charcuterie Skewers
steps: Slice the mozzarella cheese into small pieces, approximately 4 gr each. Separate the prosciutto into pieces of about 6 grams each.
