Using skewers, assemble each one by adding the blackberry, cheese cube, folded basil leaf,  prosciutto, cherry tomato, and another halved basil leaf, and complete with the olive.
Arrange the skewers on a plate or board like a wreath.
Garnish with sprigs of rosemary or a bed of mixed greens underneath for a festive touch.

name: Stuffed Dates Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F or an air fryer to the same temperature.
Slice each date lengthwise, remove the pit, and fill each with ricotta cheese.
Arrange the filled dates on a baking tray or in the air fryer basket. Air fry for 5 to 10 minutes, or until warmed through.
While the dates are cooking, cut the turkey bacon into small cubes and cook in a pan over medium heat until crispy. Set aside.
Chop the pecans into small pieces and mix them with the orange zest and crispy bacon.
Once the dates are ready, top each one with the bacon mixture. Transfer to a serving plate, and enjoy!

name: Cranberry Baked Brie
steps: Preheat the oven or the air fryer to 350℉.
Place the parchment paper in a baking dish and transfer the brie onto it. Bake it for 10 minutes. Remove and let brie sit for 1-2 minutes, then transfer to a cutting board.

Spoon the cranberry sauce over the top of the cheese, and garnish with pistachios. 
Option: garnish with a couple of whole cherries or pomegranate seeds for an extra festive touch.
Serve with bread slices on the side.
1 serving: 1 Slice of Brie Cheese (33 g)  with 2 bread slices (20 g each)

name: Festive Potato Salad

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled without salt

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the potatoes, and cook until fork-tender. Drain and set aside.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the turkey bacon until crispy. Once done, chop it into small pieces and set aside.
Shred the Brussels sprouts.
In a small bowl, mix the sour cream with the minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Add the potatoes, shredded Brussels sprouts, and turkey bacon to a large bowl. Pour the sour cream mixture over the ingredients and mix thoroughly, ensuring the cream coats the potatoes evenly.

name: Salami Cups
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F  for 5 to 10 mins.
Meanwhile, slice the olives, and chop the cheese into small cubes.
Place each piece of salami in a muffin tin, pressing gently to form a cup shape. Next, fill each salami cup with the Mediterranean mixture.
Bake for 5 minutes, or until the salami crisps up.
Once the salami cups are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool. Transfer to a plate, and drizzle the balsamic glaze.
Option: Garnish with rosemary.

name: Shredded Brussel Sprout Salad

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts frozen boiled with salt
Apple cider vinegar by always save

steps: Slice the chicken breast into strips. Shred the Brussels sprouts and slice the pomegranate, carefully removing the seeds by tapping the back of the fruit with a spoon and discarding the rind.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the turkey bacon for a few minutes until crispy. Once ready, set it aside to cool slightly, then chop it into small cubes.
Prepare the dressing: In a small bowl, mix the olive oil, mustard, and apple cider vinegar. Whisk well until combined.

Start assembling the salad by using the shredded Brussels sprouts as the base. Layer the chicken strips, turkey bacon pieces, and pomegranate seeds. Drizzle the dressing over the salad. Serve and enjoy!

name: Pear Carpaccio Salad
steps: Slice the pears into thin slices.
Arrange the pear slices on a plate, leaving space in the center for the arugula.
Cut the coppa into small pieces and roll them into little rolls. Add them to the plate.
Finish by sprinkling the feta cheese and walnuts over the top. Enjoy!

name: Sweet Potato Salad
steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small to medium-sized cubes.
Place the sweet potato cubes in a pot, cover them with water, and bring to a boil. Cook for a few minutes until they are slightly tender. Drain the water.
Transfer the sweet potatoes to an air fryer. Spray with vegetable oil spray, add salt to taste, and cook for 5 -10 minutes or until golden and crispy. Allow the sweet potatoes to cool slightly.
Assemble the plate by layering the spinach, arugula, and pecans. Finally, add small spoonfuls of ricotta cheese on top.

name: Roasted Beetroot & Walnut Salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Peel and chop the beetroot into small to medium cubes. Transfer the cubes to a bowl, spray with the vegetable oil, ensuring they are completely coated, then drizzle with honey and mix well.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and transfer the beetroot cubes to the tray.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until tender.
To speed up the oven cooking process, first boil the beetroot pieces until they are slightly fork-tender, then finish cooking them at a high temperature.
While the beetroot is cooking, roll the goat cheese into small balls and chop the walnuts.
Once the beetroot is done, cool slightly outside the oven.
On a plate, place the arugula, then top with the roasted beetroot, goat cheese, and walnuts.
Option Drizzle extra sugar-free maple syrup

name: Pork Tenderloin with Blackberry Sauce

ingredients.name: Pork tenderloin lean meat and fat raw

steps: Mix pepper, salt, and paprika in a small bowl. Rub the mixture evenly over the pork and set aside.

Mince the garlic. Heat a pan over medium heat, add the oil and garlic, and sauté for one minute while stirring constantly. Add the blackberry jam, mustard, squeezed lime juice, and a pinch of pepper, then stir well. Increase the heat to medium-high and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes. 
(If the sauce becomes too thick, add one or two tablespoons of water and mix well, add more if needed)
Preheat the grill to medium heat and spray it with vegetable oil. Once hot, place the pork on the grill and cook on low heat for 20 minutes, turning it every 5 to 10 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Once the pork is almost cooked, brush the glaze onto each side. Allow the glaze to slightly caramelize before removing the pork from the grill.
Transfer to a cutting board, slice and enjoy!

name: Smoked Pork Chops With Cherry Sauce

ingredients.name: Pork loin center chop bone-in lean meat and fat raw

steps: In a small saucepan, combine the olive oil, cherries, balsamic vinegar, and a pinch of salt. Bring the mixture to a boil and let it simmer until the liquid reduces by half, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, rub the mustard over the pork chops. Heat a large skillet over low to medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the pork chops for 5 minutes on each side.
Once ready, plate the pork chops and spoon the cherry sauce on top.

name: Baked Cranberry Cream Cheese Dip
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F
Combine the cream cheese, sour cream, and mozzarella cheese in a mixing bowl. Stir until smooth and creamy.
Toss the cranberries with the sugar in a small bowl to coat them evenly.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly across a baking dish. Sprinkle the sugared cranberries on top.
Place the dish in the oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are bubbling and the cranberries soften.
Remove from the oven and serve warm with slices of bread.

name: Crispy Potato Wedges
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F.
Halve the potatoes.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and mix them until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix the parmesan cheese, garlic powder, and paprika until well combined.
Coat the potatoes in the beaten eggs, making sure they are evenly covered. Then, roll the wedges in the parmesan cheese mixture, gently pressing to help the coating stick.
Place the potato slices in an air fryer liner. Spray with the vegetable oil spray and cook at 375°F for 7 to 10 minutes, or until the wedges are crispy and golden.

name: Bacon Wrapped Brussels
steps: Cut the Brussels sprouts in half and place them in a bowl. Sprinkle with steak seasoning and toss to coat evenly.
Wrap a half slice of bacon around each Brussels piece and place them seam-side down in the air fryer basket.  (Use a toothpick to hold the bacon in place if needed)
Cook for 10 minutes. Once done, transfer them to a plate.
Dip: Blend the sour cream, mustard, cheese, and garlic together until smooth.
Transfer the dip into a small bowl and serve alongside the Brussels sprouts.

name: Smoked Salmon Terrine

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Place the cream cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, dill, and capers in a bowl. Season with pepper and mix everything well.
Line a terrine or loaf pan with plastic wrap, leaving about 2 inches of extra wrap on each side.

Cover the entire inside surface of the pan with a layer of salmon. Next, with a spoon spread a thin layer of the cream cheese mixture over the salmon. Repeat the layers, finishing with salmon on top. Fold the plastic wrap over the salmon, press down gently, and refrigerate overnight.
Flip the terrine onto a cutting board. Remove the plastic wrap and slice carefully with a sharp knife.
Serve with lemon slices, fresh dill sprigs, and slices of bread.

name: Hasselback Sweet Potato
steps: Preheat the oven to 356°F
Clean the sweet potato and cut off both ends. Then, slice the sweet potato into thin slices, but don’t cut all the way through, leave the bottom intact.
Next, spray the sweet potato with vegetable oil and bake at medium heat for  25 to 30 minutes or until the sweet potato is tender in the middle. Be careful not to overcook it.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon. Once it’s ready, prepare cheese slices and bacon pieces that will fit into each sweet potato cut.
Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with rosemary and pomegranate arils.

name: Broccoli and Blue Cheese Souffle
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Separate the egg whites from the egg yolks. Then, beat the egg whites with a mixer until stiff, and set them aside at room temperature.
Grease a soufflé dish with vegetable oil spray, making sure to coat it well. Then, sprinkle breadcrumbs evenly on top.
In a pot, add water and bring it to a boil. Cook the broccoli until it’s tender, then blend it until you get a smooth puree.

Continue by melting the butter in a skillet. Add the flour and mix well, then pour in the milk, continuing to stir until it comes to a boil or until it thickens and remove from heat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the egg yolks, add the broccoli puree, and blue cheese.

Next, mix one spoonful of the egg whites into the mixture to lighten it, then gently fold in the rest of the egg whites. Transfer the mixture into the mold, filling it almost to the top. Use a spoon to smooth the surface by running it along the edges.
To bake, place the mold on a baking tray and transfer it to the oven. Bake for 15 to 30 minutes. Checking after 15 minutes.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Holiday Broccoli and Asparagus Cream Soup  for Sharing
steps:
Prepare the ingredients. 
Mince the garlic, and dice the onion. Next, peel and dice the potato. Cut the asparagus into small pieces and chop the broccoli into small florets.

Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion to the pot and cook until softened and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes. Add the potato and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally.

Add the broccoli, asparagus and chicken broth. Bring the mixture to a simmer. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the potato and broccoli are fork-tender. Add butter and stir until it melts into the soup.
Transfer into a blender, add the Greek yogurt and blend the soup until smooth.
Serve the soup in bowls, add croutons on top, and enjoy!

name: Easy Brazilian Cheese Bread Bites

ingredients.name: Baking aids tapioca flour by Bob's red mill

steps: Melt the butter, then mix it with all the ingredients.
Use your hands to roll the mixture into medium-sized balls. Pop them into the air fryer and cook for 10 - 15 minutes.
Let them cool for a bit, and enjoy!

name: Roasted Onion Soup
steps: Slice the onions into julienne strips and grate the garlic.
In a pot, melt the butter. Once melted, add the sliced onion and grated garlic. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions are golden brown.
Next, add the beef broth, flour, Italian seasoning, and salt to taste. Cook for about 1 minute. Add the Swiss cheese and mix well until the cheese it's completely melted.
Serve the soup in bowls, top with Gouda cheese and place a slice of bread inside, garnish with rosemary or fresh herbs.

name: Cream Cheese Bites
steps: Mince the parsley, dice the pecans and cranberries.
Combine cream cheese, swiss cheese, cinnamon, and honey in a bowl. Mix well.
Add half of the cranberries to the mixture and stir to combine.
On a plate mix the pecans, parsley and cranberries. Roll the bites in the mixture until they are completely covered.
Repeat the process with all the bites, serve and enjoy!

name: Prosciutto, Apple and Blue Cheese Appetizer
steps:
Slice the apple into thin wedges. Wrap each apple slice with prosciutto, adding arugula leaves inside
Option: use a toothpick to secure the prosciutto in place.
Arrange the arugula on a plate. Top with the apple rolls and garnish with small pieces of blue cheese.

name: Goulash - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Press saute on the Instant Pot, when the pot is hot, add the ground beef and cook until the beef is no longer pink, stir while breaking it into smaller pieces.
Add the onion and cook until softened, continue adding the garlic, and bell pepper and cook, stirring for 1 minute, then cancel the saute function.
Pour in the broth and stir, add the Italian seasoning, soy sauce, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and toss to combine.
Add the pasta and press it down, put the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce on top of the pasta, don't stir.
Place the lid and close, and set the cooking time  to 4 minutes at high pressure, once the timer ends,  release the pressure before opening.
Mix and stir in the shredded cheddar cheese.
Serve and top with fresh parsley.

name: Goulash - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Press saute on the Instant Pot, when the pot is hot, add the ground beef and cook until the beef is no longer pink, stir while breaking it into smaller pieces.
Add the onion and cook until softened, continue adding the garlic, and bell pepper and cook, stirring for 1 minute, then cancel the saute function.
Pour in the broth and stir, add the Italian seasoning, soy sauce, garlic powder, salt and pepper and toss to combine
Add the pasta  and press it down, put the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce on top of the pasta, don't stir
Place the lid and close, and set the cooking time  to 4 minutes at high pressure, once the timer ends,  release the pressure before opening.
Mix and stir in the shredded cheddar cheese.
Serve and top with fresh parsley.

name: Chicken and Lemon Pasta (High Protein)
steps: Heat a pan and place the chopped garlic and the olive oil. Next, add the cooked pasta and mix. Squeeze the lemon on top, add parmesan cheese, and blend again.
Transfer the pasta to a serving plate, cut the chicken breast into strips, and place them on the pasta.
Option: use gluten-free pasta.

name: Open Faced Sandwich Toast  (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Louis rich turkey breast and white smoked sliced
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Place a lettuce leaf folded on the rice cake, add the turkey breast, place the tomato slices, and put the folded cheese on top.
Prepare the remaining toast in the same way.

name: Pigs in Blankets
steps: Wrap the sausage with a piece of bacon.
Mix the maple syrup with the dijon mustard and set aside.
Cook on the air fryer at 356°F for 6 - 10 minutes, or until the bacon is turning golden.
Pour the maple syrup mixture over the sausages and return them to the air fryer. Cook for 5 minutes more or until bacon becomes crispy.
Transfer the sausages into a serving plate, share and enjoy!

name: Cottage Cheese with Rice Cakes (Balanced)
steps: Spread the cottage cheese on each rice cake. Top with chopped pistachios, sprinkle with pumpkin spice and drizzle honey on top.

name: Cinnamon Apple Pork - Chop

ingredients.name: Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Slice the apples into thin wedges.
Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the apples, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Mix and cook for 5 minutes until the apples are almost soft.
Season the pork chops with a pinch of salt.
In a nonstick pan cook the pork chops for 5 minutes on each side, over low to medium heat until browned and fully cooked. Serve warm, and spoon the caramelized apples over them.
Serve the caramelized apples on a plate and transfer the pork chops on top.

name: Holiday Meatballs

ingredients.name: Soup onion mix dehydrated dry form

steps: Mix the ground beef, evaporated milk, one tablespoon of the sauce breadcrumbs, and onion soup mix. Mix everything gently until well combined. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Form the meat mixture into small meatballs using your hands and set aside.
Add the ketchup, wine and the remaining sauce to a pan and cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes until smooth.

Place the meatballs in the slow cooker. Pour the sauce over them, place the lid, and cook on medium-high heat for 1 hour. Stir occasionally until the sauce thickens and the meatballs are fully cooked.
Transfer to a serving plate, garnish and season it with your favorite herbs and enjoy!

name: Cinnamon Apple Cream Cheese Dip
steps:
In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, cream cheese, vanilla, and cinnamon until smooth and creamy.
Option: add zero - calorie sweetener.
Finely chop the pecans and sprinkle them over the dip.
Place the dip in a bowl in the center of the plate and arrange the apple slices around the plate

name: Corn Poblano Pudding

ingredients.name: Corn sweet yellow frozen kernels on cob cooked boiled drained without salt
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C) and lightly grease the baking dish with cooking spray.

Cut the poblano pepper in half lengthwise, then remove the stem and seeds. Chop the pepper into small pieces. 
Option: substitute with jalapeño, or for a milder flavor, use green bell pepper instead
Mix the eggs with the yogurt and lime zest in a large bowl until smooth.
Stir in the corn, cheese, cilantro, poblano pepper, and a bit of salt and pepper. Pour the mixture into the greased baking dish and spread it evenly.
Bake for one hour to 300°For until the center is firm and the top starts to turn golden.

name: Apricot Bites
steps: Gently press each dried apricot with your fingers to flatten it slightly and create a small indent.
Add ricotta cheese into the indent of each apricot.
Top with a piece of walnut.

name: Crostini with Fruit and Prosciutto
steps: Slice the bread and apple into thin pieces.
Toast the bread slices until lightly golden and crispy.
Spread a layer of ricotta cheese on each slice of bread.
Top with a slice of prosciutto and one or two apple slices.

name: Prosciutto Rolls
steps: Spread a small amount of ricotta cheese onto each slice of prosciutto, then roll it up tightly.
Arrange the rolls on a serving board or plate. Drizzle the honey over all the rolls and sprinkle the chopped walnuts on top.

name: Caprese Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Slice the cherry tomatoes in half.
Prepare the plate by arranging the greens as the base across the entire plate. On one side, add the sliced tomatoes and place the mozzarella pearls next to them.
Slice the chicken breast into chunks or strips and add it to the other side of the plate.
Drizzle the balsamic vinegar over the entire dish. Enjoy!

name: Tangerine Kale Salad

ingredients.name: Pumpkin seeds whole with shell roasted with salt

steps: Cut the salmon into small to medium cubes. Slice the pomegranate and carefully remove the seeds by tapping the back of the fruit with a spoon and discarding the rind. Peel the mandarin and separate it into segments.

Heat a skillet over low to medium heat and spray it with vegetable oil. Lightly sear the salmon cubes on all sides, cooking for just a few seconds on each side (less than 2 minutes total), until they are browned on the outside but still tender inside. Remove the salmon from the skillet and let them cool slightly.
Prepare the plate by layering the greens as the base and add the salmon bites.
Add the mandarin segments, sprinkle the pomegranate arils, and finish with the pumpkin seeds scattered over the salad. Drizzle the olive oil over the entire plate and enjoy!

name: Pear Sandwich
steps: Place the cottage cheese in a strainer and press it with a fork to remove as much water as possible. Next, combine the cheese with the walnuts.
Toast the bread and assemble the sandwich with the rest of the ingredients. Slice the sandwich and serve.
Option: drizzle one tbsp of sugar-free maple syrup on top of the ingredients and close the sandwich.

name: Quick Turkey Sandwich (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Turkey breast sliced prepackaged or deli meat

steps: Prepare the sandwich with all the ingredients. Serve and enjoy!

name: Quick Turkey Sandwich (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Turkey breast sliced prepackaged or deli meat

steps: Prepare the sandwich with all the ingredients. Serve and enjoy!

name: Blueberry Baked Oats

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 320 °F  for about 3 minutes, or preheat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the oats, yogurt, and eggs until well combined. Gently fold in the blueberries.
Chop the almonds. Serve the mix in muffin cups or a bread pan and garnish with chopped almonds

Bake in the air fryer for 10 to 15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the muffin comes out clean.
Option: bake in the oven for 20 minutes. 
Let it cool slightly before serving.
Add a calorie-free sweetener for baking to give it a sweeter flavor.

name: Asparagus Salad
steps: Cut the hard-boiled eggs into small cubes and slice the prosciutto into small pieces.
Dressing: Combine the mustard with one lemon juice, add salt and pepper, and mix well.
Place the asparagus on a plate, add the eggs and prosciutto around the plate, and finish by drizzling the vinaigrette. Enjoy!

name: Ham and Butternut Squash Breakfast Bowl
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium high heat. Add chopped onion and crushed garlic to oil, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add cubed, peeled squash, and chopped leek, stir, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add diced ham, and sliced apple, combine and cook until hot. Season with paprika, cinnamon, salt and pepper. Mix and serve.

name: Back Bacon and Apple

ingredients.name: Unsmoked bacon back rashers by tesco

steps: Cook back bacon according to package directions, until crispy. Serve with sliced apple!

name: Portobello Sandwich - Instant Pot
steps:
Prepare the portobello mushroom by drying it with a paper towel, gently twisting off, or cutting the stem of each mushroom. 
Continue and hold a mushroom in one hand and use a spoon to scrape the gills gently.
Use a vegetable peeler to slice the cucumber lengthways into long, thin ribbons and slice the tomatoes.
Carefully place the steamer rack in the Instant Pot, spray the mushroom caps with cooking spray, and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Press the pressure cook button, and set the timer for 1 minute on high pressure. After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid.

Carefully transfer the mushrooms to a serving plate, spread the hummus inside of both mushrooms, and place all the ingredients. Place the spinach leaves, use as many as needed, and place the tomato, cucumber, ham, and cheese. Close the sandwich.
Next, use a fork to pierce the potato, and place it in the microwave for 5 minutes with high pressure.
Once it’s ready, slice lengthwise and carefully open, smash the potato inside, place the butter, salt, and pepper to taste, and serve as a side with the Portobello Sandwich.
Option: use turkey or chicken  ham instead of  traditional ham

name: Bell Pepper Egg Bites (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Country kitchen low fat smoked ham by maple leaf

steps: Slice bell peppers across, creating a "ring" about 1 inch thick. Cut the ham into small pieces.
Scrambled eggs: in a small bowl, place the egg whites, the eggs and ham, mix, and add salt and pepper to taste
Place four pepper rings into a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook for 2 minutes, then flip.
Add eggs to the center of each ring, place the lid on top, and cook for 4 minutes, depending on how you like your eggs. Season with salt and pepper, and serve with toast.

name: Potato Chowder with Shrimp (Low Carb)
steps: Fry bacon over medium heat in a large pot until crispy, about 6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add shrimp to the pot, cooking until opaque, about 2 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
Add chopped potato, onions, and garlic, stirring and cooking for 2 minutes. Then, add diced celery, spices, and carrots.
Add chicken stock and bring to a boil. Add corn, reduce to a simmer, and cook for 10 minutes. Whisk in the cream of choice, then season with salt.
Top with shrimp, black pepper, and chopped bacon.

steps: Cook pork in a skillet over medium heat.

Whisk together cornstarch, soy sauce, and ginger. 
When pork is cooked, add in minced garlic, and liquid mixture - cooking until liquid reduces and becomes "sticky".
Divide Rice into 2 separate bowls, topping with pork, and veggies.
Drizzle with sriracha, or sriracha-mayo mixture

name: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.name: Sweet potato boiled without skin or salt
Spinach frozen chopped or leaf cooked boiled drained without salt
Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Preheat oven to 350F. In a medium skillet over medium heat, brown and crumble sausage.
Add mushrooms and cook about 5 minutes or until soft, stirring occasionally. Add chopped vegetables, spices, season with salt and cook for 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to a baking dish.
Pour beaten eggs over the mixture in the baking tray and bake for 25-30 minutes or until set.

ingredients.name: Deli ham wegmans virginia baked by Wegmans

steps: Preheat oven to 400º and grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray. Line each cup with a slice of ham and sprinkle with cheddar.
Crack an egg into each ham cup and season with salt and pepper.
Bake until eggs are cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes (depending on how runny you like your yolks). Garnish with parsley and serve.
Meanwhile, chop strawberries and kiwis, and mix together with peeled mandarin segments, and blueberries.

steps: Wrap slices of prosciutto around small chunks of melon. Or serve separately.

name: Mediterranean Salad With Tofu
steps: Slice the cherry tomatoes and olives. Cut the tofu into small cubes. Peel the cucumber, cut it in half, remove the seeds, and then dice it into small cubes.
In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. Add the lime juice, salt, and pepper. Optionally, add basil, rosemary, or season to your taste.
Mix everything well and serve on a plate.

name: Cookie Dough Overnigth Oats

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Blend the almond milk with the protein. Next, add the peanut butter and blend until smooth.
In a glass or container, add the oats, chocolate chips, and a pinch of salt, then mix. Pour in the protein shake and stir again.
Close the jar and let it chill in the fridge overnight, or enjoy it right away.

ingredients.name: Vanilla bean flavor plant based organic protein by orgain
Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Use your favourite plant-based milk and blend it with the protein powder and cinnamon.
In a glass or container, add the oats, grated carrot, walnuts and combine. Next, add the protein shake and mix.
Place the lid and close. Let it chill in the fridge overnight for a thicker consistency, or enjoy it immediately.

name: Pumpkin Pie Chia Pudding (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Protein vanilla plant-based yogurt by kite hill

steps: Place all the ingredients in a jar or container, and mix. Place the yogurt and cranberries on top, place the lid, and close.
Option: use your favorite brand of plant-based milk and plant-based protein

name: Pumpkin Treats

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: In a mixing bowl, stir oats, chia seeds, protein powder, and pumpkin pie spices.
Add in the almond butter, pumpkin puree, and maple syrup.
Stir the ingredients together as they become dryer. If they are too dry, stir in 1-2 tablespoons of water. Next, roll between greased hands into a ball.

Note: 
Two treats  per Serving

name: Pumpkin Yogurt Parfait
steps: Mix the pumpkin puree, maple syrup, and pumpkin spice until well combined. Set it aside.
Begin layering in a cup or glass. Add some pumpkin mixture to the bottom, followed by half of the granola, and carefully add the Greek yogurt.
Continue with the second layer, adding the pumpkin mix granola and yogurt
Top with walnuts and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Waffles
steps:
Mix the flour and baking powder. Transfer into a blender and add all the remaining ingredients. 
Option: add pumpkin spice for a strong flavor.
Blend twice to ensure it's well combined.
Preheat the waffle maker and grease it with vegetable oil spray. Cook for about 5 to 10 minutes.
Remove the waffles and serve. Drizzle the maple syrup over all the waffles.

name: Pumpkin Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice, serve and enjoy!

name: Curried Hummus & Tempeh Sandwich (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Spicy yellow curry paste by thai kitchen

steps: Slice the tempeh thinly.
Heat a pan, and spray the vegetable oil, then add the tempeh, mushroom slices and liquid amino. Cook until mushroom slices are browned.
Combine the hummus and curry using a fork.
Toast the wholewheat bread slices.
Assemble the sandwich. Spread the hummus in each bread slice, place the spinach, and then top with tempeh and mushrooms.

name: Greek Chicken Pitas (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Chicken broiler or fryers breast skinless boneless meat only cooked grilled

steps: Slice or grate the cucumber, mince or crush the garlic, slice the onion and avocado and chop the dill.
To prepare the tzatziki, combine yogurt, dill, lemon juice, cucumber, and garlic in a bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the chicken with the tzatziki, then prepare the pitas by filling each with the chicken, onion, avocado, and a drizzle of olive oil.

Fill a glass with ice add the pumpkin blend and complete adding the coffee.

steps: Blend all the ingredients
Serve in a cup and enjoy!

name: Cookie Cheesecake
steps: Add the yogurt and protein powder to a blender; once thoroughly mixed, add the cream cheese and blend.
Transfer the mix to a silicon muffin pan. Spread the hazelnut in each muffin. Next, crush the cookies into small bites and place them on top of each muffin.
Freeze and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Protein Cookies (Low Carb)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 F or the the air fryer  to 400 F.
Mix all the ingredients and prepare the cookies with your hands.
Cook for 4 to 6 minutes with the Air Fryer or 15-20 minutes in the oven.
1 serving = 2 cookies

name: Pumpkin Yogurt Bowl

ingredients.name: Nuts mixed dry roasted with peanuts salt added

steps: Mix everything except for the nuts.
Transfer into a cup, drizzle the almond butter on top and complete with the mixed nuts.  Enjoy!

name: Microwave Scrambled Eggs  (High Protein)
steps: Spray a large microwave-safe mug. Add the egg, egg white, one chopped tomato, and chopped spinach. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Microwave for one minute. Stir and microwave for another minute or until set.
Complete the meal by serving the cooked bacon on a plate, slicing the remaining tomato, adding it to the plate, and placing the fruit.

name: Microwave Scrambled Eggs  (Low Fat)
steps: Spray a large microwave-safe mug. Add the egg, egg white, one chopped tomato, and chopped spinach. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Microwave for one minute. Stir and microwave for another minute or until set.

name: Cottage Egg Bowl
steps: Peel and cut the sweet potato into small cubes. Place the sweet potato in a bowl and cover with water. Microwave in 3-minute intervals until tender and easily pierced with a fork. Drain the water.
Prep the other ingredients. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half and cut the hard-boiled egg into slices. Drain the cottage cheese, using a fork to press and remove as much liquid as possible.
Assemble the bowl. Start by placing a portion of the cottage cheese in the bowl. Add the sweet potato cubes, followed by the cherry tomato halves. Top with the sliced hard-boiled egg.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, or paprika to taste and enjoy!

name: Toast with Roast Beef and Hard Boiled Egg

ingredients.name: Deli thin sliced roast beef by oscar meyer

steps: Slice a thick piece of sourdough bread. Toast the bread and spread the butter on top.
Slice the hard-boiled egg. Next, layer the roast beef slices over the toast, adding the hard-boiled egg slices on top. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Vanilla Date Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients add ice and enjoy!
Add extra water for a lighter consistency.

name: Cucumber and Cream Cheese Wrap
steps: Warm the tortilla in the microwave or a skillet over medium heat.
Remove the tortilla from the skillet.
Assemble the wrap, spread the cream cheese over the tortilla, and add the rest of the ingredients.
Wrap carefully and slice.

name: Blueberry Protein Baked
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 320°F (160°C) for about 3 minutes.
Prepare the muffin cups (air fryer-safe)
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs and ricotta cheese until smooth.
Add the dry ingredients. Stir in the vanilla protein powder and baking powder until well combined. Gently fold the fresh blueberries into the mixture.
Split the mixture evenly among the prepared muffin cups, filling each about 3/4 full. Place the filled muffin cups in the air fryer basket.
Cook at 320°F for 10-15 minutes until the tops are golden, and a toothpick inserted into the middle of a muffin comes out clean.
Allow the muffins to cool slightly before removing them. Drizzle the almond butter on top and enjoy!

name: Strawberry Cottage Cheese Muffins

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the air fryer 3 to 5 minutes to 320°F (160°C) for 3 to 5 minutes.

Blend the cottage cheese, oats, maple syrup, and baking powder until smooth. Gently fold in the strawberries.
Option: Add a calorie-free sweetener for baking to give it a sweeter flavor.
Use silicone muffin cups. Fill each cup about 2/3 full with the batter.
Place the muffin cups in the air fryer basket. Cook for 10-15 minutes or until a toothpick is inserted into the center of a muffin and it comes out clean.
Let the muffins cool for a few minutes before removing them from the cups.

Option: Cook in the oven, preheat and cook at 
350°F  for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: Breakfast Taco Bowl
steps: In a bowl, whisk together the egg white and whole egg. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a pan over low heat and lightly spray with oil. Pour in the egg mixture and cook gently, stirring constantly, until the eggs are soft and fully cooked.
Slice the tomato, remove the seeds, and chop it into small cubes.
Assemble the bowl. Begin by placing the scrambled eggs the bowl. Add a the black beans next to the eggs, and chopped tomato. Finish by adding slices of avocado.

name: Roast Beef Wrap  (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Delifresh slow roasted roast beef by oscar mayer

steps: Heat the tortilla in a pan. Set aside.

Spread the mayo around the tortilla,
Option: add one tbsp of mustard.
Start to assemble the wrap with the remaining ingredients; add salt and pepper to taste.
Slice the wrap, serve and enjoy!

name: Roast Beef Wrap

ingredients.name: Delifresh slow roasted roast beef by oscar mayer

steps: Heat the tortilla in a pan. Set aside.
Spread the mayo around the tortilla, and add one tbsp of mustard.
Start to assemble the wrap with the remaining ingredients; add salt and pepper to taste.
Slice the wrap, serve and enjoy!

name: Ham and Cheese Croissant
steps: Slice the croissant lengthwise to prepare it for filling.
Next, prepare the croissant by placing the cheese inside, followed by the ham slices. Add the arugula, then toast until the cheese melts. Enjoy!

name: Lemon Blueberry Muffins

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Preheat the air fryer o use the oven and preheat on 350°F
Combine the eggs, oats, greek yogurt, lemon juice, and lemon zest to taste in a blender. Blend until smooth.

Use the silicone muffin cups or spray the muffin tin with vegetable oil. Next, divide the mixture into 9 to 12 muffin cups, adding the blueberries to each cup. Top with rolled oats and more blueberries, if desired.
Bake for 10 minutes on the air fryer (25  minutes on the oven) or until the tops are lightly golden brown or a toothpick can be inserted in the muffin and comes out clean.
After removing the muffins from the air fryer or the oven, give them a couple of minutes to cool off before removing them from the muffin tin.
Store leftover muffins in an air-tight glass container in the fridge or freezer.

name: Egg Breakfast Wrap
steps: Mix the eggs and egg whites, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Then, heat a skillet, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the egg mixture on medium-low heat as an omelette. Once it's ready, set it aside.
Chiffonade the spinach. Next, spray the same skillet with the vegetable oil and cook the spinach until soft.
Heat the tortilla in a separate skillet and set aside.
Assemble the wrap: On one side of the tortilla, place the folded omelette, top with the spinach and chopped tomato, then wrap it carefully. Cut in half and serve on a plate.

name: Breakfast Quesadilla  (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Swiss cheese nonfat or fat free

steps: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, spray the vegetable oil and cook the eggs. Add salt and pepper to taste, stirring often.

Heat a skillet and warm the tortilla. Next, sprinkle the cheese over one side of each tortilla. Once the cheese has melted, divide the scrambled eggs between the two tortillas and fold each one in half.
Next, slice each quesadilla, serve it on a plate and enjoy!

name: Breakfast Quesadilla  (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Swiss cheese nonfat or fat free

steps: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and add the egg whites. Add salt and pepper to taste, stirring often.
Sprinkle the cheese over one side of each tortilla. Once the cheese has melted, divide the scrambled eggs between the two tortillas and fold each one in half.
Next, slice each quesadilla and serve it on a plate.

name: Pumpkin Yogurt Parfait  (Low Carb)
steps: Chop the walnuts and combine them with the pumpkin puree, maple syrup, and pumpkin spice. Set it aside.
Begin layering in a cup or glass. Add some yogurt to the bottom, followed by pumpkin mix.
Continue with another layer. Garnish with extra pumpkin spice and enjoy!

name: Pumpkin Yogurt Parfait  (High Protein)
steps: Chop the walnuts. Next, mix the pumpkin puree, maple syrup, and pumpkin spice until well combined. Add the walnuts and mix. Set aside.
Begin layering in a cup or glass. Add one-third of the pumpkin mixture to the bottom, followed by yogurt.
Continue with the second layer. Garnish with extra pumpkin spice on top.

name: Breakfast Stuffed Potato
steps: Mix the eggs with the egg whites. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a pan with vegetable oil spray and cook the scrambled eggs.

Meanwhile, pierce the sweet potato 3 - 4 times with a fork. Place the potato on a microwave-safe plate and microwave for 4 minutes, turning halfway through.  After 4 minutes, continue microwaving in 30-second increments until fork tender.  Split the potato down the middle.
Stuff the sweet potato with the scrambled egg and bacon.

name: Breakfast Salmon Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread, spread the cheese cream in each slice and assemble the sandwich with the rest of the ingredients,
Slice the sandwich and enjoy!

name: Blackberry Grilled Cheese  (Low Carb)
steps: Slice the blackberries. Next, assemble the sandwich and add the cheese and blackberry slices.
Heat a pan and toast the sandwich 2-3 minutes on each side until bread has lightly browned and cheese has melted.
Slice the sandwiches diagonally and serve.

name: Blackberry Grilled Cheese (Balanced)
steps: Slice the blackberries. Next, assemble the sandwich es, adding the cheese and blackberry slices.
Heat a pan and toast the sandwiches for 2-3 minutes on each side until the bread is lightly browned and the cheese has melted.
Slice the sandwiches diagonally and serve.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake Quesadilla
steps: Slice the strawberries.
Drain the cottage cheese, then place it in a bowl with the cream cheese and sweetener. Mix well.
Prepare the quesadilla by spreading the cream cheese mixture and adding the strawberry slices. You can add another layer of cream cheese and then fold the quesadilla.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add the butter, and spread it around the pan. Then, add the quesadilla and cook on both sides until heated through.
Cut in half and enjoy!

name: Breakfast Tacos

ingredients.name: Swiss cheese nonfat or fat free

steps: Chop the tomato into small cubes.
Heat a pan on medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the scrambled eggs with the tomato. Add salt and pepper to taste.

Heat the tortillas on a pan, then transfer them to a plate and assemble the tacos. Split the scrambled eggs into each tortilla, then add the black beans to each taco and finish adding the Swiss cheese on top.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Sausage (Low Carb)
steps: Slice the sausage, chop the tomato and chiffonade the spinach.

Heat a pan on medium heat. Add the butter and wait until it's completely melted. Next, add the eggs, tomato, salt and pepper to taste, and stir well. Add the sausage slices and stir until the eggs are ready.
Toast the bread and slice.
Assemble the plate with the scrambled eggs and bread slices.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Sausage (Balanced)
steps: Slice the sausage, chop the tomato and chiffonade the spinach.

Heat a pan on medium heat. Spray the vegetable oil, add the butter and wait until it melts. Next, add the eggs, tomato, salt and pepper to taste, and stir well. Add the sausage slices and stir until the eggs are ready.
Toast the bread and slice.
Assemble the plate with the scrambled eggs and bread slices.

name: Bacon Egg Wrap
steps: Mix the eggs and cottage cheese, add salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a pan, spray the vegetable oil, and cook as scrambled eggs, and stir constantly.
Warm the tortilla in the microwave or a skillet over medium heat and set aside.
Place the scrambled eggs on the tortilla, and add the bacon slices. Wrap tightly, slice, and enjoy!

name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Wrap
steps: Warm the tortilla in the microwave or a skillet over medium heat.
Remove the tortilla from the skillet and spread the cream cheese all over it.
Then, add the cucumber, avocado slices and salmon.
Wrap tightly, slice and serve.

name: Sun - Dried Tomato Chicken Wrap

ingredients.name: Low fat feta cheese by athenos

steps: Heat the tortilla in a skillet, and assemble the wrap with all the ingredients.
Carefully wrap the tortilla, cut it in half, and serve on a plate.

name: Omelette Croissant (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Turkey ham sliced prepackaged or deli meat

steps: Slice the croissant lengthwise to prepare it for filling.

Heat a skillet over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the egg as an omelette. Add salt to taste and cook on low heat. Once done, roll the omelette lengthwise, like a wrap, into three parts to fit inside the croissant.
Next, prepare the croissant by placing the cheese inside, followed by rolled ham slices. Place the omelette on top, add arugula, and enjoy.​

name: Mediterranean Wrap

ingredients.name: Low fat feta cheese by athenos

steps: Chop the tomato and cucumber into cubes, removing the seeds.
Heat the tortilla in a skillet, then spread hummus all over it. Add the cucumber, tomato, chicken, and feta cheese.
Carefully wrap the tortilla, cut it in half, and serve on a plate.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Turkey ham sliced prepackaged or deli meat

steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small cubes. Place the cubes in a bowl and lightly moisten them with water. Cook the sweet potato in the microwave in 3-minute intervals until you can easily pierce them with a fork, and they are soft.
Cut the ham into small squares. Whisk together the eggs and egg whites in a bowl, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and spray with vegetable oil. Add the ham and egg mixture to the pan. Cook on medium heat for just a couple of minutes, stirring constantly.
Once the scrambled eggs are ready, transfer them to a bowl. Add the sweet potato and finish by adding the avocado in slices.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Turkey ham sliced prepackaged or deli meat

steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small cubes. Place the cubes in a bowl and lightly moisten them with water. Cook the sweet potato in the microwave in 3-minute intervals until you can easily pierce them with a fork, and they are soft.
Cut the ham into small squares. Whisk the egg whites in a bowl, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and spray with vegetable oil. Add the ham and egg whites to the pan. Cook on medium heat for just a couple of minutes, stirring constantly.
Once the scrambled eggs are ready, transfer them to a bowl. Add the sweet potato and finish by adding the avocado in slices.

name: Beet Sweet Toast
steps: Peel and slice the beet into half-moon slices. Spray a pan with vegetable oil and cook the beet slices until soft.
Slice the bread and toast.
Place the cottage cheese in a strainer and press it with a fork to remove as much water as possible.
Next, spread the cottage cheese on the toast, add the beet slices and walnuts, and drizzle the honey over the toast. Enjoy!

name: Cottage Avocado Toast  (Low Carb)
steps: Slice the bread and toast.
Place the cottage cheese in a strainer and press it with a fork to remove as much water as possible. Then, spread the cottage cheese over the bread.
Place the avocado slices on top of the cottage cheese.
Sprinkle some paprika, sea salt and hemp.

name: Cottage Avocado Toast
steps: Slice the bread and toast.
Place the cottage cheese in a strainer and press it with a fork to remove as much water as possible. Then, spread the cottage cheese over the bread.
Place the avocado slices on top of the cottage cheese.
Sprinkle some paprika, sea salt and hemp.

name: Easy French Toast
steps: Slice the bread diagonally and slice the blackberries.
Next, in a bowl, beat the eggs and add the vanilla and cinnamon.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, and if any is leftover, soak each piece again.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and add the bread slices. Cook until they are golden brown.
Transfer to a serving plate, add the blackberries on top, drizzle with maple syrup, and sprinkle with extra cinnamon

name: Cheesecake Parfait
steps: Mix the yogur with cream cheese, vanilla and honey.

Crush the cookies, leaving some small chunks, and set aside a bit of the crushed cookies. Place the rest of the cookie mixture in a glass, add half of the yogurt mixture, and top with some strawberries, saving a few for the final layer.
Continue with the second layer by adding the remaining yogurt, the rest of the cookies, and finally, the strawberries.

name: Cheesecake Parfait  (High Protein)
steps: Mix the yogur with cream cheese, and vanilla.

Crush the cookies, leaving some small chunks, and set aside a bit of the crushed cookies. Place the rest of the cookie mixture in a glass, add half of the yogurt mixture, and top with some strawberries, saving a few for the final layer.
2 Continue with the second layer by adding the remaining yogurt, the rest of the cookies, and finally, the strawberries.

Continue with the second layer by adding the remaining yogurt, the rest of the cookies, and finally, the strawberries.

name: Italian Toast
steps: Slice the cherry tomatoes and toast the sourdough bread slices.
Next, prepare both slices of bread by spreading the ricotta cheese, adding the pesto, and finishing with cherry tomato slices. Sprinkle salt and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach With Ricotta  (Low Carb)
steps: Slice the peaches and chop the pistachios.
Preheat a pan or grill over medium heat and spray the vegetable oil.
Place the peach slices on the grill and cook until tender and with grill marks. Remove them from the grill and let them cool slightly.
Spread the ricotta cheese on a serving plate, add the peach slices, and sprinkle with pistachios. Garnish with basil leaves, and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach With Ricotta  (Low Fat)
steps: Slice the peaches and chop the pistachios.
Preheat a pan or grill over medium heat and spray the vegetable oil.
Place the peach slices on the grill and cook until tender and with grill marks. Remove them from the grill and let them cool slightly.
Spread the ricotta cheese on a serving plate, add the peach slices, and sprinkle with pistachios. Garnish with basil leaves, and enjoy!

name: Grilled Peach With Ricotta
steps: Slice the peaches and chop the pistachios.
Preheat a pan or grill over medium heat and spray the vegetable oil.
Place the peach slices on the grill and cook until tender and with grill marks. Remove them from the grill and let them cool slightly.
Spread the ricotta cheese on a serving plate, add the peach slices, sprinkle with pistachios, and drizzle the honey all over the plate. Garnish with basil leaves, and enjoy!

name: Creamy Tuna Rice Cake Toast  (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Olives green pickled canned or bottled

steps: Drain the tuna.
Slice the olives and grate the carrot finely. Take the spinach, stack a few leaves together, roll them tightly, and slice them into thin strips, complete with the rest of the spinach.
Combine all the previous ingredients in a bowl with the tuna, and add cream cheese, salt, and pepper to taste.
Press the mix with a fork and spread the creamy tuna on each rice cake.

name: Creamy Shrimp Salad (Balanced)
steps: Slice the cucumber and cut the shrimp tails.
Next, place them in a bowl with the red onion, sour cream, salt and pepper to taste.
Add the quinoa and mix well.

name: Salmon Farro Salad (Low Carb)
steps: Shred the salmon. Next, mix all the ingredients in a bowl, squeeze lemon juice and add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Salmon Farro Salad (Balanced)
steps: Shred the salmon.
Heat the farro in a non-stick pan. Add the spinach and stir.
Once the spinach wilts, serve it on a plate and add the rest of the ingredients.
Squeeze lime juice over it and add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Parisian Steak and Cheese Croissant (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Slice the meat into sticks, add salt and cook in a nonstick pan on low heat.

Halve the croissant in half and spread butter inside each half. Layer the arugula and bell pepper slices on the bottom half of the croissant. Place the cooked steak on top of the vegetables. Add cheese slices over the steak.
Place the croissant in a toaster oven or on a pan over medium heat. Toast until the cheese starts to melt.
Close the croissant, and enjoy

name: Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, spray with vegetable oil, and cook the egg. Add salt and pepper to taste, stirring often.

Heat a skillet and place the tortilla. Next, sprinkle the cheese over one side of each tortilla. Once the cheese has melted, divide the scrambled eggs between the two tortillas and fold each one in half.
Next, slice each quesadilla, serve it on a plate and complete the meal with the strawberries.

name: Flourless Easy Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F or the air fryer
Mash the bananas with a fork, whisk in the eggs, add the yogurt and mix.

Spray a muffin pan with cooking spray. Slice the raspberries and add them to each compartment. Pour the banana mixture into each compartment until it is filled. Bake for approximately 12 minutes or until the mixture appears set.

name: Mediterranean Breakfast Bowl (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large
Fat free feta cheese by athenos

steps: Place the eggs in a pot, cover them entirely with water, and cook over medium-high heat for 15 minutes. After cooking, place them in a bowl of cold water and ice for a few minutes to facilitate peeling.
Meanwhile, prepare all the ingredients. Mix the cucumber with the feta cheese and serve in a bowl. Arrange the olives on one side, then the hummus and pita.
Peel the eggs, cut them in half, and add them to the bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste, and enjoy!

Option: use boiled beet and add two tbsp of  maple syrup sugar-free.

name: Creamy Scramble Eggs  (High Protein)
steps: Heat a pan over low-medium heat. Whisk the eggs and add salt and Pepper to taste. Spray the pan with vegetable oil and pour the eggs. Keep the heat at low to medium.

Once it looks slightly cooked, begin whisking and gradually add the cream. Keep whisking until thoroughly combined and cooked. Try not to overcook; achieving a smoother texture should only take a few minutes.
Toast the bread and cut it in half.
Assemble the plate with the creamy eggs, toast and strawberries.

name: Creamy Scramble Eggs (Balanced)
steps: Heat a pan over low-medium heat. Whisk the eggs and add salt and Pepper to taste. Spray the pan with vegetable oil and pour the eggs. Keep the heat at low to medium.

steps: Heat a pan over low-medium heat. Whisk the eggs and add salt and Pepper to taste. Spray the pan with vegetable oil and pour the eggs. Keep the heat at low to medium.

Once it looks slightly cooked, begin whisking and gradually add the cream. Keep whisking until thoroughly combined and cooked. Try not to overcook; it should only take a couple of minutes to achieve a smoother texture.
Toast the bread and cut it in half.

name: Breakfast Bagel  (Low Carb)
steps: Heat a small egg pan over low-medium heat. Meanwhile, beat the egg whites and season with salt and pepper to taste.

Once warm, spray the pan with vegetable oil and pour the egg whites. Keep the heat at low-medium and cover the pan. After about 3 minutes, the egg whites should be mostly cooked, except for the top. Carefully flip the egg whites and cook for 3 minutes until fully cooked.
After it’s cooked, let it cool for a couple of minutes, and then start assembling the bagel with all the ingredients.

name: Creamy Blueberry Smoothie  (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey protein powder low carb

steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Blueberry Smoothie
steps: Place the yogur, blueberries, banana almond butter and almon milk in to a blender. Blend until smooth.
Next, add the ice and blend until it’s completely crushed.

name: Raspberry Coconut Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients, transfer to a glass and enjoy!

name: Cocoa Peanut Butter Parfait

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey protein powder low carb

steps: Serve half the yogurt in a container. Add half of the whey protein and cocoa powder and mix well.
Add half the strawberries to a glass and pour the cocoa yogurt.
Mix the remaining yogurt with the peanut butter, the rest of the protein powder, and a pinch of salt in another container.
For the next layer, add the remaining strawberries and transfer the peanut butter yogurt over them. Enjoy!

name: Cocoa Peanut Butter Parfait (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey protein powder low carb

steps: Serve half the yogurt in a container. Add half of the whey protein and cocoa powder and mix well.
Add half the sliced strawberries to a glass and pour the cocoa yogurt.
In another container, mix the remaining yogurt with the peanut butter, the rest of the protein powder, and a pinch of salt.
For the next layer, add the remaining strawberries and transfer the peanut butter yogurt over them. Enjoy!

name: Mango Coconut Parfait  (High Protein)
steps: Reserve one tbsp of coconut and chop the mango into small cubes.
Place the yogurt, shredded coconut, and cream cheese in a blender. Mix until smooth and serve in a glass or jar.
Next, blend the mango until you get a puree and serve on top of the yogurt mix.
Finish by adding the reserved mango pieces and the remaining shredded coconut..

name: Mango Coconut Parfait
steps: Chop the mango into small cubes, then divide it into two portions. Blend one portion until you achieve a smooth mango purée. Transfer the mango purée to a glass or container.
In the same blender, add the yogurt, shredded coconut, and cream cheese, then blend until smooth. Serve the mixture on top of the mango puree.
Finish by adding the reserved mango

name: Toast with Blueberries
steps: Slice a large piece of bread and toast it.
Place the cottage cheese in a strainer and press it with a fork to remove as much water as possible.
Then, add the cottage cheese and cream cheese to a food processor or blender.
Assemble the toast, spread the cheese mixture on the toasted bread, add the blueberries, and top with lime zest for a special touch of flavor. Enjoy!

name: Noodle Salad

ingredients.name: Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg

steps: Prepare the noodles according to the package instructions. Transfer to a large bowl and toss with the peanut butter and liquid aminos.
Chop the tofu, grate the carrot and zucchini with a peeler. Place the carrot and zucchini in a nonstick pan and cook until soft.
Assemble the bowl with all the ingredients and enjoy!

name: Tuscan Pasta With Plant-Based Sausage

ingredients.name: Plant-based original italian sausage by tofurky

steps: Heat a non-stick pan, stir in the oil and minced garlic
Next, add the cooked pasta, spinach and cherry tomato. Combine and heat just until the spinach softens slightly.
Transfer into a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Plant - Based Quesadilla

ingredients.name: Soy free plant-based mince by flexible foods
Mozzarella style shredded cheese by violife

steps: Dice the red bell pepper. Drain and rinse the black beans.
Add the plant-based mince to a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook for about 3-4 minutes until heated through, stirring occasionally.
Next, add the black beans and red bell pepper. Mix everything well and continue to cook until the mixture is evenly heated. Once it’s ready, remove it from the heat.

Sprinkle the vegan mozzarella cheese evenly over one half of the tortilla. Next, spread the plant-based stew over the cheese. Fold the other half of the tortilla over the fillings to form a half-moon shape.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Place the folded quesadilla in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until the tortilla is golden brown and the cheese is melted.

name: Golden Milk Parfait

ingredients.name: Greek style yogurt dairy free vanilla unsweetened by kite hill

steps: Mix the yogurt with the golden milk.
Place half of the blueberries in the glass or container, then add half of the granola and the yogurt mixture.
Finish by adding the remaining blueberries, granola, and hemp seeds.

name: Peach Parfait

ingredients.name: Greek style yogurt dairy free vanilla unsweetened by kite hill

steps: Cut the peach into cubes.
Layer a medium portion of the yogurt in a glass or container, followed by half of the peach cubes and a dash of cinnamon. Drizzle with half of peanut butter and a teaspoon of honey.
Next, add the next layer in the same way and complete by adding  the  peanut butter and honey on top.

name: Berry Parfait

ingredients.name: Greek style yogurt dairy free vanilla unsweetened by kite hill

steps: Start by spooning about half of the yogurt into the bottom of a glass or bowl, spreading it out evenly.
Sprinkle half of the blueberries and raspberries over the yogurt and top with half of the granola.
Repeat the Layers: Add the remaining yogurt, then the rest of the blueberries and raspberries. Finish by topping with the remaining granola

name: Peanut Butter & Jelly Oats

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked
Vanilla bean flavor plant based organic protein by orgain

steps: In a blender, combine the plant-based milk, protein powder, and only half of the peanut butter.
Add the oats and a pinch of salt to a glass or container and combine. Stir in the protein shake and mix.
Place the lid and refrigerate overnight.
Before eating, top with the jam and the remaining peanut butter.

name: Creamy Chocolate Overnight Oats

ingredients.name: Vanilla bean flavor plant based organic protein by orgain

steps: Microwave the chocolate for 10 - 15 seconds until it starts to melt.
Blend the almond milk and protein powder. Next, add the melted chocolate and maple syrup.
Transfer into a jar or container, add the oats and a pinch of salt and combine.
Place the lid and close. Fridge overnight or enjoy it right away.

name: Stuffed Sweet Potato With Tofu
steps: Use a fork to pierce the sweet potatoes and place them in the microwave for 5 minutes approx. Chop the tofu into small cubes, cut the red pepper into smaller cubes, and cut the spinach lengthwise.

Press saute option on the Instant Pot and place in the tofu, the oil, cajun seasoning, add salt, and pepper to taste, and mix well. Cook for a few minutes. Transfer the tofu into a small bowl and place the red pepper inside the IP, cook until blended, and then add the spinach, stir gently to combine and cancel saute function

Transfer the red pepper and spinach with the tofu and mix gently. Come back with the sweet potatoes and gently slice lengthwise and open, mash the inside very well of both sweet potatoes and carefully place them in the tofu mix.

name: Stuffed Sweet Potato (Pork)

ingredients.name: Sweet potato baked with skin without salt

steps: Dice the bacon, and chop the spinach.
In a skillet over medium heat. Add the bacon and cook until crispy. Remove the bacon from the skillet. Use a fork to pierce the sweet potatoes and microwave them for 5 minutes approx.

Add the coconut oil, and red bell pepper to the skillet and sauté for 5-7 minutes, or until tender. Next, add the ground turkey and stir to combine. Cook until it changes color. Add in the spinach, and mix well.
Gently slice lengthwise and open the sweet potato, sprinkle the cinnamon on top. Next, mash the inside very well and stuff it with the turkey filling.

name: Farro Salad And Asparagus (Balanced)
steps: Dice the chicken.
Next, stir all the ingredients in a bowl, mix well and add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the asparagus as a side and enjoy!

name: Chicken and Lemon Pasta (Balanced)
steps: Heat a pan and place the chopped garlic and the olive oil. Next, add the cooked pasta and mix. Squeeze the lemon on top, add parmesan cheese, and combine.
Transfer the pasta to a serving plate, cut the chicken breast into strips, and place them on the pasta.
Option: use  gluten-free pasta

name: Chicken Omelette (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Mushrooms portabella high vitamin D raw

steps: Slice the cherry tomatoes and mushrooms.
Heat a nonstick pan and cook the mushrooms. Next, add the cherry tomatoes, shredded chicken and combine.

Place the eggs in a small bowl and mix them. Heat another pan, add the oil, and then cook the eggs as an omelet.
Add the mushroom mixture to the omelet and fold it over.
Transfer the omelet to a serving plate and serve the remaining mushroom mix as a side.

Complete by adding the bread slices.
Option: use gluten-free bread

steps: Toast the bread, and slice the chicken breast.
Spread the pesto on each slice of bread, then prepare the sandwich with mozzarella, dehydrated tomatoes, and chicken.

steps: Prepare the ingredients and the chicken.
Heat a pan, place the tortilla, lay the cheese on top, and add the bell pepper and chicken.
Once the cheese starts melting, fold the tortilla and transfer the quesadilla to a serving plate.

name: Sheet Pan Steak and Potatoes (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Preheat oven to broil. Lightly oil a baking sheet or coat with nonstick spray.
Boil potatoes until half-tender, about 12 minutes, drain and remove.
Place potatoes and chopped broccoli in a single layer onto the prepared baking sheet. Add olive oil, garlic and thyme; season with salt and pepper, to taste. Toss to coat.
Season a room temperature steak with salt and pepper, and add to the baking sheet.
Broil the entire tray for 4-5 minutes, or until steak is browned and cooked to desire doneness.

name: Sheet Pan Steak and Potatoes (Low Carb)

Add the chicken strips to a small bowl. Add the cheese on top, microwave to melt the cheese, and mix after.
Next, spread the sour cream on top of the tortilla.
Add the chicken mixture, red pepper, black beans, corn, and salt and pepper to taste.
Wrap carefully.
