Add the chicken strips to a small bowl. Add the cheese on top, microwave to melt the cheese, and mix after.
Next, spread the sour cream on top of the tortilla.
Serve the chicken mixture on top of the tortilla, and add the red pepper, black beans, corn, and salt and pepper to taste.
Wrap carefully.

name: Southwest Burrito (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Low fat sour cream by great value

steps: Slice the red pepper and defrost the fajitas. Next, take the fajitas and weigh the indicated quantity.
Place the fajitas with the cheese on top in a small bowl, microwave to melt the cheese, and mix after.
Next, spread the cream sour on top of the tortilla.
Transfer the fajitas to the tortilla, and add the red pepper, black beans, corn, and salt and pepper to taste.
Wrap carefully.

name: Ham Egg Cups and Fruit Salad (High Protein - Pork)

ingredients.name: Deli ham wegmans virginia baked by Wegmans

steps: Preheat oven to 400º and grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray. Line each cup with a slice of ham and sprinkle with cheddar.
Mix the egg with the egg whites (2 pieces or 1/4 of a cup), serve in each ham cup, and season with salt and pepper.
Bake until eggs are cooked, 12 to 15 minutes (depending on how runny you like your yolks). Garnish with parsley and serve.
Meanwhile, chop kiwis and mix them together with peeled mandarin segments and blueberries.
Optional: Omit the cheese to keep this recipe Paleo-Friendly

name: Portobello Sandwich - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps:
Prepare the portobello mushroom by drying it with a paper towel, gently twisting off, or cutting the stem of each mushroom. 
Continue and hold a mushroom in one hand and use a spoon to scrape the gills gently.
Use a vegetable peeler to slice the cucumber lengthways into long, thin ribbons and slice the tomatoes.
Carefully place the steamer rack in the Instant Pot, spray the mushroom caps with cooking spray, and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Press the pressure cook button and manually set the timer for 1 minute on high pressure. After cooking, release pressure before opening the lid.

Carefully transfer the mushrooms to a serving plate, spread the hummus inside both mushrooms and add all the ingredients. Add the spinach leaves, using as many as needed, the tomato, cucumber, and cheese, and close the sandwich.
Next, use a fork to pierce the potato, and microwave it for 5 minutes at high pressure.
Once it’s ready, slice it lengthwise and carefully open it. Smash the potato inside, add the butter, salt, and pepper to taste, and serve as a side with the Portobello Sandwich.

name: Ham and Cheddar Roll Ups

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Lay slices of cheddar onto slices ham. Roll up and serve.

name: Beef Jerky
steps: Serve as-is.

name: Goulash- Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Press saute on the Instant Pot, when the pot is hot, add the ground beef and cook until the beef is no longer pink, stir while breaking it into smaller pieces.
Add the onion and cook until softened, continue adding the garlic, and bell pepper and cook, stirring for 1 minute, then cancel the saute function.
Pour in the broth and stir, add the Italian seasoning, soy sauce, garlic powder, salt and pepper and toss to combine
Add the pasta  and press it down, put the diced tomatoes and tomato sauce on top of the pasta, don't stir
Place the lid and close, and set the cooking time  to 4 minutes at high pressure, once the timer ends,  release the pressure before opening.
Mix and stir in the shredded cheddar cheese.
Serve and top with fresh parsley.

name: Steak and Egg with Hashbrowns (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Preheat oven to 450F. Wash and chop potatoes into bite sized chunks. Dry thoroughly, toss with half of the olive oil, season with salt and pepper, then place on a foil lined baking sheet in the oven for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook steak in a pan with the other half of the oil, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Halve cherry tomatoes, and add to pan when there is 10 minutes remaining, gentle move potatoes around and add back to the oven.
Slice cooked steak, and serve with baked potatoes, tomatoes, a fried egg and chopped parsley.

name: Chicken "Chorizo" Tacos (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: 97% lean 3% fat ground chicken breast by denmark foods

steps: Cook ground chicken with spices in a pan over medium heat, coated with olive oil. Cook until no longer pink, and break into crumbles. Season with salt to taste
Serve chicken in warmed tortillas with pico de gallo and sour cream.

name: Chicken "Chorizo" Tacos (Low Carb)
steps: Cook ground chicken with spices in a pan over medium heat, coated with olive oil. Cook until no longer pink, and break into crumbles. Season with salt to taste
Serve chicken in warmed tortillas with pico de gallo and sour cream.

name: Chicken "Chorizo" Tacos (Balanced)

ingredients.name: 97% lean 3% fat ground chicken breast by denmark foods

steps: Cook ground chicken with spices in a pan over medium heat, coated with olive oil. Cook until no longer pink, and break into crumbles. Season with salt to taste
Serve chicken in warmed tortillas with pico de gallo and sour cream.

name: Chicken Salad Bento Box (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Crackers saltines includes oyster soda soup

steps:
First, make chicken salad by combing yogurt, mayo, chicken, 1 stalk of diced celery, chopped dill, chopped onion, mustard, and vinegar in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper
To assemble each "bento" box, place 2 large leaves of lettuce in the box, and top with 1/2 of the salad mixture.
Also add to the box some sliced cantaloupe, crackers, and almonds.

name: Asian Style Noodle Soup (Balanced)
steps: Heat oil over medium heat in a large soup pot. Sauté chopped ginger and garlic for 3 minutes, before adding broth.
Bring broth to a boil before adding chopped carrots, chopped broccoli, snow peas, and chopped celery.
Add noodles, and simmer for 3 minutes, or until slightly softened. Add shrimp and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, and serve with bean sprouts.

name: Okonomiyaki - Japanese Pancake (Pork)

ingredients.name: Pork tenderloin lean meat only roasted
Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Start by finely slicing cabbage, and mixing in a bowl with sliced green onion, breadcrumbs and 1 beaten egg.
Lay pork in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Turn over once light is browned on the bottom.
Pour egg mixture over the pork slices, forming a pancake on top of them.
Cook for about 4 minutes until the bottom is slightly brown and crispy, then flip over. Cook for 5 minutes more, covering if possible, until the pancake is cooked through.

To serve: either enjoy as-is or top with homemade sauce, made by mixing ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, and Worcestershire. You may also drizzle with mayonnaise (optional), or top with pickled ginger, bonito flakes, or microgreens (all optional)

name: Greek Meatballs Bowl

ingredients.name: Olives black canned jumbo and super-colossal

steps: Heat a non-stick pan to medium heat and cook the meatballs.
Slice the cherry tomatoes and cut the cucumber into half-moon slices.
Assemble the bowl with each ingredient and finish by squeezing the lemon over the top.

name: Date Banana Cream
steps: Mix the yogurt, protein, and peanut butter.
Mince the dates.
Next, transfer the mixture to a food processor, add the banana and half a portion of dates, and blend until smooth.
Serve on a small plate and garnish with the remaining dates.

name: Tahini Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Broccoli Sausage Pasta

ingredients.name: Plant based original sausage by tofurky

steps: Cook the Pasta: If it hasn't already been cooked, boil the tagliatelle according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Cut the broccoli into small florets. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and broccoli, and sauté for 3 minutes until the broccoli starts to soften.
Slice the plant-based sausage into bite-sized pieces. Add the sausage to the skillet with the broccoli and sauté for another 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the broccoli and sausage. Season with salt and red chili flakes to taste. Cook for 1-2 more minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. Serve and enjoy!

name: Tempeh Quinoa Pesto Bowl
steps: Assemble the bowl and spread the pesto over the entire dish.

name: Nacho Bowl

ingredients.name: Soy free plant-based mince by flexible foods

steps: Drain the beans, and dice the tomatoes and bell pepper into cubes. You can also slice a jalapeño for a spicy flavor.
Heat a non-stick skillet and add the vegan meat. Cook for a little while, and then add the beans and salt. Stir to combine.
Assemble the Bowl and place the plant-based stew in it. Next, add the tomatoes and tortilla chips. Finish with avocado, sprinkle with salt, and enjoy.

name: Creamy Matcha Overnight Oats
steps: Blend the tofu with the banana, matcha, and almond milk.
Option: add non caloric sweetener.
Next, transfer to a container and add the oats and cacao nibs. Mix, place the lid and refrigerate overnight.

name: Cookie Dough Balls

ingredients.name: Stevia sweetened 55% cocoa vegan dark chocolate premium baking chips by lily's

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine peanut butter and maple syrup until it forms a creamy paste.
Stir in almond flour, coconut flour, and vegan chocolate chips. Use the spoon at first, then use your hands to squeeze, and knead the batter for 30 seconds and form a large dough ball.
Divide the dough into 16 small cookie dough balls. Roll the balls between the palms of your hands to shape round balls.
2 Cookie dough balls per serving

name: Protein Balls

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: In a mixing bowl, stir peanut butter, maple syrup, and almond milk.
Stir in the protein powder and quick oats until the batter sticks together, and it's easy to roll into balls.
If it is too dry, add more almond milk or water to bring it together and roll it into balls.

Note: The original recipe makes six servings, yielding 12 protein balls.
One serving = 2 protein balls.

name: Avo Rice Cake Toast
steps: Place the tofu and avocado in a food processor. Add nutritional yeast, garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste. Blend until smooth
Spread the avocado dip in each rice cake an place the cucumber slice on top. Enjoy!

name: Tahini Veggie Bowl
steps: Dressing: Blend half of the tofu with tahini; add salt if needed.
Cut the remaining tofu into cubes, spray it with vegetable oil, and fry in the air fryer or a non-stick pan.
Prepare the bowl with the cabbage, tofu, cucumber, rice, and red bell pepper. Drizzle the tofu dressing all over the plate. Enjoy!
Drizzle the tofu dressing all over the plate. Enjoy!

name: Green Goddess Sandwich
steps: Chop the spinach and microwave for about 15 seconds. Next, mash the tofu, add salt and garlic powder and mix with the spinach.
Prepare the sandwich. Spread the tofu on each bread slice. Add the avocado, cucumber slices and alfalfa.

name: Farro Salad
steps: Mince the garlic, dice the tofu, and chiffonade the spinach.

Next, transfer the tofu to a bowl and add olive oil, garlic, and salt. 
Option: Season it with fresh rosemary or dried herbs.
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Enjoy!

name: Orange - Chocolate Mousse
steps: Place chocolate bar pieces in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave in 20-second intervals until melted, stirring after each interval.
Combine the tofu, orange juice, and half of the orange zest in a blender. Process until smooth. Add the maple syrup and melted chocolate and blend once again.
Serve the mixture in cups and garnish with the remaining orange zest. Refrigerate for one hour for better consistency.

name: Pasta Fredda With Plant Based Sausage

ingredients.name: Plant-based original italian sausage by tofurky
Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Slice the zucchini lengthwise in half and then chop it into half moons. Bake or cook in a nonstick pan.
Slice the cherry tomatoes.
Slice the sausage. Next, heat a non-stick pan to medium-high heat and cook the sausage slices for 5 minutes.
Place the pasta, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes in a large bowl. Add the sausage slices, salt, pepper and Mediterranean seasoning to taste. Mix well and enjoy!
Option: Use gluten free pasta.

name: Earth Bowl

ingredients.name: Soy free plant-based mince by flexible foods

steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into cubes. Measure the portion and place it in a deep dish. Add a few drops of water and microwave for 5 minutes until the sweet potato is soft and can be pierced with a fork.
Drain the lentils; use boiled or canned lentils.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the vegetable oil. Add the plant-based mince and cook until heated through. Add the lentils, salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Peel and slice the avocado.
Assemble the bowl: serve the mix of plant-based mince and lentils in the bowl. Add the sweet potato, alfalfa sprouts, and avocado. Enjoy!

name: Vegetable and Sausage Bowl

ingredients.name: Plant-based original italian sausage by tofurky

steps: Cut the broccoli into small florets, dice the bell pepper into bite-sized pieces, and cut the potatoes in half. Slice the sausage into rounds.
Place the potato and broccoli in a bowl, add oil, salt and pepper to taste, and mix well.
Transfer the seasoned potato and broccoli to a large pan. Cover the pan with a lid and cook on medium heat until the vegetables are soft.
Next, add the remaining ingredients and cook until the bell pepper is soft and mixed. Transfer into a serving bowl.

name: Matcha Pudding

ingredients.name: Matcha green tea powder by sprouts
Vanilla raw vegan protein by sunwarrior

steps: Blend the coconut milk with matcha and protein powder until smooth. Next, stir in the maple syrup and blend again until thoroughly combined.
Transfer the mixture to a container, add the chia seeds, and stir to combine. Refrigerate overnight or until the mixture reaches a pudding-like consistency.
Place the raspberries and maple syrup in a bowl. Mash and combine them with a fork until you achieve a smooth puree.
Transfer half of the matcha pudding into a cup. Place the raspberry puree on top, and then add the remaining pudding to complete

name: Golden Chia Pudding

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey protein powder low carb

steps: Blend the coconut milk with the protein powder and turmeric.
Next, add the maple syrup and mix until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a container, add the chia seeds, and stir well.
Refrigerate for 15 minutes or overnight. Top with blueberries and enjoy!

name: Tofu Lemon Mousse
steps: Blend all the ingredients. Add maple to taste.
Transfer into a small container, place more lemon zest on top and place the lid.
Fridge for at least 3 hours or overnight for the consistency of the mousse.

name: Creamy Red Pepper Pasta

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Mince the garlic. Next, heat a pan and place the oil, stir in the garlic and cook a few minutes. Add the bell pepper and cook until soft.
Transfer into a blender, add the tofu, nutritional yeast and salt. Blend until get a creamy consistency. (Option add paprika to taste)
Place the sauce into the same pan on high  heat for a few  minutes, stir in the pasta and combine.
Transfer into a serving plate add red pepper flakes  and enjoy!

name: Easy Tzatiki Plant Based Bowl

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large

steps: Peel the cucumber, slice it in half lengthwise, remove the seeds, and then cut it into half-moons.
Plant-Based Tzatziki: Place the tofu in a blender and add salt, garlic powder, and half a cup of chopped cucumber. Blend until smooth.
Assemble the bowl: Place the spinach, serve the farro, then add the cucumber, cherry tomato slices, and black olives. Serve the tzatziki in the middle of the plate, and enjoy!

name: Havana Style Bowl
steps: Chop the tofu and transfer it to a bowl; add oil, salt and paprika to taste. Mix well
Heat a nonstick pan and cook the tofu for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden.
Drain the beans. Next, assemble the bowl, serve the rice, beans, and tofu and top with nutritional yeast.

name: Kale Tomato Corn Salad
steps: Prepare the ingredients according to their description, and drain the corn.
Mix all the ingredients in a bowl, add salt to taste and enjoy!

name: Kale and Quinoa Salad with Black Beans
steps: Drain the beans. Next, mix all the ingredients in a bowl, except for the avocado, and season it with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving plate and finish by adding the avocado slices
Option: squeeze lemon juice

name: Mac and Cheese Silken Tofu

ingredients.name: Cooked spaghetti or pasta, white, with salt

steps: Blend the tofu, mustard, nutritional yeast, and sugar until the sauce looks silky and smooth. Taste and then adjust salt, sugar, or dijon as desired. Option: Add some paprika to give it a special flavour.
Add the vegan butter to the hot pasta, toss to coat and then pour over the cheese sauce and toss again. Enjoy!

name: Pasta with Special Pesto
steps: Chop the garlic and then transfer it to a food processor. Add the tofu, spinach, basil, garlic, oil, and salt. Pulse to combine until you get a creamy consistency.
Cook the pasta, drain the water, and add the pesto to the pan. Mix briefly and allow the pesto to heat up.
Transfer into a serving plate. Enjoy!

name: Thai Salad - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Slice the carrot and red pepper into strips. Mince the garlic and ginger, and chop the green onion. Dice the chicken breast into small pieces. Chop the red cabbage and set all prepared ingredients aside.
Set the Instant Pot to the Sauté function. Add the sesame oil and allow it to heat up. Add the minced garlic, ginger, and green onion. Sauté for about 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the diced chicken to the Instant Pot and continue adding the carrots and bell pepper. Pour in the water, soy sauce, orange juice and sriracha. Stir everything together.
Close the lid of the Instant Pot and set the valve to Sealing. Select the manual or pressure cook function and set the timer for 5 minutes.
Once the cooking cycle is complete, perform a quick release by turning the valve to Venting. Carefully open the lid. Stir the contents to combine.
Add the peanuts and red cabbage to the dish and give it a final stir. Serve the dish, garnishing with extra green onions or sesame seeds.

name: Thai Salad - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Slice the carrot and red pepper into strips. Mince the garlic and ginger, and chop the green onion. Dice the chicken breast into small pieces. Chop the red cabbage and set all prepared ingredients aside.
Set the Instant Pot to the Sauté function. Add the sesame oil and allow it to heat up. Add the minced garlic, ginger, and green onion. Sauté for about 2 minutes until fragrant.

Add the diced chicken to the Instant Pot and continue adding the carrots, bell pepper, and pasta. Pour in the water, soy sauce, orange juice and sriracha. Stir everything together ensuring the pasta is submerged.
Close the lid of the Instant Pot and set the valve to Sealing. Select the manual or pressure cook function and set the timer for 5 minutes.
Once the cooking cycle is complete, perform a quick release by turning the valve to Venting. Carefully open the lid. Stir the contents to combine.
Add the peanuts and red cabbage to the dish and give it a final stir. Serve the dish, garnishing with extra green onions or sesame seeds.

name: Thai Salad - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Slice the carrot and red pepper into strips. Mince the garlic and ginger, and chop the green onion. Dice the chicken breast into small pieces. Chop the red cabbage and set all prepared ingredients aside.
Set the Instant Pot to the Sauté function. Add the sesame oil and allow it to heat up. Add the minced garlic, ginger, and green onion. Sauté for about 2 minutes until fragrant.

Add the diced chicken to the Instant Pot and continue adding the carrots, bell pepper, and pasta. Pour in the water, soy sauce, orange juice and sriracha. Stir everything together ensuring the pasta is submerged.
Close the lid of the Instant Pot and set the valve to Sealing. Select the manual or pressure cook function and set the timer for 5 minutes.
Once the cooking cycle is complete, perform a quick release by turning the valve to Venting. Carefully open the lid. Stir the contents to combine.
Add the peanuts and red cabbage to the dish and give it a final stir. Serve the dish, garnishing with extra green onions or sesame seeds.

name: Burrito Bowls (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Smart ground mexican style seasoned veggie protein crumbles by lightlife

steps: Cook vegan crumbles according to package directions.
Mash avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Assemble bowls by adding together shredded lettuce, rice, crumbles, avocado, and pico de gallo

name: Plant Based Wrap

ingredients.name: Soy free plant-based mince by flexible foods

steps: Add the plant-based mince and 400ml of water to a saucepan. Heat on low, cover with a lid, and stir occasionally for 4 minutes. Remove the lid, add the onion, and season with salt, paprika, and garlic powder. Cook for a further minute, stirring occasionally, or until soft.
Prepare the wrap, spread the avocado, place the alfalfa and complete with the soy mix. Enjoy!

name: Soy Tacos
steps: Prepare the soy chunks according to the package.
Preheat a pan over medium heat and add the oil.  Cook the onion until translucent.
Drain the soy and transfer it into the pan. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until they begin to brown.
Next, transfer the soy and onions to a food processor. Add walnuts, salt, paprika, and pepper to taste. Pulse to combine.
Prepare the tacos, add coriander leaves or chopped tomato and enjoy!

name: Fresh Easy Bowl
steps: Blend the tofu with chipotle powder, salt and garlic salt. Option: use paprika instead of chipotle.
Defrost the edamame and assemble the bowl. Place the edamame, mango, grated carrot, and avocado. Spread the tofu dressing all over the place, and enjoy!

name: Lentil Spread Wrap
steps: Drain the lentils to remove any excess liquid. Finely chop the bell pepper. Place the drained lentils and chopped bell pepper in a blender. Add the nutritional yeast and paprika. Blend for a few seconds until a creamy consistency is reached.
Prepare the wrap: Spread the avocado on the tortilla, then place the spinach leaves and lentils on top. Wrap and enjoy

name: Smashed Chickpea Salad Wrap
steps: Place the chickpeas, mayo, and tofu in a blender. Blend until the chickpeas are almost pureed, then stir with a fork. Add the carrot, salt, and paprika. Blend again until it reaches a creamy consistency with a few chickpea chunks.
Place the spinach in each tortilla, spread the tofu mix and wrap. Enjoy!

name: Easy Rice Bowl
steps: Chop the tofu into medium-sized cubes. Heat a pan and spray with vegetable cooking oil. Cook for a few minutes, or use the air fryer.
Slice the cherry tomatoes. Next, assemble the bowl and serve the rice, beans, avocado and tofu.

name: Cucumber Salad
steps: Dice the tomatoes and prepare the other ingredients as specified in the preparation details
Combine the ingredients in a bowl. Shredded the tofu on top, seasoning it with nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well and enjoy!
Option: squeeze one lemon and mix.

name: Matcha Overnight Oats Pudding(Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked
Matcha green tea powder by sprouts

steps: Place the matcha in a small bowl, add one tablespoon of hot water, and whisk to make a smooth, silky paste.
In a jar or container with a lid, combine the oats, chia seeds, yogurt, milk, and matcha paste, and stir to combine.
Add the frozen mango on top, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Optional:  Add zero-calorie sweetener for extra sweetness.

name: Avocado Tofu Wrap
steps: Shred the tofu, combine it with the avocado, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Spread the avocado tofu in each tortilla, and prepare the wraps with the remaining ingredients.

name: Veggies with Red Pepper Sauce
steps: Halve the red bell pepper and remove the seeds. Hold the slices over an open flame or cook in a non-stick pan.
Place the next ingredients in a food processor:   tofu, roasted pepper, minced garlic, paprika and salt. Blend until smooth.
To give a smoother consistency, refrigerate for at least 10 minutes.
Serve the vegetables on a plate and add the sauce in a small container. Enjoy!

name: Vegan Fruit Dip
steps: Dip: Place the tofu, maple, cinnamon and vanilla in a food processor. Blend until smooth.
Prepare the skewers by alternating different fruits and serving the dip on the side. Enjoy!

name: Silken Tofu Matcha
steps: Combine all the ingredients (except for the raspberries) into a food processor and pulse until pudding-like texture is achieved. Add more sweetener if needed.
Set aside 1/4  of the raspberries and mash the rest with a fork.
Next, serve half of the tofu matcha in a glass, add the mashed raspberries, fill the glass with the remaining tofu, and garnish with raspberries.
To give a smoother consistency, cover and place in the fridge for at least 10 minutes.

name: Celery Sticks with Tofu Ranch

ingredients.name: Apple cider vinegar by always save
Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Tofu Ranch: Place all the ingredients except for the dill and celery in a blender. Add garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
Option: add natural herbs such as parsley and dills.
To give a smoother consistency refrigerate the ranch for at least 30 minutes
Serve with celery sticks, and enjoy!

name: Tofu Protein Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients (except the ground flaxseeds) together in a bowl.
Option: Add caloric sweetener
Add coconut flour if the dough is too soft, or add a teaspoon of water if the dough is too thick.
Roll the dough, between the palms of your hands to shape round balls and refrigerate for 15 minutes to help set.
Roll the protein balls in a mixture of ground flaxseeds.

name: Vanilla Peach Dream
steps: Blend all the ingredients.
Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Tropical Turmeric Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!
Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!

name: Peach - Arugula Smoothie
steps: Blend all the ingredients with ice and enjoy!
Option: add zero-calorie maple syrup or non-caloric sweetener.

name: Avocado - Cacao Bowl
steps: Slice the banana and avocado. Freeze overnigth.
Set aside the blueberries. Blend the remaining ingredients and serve in a bowl.
Add the blueberries on top as a topping. Enjoy!

name: Sirloin Steak, Creamy Spinach and Potatoes (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Season the sirloin steak with salt and pepper. Cook the steak for a few minutes on each side, then set it aside and cut it into strips.
Pierce the potato with a fork several times. Microwave the potato for 5 minutes or until tender. Cut the potato lengthwise and slightly open it. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Chop the spinach. Place it in a nonstick pan or the same pan used for the steak, and cook with the cream and salt to taste. Stir for 1 - 2 minutes until the spinach is creamy and heated.
Assemble the plate with the steak, creamy spinach and potato. Enjoy!

name: Sirloin Steak, Creamy Spinach and Potatoes (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Beef top sirloin steak lean and fat trimmed to 1/8" raw

steps: Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Season the sirloin steak with salt and pepper. Cook the steak for a few minutes on each side, then set it aside and cut it into strips.
Pierce the potato with a fork several times. Microwave the potato for 5 minutes or until tender. Cut the potato lengthwise and slightly open it. Add the butter, salt and pepper to taste.
Chop the spinach. Place it in a nonstick pan or the same pan used for the steak, and cook for 1- cream and salt to taste. Stir for 1 - 2 minutes until the spinach is creamy and heated.
Assemble the plate with the steak, creamy spinach and potato. Enjoy!

name: Ginger Smoothie (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Dairy free coco whip! coconut whipped topping by so delicious

steps: In a high-speed blender add: oats, protein, almond milk, chia, almonds, pumpkin spice, ginger powder, or ginger zest and blend until smooth.
Pour into a container and set in the fridge overnight to set.
Top with whipped topping and sprinkle with more pumpkin spice or zero-calorie sweetener.

name: Ginger Smoothie (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Dairy free coco whip! coconut whipped topping by so delicious
Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: In a high-speed blender add: oats, protein, almond milk, date, pumpkin spice, ginger powder, or ginger zest and blend until smooth.
Pour into a container and set in the fridge overnight to set.
Mix whipped topping and sprinkle with more pumpkin spice or zero-calorie sweetener.

name: Shrimp Broccoli Bowl (Low Fat)
steps: Mince the garlic and chop the broccoli.
Mix the shrimp, bell pepper slices, oil, garlic, and salt in a bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Heat a pan over medium heat, and cook.
Once the bell pepper slices are soft, add the remaining ingredients. Mix well and transfer to a serving plate.

name: Quinoa Bowl (Balanced)
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes and dice the cooked chicken breast and the mozzarella.
Place all the ingredients in a bowl, add salt and pepper to taste and combine.
Add an extra flavor by squeezing in lime juice.

name: Egg Sandwich with Alfalfa
steps: Make your recipe gluten-free by using gluten-free bread.
Cut the bell pepper into strips. Next, whisk the egg whites in a bowl, add salt and pepper to taste, then spray a hot non-stick skillet with spray oil and pour in the eggs. Cook over medium heat.
Dip one side of the bread in the egg, then flip over in the skillet.
Once the egg whites are ready, flip both slices of bread over at the same time (so the egg whites are now on top).

Fold the overlapping edges of the egg onto the bread, place a slice of cheese on each piece of bread. Add the alfalfa sprouts and bell pepper on top, add avocado, then flip one slice of bread onto the other to finish off your sandwich.
Slice the sandwich in half and serve.

name: Veggie Panini (Balanced)
steps: Slice the eggplant and cook on a nonstick pan; once it's ready, cook the spinach.
Spread the pesto on the bread, and prepare the panini by placing the cooked spinach, mozzarella slices, and eggplant.

name: Pear Omelette

ingredients.name: Organic ghee clarified butter by purity farms

steps: Whisk the egg whites with cinnamon to make the omelet fluffier.
Heat a pan, stir the ghee in the pear slices, blueberries, and egg whites, garnish with almonds, and let it cook.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with more cinnamon. Enjoy!

name: Cottage Cheese Carrot Bowl (High Protein)
steps: Mix the cottage cheese with grated carrot and cinnamon.
Halve the raisins and melt the peanut butter.
Drizzle the peanut butter on top and garnish with raisins.

name: Zucchini Oats (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: To finely grate the zucchini, use a microplane grater. Also, finely grate or chop the chocolate into small pieces and set them aside
Add the oats, water, and almond milk to a large pot and bring to a simmer.
Add half the shredded zucchini and cook on medium heat until the oats thicken.
Mix in the rest of the zucchini, whey protein, and sweetener and continue to cook until the oats have fully cooked. Remove from heat and mix in half of the chocolate.
Transfer the oats to a bowl, garnish the remaining chocolate, and enjoy.

name: Creamy Tuna Rice Cake Toast  (Low Fat)
steps: Drain the tuna.

steps: In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs with turmeric until smooth. Add almond milk, one tsp of honey  (or a non-caloric sweetener), and flour. Mix well until eliminated the flour clumps.

Pour the mixture into the pan and cover it with the lid.

name: Shrimp Roll in a Bowl (Low Carb)
steps: Chop the cabbage and scallions, mince the garlic and ginger, grate the carrots, and slice the seaweed into thin strips.
Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat and add one tablespoon of the oil. Sprinkle the shrimp all over with sea salt, black pepper, and a dash of cayenne pepper if desired.
Once the skillet is smoking hot, add the shrimp in a single layer. Cook, turning once or twice, for about 2 minutes or until opaque, then remove to a plate.
Lower heat to medium and add the second tablespoon of oil. Add the veggies, cook, and stir for about a minute until softened, then add the scallions, ginger, and garlic.
Cook another minute, then add the coconut aminos to the skillet and stir. Lower the heat and add the shrimp, stirring to combine well. Remove from heat and garnish with more scallions.
Remove from heat, serve in a bow, squeeze half lime on top, and garnish with more scallions.

name: Mexican Meatball Soup (Low Fat)
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced jalapeno, celery, carrot, and onion. Cook for 3 minutes. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and stir.

Meanwhile, make meatballs. Combine in a large bowl, 2 cloves minced garlic, beef, remaining oregano and cumin, season with salt and pepper.
Form into small meatballs and add to boiling soup along with diced potatoes and chopped kale.
Simmer for 15- 20 minutes, or until meatballs are cooked, and potatoes tender. Season with salt and serve.

Add chopped onion to the remaining oil, cooking for 3 minutes, until tender. Then add crushed garlic, stir and cook another minute.
Add chicken back to the pot, along with crushed tomato, tomato paste, halved and sliced potatoes, and oregano.
Simmer over medium heat for 15 minutes, then add the olives. Continue cooking for 5 more minutes until potatoes are tender. Season with salt and pepper.

Peel and dice the carrot, mince the onion, and finely chop the cauliflower. 
Or opt for a pre-made bag of cauliflower rice. Make sure to use the same portion.
Heat a large pan and place 1/2 tsp of olive oil. Next, add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until golden.
Add the cauliflower rice, carrot, peas, sesame oil, turmeric, salt, and pepper to taste.
Stir to combine and cook with the lid on top until heated through.
Next, move them to one side of the pan and add the remaining oil and the egg whites. Let them cook and stir well.

ingredients.name: Tofu extra firm made with nigari
Liquid aminos natural soy sauce alternative by bragg

steps: Start by cooking the white rice. Meanwhile, chop the red cabbage, chop the carrot, continue with the green onion, and grate the ginger.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the oil. Once the oil is hot, use your fingers to crumble the tofu into the pan and allow it to cook undisturbed for 3 minutes. Flip, and cook for another 3 minutes. Add the turmeric powder and stir to coat. Transfer the tofu to a bowl and set aside.
In a non-stick pan, add the green onion and carrot, and defrost the edamame. Cook for 4 minutes or until the vegetables have softened and the edamame is warmed.
Add in the cooked rice, rice vinegar, grated ginger, liquid aminos, red cabbage, and scrambled tofu. Stir well to combine and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until the entire dish is warmed through. Taste and add salt or pepper as needed.
Garnish with green onion and serve.

Meanwhile, add the tofu to a blender with tahini,  1/2 cup of water, and nutritional yeast. Whizz to a smooth paste, then season to taste with salt and pepper.

In a pot, heat olive oil. Then add paneer, cut into cubes, along with spices. Fry until fragrant and lightly brown - about 5 minutes.
Thaw spinach in the microwave or under warm water. Then, blend in the blender or food processor until smooth.
Remove the paneer from the pan, adding diced onion, grated ginger, crushed garlic and chopped chillies. Saute for 3 - 5 minutes or until soft.
Add the spinach to the onion mixture. Add a little salt and 1 cup of water, stir, and cook for about 5 minutes with the lid off.
Turn the heat off. Add the yogurt a little at a time. Once the yogurt is well mixed with the spinach, add the paneer.
Turn the heat back on, cover and cook until everything is warmed through, about 5 minutes. Season with salt to taste.  Serve with Naan

ingredients.name: Dairy free coco whip! coconut whipped topping by so delicious

steps: In a blender add: oats, protein, almond milk, dates, pumpkin spice, ginger powder, or ginger zest and blend until smooth.
Pour into a container and set in the fridge overnight to set
Top with whipped topping and sprinkle with more pumpkin spice or zero-calorie sweetener.

name: Avocado Deep and Bell Peppers
steps: Mix the avocado with Greek yogurt and nutritional yeast.
Serve with bell pepper slices as a a side.

name: Pumpkin Pie Chia Pudding (Low Fat)
steps: Place all the ingredients in a jar or container and mix. Place the cranberries on top, place the lid, and close.
Option: use your favorite brand of plant-based milk and plant-based protein.

name: French Toast Casserole (Balanced)
steps: Choose rice, almond, corn, or tapioca bread for a gluten-free option.
Slice your bread into cubes, then transfer it to an oven-safe dish. Chop the tofu into small cubes (to measure the portion).

For the custard, add the following ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth: 
Silke tofu, plant-based protein, coconut milk, nutmeg, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cornstarch.
Coat your bread thoroughly with the custard mixture. Mix well to ensure everything it's covered.

Air fry at 400f for 6 minutes or until golden.
Bake option: 400f for 15 minutes

Drizzle the maple syrup and sprinkle more cinnamon on top. 
Option: change maple syrup to a zero-calorie sweetener.

name: Pumpkin Pie Chia Pudding (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Protein vanilla plant-based yogurt by kite hill

name: Sheet Pan Veggie Omelette Sandwich (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Preheat oven to 425° F. and place a rimmed sheet pan in the oven while it's preheating.

Use non-stick spray to coat a medium sized skillet over medium-high heat. Add in the spinach, halved cherry tomatoes, and season with salt and pepper. Sauté 2-3 minutes or until the spinach is wilted. Remove from the heat.
In a medium sized bowl whisk together the eggs, milk and some salt and pepper until combined.

Remove the hot sheet pan from the oven and spray with cooking spray. Pour the egg mixture into the sheet pan, then evenly disperse the spinach-tomato mixture on top. Top with grated cheese and bake for 10-12 minutes or until the frittata is set.
Portion once cooled, and serve in a warm bread roll (optional)

name: Pumpkin Mug Cake (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Protein vanilla plant-based yogurt by kite hill
Protein plant based protein vanilla cream by tru
Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps:
*Option:
Use your favorite brand of:
 Plant-based protein powder 
 Plant-based milk sugar-free
 Zero Calorie Sweetener

For the topping, combine the 1/2 protein scoop with the yogurt, and one sweetener packet, and stir gently until the mixture is uniform and set aside. Also, set aside 1 tbsp. of chopped walnuts for garnishing. Place the oats in a blender and blend until you get a flour-like consistency. (Substitute with oat flour if needed).

Transfer oat flour to a bowl. Add the last 1/4 of the protein scoop, 2 tbsp. of chopped walnuts and the rest of the ingredients (except for the topping), and mix to combine. Next, spray the vegetable oil inside the mug, add the mixture, and microwave for up to 2 minutes (check after 1 minute).
Once the mug cake it's ready, add the protein topping and the rest of the walnuts.

name: Anti - Craving Oatmeal (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Heat a pot over medium heat. Add the almond milk and oats and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Next, add the egg whites and mix until well combined.

Continue cooking, then add the protein powder and stir well until thickened.
 (If you are using an unflavored protein, add vanilla and sweetener for flavor)
Serve the oatmeal in a bowl, garnish with chopped almonds, sprinkle the pumpkin spice, and drizzle with honey.
To have a liquid consistency add water in Step One, before the almond milk.

name: Chia Pudding (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey protein powder low carb

steps: Whisk together protein powder, cashew milk, and chia seeds in a medium-sized bowl.
Transfer the chia mixture to the refrigerator, cover it, and allow it to sit for 30 minutes or overnight. The chia mixture should thicken into a pudding.
Add berries on the bottom of a cup or glass, reserving some for topping. Add pudding mixture and top with remaining berries
Serve immediately or store in the fridge for up to 4 days

name: Whey Protein Cauliflower Oatmeal (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Pre-heat a pan on medium heat.
Add riced cauliflower, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and chia seeds, and stir to combine.
Place in the whey protein and almond milk, and stir gently until getting a nice mixture.
Stir often and cook until cauliflower rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
For smoother oatmeal, stir in 1/4 cup of water.  Add more water if needed, to reach the desired consistency.
Serve in a bowl and garnish with almond butter and blueberries on top.

name: Carrot Smoothie (Low Carb)
steps: Blend all the ingredients, add cinnamon to pumpkin spice to taste and enjoy!

name: Wild Rice Soup - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Prepare the ingredients: chop the carrots, celery, and onion, mince the garlic, and slice the mushrooms.
Add the carrots, celery, onion, garlic, wild rice, fresh mushrooms, chicken broth, cauliflower, and spice poultry seasoning to the IP.
Cook for 5 minutes manually with high pressure. After cooking, release the pressure and allow the steam to empty before opening.
Preheat a saucepan and melt the butter, whisk in the almond milk, mix to combine, and add the protein powder. Add a little salt and cook until you have a good measure.
Add the cream sauce to the soup in the Instant Pot and mix.

name: Mint Chocolate Smoothie (High Protein)
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Optional: add a packet of sweetener if you'd like it sweeter.

name: Mint Chocolate Smoothie (Low Carb)
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Optional: add a packet of sweetener if you'd like it sweeter.

name: Mint Chocolate Smoothie (Low Fat)
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Optional: add a packet of sweetener if you'd like it sweeter.

name: Stuffed Zucchini (High Protein)
steps: Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and red pepper, and cook until soft. Next, add the egg whites, salt, and pepper to taste. Cook and complete by adding the cooked quinoa, mix well, and set aside.
Cut the zucchini into 2 or 3 pieces, carefully remove some of the flesh from the center. Make sure not to pierce it completely.
Boil water and immerse the zucchini for 30 seconds to 1 minute and set aside.
Fill every piece of zucchini with scrambled eggs, and add the cheese to every zucchini.
Bake it at 350 F until the cheese is completely melted.
Transfer into a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers (High Protein)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Cut each pepper in half and get rid of the seeds and ribs. Place into a baking dish.

Finely chop the broccoli and mince the garlic. In a pan, heat the oil and add the garlic. Cook until golden. Add the broccoli, sprinkle salt and pepper to taste, cook until blended, and complete by adding the cooked quinoa. Mix well.
Use half of the cheese to fill the peppers and continue placing the broccoli stew. Bake for 15 minutes, and place the remaining cheese on top. Bake it for 2 minutes more to melt the cheese.
Serve and garnish with one tsp of sour cream on top.

name: Scrambled Pancakes (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Protein vanilla plant-based yogurt by kite hill

steps:
*Option:
Use your favorite brand of:
 Plant-based protein powder 
 Plant-based milk sugar-free
 Raw Honey/for low calories change for zero-calorie sweetener.
Blend the oats and transfer them into a small bowl. Add the chia seeds and baking powder and mix
Stir in the almond milk. (Optional: Add cinnamon and/or vanilla to make it tasty)
Add vegan butter to a hot pan, and add the batter. Scramble the pancake until it’s done, for about 2-3 min on medium heat.
Transfer into a bowl, add the yogurt on the side and the raspberries. Drizzle the honey on top.

name: Coffee Tofu Smoothie (Low Fat)
steps: Place the coffee, protein, and soy milk in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Next, add the banana, vanilla, Splenda, and ice cubes. Blend until smooth.
Garnish with vegan chocolate chips.

name: Scramble Sweet Potato Pancakes (High Protein)
steps: Blend all the ingredients except for the peanut butter.
Spray vegetable oil into a hot skillet, place the pancake mix, and cook.
Crumble the pancake with the spatula and mix until it’s done, for about 2-3 min on medium heat.
Transfer the scramble pancake into a bowl, and place the peanut butter on top.
Garnish with extra pumpkin spice on top.

name: Snicker Smoothie (Balanced)
steps: In a blender, place the tofu cubes and soy milk and blend.
Add the banana, protein, peanut butter, cacao powder, and pitted dates. Blend it again.
Option: blend it with a cup of ice and Splenda for a frosty and sweeter consistency.

name: Smoothie Bowl (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Hemp hearts raw shelled hemp seeds by manitoba harvest

steps: Blend together protein powder, berries, and soy milk (adding more soy milk as necessary to desired texture).
Transfer to a bowl, and top with chia seeds, coconut, hemp hearts, and sliced strawberry.

name: Ground Beef and Vegetable Skillet (Balanced)
steps: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.

Add the ground beef and garlic. Use a wooden spoon to break up the ground beef while it cooks. Stir occasionally, and cook for about 7 minutes until no longer pink. Remove the meat from the skillet, and set aside.

Add the chopped onions and chopped red bell peppers to the same skillet. Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the onions are soft.

Add the chopped zucchini and asparagus, and cook for 3-5 minutes.
Return the ground beef to the skillet, and mix everything together.
Add the dijon, tomato sauce, oregano, crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper to taste. Cook for 1-2 minutes more. Stir in prepared instant rice, combine, heat, and serve.

name: Zucchini Soup - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Peel and cut the potato, dice all the vegetables, and mince the garlic. Cut the chicken into small cubes. Press the saute function on the Instant Pot, then place the oil, garlic, and onion. Stir for 1-2 minutes or until the onion is translucent. Next, cancel the saute function.
Continue adding the zucchini, potato, and water. Pop the lid and lock. Press pressure cook and set to 2 minutes on high pressure.
After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid, then stir the spinach and mix well. Serve in a blender and wait a few minutes to cool off before blending it.
Continue by placing the chicken inside the IP, add chicken broth, and set it to 2 minutes on high pressure. Pop the lid on top and close it.
Once the chicken it's ready, release the pressure before opening the lid. Next, blend the vegetables and place them with the chicken, mixing it all.
Serve in a bowl, and add the crumbled bacon and pumpkin seeds on top.

ingredients.name: Yam boiled or baked without salt
Red enchilada sauce by best choice

steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add cubed chicken breast, stirring and cooking for 3 minutes. Then add chopped onion, cooking until chicken is done and onions are soft.
Season with spices, salt, and pepper.
Add in cooked yam cubes (boil separately, or pierce with a fork and microwave until soft), halved cherry tomatoes, black beans, and chopped chilies, stirring to combine.
Add the sauce, and heat through, about 3 more minutes, then serve topped with chopped cilantro.

Roll the wraps tightly

name: Egg Plant Chicken Sandwich (Low Fat)
steps: Slice the aubergine and bell pepper. Next, cook them in a non-stick pan from both sides. Once the vegetables are ready, set aside.
Dice the chicken breast and microwave for one minute.
Toast the bread slices and spread them with pesto and feta cheese. Prepare the sandwich by adding aubergine, bell pepper, and chicken breast.

name: Egg Plant Chicken Sandwich (Low Carb)

name: Happy Bowl - Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Dijon mustard vinaigrette by terrapin ridge farms

steps: Peel and chop the sweet potato into bite-sized cubes. Chop the onion and red pepper into small cubes.

Place the steamer rack inside the Instant Pot. Add 1 cup of water, and carefully place the eggs. Put the lid on and select 'pressure cook.' Set the temperature to 'high' for 5 minutes. After cooking, make sure to release the pressure before opening the lid.
Transfer the eggs to an ice bath. Peel the eggs and cut them in half.
Carefully remove the steamer rack and place the sweet potato, broccoli, onion, red pepper, and oil. Salt and pepper to taste.
Select the pressure cook button and manually set it to 3 minutes. After cooking, release the pressure before opening it and press cancel when it's done.
Place the spinach into a bowl, and serve the sweet potato and vegetables on top.
To finish, add the halved boiled eggs, pour over the dressing, and place the cheese.

name: Spiced Shrimp Pasta Salad (Low Fat)
steps:
To make pasta salad, combine kale, pasta, yogurt, lemon juice, honey, feta, cherry tomatoes, and olive oil in a large bowl.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss shrimp in spices and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the salad mixture into four servings, and top each with shrimp to serve.

name: Mushroom Chicken Cream - Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Prepare all the ingredients, dice the chicken breast into 1-inch pieces, slice the mushrooms, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley and red onion.
Add the olive oil, chicken, mushrooms, garlic, red onion, thyme dried, salt and pepper, chicken broth, and rice to the Instant Pot in that order.
Cook on high pressure for 3 minutes, allowing a few minutes of natural pressure release before opening.
Next, stir in the sour cream and parsley, and let sit a couple of minutes to thicken, and adjust salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in a bowl and sprinkle with chili flakes and parsley.

name: Mushroom Chicken Cream - Instant Pot (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Prepare all the ingredients: dice the chicken breast into 1-inch pieces, slice the mushrooms, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley and red onion.

Add the olive oil, chicken, mushrooms, garlic, red onion, thyme dried, salt and pepper, chicken broth, and cauliflower rice to the Instant Pot in that order. Cook on high pressure for 3 minutes, then allow a natural pressure release. Allow a couple of minutes of natural pressure release before open.
Next, stir in the sour cream and parsley, and let sit a couple of minutes to thicken, and adjust salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in a bowl and sprinkle with chili flakes and parsley.

name: No Egg Scrambled (Low Carb)
steps: Whisk the portion of just-egg in a bowl and season one tablespoon of nutritional yeast and pepper. Mix
Peel and chop the potato into medium cubes, transfer it to a plate, and microwave for 3 minutes, until soft.
Spray the vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat, and add broccoli and salt. Cover with a lid, and steam-cook for a few minutes.
Next, add in the potatoes, and the remaining nutritional yeast, and mix.
Make room in the frying pan, add cooking spray oil, pour the just-egg and cook until just cooked.
Serve and sprinkle the sesame seeds on top.

name: No Egg Scrambled (Balanced)
steps: Whisk the portion of just-egg in a bowl and season one tablespoon of nutritional yeast and pepper. Mix to combine. Peel and chop the potato into medium cubes, transfer it to a plate, and microwave for 3 minutes, until soft.
Spray the vegetable oil in a frying pan, add broccoli and salt, cover with a lid, and cook for a few minutes. Next, place in the potatoes, and the remaining nutritional yeast, and mix well.
Make space in the frying pan, add extra cooking spray oil, serve" just-egg", and cook until just cooked.
Serve and sprinkle the sesame seeds on top.

name: Reuben Sandwich (Low Carb)
steps: Start by spreading butter on 1 side of each piece of bread.
Top bread with corned beef, sauerkraut, mayonnaise, and swiss cheese, then the next piece of bread.
Put into a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, about 5 minutes per side until sandwich is heated through, toasted, and cheese has melted.
Serve with dill pickles. Optional: Make this an open faced sandwich with a single piece of bread.

name: Reuben Sandwich (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Swiss cheese nonfat or fat free

steps: Start by spreading butter on one side of each piece of bread.
Top bread with corned beef, sauerkraut, mayonnaise, and swiss cheese, then the next piece of bread.
Put into a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, about 5 minutes per side until sandwich is heated through, toasted, and cheese has melted.
Serve with dill pickles. Optional: Make this an open faced sandwich with a single piece of bread.

name: Cajun Shrimp Cauliflower Rice - Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Baked products crackers gluten-free multigrain and vegetable made with corn starch white rice flour

steps: Prepare all the ingredients, press the saute option, add the oil, garlic, and onions, and stir for 30 sec.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes. Next, add the white rice, cauliflower, tomato paste, cajun or red pepper seasoning, salt, water, and chopped kale. Combine all the ingredients.
Place the lid, and cook on manual high pressure for 3 minutes.
Once it's ready, allow the pressure to release naturally, and turn the steam release valve to the venting position to remove any remaining pressure.
Serve everything in a bowl.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup - Instant Pot (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, chop carrots into small cubes and prepare the other ingredients.
Press the saute function, add the oil, and once it is heated, add in onions and garlic. Saute until the onions are soft.
Next, add the tomatoes, carrots, chicken broth, water, chicken breast, cumin and chilli powder. Pressure cook on high for 5 minutes. Once it's done, release the pressure for 5 minutes
Remove chicken and shred using 2 forks and return to the Instant Pot. Add the corn, lemon juice, chilli powder and stir well,  add salt and pepper to taste
Garnish with cheese, cream, avocado slices and coriander leaves.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup - Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Baked products crackers gluten-free multigrain and vegetable made with corn starch white rice flour
Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, chop carrots into small cubes and prepare the other ingredients.
Press the saute function, add the oil, and once it is heated, add the onions and garlic. Saute until the onions are soft.
Next, add the tomatoes, carrots, chicken broth, water, chicken breast, cumin and chilli powder. Pressure cook on high for 5 minutes. Once it's done, release the pressure for 5 minutes
Remove chicken and shred using two forks, and return to the Instant Pot. Add the corn, lemon juice, chilli powder and  add just half of the tortilla chips, stir well and add salt and pepper to taste
Garnish with cheese, the half of tortilla chips and coriander leaves.

name: Salmon Patties (High Protein)
steps:
Cook the salmon until it soft enough to shred
 with a fork.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place all the ingredients, except coconut oil, in a large mixing bowl and mix well.
Divide the mixture into four to six equal portions and shape each into a patty.

Bake the patties for 15 minutes at 350 F. Meanwhile, peel and chop the beetroot and mango, then boil the beetroot cubes until they are fork-tender. Serve on a large plate and mix the beetroot with mango chunks.
Heat coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat, transfer the salmon patties to the skillet, and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Serve the patties with the beetroot salad, squeeze lime on top of the patties and beetroot, and enjoy!

name: Sheet Pan Tofu Bowl (Low Carb)
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F and line a baking tray with parchment paper, set aside.
Open the tofu and drain the water. Using your hands, tear the tofu into similar size chunks and add to a mixing bowl.
Peel and chop the carrots and red onion into 1/2-inch pieces, chop the cabbage and add to a mixing bowl.
Add the olive oil, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper into the mixing bowl and toss everything to combine.
Spread evenly across the baking tray and bake for 20 minutes or until browned and crispy.
Plate into two bowls and drizzle each with tahini and sambal sauce.

name: Sheet Pan Tofu Bowl (Balanced)
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 F and line a baking tray with parchment paper, set aside.
Open the tofu and drain the water. Using your hands, tear the tofu into similar size chunks and add to a mixing bowl.
Peel and chop the carrots and red onion into 1/2-inch pieces, chop the cabbage and add to the mixing bowl.
Add the green peas, olive oil, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper into the mixing bowl and toss everything to combine.
Spread evenly across the baking tray and bake for 20 minutes or until browned and crispy.
Plate into two bowls and drizzle each with 2 tahini teaspoons and 2 teaspoons of sambal sauce or chilli sauce.

name: Sardines with Crispbreads (Balanced)
steps: Spread crackers with cream cheese.
Top with sardines, lettuce, and thinly sliced red onion.
Squeeze lemon over top (optional) and serve.

name: Tofu Pesto Toast (High Protein)
steps: Blend the tofu with pesto, nutritional yeast, and salt.
Toast the bread, place the arugula on each piece, and spread the pesto tofu on each slice of bread.
Use rice bread, chickpea bread for a Gluten Free Version

name: Cottage Bowl with Beetroot (High Protein)
steps: Peel and chop the beetroot and carrot into small chunks.
Boil the beetroot chunks until they are fork-tender.
Place the cottage cheese, minced garlic, lemon juice, and two tsp of rosemary in a blender. Blend until smooth. Salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the cottage cheese in a bowl, add the roasted beetroot and carrot in the middle, and top with the pistachios and olive oil.
Garnish with the remaining rosemary.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Original red hot sauce by frank's
Tortillas whole wheat flour low carb

steps: Slice chicken breast into long, thin strips
Whisk together hot sauce, paprika, garlic powder, and salt in a small bowl. Add chicken strips.
Add the chicken strips to a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat (with optional olive oil). Cook until no longer pink, about 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place tortillas on a plate and spread with a thin layer of blue cheese or ranch dressing. Layer with lettuce, carrots, and cheese.
Arrange a few chicken strips down the center of each tortilla. Wrap tightly, like a burrito, and serve.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Original red hot sauce by frank's
Salad dressing blue or roquefort cheese reduced calorie

steps: Slice chicken breast into long, thin strips
Whisk together hot sauce, paprika, garlic powder, and salt in a small bowl. Add chicken strips.
In a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat (with optional olive oil), add the chicken strips. Cook until no longer pink, about 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place tortillas on a plate and spread with a thin layer of blue cheese or ranch dressing. Layer with lettuce, carrots, and cheese.
Arrange a few chicken strips down the center of each tortilla. Wrap tightly, like a burrito, and serve.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps (High Protein )

ingredients.name: Original red hot sauce by frank's
Salad dressing blue or roquefort cheese reduced calorie

steps: Slice chicken breast into long, thin strips
In a small bowl, whisk together hot sauce, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Add chicken strips.
In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat (with optional olive oil), add the chicken strips. Cook until no longer pink, about 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place tortillas on a plate and spread with a thin layer of blue cheese or ranch dressing. Layer with lettuce, carrots, and cheese.
Arrange a few chicken strips down the center of each tortilla. Wrap tightly, like a burrito, and serve.

name: Turkey "Sausage" Pasta with Fennel (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps:
Quickly blanch broccoli florets in boiling salted water for 2 minutes. Remove. 
Add pasta to boiling water.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with olive oil, add turkey, cook and crumble it until brown, about 6 minutes.
Add spices to turkey, then add thinly sliced onion, thinly sliced fennel, and crushed garlic. Stir to combine and cook until tender.
Add in cherry tomato, cooked pasta, cooked broccoli, and salt and pepper. Stir to combine and season with salt and pepper. Optionally, top with shredded parmigiano.

name: Turkey "Sausage" Pasta with Fennel (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps:
Quickly blanch broccoli florets in boiling salted water for 2 minutes. Remove. 
Add pasta to boiling water.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with olive oil, add turkey, cook and crumble it until brown, about 6 minutes.
Add spices to turkey, then add thinly sliced onion, thinly sliced fennel, and crushed garlic. Stir to combine and cook until tender.
Add in cherry tomato, cooked pasta, cooked broccoli, and salt and pepper. Stir to combine and season with salt and pepper. Optionally, top with shredded parmigiano.

steps:

name: Pesto Chicken Quesadilla (Balanced)
steps: Slice the tomato.
Start by slicing the tortilla. You'll be cutting it once, in a straight line from the center to one side. You'll be folding the tortilla into quadrants, and this helps it fold more easily.

Spread the pesto in one quadrant and add half of the spinach. Place the cheese and tomato slices in the other quadrant, and in the last one, place the rest of the spinach and the chicken strips on top of it.
Fold the tortilla over on itself, quadrant by quadrant.
Optional: toast in a skillet or panini press. Serve with carrots as a side.

name: Shredded Wheat Cereal with Soy Milk and Flax (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Shredded wheat biscuits by uncle tobys

steps: Add shredded wheat to a bowl, top with soy milk, flax seeds, and fruit.

name: Silken Tofu Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 30 second intervals, stirring each time, until the chocolate is melted. Set aside.
Meanwhile, place the silken tofu and maple syrup in a food processor and blend until very smooth. Add the melted chocolate and blend until well combined.
Scoop the mixture into ramekins or glasses, and refrigerate for about 30 minutes, or until chilled.
To serve, garnish with chocolate shavings, raspberries, blackberries, or cocoa.

name: Smoked Turkey and Swiss Crepes (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Deli & lunch meat special select smoked turkey breast by Farmland foods

steps: To make the crepes, in a blender (or a bowl) combine the milk, egg, flour, oil and a pinch of salt and blend until smooth, about 1 minute.

In a nonstick pan over medium heat, use nonstick spray to coat the pan evenly. Lift the pan at a slight angle and pour 4 Tbs. of the batter into the center, tilting the pan to spread the batter to the edges. Return the pan to the heat and cook until the crepe is golden underneath, 1 to 2 minutes. Using a spatula, flip the crepe over and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover. Repeat with the remaining batter to make all crepes.

To assemble, lay a crepe flat. Arrange 2 slice of turkey on the crepe and top with 2 slice of the cheese and a handful of spring mix / arugula. Season with salt and pepper. Fold the crepe into quarters. Repeat with the remaining crepes and filling.
Set the pan over medium heat. Place the crepes in the pan and cook, turning once, until the cheese begins to melt, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Serve immediately.

name: Cafe Mocha Protein Shake (Low Fat)
steps: Blend together ice, coffee, milk, and protein powder.
Pour into a glass, and grate dark chocolate on top to finish.

name: Pizza Omelette (High Protein)
steps: Mix the egg whites with the egg, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper to taste.
Heat a nonstick pan, spray with vegetable oil, and place the egg mixture. Cook with low heat.
Add the red onion, black olives, and chopped tomato to the pan. Cook until the tomato is soft. Next, add the tomato sauce and mix.
Add the sauce to the omelet and close it like a half-moon.

Serve the toast.
Use rice bread or chickpea bread for a Gluten Free Option

name: Protein Yogurt with Toast (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Vanilla whey protein powder low carb

steps: Stir protein powder into greek yogurt until combined.
Serve with buttered toast.

name: Bell Pepper Egg Bites (Low Carb)
steps: Slice bell peppers across, creating a "ring" about 1 inch thick. Aim to get 5 rings, one for each egg.
Place pepper rings into a non-stick pan over medium heat with melted butter. Cook for 2 minutes, then flip.
Add eggs to the center of each ring, and cook for a further 2-4 minutes, depending on how you like your eggs. Season with salt and pepper, serve with toast.

name: Reuben Sandwich (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Thin sliced organic good seed bread by dave's bread
Light spread by i cant believe it's not butter

steps: Start by spreading butter on 1 side of each piece of bread.
Top bread with corned beef, sauerkraut, and swiss cheese.
Put into a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes per side until the sandwich is heated through, toasted, and the cheese has melted.
Serve with dill pickles. Optional: Make this an open-faced sandwich with a single piece of bread.

name: Reuben Sandwich (Balanced)
steps: Start by spreading butter on 1 side of each piece of bread.
Top bread with corned beef, sauerkraut, and swiss cheese, then the next piece of bread.
Put into a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, about 5 minutes per side until sandwich is heated through, toasted, and cheese has melted.
Serve with dill pickles. Optional: Make this an open faced sandwich with a single piece of bread.

name: Creamy Pasta (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Impastable low carb pasta fettuccini by thin slim foods

steps: Chop the garlic and saute the onion in olive oil until translucent then toast your garlic for 2 minutes
Add the onions and garlic to a blender with the rest of the sauce ingredients: almond milk, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and tofu, and blend until smooth. Taste to add salt and pepper.
Transfer the sauce to a saucepan, add in the mushroom slices, and simmer for 5 minutes while you cook your pasta.
Cook the pasta for 4  to 10 minutes in boiling water, then add it to the sauce, and also add the spinach, then mix to combine.

name: Taco Stuffed Peppers (Low Fat)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Add olive oil to a large skillet over medium heat. Add the ground turkey and taco seasoning, breaking up the meat. Cook until the meat is browned and cooked through.
Slice peppers in half and place on the baking sheet. Mix the browned taco meat, black beans, salsa, frozen corn, half cheese, cheese, and cooked rice in a large bowl.
Divide the mixture among the peppers. Bake for 20 minutes.
Add the remainder of the cheese to the top of the peppers and bake for five more minutes.
To serve, top with a tablespoon of sour cream and diced tomatoes.

name: Bbq Burrito (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Apple cider vinegar by always save
Baby spring mix lettuce prewashed packaged
Tofu extra firm made with nigari
Protein plant powered tortilla by mission

steps: Preheat the oven to 350F. Use the large side of a cheese grater to grate the block of tofu into shreds. Set aside.
Mix the oil, tomato paste, sauce soy, maple syrup, garlic, onion, and chili powder in a large bowl. Add the shredded tofu, and use a spatula to gently toss to evenly coat the tofu in the seasonings.
Line with parchment paper or lightly grease a large baking sheet.
Spread the tofu evenly over the prepared pan. Bake for 10 minutes, stirring the tofu halfway through until it is browned.
Next, microwave the tortillas for 5 to 10 seconds to soften them. Place the lettuce mix, bbq tofu, red pepper, cucumber, and red onion in both tortillas.  Roll the wrap tightly.
Option: use any vegetables available in your fridge.

name: Arugula Salad - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Cut the asparagus on the diagonal into bite-sized pieces, cut the  cherry tomatoes into halves and cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces
Add the pasta to the Instant Pot,  add enough water to nearly cover the pasta, carefully place the steamer rack on it and place the chicken and the asparagus on top
Add the steamer rack on the IP place the chicken on top and add the asparagus, close the lid and cook on high pressure for 3 minutes when it finished release the pressure before open
Close the lid and set the valve to sealing. Cook on high pressure for 0 minutes with a 3-minute natural release.

After cooking, carefully transfer the asparagus and chicken onto a serving plate, remove the steamer rack, and there will be just a little bit of water leftover, drain the pasta and add it to the plate
Next, add the arugula, basil, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste and stir together.

name: Arugula Salad - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Cut the asparagus on the diagonal into bite-sized pieces, cut the  cherry tomatoes into a halves
Add the pasta to the Instant Pot,  add enough water to nearly cover the pasta

Close the lid and set the valve to sealing,
cook on high pressure for 0 minutes with a 3 minute natural release, when it’s finished there will be just a little bit of water leftover, drain the pasta

Transfer the pasta to a serving plate, then add the asparagus to the Instant pot, place the lid on and cook on high pressure for 1 minute, when it's ready, release the pressure for a few minutes before removing the lid.

Place the asparagus with the pasta, add the arugula, basil, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste, stir together and adjust spices or add your favorite ones. Complete by sprinkling  the cheese on top

name: Arugula Salad - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Cut the asparagus on the diagonal into bite-sized pieces, and cut the cherry tomatoes into halves.
Add the pasta to the Instant Pot, and add enough water to nearly cover the pasta.

Close the lid and set the valve to sealing,
cook on high pressure for 0 minutes with a 3-minute natural release, when it’s finished there will be just a little bit of water left over, drain the pasta.

Transfer the pasta to a serving plate, then add the asparagus to the Instant pot, place the lid on and cook on high pressure for 1 minute, when it's ready, release the pressure for a few minutes before removing the lid.

Place the asparagus with the pasta, add the arugula, basil, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste, stir together and adjust spices or add your favorite ones. Complete by sprinkling the cheese on top.

name: Sriracha Pineapple Salad - Instant Pot (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Peppers sweet bell red raw
ingredients.unit: large (2-1/4 per lb, approx 3-3/4" long, 3" dia)

steps:
Cut lengthwise the peppers, slice the pineapple, dice the onion, mince the ginger and garlic, and finally halve the cherry tomatoes. 
Optional shred the lettuce.
Place the steamer rack in the Instant Pot, add the salmon, add the pineapple and pepper on top, don't mix, set to high pressure for 6 minutes, and pop the lid on.
Prepare the dressing in a small bowl. Stir in the sriracha, soy, ginger, garlic, honey, and lemon juice. Whisk together and adjust the sriracha to taste.
After cooking, allow a couples of minutes of natural pressure release before removing  the lid

In a large plate add the lettuce, serve the cherry tomatoes in the center with the red onion, next  transfer the salmon, pineapple and peppers and place them around the cherry tomatoes, add the avocado sliced and  drizzle the dressing all around the plate

name: Sriracha Pineapple Salad - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps:
Cut lengthwise the peppers, slice the pineapple, dice the onion, mince the ginger and garlic, and finally halve the cherry tomatoes. 
Optional shred the lettuce.
Place the steamer rack in the Instant Pot, add the salmon, add the pineapple and pepper on top, don't mix, set to high pressure for 6 minutes, and pop the lid on.
Prepare the dressing in a small bowl. Stir in the sriracha, soy, ginger, garlic, honey, and lemon juice. Whisk together and adjust the sriracha to taste.
After cooking, release the pressure before opening.
On a large plate, add the lettuce, and serve the cherry tomatoes in the center with the red onion. Serve the salmon, pineapple, and peppers, add the avocado slices, and drizzle the dressing.

name: Sriracha Pineapple Salad - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps:

name: Instant Pot Chicken Pho (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Coriander seed ground or whole dried

steps: Heat the Instant Pot in sauté mode. Cook diced onion, garlic, and ginger for 2 minutes. Add in spices and stir for 30 seconds.
Add chicken, broth, water, sugar, and fish sauce to the pot. Mix, seal and cook on high pressure for 15 minutes.
Release pressure after 15 minutes. Remove the chicken, and shred with a fork. Strain the broth to remove spices.
Cook noodles according to package directions, then place in a bowl with broth and cooked chicken.
Top with desired toppings (bean sprouts, hoisin sauce, basil, chiles, lime, peanuts, etc.)

name: Chorizo Tacos (High Protein)
steps: Heat a nonstick pan, add the vegan chorizo, and sprinkle the nutritional yeast.
Microwave the tortillas for 30 seconds
Prepare each taco with chorizo, red cabbage, avocado slices, and chopped coriander.

name: Hummus Chicken Burrito (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Diced grilled chicken breasts by kroger

steps: Microwave the tortilla for 5 to 10 seconds to soften it.
Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Place the cooked brown rice on top.
Place the diced chicken, avocado, and red bell pepper.
Roll the wrap tightly and cut it in half

name: Breakfast Burrito (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Mexican chipotle vegan sausages by field roast

steps: Add diced pepper, diced onion, and chopped sausage to a pan over medium high heat with olive oil.
Cook, stirring often, until vegetables are soft and sausage is heated through. About 10 minutes
Add vegetable mixture to a warm tortilla, top with thinly sliced avocado. Roll burrito and serve.

name: One-Pan Moroccan Chicken (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh meat and skin raw

steps: Toss chicken thighs in cinnamon, coriander, cumin, salt and pepper.
Brown in a medium-high heat pan with 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes per side, or until golden brown
Push chicken to the side of the pan. Add in diced onions, peppers, garlic, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add in chopped spinach, cooking until wilted.
Add hot chicken stock, and stir to combine. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix together tahini, lemon Juice, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of cumin. Add a little cold water if it's too thick for you.
Top chicken and veggie mixture with tahini sauce.

name: One-Pan Moroccan Chicken Couscous (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Couscous or cous cous dry uncooked

steps: Toss chicken thighs in cinnamon, coriander, cumin, salt and pepper.
Brown in a medium-high heat pan with oil for 4 minutes per side or until golden brown
Push chicken to the side of the pan. Add in diced onions, peppers, garlic, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add in chopped spinach, cooking until wilted.
Add hot chicken stock and couscous and stir to combine. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix together Tahini, Lemon Juice, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of cumin. If the mixture is too thick, add a little cold water.
Top couscous and chicken mixture with tahini sauce.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich (High Protein)
steps: Chop the red onion and chives.

Heat water in a pot over medium-high heat. Once the water comes to a boil, place in the eggs and cook for 15 minutes. Remove the eggs from the pot. Place the eggs under water to stop the cooking process, and leave them for a few minutes.
Peel the eggs, leaving just two eggs with yolk, then cut them into small cubes.
Add the mayo, mustard, paprika, red onion, and nutritional yeast into a mixing bowl. Next, incorporate the eggs and chives, and stir well.
Toast the bread. Next, top with the egg salad, and crush the mixture a bit more with a fork. Serve the remaining salad as a side.

name: Veggie Scramble and Toast (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Light spread by i cant believe it's not butter

steps: Sautee chopped spinach and tomatoes in butter. Push to the side of the pan
Scramble eggs, whites, and chopped ham together in the pan.
Stir to combine, season with salt and pepper and serve with toast

name: Tropical Ceviche (Low Fat)
steps: Finely chop the red onion and green bell pepper, continue with the tomato, remove the seeds, and chop into small cubes. Do the same with the mango and avocado.
Chop the tilapia into small cubes. Next, mix the fish with lime juice. Add in salt and pepper.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and fridge for at least 30 minutes or until the fish changes its color. (Allow the fish to cook well with the lime)
Once the fish is white, drain some lime juice. Serve in a bowl and stir in all the veggies, mango, and avocado. Mix well.
Garnish with chopped coriander and enjoy!

name: Tropical Ceviche
steps: Finely chop the red onion and green bell pepper, continue with the tomato, remove the seeds, and chop into small cubes. Do the same with the mango and avocado.
Chop the tilapia into small cubes. Next, mix the fish with lime juice. Add in salt and pepper.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and fridge for at least 30 minutes or until the fish changes its color. (Allow the fish to cook well with the lime)
Once the fish is white, drain some lime juice. Serve in a bowl and stir in all the veggies, mango, and avocado. Mix well.
Garnish with chopped coriander and enjoy!
