Chop the tilapia into small cubes. Next, mix the fish with lime juice. Add in salt and pepper.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and fridge for at least 30 minutes or until the fish changes its color. (Allow the fish to cook well with the lime)
Once the fish is white, drain some lime juice. Serve in a bowl and stir in all the veggies, mango, and avocado. Mix well.
Garnish with chopped coriander and enjoy!

name: Pasta "Bolognese" (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Veggie meal starters grillers crumbles by morning star farms

steps: Begin by boiling pasta of your choice to the desired doneness.
Meanwhile, finely chop vegetables, and add to a pan over medium heat with olive oil. Cooking for about 5 minutes or until tender.
Add veggie crumbles to the pan alongside vegetables, cooking for 5 minutes or until heated.
Add pasta sauce to vegetable mixture and cook until heated through.
Drain cooked pasta and add to sauce. Season with salt and pepper, then serve.

name: Gnocchi and Chicken (Balanced)
steps: Boil water in a pot and add salt. Next, add the gnocchis and let them cook according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat a small pan, place the oil, and add the mushroom slices. Cook until soft, and add the tomato sauce.
Once the gnocchi are ready, remove them with a spoon that allows the water to be removed, place them with the mushrooms, and mix well.
Serve the chicken breast on a plate and add the gnocchis as a side.

name: Gnocchi and Chicken (Low Fat)
steps: Boil water in a pot, and add salt. Next, add the gnocchis and let them cook according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat a small pan, place the oil, and add the mushroom slices. Cook until soft, and add the tomato sauce.
Once the gnocchi are ready, remove them with a spoon that allows the water to be removed, place them with the mushrooms, and mix well.
Serve the chicken breast on a plate and add the gnocchis as a side.

name: Gnocchi and Chicken (High Protein)
steps: Boil water in a pot and add salt. Next, add the gnocchis and let them cook according to the package directions.
Meanwhile, heat a small pan, place the oil, and add the mushroom slices. Cook until soft, and add the tomato sauce.
Once the gnocchi are ready, remove them with a spoon that allows the water to be removed, place them with the mushrooms, and mix well.
Serve the chicken breast on a plate and add the gnocchis as a side.

name: Nordic Wrap (Balanced)
steps: Spray the pan with vegetable cooking spray, and add the egg whites. Swirl the pan to create a round omelet shape similar to the size of your tortilla.
Next, place the green onion all around it and salt and pepper to taste.
Before the omelet is ready (it will look a little liquid), cover it with spinach, place the tortilla on top, and finish the cooking process, then transfer it to a plate.
Top the tortilla with salmon slices, red onion, and cheese. (Option: use reduced-fat feta cheese, same portion)
Wrap carefully, and serve the fruit as a side.

name: Blue Yogurt

ingredients.name: Organic spirulina blue-green algae by organika
Natural granola by bob's red mill

steps: Mix the yogurt with spirulina and add the granola on top.

name: Dirty Banana Pudding (High Protein)
steps: Blend the yogurt with tofu, banana, and coffee. Add one or two packets of non-caloric sweetener.
Transfer into a cup, add the chia seeds, and mix.
Fridge for 15 minutes or overnight.

name: Breakfast Portobello (High Protein)
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Set a wire rack on a rimmed baking sheet and set aside.
Slice the red pepper, and chop the tofu into small pieces.
Gently scoop out the gills that are inside the portobello mushrooms. Spray the mushroom caps with cooking spray.
Bake the mushrooms for 20 - 25 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat a non-stick pan, spray the vegetable oil and add the red pepper slices, tofu, turmeric, salt, and pepper to taste. Cook until the red pepper is tender, and crumble the tofu with a spatula. Add in the cooked quinoa and stir well.
Divide this mix between the portobello mushrooms. Garnish with chopped green onion.

name: Pumpkin Soup - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Peel the pumpkin and cut it into medium cubes. Chop the cauliflower, dice the onion, and mince the garlic and ginger.
Press the Saute function, let it heat up, then add the oil, onion and garlic. Cook until the onions are soft.

Next, add the pumpkin,  cauliflower, almond milk, vegetable broth, turmeric powder, ginger root, salt and pepper to taste. Cancel the saute function and select pressure cook for 6 minutes; once it's done, release the pressure for a few minutes before opening.

Ladle half of the soup into a blender, then add the protein. Add the rest of the soup and blend until smooth 
*Wait a few minutes to cool a little before blending*
Transfer to a bowl and garnish with pumpkin seeds

name: Tofu Scramble with Rice (Low Carb)
steps: Add olive oil to a pan over medium heat.
Cook chopped spinach, onions, and bell peppers until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add in crumbled tofu (you can do this by hand, or with the back of a spatula). Cook until the tofu is hot and most of the water has evaporated.
Stir in the spices, season with salt and pepper, then serve with instant rice.

name: Cashew Chicken Lettuce Wraps (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Season sliced chicken with salt and pepper and add to hot skillet. Cook, flipping once, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add crushed garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
In a small bowl stir together the chicken stock, soy sauce, ginger, hoisin sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch.
Reduce heat to low, add the sauce from the bowl and continue to cook, stirring, until thickened
Add sriracha hot sauce to taste. Stir in roughly chopped cashews and most of the sliced green onion, reserving some for garnish at the end.
Serve in cold lettuce cups. Top with remaining chopped green onions, grated carrot, and tortilla strips.

name: Cashew Chicken Lettuce Wraps (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Season sliced chicken with salt and pepper and add to hot skillet. Cook, flipping once, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add crushed garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
In a small bowl, stir together the chicken stock, soy sauce, grated ginger, hoisin sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch.
Reduce heat to low, add the sauce from the bowl and continue to cook, stirring, until thickened.
Add sriracha hot sauce to taste. Stir in roughly chopped cashews and green onion.
Serve in cold lettuce cups. Top with remaining chopped green onions, grated carrot, and tortilla strips.

name: Cashew Chicken Lettuce Wraps (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Season sliced chicken with salt and pepper and add to hot skillet. Cook, flipping once, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add crushed garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
In a small bowl, stir together the chicken stock, soy sauce, grated ginger, hoisin sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch.
Reduce heat to low, add the sauce from the bowl and continue to cook, stirring, until thickened.
Add Sriracha hot sauce to taste. Stir in roughly chopped cashews and sliced green onion.
Serve in cold lettuce cups. Top with remaining chopped green onions, grated carrot, and tortilla strips.

name: Coconut Cauliflower Oatmeal (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Pre-heat pan over medium heat.
Add in riced cauliflower, oats, vanilla extract, and coconut milk, and stir to combine. Cook until oats and cauliflower are tender and liquid is absorbed.
Transfer oat mix to a bowl and stir in the yogurt, sweetener, and coconut flakes. Once mixed, top with raspberries and serve.

name: Coconut Crusted Fish-Instant Pot (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Dijon mustard vinaigrette by terrapin ridge farms

steps: Cut the potatoes in half and prepare all the ingredients.
Place the broccoli florets and potato halves in the Instant Pot, add 1/3 cup of water, salt, and pepper, and place the steamer rack on top.
In a bowl, crack the egg and mix; in another bowl, add the coconut flakes, garlic powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Toss to combine
Dip the fish into the egg mixture bowl and then into the shredded coconut bowl, ensuring the filets get completely coated.
Next, come back to the IP and lay coated the fish on the steamer rack, squeeze 1/4 of lime on top of it, close the lid, set the pressure cook, and manually set 3 minutes on high pressure
When it is done cooking, use the quick-release method and allow a couple of minutes before opening.
Carefully remove (easier to remove the trivet with the fish) and serve on a plate with the potato and broccoli florets as a side.
Drizzle dijon mustard on top of the fish and lime slices (or lime juice)

name: Coconut Crusted Fish - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Cut the potatoes in half and prepare all the ingredients.
Place the broccoli florets and half the potatoes in the Instant Pot, add 1/3 cup of water, salt and pepper to taste, and place the steamer rack on top.
In a small bowl, place the egg whites and mix. In another bowl, add the coconut flakes, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine.
Dip the fish into the egg mixture bowl and the shredded coconut bowl, ensuring the filets get entirely coated.
Next, come back to the IP and lay coated the fish on the steamer rack, squeeze 1/4 of lime on top of it, close the lid, set the button pressure cook, and manually set 3 minutes on high pressure.
When the cooking time is complete,  release the pressure before opening.
Carefully remove (easier to remove the trivet with the fish) and serve on a plate with the potato and broccoli florets as a side.
Drizzle dijon mustard on top of the fish and lime slices (or lime juice)

name: Flaxseed Oatmeal (Low Carb)
steps: Place a saucepan on medium-high heat. Add the unsweetened almond milk, vanilla extract, and cinnamon, and stir.

Next, add the hemp seed hearts and flax seeds.
 Turn the stove to medium heat and stir well.
Stir in the sweetener. Heat the mixture (uncovered) until the flaxseed thickens. Once it's ready, add the protein and mix well.
Serve in a bowl and top with blueberries, almonds, and coconut flakes.

name: Chocolate Protein Oatmeal (Balanced)
steps: Add hemp hearts, oatmeal, cocoa, and soy milk to a pot, stir to combine, and cook over medium heat until boiling.
Reduce heat to low and cook for about 5 minutes, or until thickened.

Slice the rest of the banana and chop the dark chocolate into small pieces.
Transfer the mix from the blender to a bowl, add the banana slices on top, and garnish with the dark chocolate.

steps: Grate the carrot and set aside 1/3 cup for later.

Add 2/3 of the grated carrots, rolled oats, vanilla, sweetener to taste, and cinnamon in a small saucepan. Add the almond milk and water and stir everything together. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a low simmer.
In a small bowl, mix the egg whites and egg together and add them to the saucepan with the oats. Make sure to mix well, so that the egg becomes fully mixed into the porridge.
Cook and occasionally stir until oats reach your preferred consistency. Add extra water or almond milk to thin the porridge out as it’s cooking if needed.
Serve the porridge in a bowl and garnish with a sprinkle of extra cinnamon, coconut flakes, and the remaining 1/3 of the carrot on top.

Spread pesto with half of the spinach in one quadrant,  place cheese and tomato slices in the other, and in the last one, put the rest of the spinach and the chicken on top of it.
Fold the tortilla over on itself, quadrant by quadrant.

Next, transfer the cooked ingredients to a blender and add some mustard. Blend until everything is smooth (Don't blend too much otherwise it will be watery). Blend and stop after a few seconds, then with a spoon, stir together. Taste and adjust the mustard, and blend it again.
Place the tortilla onto a plate, spread the tuna pate on top, and add the lettuce leaves covering it all. Complete by adding the remaining onions and cucumber sticks. Wrap carefully.
Serve as a side the remaining cucumber with the tomatoes, drizzle sesame oil, add salt and pepper to taste, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Slice peppers in half and place on the baking sheet. Mix the browned taco meat, black beans, salsa, frozen corn, half of the cheese, and the cooked rice in a large bowl.
Divide the mixture among the peppers. Bake for 20 minutes.
Add the remainder of the cheese to the top of the peppers and bake for five more minutes.

steps: Add the vegetable broth, crushed garlic cloves, and salt to a pot, and bring it all to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes (If you cook more than one portion, it will take more time).
Turn it off after simmering and add the textured soy chunks. Let it absorb for about 10 minutes while moving it around so that most of the broth gets absorbed.
Once the soy is ready, drain the excess liquid and discard the garlic cloves.
Meanwhile, chop the cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, avocado, and parsley.
Transfer the soy into a bowl, and add the cucumber, tomato, red onion, and parsley. Next, stir in the liquid aminos, squeeze the limes, add some pepper, and mix.
Taste it to adjust salt and pepper and complete by adding the avocado cubes.

name: Soba Noodle Salad (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Snow peas or sugar snap peas raw

steps: Prepare the vegetables first. Slice the peas in half lengthwise, (or just roughly chop them). Slice the carrots into long, thin strips.
To make the sauce: whisk together the soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, peanut oil, maple syrup, miso, grated ginger, and chile sauce.
Bring two big pots of water to a boil.
Once the pots of water are boiling: In one pot, cook the soba noodles just until al dente, according to package directions ( about 5 minutes), then drain and briefly rinse under cool water.
Cook the frozen edamame in the other pot until warmed through (about 4 minutes) but before draining, toss the halved peas into the boiling edamame water and cook for an additional 20 seconds. Drain.
Combine the soba noodles, edamame, snap peas and carrots in a large serving bowl. Pour in the dressing and toss with salad servers. Toss in the chopped cilantro and sesame seeds. Serve.

name: Soy Chicken with Edamame and Couscous (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Couscous or cous cous dry uncooked

steps: Remove the bone and skin from the chicken.
Heat a deep pan over medium high heat and spray with a non-stick cooking spray. Add in chicken thighs and soy sauce.

Spread out the thighs so that they are in a single layer. Let them cook for 6 minutes, then stir them around and scrape the bottom of the pan before turning them over and cooking for another 6 minutes or until they are cooked through.

Meanwhile, bring to a boil 2 -1/2 cup of water.  Add couscous, then reduce to a simmer and cover, for 5 minutes. If there is any liquid remaining in the pot after 8 minutes, drain it off and then set couscous aside.
Cook edamame according to package directions.
Toss couscous with the juice of a lemon, season with salt and pepper, olive oil and chives (optional)

steps: Preheat oven to 425 F,  trim or snap off the bottoms of the asparagus. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Toss with salt and pepper. Roast for 9 to 12 minutes. Squeeze lime juice over top.
To make the patties, combine the turkey beef, thyme, rosemary, cayenne, salt, and pepper in a large mixing bowl.
Next, form into 1-2 inch rounds, and cook in a pan over medium heat with the lid on until brown. Make sure to flip the patties in the middle of the process.
Peel the sweet potato. Grate 3/4 of it, then microwave the remaining sweet potato in a bowl with a tablespoon of water for 3 to 5 minutes or until soft. Next, mash it with a fork.
Transfer grated and mashed sweet potatoes into a bowl, stir in the almond flour and mix.
In a pan, pour coconut oil and heat over medium until the pan is hot. Next, drop in sweet potato cake, flatten them with a spatula, and cook each side until golden brown.
Serve the asparagus, place the burgers on top, and serve the sweet potato hash browns as a side.

name: Curry Salmon Bowl (High Protein)
steps:
Place salmon on a baking tray, season with salt and pepper, and into an oven preheated to 450F. Set a timer for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, saute garlic, ginger, and lemongrass in a large pot over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add brown sugar and curry paste, cook for 3 minutes more. Add fish sauce/soy sauce, and coconut milk bringing to a simmer. 
Add spinach to sauce, until it's wilted, then season with salt, pepper, and lime juice to taste.
Remove salmon, in another bowl mix the rice with cauliflower rice and place the salmon, topped with curry sauce, and a lime wedge. 
For a lower fat version, use less curry sauce for each serving.

ingredients.name: Deli & lunch meat special select smoked turkey breast by Farmland foods

steps: To make the crepes, in a blender (or a bowl) combine the milk, egg, flour, oil and a pinch of salt and blend until smooth, about 1 minute.

In a nonstick pan over medium heat, use nonstick spray to coat the pan evenly. Lift the pan at a slight angle and pour 4 Tbs. of the batter into the center, tilting the pan to spread the batter to the edges. Return the pan to the heat and cook until the crepe is golden underneath, 1 to 2 minutes. Using a spatula, flip the crepe over and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover. Repeat with the remaining batter to make all crepes.

To assemble, lay a crepe flat. Arrange 2 slice of turkey on the crepe and top with 2 slice of the cheese and a handful of spring mix / arugula. Season with salt and pepper. Fold the crepe into quarters. Repeat with the remaining crepes and filling.
Set the pan over medium heat. Place the crepes in the pan and cook, turning once, until the cheese begins to melt, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Serve immediately.

Microwave the ground chicken or heat it in a pan.

name: Chicken, Instant Rice, and Broccoli (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chicken broilers or fryers breast meat and skin raw
Rice brown instant cooked without salt

steps: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Season chicken breast with salt and pepper before placing, skin side down, in hot oil.
Allow chicken to cook for 5 minutes, or until skin pulls away easily and is golden brown.

Flip chicken breast and cook for 2 more minutes. Add chopped broccoli to the pot, surrounding chicken. Add 1/4 cup of water to the pot, turn heat to high and cook, covered with a lid, for 6 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken from pot and set aside. Add butter to broccoli and stir to coat, seasoning with salt.
Serve chicken with instant rice, and broccoli.

name: Pork Chop with Sweet Potato and Applesauce (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Applesauce canned unsweetened with added ascorbic acid
Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Season pork chop generously with salt and pepper.
Fry pork chop for about 8 minutes total, flipping once halfway through. Cook until internal temperature reaches at least 150F
Meanwhile, wash and deeply pierce sweet potato with a fork. Microwave on high for 6 minutes, or until tender throughout.
Serve seared pork with potato, and top with applesauce.

name: 12-Minute Salmon with Lemon Couscous (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Couscous or cous cous dry uncooked

steps: Preheat oven to 450F. Line a baking tray with aluminum foil and place salmon on tray. Season generously with salt and pepper.
When oven reads 450F, add salmon to the oven and remove in 12 minutes.
Heat oil in a pot with a lid, then add 1 crushed garlic clove and sauté for 30 seconds. Add vegetable broth, lemon juice,  lemon zest, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Add couscous to broth, remove from heat, cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, and add chopped parsley to serve.

name: Cobb Salad (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Low fat feta white cheese by nadec
Dressing low fat ranch by Compliments
Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt

steps: Assemble salad by placing chopped lettuce in a bowl, and topping with crumbled feta, chopped egg, halved cherry tomato, and chickpeas.
Drizzle with dressing and serve.

name: Teriyaki Tempeh and Broccoli (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Rice brown instant cooked without salt
Sesame seed kernels (shelled) toasted without salt

steps: Begin by chopping broccoli into bite-sized florets, chopping garlic, and slicing tempeh into thin strips.
In a pan over medium heat, brown the tempeh in olive oil on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Once browned, add broccoli, nutritional yeast, 3 tbsp of water, and teriyaki sauce to the pan, stirring to coat, and simmering for 10 minutes, until sauce is thickened and broccoli is cooked.
Serve over instant rice, and top with sesame seeds.

name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Brussels Sprout Bake (Low Carb)
steps: Preheat oven to 425F, line 2 baking trays with aluminum foil.
Toss sweet potato cubes in 2 tsp olive oil, and spread on a baking tray in a single, even layer. Season with salt and pepper, and bake for 10 minutes.
Toss halved brussels sprouts with the remaining 2 tsp of oil and add to the other baking tray with chopped sausages. Add to oven with potatoes and bake for a further 20 minutes.
Remove everything from the oven, add to a bowl and top with a fried egg.

name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Brussels Sprout Bake (Balanced)

name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Brussels Sprout Bake (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Sausages and meats ham smoked extra lean low sodium

steps: Preheat oven to 425F, line 2 baking trays with aluminum foil.
Toss sweet potato cubes in 1 tsp olive oil, and spread on a baking tray in a single, even layer. Season with salt and pepper, and bake for 10 minutes.
Toss halved brussels sprouts with the remaining 1 tsp of oil and add to the other baking tray with chopped sausages. Add to oven with potatoes and bake for a further 20 minutes.
Remove everything from the oven, add to a bowl and top with a fried egg.

name: Scallion Pancake with Fried Egg (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Slice green onion, half into 1 inch lengths, and the other half into very thin coins.
Mix together flour, water, sesame oil, and green onions in a mixing bowl.
Pour batter into a thin layer in a round shape in a non-stick pan over medium high heat, flipping occasionally until browned, crispy on the outside, and cooked through the center.
Serve with a drizzle of sriracha sauce, and fried egg.

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Mix the spinach, oats, egg white, egg, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper in a blender.
Transfer the mix to a non-stick pan, spray first with vegetable oil, and cook on medium heat.  Prepare one to three crepes depending on the size of the pan.
Slice the cherry tomatoes and red onion.
Split the pesto between each crepe and fill them with red onion and cherry tomatoes.

name: Tuna-Mango Jar (Balanced)
steps: In a jar or container, add in the lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste and shake to combine.
Next, add in chopped cucumber, sliced red onion, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced avocado, drained tuna, mango, and sesame seeds.
Add the lid and put in the fridge until ready to enjoy.

name: Hard Boiled Eggs with Chili Butter and Garlic Yogurt (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps:
Chili Butter: 
In a saucepan or skillet melt butter with olive oil.

Add chili flakes or red pepper when it is shimmering and melted. (It will bubble a bit). Let everything cook together, brown, and infuse. Mix well and allow it to infuse for a few minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

Garlic Yogurt:
 Mix yogurt, lime juice, zest, salt, pepper, and minced garlic in a bowl. Whip in a food processor or with an immersion blender. Mix well and set aside.
On a plate, add the yogurt mixture. Place the halved boiled eggs and add the boiled egg whites in halves too.
Finish off with chili butter and chopped parsley.
Toast the bread and serve it as a side.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Salsa and Potato (High Protein)
steps: Poke a washed potato with a fork deeply, microwave for about 5 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook scrambled eggs in a pan coated with nonstick spray over medium heat.
Slice cooked potato, season everything with salt and pepper, then top with salsa to serve.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Salsa and Potato (Balanced)
steps: Poke a washed potato with a fork deeply, microwave for about 5 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook scrambled eggs in a pan coated with nonstick spray over medium heat.

name: Chicken Bruschetta - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Add the chicken breast and broth to the IP, carefully place the steamer rack, add the asparagus on top, put the lid, and cook with high pressure for 4 minutes. When finished, release the pressure for a few minutes before opening.
For the bruschetta, place the chopped tomatoes into a small bowl and add Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Pierce the potato deeply with a fork multiple times and microwave for 5 minutes on full power. Remove the potato to a serving plate, slice it lengthwise, and add butter, salt, and pepper to taste.
Remove the asparagus from the IP. Place the cheese on the chicken breast and wait until it's melted. Add spinach to the side of the pot and stir until wilted. Press cancel to turn off the IP.
Serve chicken over the spinach, topping with pesto sauce, cherry tomatoes, and asparagus.

name: Lazy Lasagna - Instant Pot (Low carb)
steps: Dice the onion and prepare the ingredients.

Turn on the Sauté function on the Instant Pot. 
Add the beef while breaking it into smaller pieces, and cook until the meat is no longer pink (5 min). Turn off the saute function.

Add the broth, tomato sauce, spinach, and spices.
Break the noodles and add them lightly, being careful not to push them to the bottom (don't stir).

Place the lid on, manually press cook, and set the time to 6 min on high pressure.
Serve and add the cheese on top.

*Add one more cup of chicken broth to give a soup consistency*
*For crunchy spinach, place it at the end and combine*

name: Lazy Lasagna - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Dice the onion and prepare the ingredients.
Press the Sauté function, and heat the olive oil, garlic, and onion. Stir until the onions are translucent.

Add the beef while breaking it into smaller pieces, and cook until the meat is no longer pink (5 min). Turn off the saute function.
Add the broth, tomato sauce, spinach, and spices.
Break the noodles and add them lightly, being careful not to push them to the bottom (don't stir).
Place the lid on, manually press cook, and set the time to 6 min on high pressure. Serve and add the cheese on top.

*Add one more cup of chicken broth to give a soup consistency*
*For crunchy spinach, add it at the end and combine*

name: Mexican Ground Beef - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Peel the zucchini and carrots and chop them into small cubes. Continue with the onion, tomatoes, and potato. Slice the avocado and set aside for garnish.
Press the sauté button, add the oil and onion, and cook until they have softened. Next, add the beef and mix well.
Cancel the saute function and add all the remaining ingredients except the avocado. Place the lid, and close.
Select the pressure cook button and set it on high pressure for 4 minutes. After cooking, release the pressure for the minutes indicated in the manual.
Serve the beef and vegetable mixture in a bowl and garnish with avocado.

name: Mexican Ground Beef - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Peel the zucchini and carrots and chop them into small cubes. Continue with the onion, tomatoes, and potato. Slice the avocado and set aside.
Press the sauté button, add the oil and onion, and cook until they have softened. Next, add the beef and mix well.
Cancel the saute function and add all the remaining ingredients except the avocado. Place the lid, and close.
Select the pressure cook button and set it on high pressure for 4 minutes. After cooking, release the pressure for the minutes indicated in the manual.
Serve the beef and vegetable mixture in a bowl and garnish with sliced avocado.

name: Beef Stroganoff - Instant Pot (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak broiled trimmed to 0" fat

steps: Prepare the ingredients, slice the onion and mushroom, mince the garlic, and cut the beef into bite-sized pieces.
Set the Instant Pot to saute and let it heat up. Add the oil, onion, garlic, and beef pieces. Let them cook for 2-3 minutes until the onion is translucent.

Add the spices (nutmeg, salt, pepper) and the beef broth, stir together, and add the pasta, place the lid on Instant Pot. Press the pressure cook button and manually set the time for 8 minutes on high pressure.

Once ready, quickly release until all the pressure is gone, then remove the lid, place in the mushrooms, and let them cook for a while. Strain the beef, add the sour cream, and mix well (leave a small portion of broth to mix with the sour cream to make it tastier).
Serves on a plate and garnishes with parsley leaves.

name: Mexican Ground Beef - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Peel the zucchini and carrots and chop them into small cubes. Continue with the onion, tomatoes, and potato. Slice the avocado and set aside.

Cancel the saute function and add all the remaining ingredients except the avocado. Place the lid, and close.

Serve the beef and vegetable mixture in a bowl and garnish with avocado.

name: Salmon Power Bowl (High Protein)
steps: Preheat oven to 425 F. Cube sweet potatoes.
Bake on a sheet pan the sweet potato, cauliflower rice, and top with salmon. Bake for 10-15 minutes until salmon is fork-tender.
Dressing: whisk together the oil, vinegar, maple syrup,  and a pinch of salt.
Serve in a bowl with spinach, cauliflower, sweet potatoes, and salmon. Top with dressing!
This recipe makes excellent meal prep. Save the ingredients in separate containers in the fridge for 3-5 days.

name: Zucchini Baked Patties (High Protein)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Grate and thoroughly drain zucchini by placing it in a colander, sprinkling it with salt, weighing it down with a heavy bowl, and letting it sit for around 15 minutes.
Squeeze out moisture before adding it to a large mixing bowl.
Combine all remaining ingredients with squeezed zucchini.
Form into patties about ⅓ cup each. Space at least one inch apart on parchment-paper-lined baking sheets. Bake for 15 minutes to 30 minutes and flip if it's necessary.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Potato and Salsa (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Potatoes white, flesh and skin, baked

steps: Poke a washed potato with a fork deeply, microwave for about 5 minutes or until tender
Meanwhile, cook scrambled eggs in a pan coated with nonstick spray over medium heat.
Slice cooked potato, season everything with salt and pepper, then top with salsa to serve.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Potato and Salsa (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Potatoes white, flesh and skin, baked

steps: Poke a washed potato with a fork deeply, and microwave for about 5 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook scrambled eggs in a pan coated with nonstick spray over medium heat.

name: Seitan Chorizo Quesadilla (High Protein)
steps: Heat a pan over medium heat, and add olive oil. Cook chopped onions and peppers until tender, about 3-5 minutes. Then add chopped spinach and stir, cooking until wilted.
Add crumbled seitan 'sausage' and mix. Season with salt and spices and stir, cooking until hot. Remove the mixture from the pan.
Wipe out the pan, and add the flour tortilla. Add the filling back into the tortilla, covering just half of the wrap.
Top with vegan cheese, and fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the tortilla is hot and crispy.

name: Zucchini Stew (Balanced)
steps: Preheat the oven to 365 F. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, heat the oil, add the onion and garlic, and cook until soft.
Add the crumbled Beyond Meat to the skillet and cook for a few minutes. Add the diced tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, spinach, and Italian seasoning. Cook until vegetables are tender.

Spread half of the Beyond Meat mixture on the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange the zucchini ribbons on top of the Beyond Meat mixture. Spread the remaining meat mixture on top of the zucchini. Sprinkle the shredded vegan mozzarella cheese on top of the meat mixture.
Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and the zucchini is tender.

name: Zucchini Stew (High Protein)
steps: Preheat the oven to 365 F. Cut the zucchini lengthwise. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, spray the oil, add the onion and garlic, and cook until soft.

Add the crumbled Beyond Meat to the skillet and cook for a few minutes. Add the diced tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, spinach, and Italian seasoning. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add salt and Pepper to taste.
Arrange some zucchini on the baking dish, spread half of the Beyond Meat mixture, place another zucchini layer, and spread the remaining mixture. Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the Zucchini is tender.

name: Egg Salad (High Protein)
steps: Peel the potato, and chop it into small cubes. Next, chop the cauliflower, red onion, and chives.
Place the potato cubes in a pot, cover with water, and cook until fork-tender. In the middle of the process, add the cauliflower florets.
Peel the eggs and chop them into small cubes. Make sure to remove the necessary yolks.
Place the mayo, mustard, paprika, red onion, and nutritional yeast in a mixing bowl. Next, incorporate the eggs, potato, and cauliflower and stir well. Garnish with chive on top.

name: Kale Shrimp Skillet (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Frozen cooked medium shrimp by price chopper

steps: Start by heating olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.

Add finely diced onion and garlic to the pan. Saute for 2-3 minutes until translucent. Then add the finely chopped sweet potatoes to the pan, season with salt, add a tablespoon of water, and cook for 5-6 minutes until softened.
Add shrimp to the pan, and cook until opaque, about 2 minutes. Add chopped kale, stirring until wilted.
Season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes before serving!

name: Glazed Salmon
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Combine aminos, sesame oil, and maple syrup. Allow salmon to sit in the sauce.
Dice veggies into bite-sized pieces. Add to a baking sheet coated with aluminum foil. Transfer salmon to a baking sheet. Drizzle the sauce onto the salmon and the vegetables. Bake for 15-20 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and enjoy!

name: Honey Garlic Salmon (High Protein)
steps: Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add salmon, season with salt and pepper. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Whisk together aminos, vinegar, honey, and crushed garlic. Pour over the salmon, and cook for about 1 minute, until it starts to thicken.
Serve fish with steamed cauliflower rice and steamed broccoli. Top with remaining sauce and sesame seeds.

name: Spiced  Plantains and Cod
steps: Preheat the oven to 450F. In a bowl, mix together all the spices with some salt, and add the oil.
Remove the skin from the plantain and halve lengthwise. Slice the bell peppers.
Coat the beans, fish, plantains, and bell peppers with the spice mixture and spread on a baking tray coated with aluminum foil.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the fish is cooked, and the vegetables are tender.

name: Thai Shrimp Curry (High Protein)
steps: Start by heating oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion, potato, garlic, ginger, and lemongrass. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, before adding the curry and stirring to coat.
Add in the coconut milk, broth, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer. Add shrimp, and sliced mushrooms, and simmer for 5 minutes, or until shrimp and potatoes are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, finish by squeezing in fresh lime juice.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Combine coconut aminos and sesame oil in a bowl, and toss with salmon and chopped green onion.

Let sit for 5 minutes, or up to 2 hours. 
Option: Chop the salmon in small cubes.
Place warm cauliflower rice in a bowl, and top with chopped cucumber, sliced avocado, seaweed sheets, and sesame seeds.

name: Pork Chop with Potatoes O'Brien (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Pork top loin chops boneless lean meat only raw

steps: Heat half of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Dice potatoes, peppers, and onions. Chop parsley.
Add onion to the pan and cook, stirring, until lightly browned and softened, about 5 minutes. Add peppers, mix, and cook for 3 more minutes, until slightly tender. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and diced potatoes to the pan. Cook, turning to brown all sides, for about 7 minutes. You may need to work in batches.
Combine potatoes with onion mixture in a bowl, and toss with chopped parsley, salt, and pepper to taste.

Then, cook a pork chop, seasoned with salt and pepper on both sides, in the pan over medium high heat. 3-4 minutes per side for thinner chops, and 5-7 minutes per side for thicker. When browned and cooked through, remove and serve with potatoes.

steps: In a bowl, mix together ground meat with seasonings.  Heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil.
Form meat into 6 equal patties, about 1/2 in thick. Fry the patties for 2-3 minutes per side, until browned on the outside, and cooked throughout.
Remove from the pan and serve with chopped mixed fruit.

name: Steak and Potato Breakfast Hash (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Beef round top steak boneless lean and trimmed to 0" fat all grades raw

steps: Heat half the oil in a pan over medium-high heat, and coat cubed steak with spices. Season with salt and pepper, then add to the pan.
Cook meat for 5-7 minutes, or until browned on all sides, and done to your liking. Remove.
Add the remaining oil to the pan, then add potato (diced small), chopped peppers, and onion. Cook until potatoes are nearly tender.
Add steak back to the pan, combine, and cook for 2 more minutes to let the flavour come together. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Pork and Brussel Sprout Breakfast Hash (High Protein)

Add chopped garlic, spices, and vinegar, mix, and cook until browned. About 8 minutes.
Set meat aside. Add the chopped sprouts and onions to the pan, cooking over high heat for about 6 minutes, or until browned and starting to tenderize.
Add pork back to the pan, mix everything together, and cook for another 2 minutes before serving.

Serve two bunches of lettuce, place the patties in each, and split all the ingredients.

Mix the egg whites in a bowl and add the nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper to taste. Peel and grate the potato.

Split the egg whites, potato, and Beyond meat between the muffin cups. Place the cheese on top.
Cook in the oven for 10-15 minutes at 300 degrees.
Transfer into a serving plate and enjoy!

ingredients.name: Organic protein sweet vanilla bean plant based powder by orgain
Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps:
*Option:
Use your favorite brand of:
 Plant-based protein powder 
 Plant-based milk sugar-free
 Zero-Calorie Sweetener
Blend dry oats to make oat flour (or substitute with oat flour). Transfer to a bowl and add 1/2 scoop of the protein, baking powder, and 1/2 tsp of cinnamon, and mix thoroughly.
Next, add 2 tbsp. of chopped walnuts, the grated carrot, half of the almond milk, and stir gently to combine.
Take a cup and spray the inside with a non-stick spray. Place the mixture into the mug and microwave for 1 to 2 minutes (until fully cooked).
Topping: In a small bowl, place the remaining protein with the rest of the almond milk and stir to combine. Next, add cinnamon, vanilla, zero calorie sweetener and mix.
Carefully remove the mug from the microwave. Add the protein topping, sprinkle with the rest of the walnuts, and enjoy.

ingredients.name: Seitan cubed wheat protein by west soy

steps: Chop the zucchini, mince the garlic, and cut the seitan into smaller cubes.

Heat a pot over medium heat and add the oil, garlic, and onion. Stir for 1-2 minutes. Continue adding the zucchini, vegetable broth, and salt and pepper to taste. Pop the lid on and cook over medium heat.
Once the zucchini is fork tender, turn it off. Wait a few minutes to cool off and transfer it to a blender. Next, add in the water, and tofu. Blend until smooth.
Heat a pan and add the seitan. Let it cook for a few minutes.
Transfer the seitan into a bowl, serve the soup, and mix.

Add chopped, peeled, sweet potato, and boil for 15 minutes, or until completely soft.
Then, add frozen mixed vegetables, or fresh chopped vegetables to boiling water and cook until heated through. 
Meanwhile, sear a vegan sausage in a frying pan according to package directions.

steps: Blend together the egg whites with the egg and spinach and add salt and pepper to taste.

Slice the red bell pepper and mushrooms. Peel and chop the sweet potato into small chunks, then place them in a bowl with 2 tbsp of water and microwave for 5 minutes. Mash the sweet potato with a fork.

Heat a nonstick pan, add one tsp of oil, then stir in half of the egg mixture. Cook over low heat for 3 minutes, flip, and cook another 3 minutes on the other side. Next, transfer to a plate and prepare another omelet with the remaining oil.
Add the red bell pepper and mushrooms to the pan and cook until soft. (Add vegetable cooking spray if needed)
Spread the mashed sweet potato inside both omelets, fill it with the veggies, and fold them into four pieces.

name: Asparagus Omelette (High Protein)
steps:
Chop the potatoes into chunks, chop the asparagus, and slice the mushrooms. 
Mix the egg whites with the egg, salt, and pepper to taste.
Heat a nonstick pan, spray with vegetable oil, and place the egg mixture. Cook with low heat. Transfer the omelet to a serving plate.
Next, in a small bowl, place the potato chunks, oil, and paprika, and mix to combine. Cook, and before being ready, place in the asparagus and mushrooms. Coof for a few minutes more.
Serve the necessary amount on the omelet, and serve the rest as a side dish.

Mix egg yolk, green onion, mayo, paprika, onion powder, and salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mashed egg whites with the egg yolk mix and stir well.
Toast the bread, and add the lettuce and egg salad to make the sandwich.

Add the green pepper, cilantro, and ground beef, cook until the meat is no longer pink, season with salt and pepper, and stop the saute function.

steps: In a plastic bag, place the cajun powder, salt, and pepper to taste. Then prepare the fish by spreading all the oil around it and placing it on the plastic bag close and shaking it until the fish is covered.

Add the diced zucchini and vegetable broth, salt, and pepper to taste, and cook until the zucchinis are tender. Add 1/4 of a cup of Swiss cheese and mix until completely melted.

ingredients.name: Matcha green tea powder by sprouts
Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: In a medium saucepan, whisk the matcha and milk together until dissolved. Add the oats and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix together the egg, egg whites, and one packet of zero-calorie sweetener.
Transfer the egg mixture into the saucepan, and make sure to stir rapidly until the egg becomes completely incorporated into the porridge.
Continue cooking the oats, stirring occasionally until the oats reach your preferred consistency. Add a little extra water if needed.
Transfer to a bowl and garnish with hemp seeds and blueberries.

name: Asian Steak and Green Beans (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add in thinly sliced steak and cook, until browned, about 4 minutes. Season with salt and remove.
Add chopped green beans, crushed garlic, and thinly sliced ginger to the pan, add 2 tbsp of water, cover and cook for 5 minutes or until tender.
Add sliced steak back to the pan, topping with soy sauce and chopped basil. Stir to combine, and serve over rice.

name: One-Pan Roasted Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Preheat oven to 425F.
Peel carrots, peel and cut onion into eighths, and remove the top of one head of garlic. Place on a baking sheet lined with foil.
Place chicken thighs and vegetables on the tray, coating lightly with oil, and seasoning with chopped rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Roast for about 20 minutes, or until chicken is brown and vegetable tender.

name: Beef and Plantain Bowls with Green Salsa (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Sauce la victoria green chile salsa mild

steps: Preheat oven to 400F and line a tray with aluminum foil. Peel and slice plantains into coins. Drizzle with half of the oil, season with salt, and bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown, flipping once.
Meanwhile, add beef and chopped onion to a pan over medium heat with the remaining oil, cooking until browned and cooked through, crumbling with a spoon.
Season beef mixture with salt and chili powder, then add in chopped kale, cooking until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Serve beef mixture with plantains, and top with green salsa.

name: Avocado Chicken Lettuce Wraps (Balanced)
steps: Start by mashing avocado in a bowl using a fork. Season with salt, pepper, and juice of half a lemon.
Add chopped, cooked, chicken breast, onion, halved cherry tomatoes, and bell peppers.
Scoop mixture into clean, dry lettuce leaves, and top with grated carrot.

name: Savory Cottage Cheese (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Everything bagel seasoning by olde thompson
Crackers saltines includes oyster soda soup

steps: Dice bell pepper, slice cherry tomatoes into halves, and thinly slice cucumbers. Cut the avocado into cubes.
Transfer the cottage cheese to a serving bowl. Top with bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and bagel seasoning. Add in the halved boiled egg, and avocado cubes.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Enjoy!

name: Ground Turkey Bowl (High Protein)
steps: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Peel and chop the sweet potato and chop the broccoli into smaller florets.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet, and cook until browned and no longer pink, breaking it up with a spatula as it cooks.
Add the chopped sweet potato and broccoli to the skillet and stir to combine with the turkey. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes, occasionally stirring until the vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika and garlic powder over the turkey and vegetables, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir to combine.
Serve in a bowl with the avocado cubes and mix.

name: Smoked Salmon and Cauliflower Bowl (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Organic naturally smoked salmon by blue hill bay

steps: Heat a pan, add the mushrooms cook with the lid on top. Stir occasionally.
Once the mushrooms are ready, remove them from the pan, and add the cauliflower rice. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook for 3 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Prepare the other ingredients as directed, and then measure portions.
Add the cauliflower rice and mushrooms in a bowl, and continue adding the remaining ingredients.

name: Shrimp Fajitas (High Protein)
steps: Slice the bell pepper and onion. Next, in a small bowl, stir together the seasoning ingredients.
Add the shrimp, one tablespoon of olive oil, juice from half a lime, and the seasoning mix in a large bowl. Toss it all together until the shrimp is well coated, and set it aside to marinate.
Heat the remaining olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the bell peppers and onion, and saute until softened. Once it's ready, transfer it to a plate.
In the same skillet, add the shrimp and cook for about 2 -3 minutes on each side. Add the bell peppers and onions to the skillet, and toss everything.
Transfer to a serving plate, squeeze the remaining lime on top, and enjoy!

name: Healthier French Toast (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Whole wheat high protein bread by p28

steps: In a shallow bowl, combine the egg whites, whole egg, almond milk, cinnamon, ginger, peanut butter powder, maple syrup, and vanilla extract to the dish. Mix together ingredients until combined.
Heat the skillet over medium heat, while it is heating, dip the bread into the batter on both sides and soak for at least 1 minute in the batter.

Spray the pan with nonstick cooking spray and place in the toast. Flip the toast when one side is lightly browned and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side. Then remove from the skillet once each side is golden brown.
Top with berries and serve.

name: Roasted Chickpeas
steps:
Preheat oven to 350°. Drain chickpeas from the can and rinse them well. Pour chickpeas onto baking sheet in an even layer.
When oven is heated, place chickpeas in oven until completely dry, about 6 minutes.
Remove chickpeas from oven and toss with oil and salt. Return to oven and bake until golden brown, dry, and crispy, about 35 minutes, tossing halfway through. 
Combine chickpeas and seasonings on sheet tray and toss to combine. Spread into an even layer and let cool completely.

name: Tuna Melt (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids
Medium cheddar reduced fat natural cheese 2 % milk by sargento

steps: Combine tuna, chopped celery, chopped carrots, chopped onion, mayonnaise, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over low heat.
Spray skillet with non-stick spray, and place a slice of bread on top
Top bread with cheese, then tuna salad and tomato slices. Cook on low heat until cheese melts and bread is toasted, flip and toast on the other side.
Serve immediately. For a lower carb option, make an open-faced sandwich.

Fish tuna white canned in water without salt drained solids

name: Spinach, Feta, and Sun-Dried Tomato Omelette and Potatoes (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Potatoes white, flesh and skin, baked

steps: Preheat a pan over medium heat. Spray with non-stick cooking spray.
Rinse, then deeply gouge a small potato with a fork, and microwave for 4 minutes.
Finely dice the garlic, and add to the pan with spinach, and diced mushrooms. Cook for about 4 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted, and the mushrooms sottened. Remove and set aside.
Next, pour in beaten eggs, cooking in a flat round shape for about 30 seconds, pulling away the edges and allowing the egg to flow to the sides of the pan.
Top with spinach mixture and crumbled feta. Season with salt and pepper, add chopped sun dried tomatoes, fold in half and serve.
Potatoes can be seasoned with salt and pepper, or cayenne if desired.
Optional: omit cheese for a paleo version.

name: Spinach, Feta, and Sun-Dried Tomato Omelette and Potatoes (High Protein )
steps: Preheat a pan over medium heat. Spray with non-stick cooking spray.

Finely dice the garlic, and add to the pan with spinach, and diced mushrooms. Cook for about 4 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted, and the mushrooms softened. Remove and set aside.
Next, combine the egg whites with the eggs, pour them into the pan, and cook in a flat round shape for about 30 seconds, pulling away the edges and allowing the egg to flow to the sides of the pan.
Top with spinach mixture and some swiss cheese. Season with salt and pepper, add chopped sun-dried tomatoes, fold in half, and serve.
Potatoes can be seasoned with salt and pepper, or cayenne if desired. Place the remaining cheese on top.
Optional: omit cheese for a paleo version.

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw
Rice brown instant cooked without salt

steps: Slice zucchini lengthwise, and brush with a small amount of oil.

Grill steak on a preheated grill to your desired doneness, about 4-5 minutes per side. You can also grill the zucchini at the same time, until lightly blackened and tender. Season both with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, very finely chop garlic and parsley, mix in a bowl with oregano, olive oil, and vinegar, season with salt and pepper.
Serve steak thinly sliced, with chimichurri, zucchini, hot rice, and a lemon wedge.

Rice brown instant cooked without salt

name: Chipotle Steak Tacos (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Beef round eye of steak boneless separable lean and fat trimmed to 0" choice raw

steps: Preheat a pan over medium-high heat with Canola or Coconut oil
Season your steak generously with salt and pepper
Sear Steak on both sides for 5 minutes, or until golden brown - remove the steak, rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly, and seasoning with chipotle powder.
Add sliced peppers and onions to the pan, with minced garlic, jalapenos, and cumin - saute for 5 minutes until tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Warm corn tortillas in a pan, or in the microwave - then top 2 tortillas with thinly sliced steak, vegetables, sour cream, and a wedge of lime

name: Chicken Salad with Apple and Cranberry (Low Fat)
steps: In a bowl, combine the diced chicken, cranberries, finely diced celery,  diced red onion, diced apple, and walnuts, if using.
In a cup or small bowl, combine mayonnaise, the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

Stir the mayonnaise mixture into the chicken. Line the bread with lettuce leaves and spread the chicken salad on the lettuce. Or serve the chicken salad as open-faced sandwiches for a lower carb option

name: Chicken Salad with Apple and Cranberry (High Protein)
steps: In a bowl, combine the diced chicken, cranberries, finely diced celery,  diced red onion, diced apple, and walnuts, if using.
In a cup or small bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

Stir the mayonnaise mixture into the chicken. Line the bread with lettuce leaves and spread the chicken salad on the lettuce. Serve the remaining mix as a side.
Or serve the chicken salad as open-faced sandwiches for a lower carb option

name: Cottage Sweet Salad (High Protein)
steps: Finely chop the spinach, halve the grapes, peel the cucumber, remove the seeds, then chop into small cubes and grate the carrot.
Mix the cottage cheese with the cucumber, carrots, walnuts, and grapes.
Serve the spinach in a bowl and place the cottage mix on top. Enjoy!

name: Cottage Salad in Iceberg Leaves (High Protein)
steps: Place the egg into a pot and cover it with water. Bring to a boil for 15 minutes.

Remove the egg from heat, and submerge it in an ice bath. This will stop the egg from cooking further and make peeling easier. When cool enough to handle, peel the egg, and mash them with a fork in a large bowl.
In the same bowl, add the remaining ingredients except for the lettuce leaves. Mix to combine.
Taste it and adjust salt and pepper or any seasoning of your preference.
Join two leaves, stuff each portion with the cottage salad. (Add many lettuces leaves as you need it)

name: Sesame Pineapple Steak Bites (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Chop steak and pineapple into bite-sized pieces. Toss steak chunks in a bowl with chopped garlic, coconut aminos, and sesame oil to coat.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, then add steak chunks. Sear on each side, until browned and cooked to just before desired doneness, about 5 minutes.
Drain excess liquid from the pan. Add in pineapple chunks and cook until heated through and lightly softened, about 2 minutes.
Serve, and top with freshly chopped cilantro.

name: Peach Overnight Pudding (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Transfer to a jar or container and place lid.
Place in the refrigerator overnight, or for at least 4-6 hours, to allow mixture to thicken.
Optional: use cinnamon, vanilla or almond extract, or any other sweet spices to enhance the flavor.

name: Cinnamon Roll Smoothie (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Oatmeal or rolled oats regular or quick dry uncooked

steps: Place all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth. Add ice cubes or water for a lighter consistency.
Serve in a large glass. Optional: add zero-calorie sweetener for extra sweetness.

name: Power Green Smoothie  (Low Carb)
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender, add a few ice cubes, and blend until smooth.
Choose plant-based protein for a vegan smoothie.

name: Beef Stroganoff - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak broiled trimmed to 0" fat

steps: Prepare the ingredients, slice the onion and mushroom, mince the garlic, and cut the beef into bite-sized pieces. Set the Instant Pot to saute and let it heat up. Add the oil, onion, garlic, and beef pieces. Let them cook for 2-3 minutes until the onion is translucent.

Add the spices (nutmeg, salt, pepper) and the beef broth, stir together, and add the pasta, place the lid on Instant Pot. Press the pressure cook button and manually set the time for 8 minutes on high pressure.

Once ready, quickly release until all the pressure is gone, then remove the lid, place in the mushrooms, and let them cook for a while. Strain the beef, add the sour cream, and mix well (leave a small portion of broth to mix with the sour cream to make it tastier).
Serves on a plate and garnishes with parsley leaves.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Chickpeas or garbanzo beans boiled with salt

steps:
Combine a pinch of salt, 1/2 tsp cumin, and paprika in a bowl.  Add chicken and oil, and toss to coat. 
Combine a pinch of salt, the remaining cumin, yogurt, lemon juice, tahini, and crushed garlic in a small bowl. 

Place warm rice in the bottom of the bowl. Top with shredded chicken, chickpeas, sliced cucumber, halved tomatoes, and yogurt mixture.

Cook instant rice (like Uncle Ben's) according to package directions.
Serve together topped with soy sauce.

name: Egg Avocado Breakfast Sandwich (Low Fat)
steps: Cook egg and whites scrambled together in a pan coated with nonstick spray over medium heat.
Toast bread and top with sliced avocado.
Add egg to bread, season with salt and pepper, serve as a sandwich.

name: Microwave Mug Omelette (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: Whisk eggs together with milk in a large microwave safe mug.
Stir in cheese, chopped peppers, green onion, and season with salt and pepper.
Microwave, then remove and stir, in 30 second increments, until egg is set. Serve with apples.

name: Tofu Scramble with Rice (Balanced)
steps: Add olive oil to a pan over medium heat.
Cook chopped spinach, onions, and bell peppers until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add in crumbled tofu (you can do this by hand, or with the back of a spatula). Cook until the tofu is hot and most of the water has evaportated.
Stir in the spices, season with salt and pepper, then serve with instant rice.

name: Spiced Mixed Nuts

ingredients.name: Nuts mixed dry roasted with peanuts salt added

steps: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat, adding nuts and stirring to roast for 5 minutes.
Remove nuts, draining excess butter, and toss with spices.

name: Veggies and Tzatziki

ingredients.name: Dill weed fresh or raw herb

steps: Peel cucumber, remove seeds with a spoon, then grate and squeeze out excess water.
Mix cucumber with yogurt, crushed garlic, chopped dill, and lemon juice. Season with salt to taste.
Serve with carrots, cut into sticks.

name: Sweet Potato Chips
steps: Preheat oven to 300F.
Slice sweet potatoes very thinly using a knife or a mandolin. Toss potatoes with olive oil to coat.

Arrange sweet potato slices on parchment lined baking trays and sprinkle with salt. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crisp and golden around the edges. Let cool for 5 more minutes after removing from the oven as they will continue to crisp up.

name: Air Popped Popcorn
steps: Add kernels to a preheated deep pot with a lid over medium heat. Shake pot for about 2 minutes, or until all kernels are popped

name: Blueberry Frozen Yogurt Popsicles
steps: Blend the blueberries until almost liquified into a smoothie consistency.
Pour the blueberries mixture into a large bowl. Stir in the agave/honey.
Add yogurt, and mix gently until just barely combined, leaving yogurt and berries somewhat separate.
Pour mixture into popsicle molds, and freeze overnight or for 6 hours.

name: Kale Chips
steps:
Preheat oven to 350F
Cut kale leaves off of stems, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Toss kale with olive oil and salt, then arrange on a baking tray, with space between each leaf.
Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until lightly browned and crisp, but not burnt.

name: Edamame with Sesame Seeds
steps: Boil edamame for 3-4 minutes. Drain and dry with a paper towel.
In a pan over high heat, add sesame oil. When the oil is hot, add edamame pods and fry for about 2-3 minutes, until the pods are slightly charred.
Add soy sauce and stir until the sauce has evaporated.
Season with salt and black pepper.

name: Veggie Scramble and Toast (Low Carb)
steps: Sautee chopped spinach and tomatoes in butter. Push to the side of the pan
Scramble eggs and whites together in the pan.
Stir to combine, season with salt and pepper and serve with toast

Salmon pink canned drained solids with bone

Serve with crackers

name: Instant Pot Beef and Broccoli (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef round eye of roast separable lean only trimmed to 1/8" fat select cooked roasted

steps: Add beef broth, garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil to the instant pot. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Then add beef and stir to combine.

Place the lid. Cook at high pressure for 10 minutes. Make sure the valve is set to the sealing position.
When the cooking time ends, do a quick pressure release. (Set the valve to the venting position and when the valve drops, carefully remove the lid
Add the cornstarch and water mixture and stir until smooth.
Select "saute", add the broccoli, and stir a bit. Close the Instant Pot and cook the broccoli on saute for 3 to 5 minutes.
Open the lid, serve, and enjoy with steamed rice.

name: Avocado Toast with Smoked Salmon (High Protein)
steps: Peel the boiled eggs, remove the yolks, and serve halved with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast sourdough bread.
Mash and spread avocado to cover the entire surface.
Top with thinly sliced onions, tomato, and smoked salmon.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Avocado Toast with Smoked Salmon (Low Fat)

Mash and spread avocado to cover entire surface.

Spread the beetroot, tofu, and red pepper in a single layer. Spray the vegetable oil, and sprinkle paprika, salt, and pepper to taste.
Roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the beetroot is lightly browned and fork-tender.
Place the spinach into a bowl, add the roasted ingredients, and garnish with chopped mixed nuts.

name: Egg Plant Stew (High Protein)
steps: Heat a pan and add the oil. Place in the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the eggplant cubes and water, place the lid on top, and cook until soft.

Next, add in the beyond meat mix and let it cook. Continue adding the chickpeas, tomatoes, paprika, and cinnamon. Stir well and close. Allow everything to cook. Next, taste and adjust with salt and pepper.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving plate.

name: Chorizo Hash (High Protein)
steps: Chop the potato and avocado into small cubes. Then chop the red onion and red pepper into smaller cubes.
Heat a pan, and add the coconut oil and the chopped potato. Put the lid on, and let them cook until soft.
Next, stir in the nutritional yeast, red onion, bell pepper, salt, and pepper to taste and cook until tender. Once it’s ready, add the chorizo and stir well to combine.
Serve on a plate and mix with avocado cubes. Garnish with chopped cilantro on top.

name: Tuscan Shrimp Soup (High Protein)
steps: Peel and chop the potato into small cubes, and boil until they are fork-tender.
Mince the garlic. Place a large pot over medium heat, add one teaspoon of oil and garlic, and sauté for one minute.
Add the shrimp and cook for two minutes on each side. Next, move into a bowl.
Return the pot to medium heat. Add the remaining oil and heat until shimmering. Add onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Add coconut cream and water. Bring to a slow boil and stir occasionally.
Transfer into a blender, add in the potato cubes, and wait a few minutes to cool down before blending. Return to the pot.
Next, add chopped spinach, chopped sundried tomatoes, shrimp, basil, oregano, parsley, salt, and pepper to taste and stir well.
Serve into a bowl and enjoy!

name: Shrimp Stir Fry (High Protein)
steps: Slice the mushrooms, finely slice the carrot, and mince the garlic.
Heat a large skillet, and add one and a half tablespoons of oil and the garlic over medium heat. Add the shrimp, cayenne, salt, and pepper to taste. Cook for around 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the shrimp from the pan and set aside. In the same pan, add the remaining oil and turn the heat to medium-high. Add all of your veggies.
Put the lid on top, stirring occasionally. Once the veggies are ready, throw in the shrimp and heat through.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Spiced Mexican Tuna Steak (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Apple cider vinegar by always save

steps: Cut the onion and red bell pepper into thin strips. Mince the garlic, peel, and chop the sweet potato into small cubes.
Coat the tuna steaks with one tablespoon of olive oil on both sides. Next, sprinkle with salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, and garlic, and spread with your hands. Set aside.
Microwave the sweet potato chunks in a container with three tablespoons of water for 5 minutes until it is soft enough to mash with a fork. Check if it needs more water. Mash until you have a puree.

Next, heat the half tablespoon of coconut oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the onions and peppers, then season it with a pinch of salt, pepper, and the vinegar. Mix through and cook until softened and slightly browned. Remove to a plate.
Heat the remaining coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tuna steak, turn the heat down, drizzle with juice from half a lime, and cook for 3 minutes on each side. Set aside.
Combine avocado and chopped cilantro, season with the remaining lime juice and salt.
Serve the sweet potato puree in the middle of a large plate. Place the tuna steak on top, add the avocado mix to the tuna, and finish by adding the onion and pepper on top and around the plate.

name: Thai Chicken Curry - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Dice the onion, slice green onion, mince the ginger and the garlic. Chop lengthwise the green pepper, thinly slice the carrots and zucchini and chop the chicken in bite sized pieces.
Press the saute button. Once the pot is hot, add the olive oil, ginger, garlic, and onion. Stir, cooking for one minute, then add the chicken.
Add peppers, broccoli, zucchini, carrots, and curry paste. Mix well.
Next, stir in the soy sauce, coconut milk, cilantro, and chicken broth. Mix gently. Cancel the saute function and pop the lid.
Select pressure cook, set on high temperature for 7 minutes. Once it's ready, release the pressure before opening.
Finish by adding the lime juice and stir well. Taste it, and adjust the soy sauce and curry if it needs.
Serve on a plate and place the rice on top, garnish with cilantro and green onion.

*Optional: Place the chopped eggplant in a bowl, sprinkle it with salt, and let it sit for 10 to 30 minutes. Thoroughly rinse the eggplant and pat it dry before using. This process helps cut some of the natural bitterness.

steps:
*Option: Use pasta or gluten-free pasta if you don't find noodles rice* 
Quantity is the same for any option.
Prepare all the ingredients, dice the chicken breast, chop the spinach, cut the mushrooms in half, and mince the ginger and garlic.
Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat sesame oil, garlic, and ginger, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken and carrot, followed by chicken broth, soy sauce, 1/2 cup of water, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place the lid, cancel the saute function, and set it to High pressure for 10 minutes. The IP will switch to keep warm mode, then release the pressure before opening.
Stir in noodles and mushrooms and cook until pasta is soft (5 min approx.)
Once it's ready, add the spinach and combine, adjust salt and pepper to taste, and transfer to a bowl. Add the halves of boiled eggs on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Quantity is the same for any option.
Prepare all the ingredients, dice the chicken breast, chop the spinach, cut the mushrooms in half, and mince the ginger and garlic.
Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat sesame oil, garlic, and ginger, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken and carrot, followed by chicken broth, soy sauce, 1/2 cup of water, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place the lid, cancel the saute function, and set it to High pressure for 10 minutes. The IP will switch to keep warm mode, then release the pressure before opening.
Stir in noodles and mushrooms and cook until pasta is soft (5 min approx.)
Once it's ready, add the spinach and combine, adjust salt and pepper to taste, and transfer to a bowl. Add the halves of boiled eggs on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Ramen with Chicken - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps:
*Option: Use pasta or gluten-free pasta if you don't find noodles rice* 
Quantity is the same for any option.
Prepare all the ingredients, dice the chicken breast, chop the spinach, cut the mushrooms in half, and mince the ginger and garlic.
