Once it's ready, add the spinach and combine, adjust salt and pepper to taste, and transfer to a bowl. Add the halves of boiled eggs on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Bruschetta - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Add the chicken breast and broth to the IP, carefully place the steamer rack, add the asparagus on top, put the lid, and cook with high pressure for 4 minutes. When finished, release the pressure for a few minutes before opening.
For the bruschetta, place the chopped tomatoes into a small bowl and add Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Pierce the potato deeply with a fork multiple times and microwave for 5 minutes on full power. Remove the potato to a serving plate, slice it lengthwise add butter, salt, and pepper to taste.
Remove the asparagus from the IP. Place the cheese on the chicken breast and wait until it's melted. Add spinach to the side of the pot and stir until wilted. Press cancel to turn off the IP.
Serve chicken over the spinach, topping with pesto sauce, cherry tomatoes, and asparagus.

name: Chicken Bruschetta - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Add the chicken breast and broth to the IP, carefully place the steamer rack, add the asparagus on top, put the lid, and cook with high pressure for 4 minutes. When finished, release the pressure for a few minutes before opening.
For the bruschetta, place the chopped tomatoes into a small bowl and add Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Pierce the potato deeply with a fork multiple times and microwave for 5 minutes on full power. Remove the potato to a serving plate, slice it lengthwise add butter, salt, and pepper to taste.
Come back with the IP, when it's done release the pressure for a few minutes before opening, carefully remove the asparagus and set aside.
Place the cheese on the chicken breast and wait until it's melted. Add spinach to the side of the pot and stir until wilted. Press cancel to turn off the IP.
Serve chicken over the spinach, topping with pesto sauce, cherry tomatoes and asparagus.

name: Autumn Salad - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Start by peeling the sweet potato and beetroot, chop them into medium cubes, and chop the apple into small cubes.
In a small jar, combine the oil, squeeze the orange, and add orange shredded lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Place the sweet potato, beetroot, and apple inside the IP, drizzle half of the vinaigrette, and combine.
Add the steamer rack, lay down the salmon, and add the other half of the vinaigrette.
Cook on high pressure for 6 minutes, and release the steam before opening.
Cut the salmon into small pieces.
Transfer the IP mixture onto a serving plate, and add the chopped spinach, the salmon, and the crushed almonds.

name: Autumn Salad - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Start by peeling the sweet potato and beetroot, then chop them into medium cubes, and chop the apple into small cubes.
In a small jar, combine the oil, squeeze the orange, and add orange shredded lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Place the vegetables inside the IP, drizzle half of the vinaigrette, and combine.
Add the steamer rack, lay down the salmon, and add the other half of the vinaigrette.
Cook on high pressure for 6 minutes, and release the steam before opening.
Cut the salmon into small pieces.
Transfer the IP mixture onto a serving plate,  and stir in the salmon.

name: Autumn Salad - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Start by peeling the sweet potato and beetroot, then chop them into medium cubes.
In a small jar, combine the oil, squeeze the orange, and add orange shredded lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Place the sweet potato, and beetroot inside the IP, drizzle half of the vinaigrette, and combine.
Add the steamer rack, lay down the salmon, and add the other half of the vinaigrette.
Cook on high pressure for 6 minutes, and release the steam before opening.
Cut the salmon into small pieces.
Transfer the IP mixture onto a serving plate, and add the chopped spinach, the salmon, and the crushed almonds.

name: Lazy Lasagna - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Dice the onion and prepare the ingredients.
Press the Sauté function, and heat the olive oil, garlic, and onion. Stir until the onions are translucent.
Add the beef while breaking it into smaller pieces, and cook until the meat is no longer pink (5 min). Turn off the saute function.
Add the broth, tomato sauce, spinach, and spices.
Break the noodles and add them lightly, being careful not to push them to the bottom (don't stir).
Put the lid on, and set the time to six minutes on high pressure.
Serve and add the parmesan cheese on top.

*Add one more cup of chicken broth to give a soup consistency*
*For crunchy spinach, add it at the end and combine*

name: Tilapia and Confetti Salad - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: In a plastic bag marinate the fish with orange juice, half of the olive oil, and rosemary.
Shake the bag, and let it marinate while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. Prepare all the ingredients.
Press saute function on the IP, add the remaining oil, carrot, red pepper, cabbage, and chopped green onion, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the water and season it with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the trivet on top of the quinoa and carefully lay down the tilapia (keep the rest of the vinaigrette)
Place the lid and cook on high pressure for 2 minutes. Allow natural pressure release before open
Remove the fish and trivet, serve the quinoa in a bowl, place the fish over the quinoa, spread the vinaigrette on top, and sparkle the sesame seeds.

name: Tilapia and Confetti Salad - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: In a plastic bag, place the orange juice for marinating the fish, half of the olive oil, and rosemary.
Shake the bag, and let it marinate while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. Prepare all the ingredients.
Press saute function on the IP, add the remaining oil, carrot, red pepper, cabbage, and chopped green onion, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the quinoa and water. Season it with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the trivet on top of the quinoa and carefully lay down the tilapia.
Place the lid and cook on high pressure for 2 minutes. Allow natural pressure release before opening.
Remove the fish and trivet, serve the quinoa in a bowl, place the fish on top of the quinoa add more orange juice.

name: Tilapia and Confetti Salad - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: In a plastic bag marinate the fish with orange juice, half of the olive oil, and rosemary, and prepare all the ingredients.
Shake the bag, and let it marinate while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. Prepare all the ingredients.
Press saute function on the IP, add the remaining oil, carrot, red pepper, cabbage, and chopped green onion, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the quinoa and water and season it with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the trivet on top of the quinoa and carefully lay down the tilapia (keep the rest of the vinaigrette)
Place the lid and cook on high pressure for 2 minutes. Allow natural pressure release before open
Remove the fish and trivet, serve the quinoa in a bowl, and place the fish over the quinoa.

name: Turkey Chili - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Dice finely the green bell pepper, peel and thinly slice the carrots, dice the onion and green onion, mince the garlic and jalapeno and drain the beans.
Press saute function, let it heat up, and add the oil, onion, green pepper, carrots, garlic, jalapeno, and half of the green onion. Cook and occasionally stir for 3 min.
Add the turkey and stir to break up the meat into small pieces. Cook until the beef is no longer pink.
Add the tomatoes, black beans, water, chili powder, cumin, salt and soy sauce. Stir to combine
Secure the lid, cancel saute function, and press the button Pressure Cook set high for 5 minutes. After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid.
Open and taste to adjust soy sauce or another seasoning as needed.
Serve it and place the other half of the green onion on top.
*Option: prepare with ground chicken or ground beef 90/10 *

name: Turkey Chili - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Finely diced the green bell pepper, diced the onion, peel and thinly slice the carrot, diced the green onion, mince the garlic and jalapeno and drain the beans
Press saute function, let it heat up, and add the oil, onion, green pepper, carrots, garlic, jalapeno, and half of the green onion. Cook and occasionally stir for 3 min.
Add the onion, green pepper, carrots, garlic, jalapeno and half of green onion.Cook stirring occassionally for 3 min
Add the tomatoes, black beans, water, chili powder, cumin, salt and soy sauce. Stir to combine
Secure the lid, cancel saute function and press Pressure Cook set  high pressure for 5 minutes, when the cook time is complete, quick release the pressure for 5 min more
Open and taste to adjust soy sauce, or other seasoning as needed
Serve it and spread the cheese on top, the cream and half of green onion
*Option: prepare with ground chicken or ground beef 90/10 *

name: Turkey Chili - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Finely diced the green bell pepper, diced the onion, peel and thinly slice the carrot, diced the green onion, mince the garlic and jalapeno and drain the beans
Press saute function, let it heat up, and add the oil, onion, green pepper, carrots, garlic, jalapeno, and half of the green onion. Cook and occasionally stir for 3 min.
Add the onion, green pepper, carrots, garlic, jalapeno and half of green onion.Cook stirring occassionally for 3 min
Add the tomatoes, black beans, water, chili powder, cumin, salt and soy sauce. Stir to combine
Secure the lid, cancel saute function and press Pressure Cook set  high pressure for 5 minutes, when the cook time is complete, quick release the pressure for 5 min more
Open and taste to adjust soy sauce, or other seasoning as needed
Serve it, spread the cheese on top and the other half of green onion

name: Caponata with Ground Turkey - Instant Pot (Low Fat)
steps: Chop the eggplant into medium cubes, the red pepper into small cubes, mince garlic, and dice the olives.
Set saute option on the Instant Pot, place the oil, garlic and onions, stir and saute the onions until they soften
Next, add the red peppers and all the remaining ingredients, basil leaves, and add salt and pepper to taste. Cancel saute process, and set pressure cook with high pressure for 5 minutes.
After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid and taste to adjust salt and pepper.
Serve and garnish with basil

name: Caponata with Ground Turkey - Instant Pot (Low Carb)
steps: Chop the eggplant into medium cubes, the red pepper into small cubes, mince garlic, and dice the olives.
Set saute option on the Instant Pot, place the oil, garlic and onions, saute the onions until they soften
Next, add the red peppers and all the remaining ingredients, basil leaves, and add salt and pepper to taste. Cancel saute process, and set pressure cook with high pressure for 5 minutes.
After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid and taste to adjust salt and pepper.
Serve and garnish with basil or coriander

steps: Chop the eggplant into medium cubes, the red pepper into small cubes, mince garlic, and dice the olives.

Next, add the red peppers and all the remaining ingredients, basil leaves, and add salt and pepper to taste. Cancel saute process, and set pressure cook with high pressure for 5 minutes.

name: Pizza Casserole - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Slice the mushrooms, dice the green pepper, and slice the red onion.
Set to saute function and let it heat up, stir in the ground turkey and cook while breaking it into smaller pieces.
Carefully add chicken broth, mushrooms, and quinoa to Instant Pot, making sure to add quinoa last.
Pop the lid and close it. Set pressure cook on high for 2 minutes. After cooking, release the pressure before opening.

Remove the lid, and add the tomato sauce, onion, green pepper, oregano, Italian seasoning, and black pepper to taste. Mix and close, and let it sit for 5 minutes to soft veggies. Open, add olives, and chilli
Serve in a bowl, then top with cheese, and microwave for 15 seconds to melt the cheese.

name: Pizza Casserole - Instant Pot (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Slice the mushrooms, dice the green pepper, and slice the red onion.

ingredients.name: Natural shredded fat free mozzarella cheese by kraft

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, chop carrots into small cubes and prepare the other ingredients
Select the saute function on the Instant Pot,  wait until it heats up, then stir in the oil, onions, and garlic. Saute until the onions are soft.

Next, add the tomatoes, carrots, chicken broth, water, chicken breast, and cumin. Add a few coriander leaves and chili powder and set the pressure cook on high for 5 minutes. After cooking, release the pressure before opening the lid.

Remove the chicken and shred using two forks, then return the chicken to the Instant Pot and add the corn, lemon juice, and chili powder. 
Crush just half of the tortilla chips and add it to the soup and stir well. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with cheese, half of the tortilla chips, and coriander leaves

name: Egg Plant Tofu Stew - Instant Pot (Balanced)
steps: Chop all the ingredients in lengthwise slices, and chop the tofu the same way.
Place all the vegetables and tofu into a bowl, add the oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste, and toss to combine.
Next transfer into the Instant Pot, press pressure cook, and manually set the time for 2 minutes on high pressure, after cooking release the pressure and allow the steam to empty before opening
Serve into a plate and add the cream on top

name: Mushroom Chicken Cream - Instant Pot (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice
Rice white medium grain dry uncooked

steps: Prepare all the ingredients, dice the chicken breast into 1-inch pieces, slice the mushrooms, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley and red onion.

Add the olive oil, chicken, mushrooms, garlic, red onion, thyme dried, salt and pepper, chicken broth, and rice to the Instant Pot in that order. Cook on high pressure for 3 minutes. After cooking, allow pressure release before opening.
Next, stir in the sour cream and parsley, sit for a couple of minutes to thicken, and adjust salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in a bowl and sprinkle with chili flakes and parsley.

name: Instant Pot Beef and Broccoli (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Beef round eye of roast separable lean only trimmed to 1/8" fat select cooked roasted

steps: Add to the instant pot; beef broth, garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Then add beef and stir to combine.

Lock the lid in place. Cook at high pressure for 10 minutes. Make sure the valve is set to the sealing position.
When the cooking time ends, do a quick pressure release. (Set the valve to the venting position and when the valve drops, carefully remove the lid
Add the cornstarch and water mixture and stir until smooth.
Select "saute", add the broccoli and stir a bit. Close the Instant Pot and let the broccoli cook for 3 minutes (fresh) or 5 minutes (frozen) on saute (no need for pressure cooking).
Open the lid, serve and enjoy.

name: Instant Pot Beef and Broccoli (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Beef round eye of roast separable lean only trimmed to 1/8" fat select cooked roasted

steps: Add to the instant pot; beef broth, garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Then add beef and stir to combine.

Lock the lid in place. Cook at high pressure for 10 minutes. Make sure the valve is set to the sealing position.
When the cooking time ends, do a quick pressure release. (Set the valve to the venting position and when the valve drops, carefully remove the lid
Add the cornstarch and water mixture and stir until smooth.
Select "saute", add the broccoli and stir a bit. Close the Instant Pot and let the broccoli cook for 3 minutes (fresh) or 5 minutes (frozen) on saute (no need for pressure cooking).
Open the lid, serve and enjoy with steamed rice.

name: Shrimp & Rice Bowl (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps:
Heat butter, olive oil and crushed garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add cajun seasoning and shrimp. Cook, stirring until the shrimp begin to curl, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Add diced tomatoes and roughly chopped scallions to the skillet and cook, stirring, for about 1 minute. 
Add the cooked rice and cauliflower rice, next add  1/4 to 1/2 cup of water. Continue to cook until the rice is hot throughout and the shrimp are cooked about 3 more minutes.
Stir in the parsley and serve

name: Red Pepper Egg Bites with Salsa
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Line a muffin tin with muffin liners.
Dice bell peppers and cook in a pan coated with non-stick spray over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Mix together egg whites, eggs, peppers, and season  mixture with salt and pepper.
Divide mixture evenly among muffin tin, bake for 15-20 minutes, or until eggs are set. Serve with salsa on the side.

name: Ginger Chicken and Veggie Bowls (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Snow peas or sugar snap peas raw

steps: Heat half the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped carrots, bell pepper, zucchini, and snow peas to the pan. Cook for 4 minutes, or until slightly tender, then remove.
Add the remaining olive oil to the pan. Add chopped chicken to the pan and season with salt. Cook until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together sauce ingredients, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch, sugar, garlic, and ginger. Add to the pan and cook, coating the chicken, until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Serve vegetables and chicken over warm rice.

name: Teriyaki Beef and Sweet Potato (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Preheat the oven to 350F.
Mix together grated ginger, garlic, applesauce, and coconut aminos. Add cubed steak and toss to coat.
Coat sweet potato chunks in half the olive oil, and bake for 25 minutes or until soft.
Heat remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add sliced mushroom and cook until brown. Then add steak and marinade and fry for 3-5 minutes.
Stir in half the sliced green onion and sweet potato chunks, tossing to combine.
Top with remaining sliced green onion.

name: Pesto Chicken Stir Fry (Balanced)
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Prep vegetables by slicing onion, halving zucchini and slicing lengthwise, chopping peppers, and green beans.
Add cubed chicken breast to the pan with hot oil. Season with salt and pepper, cook until cooked through, about 4-5 minutes.
Add beans, peppers, corn, and onions, saute for 3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add in zucchini, saute for 2 minutes, and season with salt and pepper. Stir in pesto and serve hot topped with parmesan cheese.

name: Mexican Meatball Soup (Balanced)
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced jalapeno, celery, carrot, and onion. Cook for 3 minutes. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and stir.
Add stock, 2 cups water, tomatoes, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp oregano, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, make meatballs. Combine in a large bowl, 2 cloves minced garlic, beef, remaining oregano and cumin, season with salt and pepper.
Form into small meatballs and add to boiling soup along with diced potatoes and chopped kale.
Simmer for 15- 20 minutes, or until meatballs are cooked, and potatoes tender. Season with salt and serve.

name: Cauliflower Pork Fried Rice (Balanced)
steps: Heat avocado oil in a pan over medium heat. Scramble eggs in the pan, then remove to a plate.
Add sliced garlic, ginger, green onion, and pork.  Cook for ~5 minutes, or until pork has browned, and is broken apart.
Add cauliflower, coconut aminos, sesame oil, diced carrot, peas, and corn. Combine and cook until heated through.
Add back in scrambled eggs and mix to combine. Season with salt and serve with more green onion.

name: Mediterranean Sheet Pan Chicken (Balanced)
steps: Preheat the oven to 425F.
In a small bowl, combine oil, thyme, crushed garlic, oregano, and mustard, with a pinch of salt and pepper.

In a large bowl, mix together vegetables: 1 zucchini halved and sliced, 1 bell pepper chopped, red onion, and 1 cup cherry tomatoes. Add half of the oil mixture, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine.
Place vegetables on a baking tray lined with aluminum foil, and top with chicken breasts. Drizzle remaining oil mixture over chicken.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove. Sprinkle with crumbled feta and sliced olives. Place back in oven for 10 more minutes, or until chicken is cooked.
Top with chopped parsley and serve.

name: Peanut Chicken Meal Prep Bowls (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice

steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add in thinly sliced chicken, and season with salt and pepper. Cook until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.
Blend together dressing ingredients in a blender. Peanut butter, vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, ginger, brown sugar, and chili flakes.
Assemble bowls by adding in cooked rice, thinly sliced cabbage, carrots, and bell pepper. Top with cooked chicken and dressing.

name: Sheet Pan Jerk Chicken with Sweet Potato Wedges (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Vegetables peppers red bell by Freshdirect
Caribbean jerk marinade by great value

steps: Preheat oven to 425 F
Slice onions, peppers, and potato into wedges and toss with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss chicken strips in jerk marinade, and a pinch of salt.
Arrange all ingredients on a sheet pan with space in between each ingredient - bake for 40 minutes, or until potatoes are crisp, and chicken is cooked

name: One-Pan Moroccan Chicken Couscous (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Couscous or cous cous dry uncooked

steps: Toss chicken thighs in cinnamon, coriander, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Brown in a medium-high heat pan with 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes per side, or until golden brown
Push the chicken to the side of the pan. Add in diced onions, diced peppers, crushed garlic, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add in chopped spinach, cooking until wilted.
Add hot chicken stock, couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix together tahini, lemon juice, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of cumin. Add a little cold water if it's too thick for you.
Top couscous and chicken mixture with tahini sauce.

name: Grilled Steak with Chimichurri, Brown Rice, and Zucchini (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Beef round eye of separable lean only trimmed to 0" fat all grades cooked roasted cube steak
Rice brown instant cooked without salt

steps: Slice zucchini lengthwise, and brush with a small amount of oil.

Grill steak on a preheated grill to your desired doneness, about 4-5 minutes per side. You can also grill the zucchini at the same time, until lightly blackened and tender. Season both with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, very finely chop garlic and parsley, mix in a bowl with oregano, olive oil, and vinegar, season with salt and pepper.
Serve steak thinly sliced, with chimichurri, zucchini, hot rice, and a lemon wedge.

name: Beef and Broccoli (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Beef round top steak boneless lean and trimmed to 0" fat all grades raw

steps: In a large bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of cornstarch with 3 tablespoons of water. Add the beef to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch with the soy sauce, brown sugar, crushed garlic, and grated ginger.

Add 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil and once it is hot, add the thinly sliced beef and cook, stirring constantly until the beef is almost cooked through. Transfer the beef to a plate and set it aside.
Add the remaining vegetable oil to the pan and once it is hot, add the broccoli florets and sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli is tender, about 4 minutes.
Return the beef to the pan then add the prepared sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Serve with rice and top with sesame seeds.
Heat a large nonstick pan over medium heat.

name: Baked Chicken Taquitos (High Protein)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat
Rotisserie chicken breast meat only skinless

steps: Start by preheating the oven to 350F.
In a bowl, shred chicken with a fork. Mix chicken together with cream cheese, 1/2 cup of grated cheese, spices, and chilies (optional). Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Wrap tortillas in a damp cloth and microwave for 10-20 seconds, to warm them up and make them more tender.
Fill each tortilla lengthwise with the chicken filling and wrap tightly. Lightly brush the tortillas with a coating of oil, and place in the oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden and crispy.
Serve with Salsa and place the remaining cheese on top

name: Apple Rosemary Braised Chicken (High Protein)
steps:
Sear Chicken in a deep pot over medium heat with melted butter. 
Let sit for 5 minutes, or until golden brown, then flip and sear on other side. Remove and set aside.
Add small chunks of onion into pot and saute for 3 minutes, or until soft and lightly brown.
Add small apple chunks, liquid ingredients, rosemary, salt and pepper. Stir to combine. 
Reintroduce chicken to the pot, and cook, covered, for 12 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.

name: Chicken and Veggie Oven Kebabs (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Green bell peppers by pero farms

steps: Preheat oven to 325F

Begin by cutting the chicken into 1-inch chunks. 
In a bowl, mix together chicken with olive oil, vinegar, honey, crushed garlic, and oregano. Season with salt and pepper. 

(Optional: marinate for 20 minutes)
Assemble kebabs by skewering pieces of bell pepper, onion, zucchini, and chicken in alternating fashion.
Bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway, or until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165F.
Serve with pita and tzatziki

name: Cottage  BlackBerry  Overnight Oats (Low Carb)
steps: Place the cottage cheese, oats, milk, and honey in a bowl and stir.
Transfer half of the mixture into a jar or container, add the blackberries and the almonds, place the remaining mixture on top, and close the jar.
Place in the refrigerator overnight or for 4-6 hours.

name: Cottage  BlackBerry  Overnight Oats (Low Fat)
steps:
Use your favorite brand of plant-based milk sugar-free. 
Change honey for a zero-calorie sweetener for fewer calories.
Place the cottage cheese, oats, milk, and honey in a bowl and stir.
Transfer half of the mixture into a jar or container, add the blackberries and the almonds, place the remaining mixture on top, and close the jar.
Place in the refrigerator overnight or for 4-6 hours.

name: Pepper Steak Stir Fry (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Beef flank steak lean and fat trimmed to 0" raw

steps: Start by heating half the oil in a pan over medium heat. Slice peppers lengthwise and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender. Set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pan. Thinly slice steak and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 30 minutes.
Add peppers back into the pan with the steak. In a bowl, mix together cornstarch, sugar, soy sauce, and 3 tbsp of water.
Pour sauce mixture over steak and vegetables, cooking until thickened, about 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Shrimp Taco Salad (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil by il casolare
Corn sweet yellow frozen kernels unprepared

steps: Start by heating a pan over medium heat with olive oil. Toss shrimp with spices, then cook in the oil for 2 minutes per side, until shrimp is cooked.
Chop lettuce, finely slice cabbage, slice tomatoes, and jalapeno.
Arrange salad by topping lettuce with shredded cabbage, tomatoes, shrimp, jalapeno, crushed chips, corn kernels, pico de gallo and dressing.

name: Greek Chicken Salad Bowls (Low Carb)
steps: Cube chicken, toss with spices, and cook in a pan over medium heat, coated with olive oil. Season salt and pepper, cooking until no longer pink.
Slice cucumbers, dice peppers, dice onions, and slice cherry tomatoes, toss with feta and olives to make the salad.
Add chicken to the salad, and eat right away, or cool and eat later, topping with tzatziki and pita when ready to eat.

name: Mediterranean Shrimp and Couscous (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Pearl harvest couscous by wild roots
Headless shell-on wild white shrimp by whole foods

steps: In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, olives, and feta. Season with pepper.

Heat a large deep skillet over medium-high heat. When hot, add the oil, then the shrimp, season with salt, and cook until opaque, 2 minutes per side, stirring in the garlic just before finished. Transfer to the bowl of the tomato mixture.

Add the broth to the skillet, increase the heat to high, and bring to a boil. Add the couscous, stir, cover and reduce the heat to medium. Cook until all the liquid is absorbed, 10-12 minutes. Fluff with a fork and add to the bowl of the shrimp and tomato mixture. Add the lemon juice and toss well.
Divide among 4 bowls, garnish with parsley and the lemon's zest, and serve.

name: Baked Chicken Taquitos (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Rotisserie chicken breast meat only skinless
Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Start by preheating the oven to 350F.
In a bowl, shred chicken with a fork. Mix chicken together with cream cheese, grated cheese, spices, and chilies (optional). Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Wrap tortillas in a damp cloth and microwave for 10-20 seconds, to warm them up and make them more tender.
Fill each tortilla lengthwise with the chicken filling and wrap tightly. Lightly brush the tortillas with a coating of oil, and place in the oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden and crispy.
Serve with Salsa

name: Shrimp & Rice Bowl (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps:
Heat butter, olive oil and crushed garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add Cajun seasoning and shrimp. Cook, stirring, until the shrimp begin to curl, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Add diced tomatoes and roughly chopped scallions to the skillet and cook, stirring, about 1 minute. 
Add the cooked rice and 1/4 cup water. Continue to cook until the rice is hot throughout and the shrimp are cooked, about 3 more minutes.
Stir in the parsley and serve

name: Shrimp & Rice Bowl (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps:
Heat butter, olive oil and crushed garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add cajun seasoning and shrimp. Cook, stirring, until the shrimp begin to curl, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper.
Add diced tomatoes and roughly chopped scallions to the skillet and cook, stirring, about 1 minute. 
Add the cooked rice, cauliflower, and 1/4 cup water. Continue to cook until the rice is hot throughout and the shrimp are cooked, about 3 more minutes.
Stir in the parsley and serve

name: Beef and Broccoli (Low Fat)

ingredients.name: Beef round top steak boneless lean and trimmed to 0" fat all grades raw

steps: In a large bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of cornstarch with 3 tablespoons of water. Add the beef to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch with the soy sauce, brown sugar, crushed garlic and grated ginger.

Add 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil and once it is hot, add the thinly sliced beef and cook, stirring constantly until the beef is almost cooked through. Transfer the beef to a plate and set it aside.
Add the remaining vegetable oil to the pan and once it is hot, add the broccoli florets and sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli is tender, about 4 minutes.
Return the beef to the pan then add the prepared sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Serve with rice and top with sesame seeds.
Heat a large nonstick pan over medium heat.

name: One-Pan Moroccan Chicken Couscous (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh stewed meat only skinless
Couscous or cous cous dry uncooked

steps: Toss chicken thighs in cinnamon, coriander, cumin, salt and pepper.
Brown in a medium-high heat pan with 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes per side, or until golden brown
Push chicken to the side of the pan. Add in diced onions, diced peppers, crushed garlic, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add in chopped spinach, cooking until wilted.
Add hot chicken stock, couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix together tahini, lemon juice, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of cumin. Add a little cold water if it's too thick for you.
Top couscous and chicken mixture with tahini sauce.

name: Apple Rosemary Braised Chicken (Low Fat)
steps:
Sear Chicken in a deep pot over medium heat with melted butter. 
Let sit for 5 minutes, or until golden brown, then flip and sear on other side. Remove and set aside.
Add small chunks of onion into pot and saute for 3 minutes, or until soft and lightly brown.
Add small apple chunks, liquid ingredients, rosemary, salt and pepper. Stir to combine. 
Reintroduce chicken to the pot, and cook, covered, for 12 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.

name: Honey Chili Chicken Meal Prep (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Sesame seed kernels (shelled) toasted without salt

steps: Preheat oven to 425 F. Chop chicken breast and toss with flour to coat. Place bite sized pieces of chicken on a foil lined baking sheet and into hot oven for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, remove tray, and add chopped broccoli to one side of the pan. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper. Return to oven for 10 more minutes.
Meanwhile, mix together ketchup, honey, and sriracha sauce in a bowl. Microwave for 2 minutes, and stir again.
Remove tray from oven, and combine chicken with sauce, mixing to coat. Place chicken in bowls with broccoli and cooked rice.
Top with sliced green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Sheet Pan Miso Ginger Tofu (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Extra firm organic tofu by trader joe's

steps:
Heat oven to 425F. Add Sesame Oil, soy Sauce, Miso Paste, Rice Vinegar, Maple Syrup, Ginger, and Garlic to a large mixing bowl and whisk to incorporate.
Dice tofu into cubes and add both it and the sweet potato into the sauce. Mix carefully to coat. Spread the tofu and sweet potatoes over the baking sheet, reserving any extra sauce in the bowl, and bake for 15 minutes.
While baking, add the green beans to the bowl and coat with any residual sauce.
After 15 minutes, stir the tofu and sweet potato before adding the green beans to the baking sheet.  Cook an additional 15 minutes, or to your desired texture.

name: Quick Turkey Sloppy Joes (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Hamburger or hot dog buns white

steps: In a pan over medium heat, heat oil. Cook turkey, crumbling, until browned and cooked throughout.
Add chopped onions, mushrooms, and saute for 3 minutes. Add in tomato paste, 2 tbsp of water,  spices, garlic, vinegar, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes, or until the mixture is thickened. Season with salt and pepper, then serve on a toasted bun.

name: Plant Based Hash with Brussels Sprouts (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Rice brown instant cooked without salt
Beyong meat burger patties by the beyond burger

steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Placed halved sprouts, cut side down in the pan and leave for 3 or 4 minutes, until golden brown.
Flip sprouts, adding chopped onions, mushrooms, and crumbled patty to the pan. Cook for another 3 minutes.
Add a splash of water to the pan, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add rice to the pan. Stir to combine, cooking until all ingredients are heated through and sprouts are tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Elote - Mexican Street Corn

ingredients.name: Cilantro or coriander leaves fresh or raw herb

steps: Start by removing the husk of the corn, and placing  on a preheated barbecue, or grill pan thats been brushed with 1 tsp of oil.
Grill corn for about 3 minutes on each side, or until charred and tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix juice of 1 lime with remaining olive oil, smoked paprika, chili powder, and crushed garlic.
Remove the corn and brush all over with lime oil, top with crumbled cheese, and chopped cilantro.

name: Chicken Salad with Apple and Cranberry (Low Carb)
steps: In a bowl, combine the diced chicken, cranberries, finely diced celery,  diced red onion, diced apple, and walnuts, if using.
In a cup or small bowl, combine mayonnaise, the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

Stir the mayonnaise mixture into the chicken. Line the bread with lettuce leaves and spread the chicken salad on the lettuce. Or serve the chicken salad as open-faced sandwiches for a lower carb option

name: Sheet Pan Veggie Omelette (Low Carb)

ingredients.name: Cheddar or colby cheese low fat

steps: Preheat oven to 425° F. and place a rimmed sheet pan in the oven while it's preheating.

Use non-stick spray to coat a medium sized skillet over medium-high heat. Add in the spinach, halved cherry tomatoes, and season with salt and pepper. Sauté 2-3 minutes or until the spinach is wilted. Remove from the heat.
In a medium sized bowl whisk together the eggs, milk and some salt and pepper until combined.

Remove the hot sheet pan from the oven and spray with cooking spray. Pour the egg mixture into the sheet pan, then evenly disperse the spinach-tomato mixture on top. Top with grated cheese and bake for 10-12 minutes or until the frittata is set.
Portion into 6 pieces once cooled, and serve.

ingredients.name: Onions green spring or scallions raw

steps: In a skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add shredded carrots, sliced red and green cabbage, and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the scallions, crushed garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the turkey and sauté until fully cooked and no longer pink, 5-6 minutes.
Season the mixture with the soy sauce, rice vinegar and sriracha. Serve over rice. Optionally: top with sesame seeds, cilantro, or chopped red chiles.

name: Sheet Pan Fajita Shrimp (Balanced)
steps: Preheat oven to 400F.
In a small bowl, combine lime juice, oil, spices and crushed garlic and stir to combine.  Add shrimp, sliced onion and sliced peppers, stir until everything is well coated.
Pour onto a foil-lined baking sheet. Bake for 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare microwave rice per package directions. Serve shrimp and vegetables over rice with thinly sliced cabbage, lime juice,  and guacamole.

name: One Pot Garlic Shrimp and Quinoa (Balanced)
steps: In a large nonstick skillet with a tight-fitting lid, heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil over medium high.
Add the shrimp, then sprinkle with salt and chili powder. Sauté just until the shrimp are pink and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove the shrimp to a plate.

Heat the remaining olive oil in the same skillet, then add the diced onion. Let cook until the onion begins to soften, about 3 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add in zucchini, sliced into half-moons, and stir to combine.
Add the quinoa and stir to coat the quinoa with the oil and let brown for 1 minute. Pour in the stock and bring to a boil. Cover and lower heat to low, cooking for 12 - 15 minutes, until cooked.
Zest the lemon directly into the pan, then juice the lemon and add the lemon juice and chopped parsley to the skillet as well. Toss to combine, then top with the reserved shrimp.

name: Black Bean Spaghetti with Quick Tomato Sauce (Balanced)

ingredients.name: Olives black canned small to extra large
Chili flakes or crushed red pepper spice
Black bean spaghetti pasta dry uncooked

steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium high heat. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Saute chopped olives, sliced garlic, and chili flakes in oil for 3 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, and increase heat to high, cooking until tomatoes breakdown and begin to bubble, about 6 minutes. Then add oregano, season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Serve pasta in a bowl topped with tomato sauce.

name: Veggies and Hummus
steps: Slice cucumber, carrots, and celery into long strips, and serve with hummus on the side
